Job Description

The Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) requires a Senior Exadata Applications DBA to support the migration and development support of various applications for North Carolina Families Accessing Services through Technology (NC FAST).


The Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is seeking an experienced Oracle Exadata DBA to lead the migration of large Oracle 19c databases (100+ TB) from standard AWS environments to Oracle Exadata in AWS. This role is responsible for optimizing, administering, and supporting Exadata platforms across development, test, and production environments, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability for a large portfolio of applications.


The DBA will work closely with engineering and application teams to modernize database architecture, streamline data models, and implement best practices for operating mission‑critical systems on Exadata within AWS.

Key responsibilities:

• Lead end‑to‑end migration of large 19c databases to Oracle Exadata in AWS, including planning, execution, cutover, and validation.

• Design and implement Exadata‑optimized database configurations, storage features, and performance strategies.

• Manage Oracle Exadata environments (dev/test/prod), including schema design, data modeling, and SQL optimization.

• Perform advanced performance tuning using AWR/ASH analysis, indexing, partitioning, and resource management.

• Administer high‑availability and DR configurations using Oracle Data Guard.

• Implement and manage replication solutions such as Oracle GoldenGate.

• Troubleshoot performance, configuration, and availability issues across Exadata and Linux platforms.

• Execute backups, restores, patching, and upgrades for Exadata environments.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Database Administrator (SQL Server & PostgreSQL) - Onsite in Atlanta GA

We're looking for a Senior Database Administrator to oversee database operations with our client in telecommunications. The Senior DBA is a key member of the IT Systems team and is responsible for architecting, deploying, and supporting critical database infrastructure across the enterprise. The ideal person is a strong, senior level DBA with expertise in both MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL. This reports to the Senior Technology Leader and requires someone to step into a leadership capacity to guide junior team members, drive architectural improvements, and own critical database initiatives from start to finish.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and support highly available database solutions across MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.
  • On SQL Server: design and maintain replication topologies, index/statistics maintenance, and Query store-driven performance tuning.
  • On PostgreSQL: design and maintain streaming and logical replication, connection pooling, partitioning, autovacuum/bloat management, and query plan tuning.
  • Administer all databases across the full development-to-production lifecycle.
  • Develop stored procedures and functions in T-SQL and PL/pgSQL.
  • Optimize databases and applications for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Define and enforce database standards and best practices across the organization.
  • Maintain data backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures across both platforms.
  • Coordinate and support application testing during database maintenance and upgrades.
  • Collaborate with developers and testers during release cycles.
  • Identify and resolve performance issues including long-running queries, missing indexes, and schema inefficiencies.
  • Forecast storage requirements and perform ongoing capacity planning.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot database issues across Linux and Windows platforms.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 5-10+ years as a Database Administrator in an enterprise environment.
  • Substantial hands-on senior-level experience in both SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • SQL Server expertise: replication, index and statistics maintenance, Query Store, performance tuning, etc.
  • Strong PostgreSQL expertise: streaming and logical replication, partitioning, autovacuum/bloat management, backup/recovery, and query plan analysis.
  • Strong proficiency in T-SQL and PL/pgSQL.
  • Proven ability to lead projects independently and provide technical guidance to junior team members; proactive in nature with the ability to drive projects from start to finish.
  • Good Linux and shell scripting experience.
  • Experience with MySQL and other database platforms such as Informix.
  • Familiarity with BI reporting tools and data warehousing.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

Position Summary

The program seeks a Senior Database Administrator to manage the ongoing administration of its on-premises database environment, which continues to operate in a monitored hybrid enclave while the program migrates workloads to Azure Government.

The environment includes two primary database administration areas: SQL Server databases managed through SQL Server Management Studio and MariaDB databases supporting the on-premises ServiceNow instance, hosted on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9.8 servers and administered through SSH using the Linux command line.

The primary focus of this position is on-premises database administration. Candidates supporting the Azure Government cloud migration must also meet the additional qualifications outlined below.

SECTION 1: ON-PREMISES DATABASE ADMINISTRATION

Responsibilities

  • Administer production SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio, including backup and recovery, periodic restore verification, performance tuning, index and statistics maintenance, security and permissions management, capacity and health monitoring, and patch coordination through program change control.
  • Administer MariaDB databases supporting the on-premises ServiceNow instance on RHEL 9.8 servers through SSH, including service health monitoring, logical and physical backups, user and grant management, configuration reviews, and log analysis using Linux command-line tools.
  • Maintain database inventories and documentation, including configurations, backup and retention schedules, and tested recovery procedures.
  • Follow established program change management procedures and document administrative actions in accordance with applicable policies.
  • Support incident response activities related to database issues and participate in an on-call rotation, if applicable.
  • Maintain legacy database environments throughout the hybrid-enclave period, including decommissioning, final backups, and archival activities as systems are retired or migrated.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience administering production SQL Server databases, including backup and restoration, security, performance tuning, and routine maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience administering MariaDB or MySQL databases through the Linux command line, including SSH-based administration of RHEL servers.
  • Experience working with PowerShell and Windows Server environments supporting SQL Server databases.
  • Experience developing administrative automation scripts using PowerShell, T-SQL, and Bash.
  • DoD 8140/8570 IAT Level II baseline certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, or ability to obtain certification within the contract-required timeframe.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance or ability to meet contract-specific clearance requirements.
  • Strong understanding of change management procedures and the ability to maintain clear, accurate technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and its underlying database environment.
  • Experience supporting database operations within DoD or U.S. Army environments.
  • Experience using database monitoring and management tools.
  • Advanced RHEL administration experience, including systemd service management, dnf patch coordination, and SELinux.

SECTION 2: ADDITIONAL SCOPE - CLOUD MIGRATION SUPPORT

The following qualifications apply if the position includes supporting the program's Azure Government cloud migration.

Additional Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Azure Government environments and Azure data services, particularly Azure SQL Managed Instance, which is the program's target environment for SQL Server workloads.
  • Experience or exposure to database migration assessments and execution using Data Migration Assistant, Azure Database Migration Service, and backup/restore-based migration approaches.
  • Understanding of database schema and compatibility remediation during migration activities.
  • Ability to operate within a DevSecOps environment, including automated approval processes, release management, and required documentation.
  • Understanding of database lifecycle and disposition planning, including identifying workloads for migration, retirement, or replacement by enterprise services.
  • Ability to maintain accurate database inventories and support data retention and handling requirements throughout migration activities.

Preferred Cloud Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300).
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).
  • Experience working with centrally provisioned U.S. Army cloud environments.

POSITION DETAILS

Location: Orlando, Florida

Work Arrangement: Onsite/Hybrid - To Be Confirmed

Reports To: Program Leadership - To Be Determined

Security Clearance: DoD Secret

Travel Requirements: Minimal - To Be Confirmed

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on protected characteristics.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Texas Workforce Commission connects people with careers across the state. While we are based in Austin on the north lawn of the Texas State Capitol, we have offices statewide. We're a Family Friendly Certified Workplace with great work-life balance, competitive salaries, extensive opportunities for training and development, and fantastic benefits. This position is based at 1411 Brazos Street, Austin in the Information Technology Division.

TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas.

Who You Are

You are a forward-thinking Oracle DBA who thrives on the challenge of managing complex database environments. You take pride in being the guardian of data integrity, developing robust procedures that keep systems secure and reliable and work as a collaborative partner with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic data solutions. With your technical expertise and "owner" mindset, you have a proven ability to solve intricate problems and implement industry-leading database standards.

What You Will Do

The Database Administrator V performs highly advanced database administration work. Work involves providing direction and guidance in database administration operations and planning; overseeing the effective and efficient storage, retrieval, customization, and archiving of data by managing diverse data sets to ensure integrated database systems; planning, developing, and implementing database policies and procedures; and ensuring and verifying data integrity. May oversee the work of others. Works under minimal supervision, with considerable latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

You Will Be Trusted To

  • Provide professional and technical assistance in the planning and development of TWC on-line transaction processing (OLTP) and decision support databases.
  • Consult with programmer/analysts to ensure the conceptual and design phases of new applications are consistent with the structural parameters within the database environment.
  • Responsible for the development and ongoing enhancements of decision support database systems, monitoring and fine-tuning database performance in both the OLTP and decision support environment, developing and supporting business interface processes and developing database conversion stored procedures.
  • Implements and maintains policies and standards related to the design of databases, data access requirements, security and recovery procedures for the database.
  • Evaluate database engines, query and performance monitoring tools.
  • Maintain disaster recovery procedures and participate in disaster recovery tests and actual recoveries as needed.
  • Will be expected to give expert advice on database/information availability, design policies and standards and database query tools.
  • Contribute to teamwork and communicate effectively.
  • Promote an image of IT excellence.
  • Maintains a consistent and reliable work schedule, with the flexibility to work outside of standard business hours, including on-call rotations, to support production issues or address urgent operational needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to maintain IT operations.

You Qualify With

  • Five years of full-time experience in computer programming and/or systems analysis.
  • Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for this position.

You Are a Great Fit With

  • Knowledge of the principles, practices, and techniques of computer programming and systems design, of computer operations, systems, and procedures.
  • Knowledge of data structure design and proficiency with current database technologies in Oracle version 19c and 26ai.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting stored procedures, CRON scripts, and UNIX shell scripts to support business operations and application requirements and to enhance database performance and efficiency.
  • Provide support in troubleshooting and resolving database-related issues.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning, backup, recovery, and security best practices.
  • Strong experience with programming Powershell and SQLPlus scripts.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for configuring and supporting large, complex relational databases, including database backup/restoration, maintain database security, and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard agency data.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Skilled in the development of computer programs and stored procedures utilizing high level programming languages, data modeling, and industry standard data extract/transform/load (ETL) tools.
  • Skilled in applying data modeling methodologies, data conversion techniques and implementing repeatable processes for creating and modifying data base structures.
  • Experience working with databases in the cloud environments like AWS or the Oracle cloud.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with a team of database administrators, analysts and developers to complete work assignments.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively, both orally and in writing to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, coworkers, and vendors.
  • Ability to work independently while understanding the need for communicating and coordinating work efforts with others.
  • Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues.

You Gain

  • A Family Friendly Certified Workplace
  • Competitive salary: $8,500 - $11,500/month
  • Defined Retirement Benefit Plan
  • Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
  • Medical Insurance
  • Paid time off, including time for vacation, sick and family care leave
  • Additional benefits for active employees can be found at https://www.ers.texas.gov/Active-Employees/Health-Benefits

Duty involves up to 10% travel within the state of Texas.

Veterans

Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser: https://hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/MilitaryCrosswalk/MOSC_InformationTechnology.pdf

How To Apply

To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online at www.workintexas.com or on Taleo (Job Search). TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. A position utilizing this classification will be designated as security sensitive according to the Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.

Are you a database professional who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and driving operational excellence? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your expertise can influence technical strategy and support business-critical platforms?

Are you passionate about improving database performance, mentoring others, and researching emerging technologies? Join us and help deliver reliable, scalable database solutions that make a meaningful impact.

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below,

https://risk.lexisnexis.com

About Our Team

The team is a geographically distributed DBA/technology team with roughly 20 members across home-based, office-based, and contractor roles. The team includes both employees and contractors and provides database/infrastructure coverage across multiple locations, with a mix of operational support and technical expertise.

About The Role

This position is a senior role within the database administration team. This position requires total proficiency in all aspects of database administration and design. This position is expected to mentor and oversee junior members of staff and will work closely with the development teams to provide high-quality business solutions and play an active role in projects from inception to delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve performance issues and root cause resolution.
  • Ensure clear and early communication, in particular ensuring that the line manager and/or relevant parties are kept informed of progress, issues, and difficulties.
  • Train junior-level DBA staff as necessary, ensuring they are up to speed on critical processes and technologies.
  • Lead research into new or alternative technologies.
  • Review and sign off recommendations for upgrades or changes to the back-office infrastructure environment.
  • Engage with Technical Architects and other senior members of Development teams to provide technical designs and guidance to the Database Operations team, taking responsibility for the implications and impact of their design decisions.
  • Responsible for maintenance and “bug fix” activities for existing database infrastructure and equipment.
  • Undertake research into new or alternative technologies and make recommendations for upgrades or changes to the database infrastructure environment.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of DBA experience
  • BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required
  • Experience as a MySQL DBA along with PostgreSQL or SQL Server is beneficial.
  • Proficient in Terraform and Github, Cloud experience such as AWS or Azure (preferably Azure).
  • Strong understanding of database infrastructure, maintenance, administration, and design.
  • Ability to complete root cause analysis on database-related issues.
  • Strong problem-solving skills in multiple operating environments.
  • Ability to complete impact analysis on database-related issues.
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues that involve database infrastructure.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $95,300 - $158,800. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates. This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

Job Description

Are you an experienced Sr. Database Administrator, ready for a unique opportunity to grow with an environmental state agency?

Join TCEQ! We bring passion and drive to carry out our mission of protecting our state's public health and natural resources.

NOTE: To determine qualifications, TCEQ job postings require fully completed applications with a detailed job history. Incomplete applications may lead to disqualification. See below for more details.

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

As part of TCEQ Administrative Services, you would help support the logistical and operational structure for TCEQ statewide -- the business foundation for the whole agency. See details about what we do.

This position is a member of our Information Resources Division.

Here's What You'll Be Doing

  • Perform highly advanced database administration activities in support of the Agency's databases and environments. Serve as a technical expert and work with TCEQ staff and external customers in providing high level technical support and consultation services for database-related activities. Lead the design and creation of database standards, guidelines, policies, and procedures. Implement improvements to existing database design standards reuse of data components, data model review and procedures, change procedures for existing databases, and naming conventions. Document new standards by following the change control board approval process.
  • Lead the monitoring of existing development, test, and production databases. Analyze and implement performance improvements, evaluate the risks and benefits, and recommend appropriate changes to the environment. Develop backup and recovery best practice guidelines for the team to follow and maintain to meet agency database Backup and Recovery SLAs for frequency, retention, and recovery windows. Communicate with customers, management, consultants, and staff to gather and disseminate complex information, and participate in agency-wide activities related to database technology and architectural guidance to maintain standards in all database environments.
  • Lead the creation, modification, and implementation of database objects in development environments. Coordinate with Team for Texas in the creation, modification, and implementation of database objects in test and production environments. Assist in the design, maintenance, and inventory of existing database objects used in agency applications.
  • Lead the implementation of database security controls as needed to support application security requirements. Monitor and implement database security controls for new and existing database environments. Design and document new database security controls implemented to improve security and to meet audit standards. Communicate with managers and technical staff on database security breach findings. Communicate regularly with technical, applications, and operational staff to ensure database integrity and security.
  • Communicate with managers, technical staff, customers, consultants, and colleagues to share and disseminate complex information needed during planning, development, and build phases for project related database technology and architectural guidance to maintain standards in development, test, and production database environments. Assist the team lead and work lead in the creation of system architecture diagrams, and descriptions that represent current and proposed systems, including costs and benefit analysis reports. Lead, mentor, and train junior DBAs as well as teammates, by documenting processes, solutions, procedures to accomplish on call and support job functions by collaborating and sharing organizational knowledge.

Key Qualifications

  • Experience administering databases in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Experience administering Oracle database(s) in Exadata/RAC environments.
  • Experience planning, implementing, and maintaining Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL databases in production, test and/or development environment.

Required Education & Experience

Seven years of full-time experience in data administration, database administration, data modeling, repository administration, or management of data or repository related functions.

OR

A bachelor's degree with 12 semester hours in computer science from an accredited college or university, plus six years of full-time experience in database administration, data administration, data modeling, repository administration, or management of data or repository related functions.

OR

Completion of 30 semester hours (600 clock hours) in computer science from a licensed vocational, technical or business school or accredited college, plus six years of full-time experience in database administration, data administration, data modeling, repository administration, or management of data or repository related functions.

  • Employees in this classification series may research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure, including but not limited to a communication infrastructure system, cybersecurity system, electric grid, hazardous waste treatment system, or water treatment facility. See Tex. Business & Commerce Code Section 117.001(2). Accordingly, the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure is a requirement to be hired for and to continue to be employed with TCEQ.

How To Apply

To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online at www.workintexas.com or in the CAPPS Recruit (TAM).

Applications must be fully completed with a job history, including job title, employment dates (mo./yr.), full-time or part-time and hours per week, employer name, supervisor's name and phone number, and detailed description of duties performed. Incomplete applications may lead to disqualification. Please be aware that resumes will not be accepted in place of a completed application.

We strongly encourage all candidates to apply in the CAPPS Online Application system.

TRANSCRIPT / COLLEGE HOURS or COURSE WORK

See instructions on how to attach documents. A copy of your official college transcript or evaluation of foreign credentials in CAPPS is required if needed to meet the qualifications listed above.

WORK SCHEDULE

Standard business hours are M-F, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

Individual and work group schedule determined by the TCEQ Information Resources Division.

Benefits

  • Optional 401(k) and 457 plans
  • Insurance: Health, Vision, Dental, and optional FSA
  • Paid day(s) off from work on national holidays and holidays that the state observes
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Longevity pay based on your number of years working for the state
  • Wellness Program and Activities
  • Onsite Nurse Practitioner in HQ
  • Work-Life Balance

CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT

TCEQ will conduct a criminal history records search, driving history (if required for the job) on candidates offered employment.

In compliance with ADA, if you need accommodation during the employment process, please contact HRSS for assistance at (512) 239-0102.

MILITARY OCCUPATIONAL SPECIALTY (MOS) CODES

Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) codes can be found at: https://hr.sao.texas.gov/CompensationSystem/JobDescriptions/. Please click the hyperlink under `Occupational Category' for the respective Class Title.

Texas Commission on Environmental Quality is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionHtml:
Your journey as a Principal Database Administrator starts here! This role is essential to maintaining the stability, security, and availability of GovCloud database environments that support Epicor customers. The Principal Database Administrator design, implement, and support databases to meet business requirements, develop database strategies, and ensure robust system monitoring. You will play a key role in advising management, mentoring team members, and driving best practices for database management. We are seeking applicants with strong leadership, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Advise management on database concepts and functional capabilities, translating data models or user specifications into designs that comply with standards, guidelines, procedures, and processes.
  • Install, configure, and maintain database management system product software on database and application servers.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex databases, including access methods, access time, device allocation, validation checks, organization, protection, and security.
  • Apply telemetry and observability practices to interpret database metrics, and other operational signals using Datadog or comparable monitoring tools; identify patterns, anomalies, and potential root causes to improve database reliability and performance.
  • Deliver formal and informal training, mentorship, and support to other Database Admins.
  • Recommend and implement best practices, keeping up with external trends to incorporate into products and processes.
  • Lead and manage database projects, ensuring deadlines are met and schedules are maintained.

What You Will Likely Bring

  • 8+ years’ applicable experience and demonstrated success/knowledge, including 3+ years of specialized or industry experience.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to propose and implement new ideas, lead a team to meet deadlines, and manage schedules effectively.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to mentor others.
  • Analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Recognized as a thought leader and change agent.
  • Expertise in running Microsoft Access queries and updates, with broad database management experience.

Sponsorship

This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without Epicor sponsorship.

Export Control

This position requires access to customer information subject to U.S. export-control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by applicable law or otherwise eligible to obtain any required U.S. government authorization to access such information. Any offer of employment is contingent upon Epicor’s determination that the candidate can lawfully be provided the access required for the position. For these purposes, a U.S. person generally includes a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
  • Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
  • Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
  • Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
  • Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
  • Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer. 

Recruiter

Mouy Bun

Job Description

Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for a Sr. Database Engineer in our INTEL SECTOR's Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA). Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos, we offer competitive benefits, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. Join us and make a difference in National Security!

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze system requirements to develop system architecture, design documentation, and technical specifications supporting large‑scale enterprise environments.
  • Create system configuration documentation including capacity planning, performance modeling, risk assessments, and analysis of alternatives for complex system challenges.
  • Provide database engineering leadership for large distributed systems, ensuring robust design, integration, and scalability across interconnected components.
  • Collaborate across Agile teams including integration engineers, testers, IA engineers, and technical managers to support end‑to‑end system delivery.
  • Design and administer databases ensuring normalized schemas, compliance with security standards, and alignment with industry best practices.
  • Implement and maintain database environments including installations, upgrades, patching, object creation (tables, indexes, views, stored procedures), and performance tuning.
  • Ensure system reliability by monitoring performance, resolving bottlenecks, validating backups, and documenting disaster recovery strategies.
  • Support long‑term planning by forecasting future database needs, advising development teams, preparing progress reports, and contributing to program increment planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors of Science Degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or a related field with at least 12+ years of related experience or a Master’s Degree with at least 10+ years of relevant experience. Will consider work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Active DoD Secret Clearance to be considered and be eligible to obtain up to a TS/SCI clearance in the future.
  • Minimum of ten (12) years of experience in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
  • Minimum of eight (10) years of professional experience as a database administrator.
  • Minimum of six (8) years of experience in developing database architectures.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and administering highly available relational database environments, including the development of functions, stored procedures, and triggers, using Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable enterprise database technologies
  • Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, database clustering, replication, load balancing, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery in production environments
  • Experience supporting database workloads in Kubernetes and AWS, Azure, or hybrid-cloud environments
  • Experience in supporting development efforts in all phases of the development life cycle.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic team environment, manage time effectively, meet schedules, and participate in Agile Scrum activities
  • DoD 8570 approved security certification (i.e., Security +) (Will be required 90 days after hire).

Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledgeable in Agile Methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Lean), particular to the incorporation of security / IA into the lifecycle.
  • Experience integrating security into a Continuous Integration Environment.
  • Knowledgeable on various web services / service-oriented architectures
  • Experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL high-availability, replication, and recovery technologies
  • Experience with cloud-based database services and containerized database platforms
  • Previous experience in Administration and Operations roles.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. descriptionHtml:
Overview

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data. You`ll also advise customers on database design, migration, and integration approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Washington DC area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, enterprise database environments
  • Configure and maintain database platforms
  • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing
  • Advise customers on enterprise database best practices

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Demonstrated experience with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (such as AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database)
  • Understanding of geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

40

What You’ll Be Doing

Responsible for performing enterprise database administration and management activities in a safe, recoverable manner that ensures the optimal operation for SQL Server environments within the organization.

  • Identify and initiate resolutions to user problems/concerns associated with database server software.
  • Work with Data Services team to establish security standards and how database server environments will be accessed and protected.
  • Serve as point of escalation for performance tuning and potential service level issues for database environments both proactively and when problems occur.
  • Collaborate with Data Services team to define and design for logical & physical database architecture and roadmap, which may require interviewing users and understanding their data usage requirements and needs.
  • Collaborate with IT Compute, Network teams to perform capacity management and planning in collaboration with development personnel, system administrators and system architects.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with I.S. & service providers, including knowledge of best practices, documentation preparation, policies and technical details.

Additional Job Functions

  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with regulatory compliance and assigned training requirements including but not limited to BSA regulations corresponding to their specific job duties. Failure to do so may result in disciplinary and other employment related actions.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field or equivalent years of experience required
  • 5-7 years of prior relevant experience required

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong SQL and stored procedure development skills
  • Exposure to SSIS, SSRS and PowerBi
  • Exposure to Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence
  • ORACLE Database administration
  • IBM DB2 Database administration
  • PostgreSQL and MySQL exposure
  • Knowledge of current storage concepts
  • Knowledge and understanding of SQL Server, Oracle & DB2 configuration standards.
  • Understanding of Data Replication
  • Demonstrate leadership quality in collaboration and problem resolution
  • Strong team player
  • Ability to take leadership of issues and drive them to closure
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Customer service orientated
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve problems as they occur
  • Strong desire to learn and take on additional responsibilities
  • Ability to support multiple concurrent projects
  • Exposure .NET application development
  • Windows server, RedHat and AIX UNIX administration exposure
  • Azure Cloud exposure

Job Title: Oracle Database Administrator

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Top Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: None

Type of Travel: None

* * *

The Opportunity

Join a mission‑critical DoD modernization effort supporting a major financial and acquisitions system relied on for more than 20 years. You will play a key role administering and optimizing Oracle databases as the program transitions from legacy infrastructure to a modern RHEL‑based, container‑enabled technical stack.

You can leverage your Oracle expertise to ensure high availability, security, and performance for production environments supporting a national‑level customer. You will collaborate with system administrators, developers, security teams, and DevSecOps engineers to design robust database solutions that drive program success.

You will contribute directly to modernizing infrastructure by applying your Oracle 19c, DataGuard, Linux, and Windows expertise to a highly visible, high‑impact program.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Oracle Database environments (primarily 19c) across Linux and Windows platforms.
  • Implement, manage, and monitor Oracle DataGuard for high availability, replication, and disaster recovery (required).
  • Perform database tuning, query optimization, capacity planning, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Support deployments, upgrades, schema changes, and release activities in coordination with developers and functional/technical teams.
  • Ensure database security compliance, including baseline hardening, patching, auditing, and STIG‑aligned configuration.
  • Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN and program‑approved backup tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex database issues across dev, test, and production environments.
  • Maintain database documentation, operational runbooks, and architecture diagrams.
  • Collaborate with application, DevSecOps, system administration, and cybersecurity teams to integrate database services with CI/CD pipelines and secure architectures.
  • Participate in on‑call or after‑hours maintenance windows as required to support mission‑critical availability.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Top Secret clearance.
  • 5+ years of hands‑on Oracle DBA experience supporting enterprise production environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise with Oracle DataGuard implementation and administration (mandatory).
  • Strong experience with Oracle 19c installation, configuration, tuning, and lifecycle management.
  • Proficiency in Linux (RHEL preferred) and familiarity with Windows‑based Oracle environments.
  • Experience with RMAN backup/recovery, performance tuning, and database security best practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex database and infrastructure issues across multiple teams.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, replication, and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Solid communication and documentation skills, with ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams.

Desired

  • Experience supporting DoD, federal financial systems, or other high‑security environments.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized or cloud‑adjacent architectures.
  • Experience working with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) or other monitoring tools.
  • Knowledge of STIGs, DISA compliance, and secure database configuration.
  • Certifications such as Oracle OCP/OCA, Linux+, RHCSA, or related DBA credentials.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$86,600 - $181,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Purpose

Designs and architect’s database solutions. Triage at level 3 to find out solutions of medium very complex issues. Act as SME for the application supports to provide in depth database needs of databases from design, performance, deployment. Automate any mundane tasks. Bring new skills and technology to help supporting applications uses latest and greatest design and features. Exposure to any of cloud database technologies and free RDBMS/No-SQL experience is an added advantage. Responsible for standards and design of physical data storage, maintenance, access, and security administration.

Responsibilities

  • Designs and architect’s database solutions.
  • Optimizes database access and allocates/re-allocates database resources for optimum configuration, database performance, and cost.
  • Performs data analysis to provide management with timely and accurate information and predict future requirements.
  • Ensures service level agreements are met for internal and external clients.
  • Provide strategic engineering solutions to drive technological improvements
  • Take ownership of projects to ensure successful implementation including Tech-Stack upgrade efforts
  • Foster relationship and act as a technical liaison between the DBA Team and the Lines of Business
  • Monitors database performance, availability, and capacity.
  • Participates in continuous business process redesign to improve internal operations.
  • Performs backup and recovery on Database Management Systems, configures database parameters and prototype designs against logical data models, and defines data repository requirements, data dictionaries and warehousing requirements
  • Optimizes database access and allocates/re-allocates database resources for optimum configuration, database performance and cost
  • Ensures service level agreements are met for internal and external clients
  • Provides status reports that detail issues for escalation to management
  • Performs configuration, scripting, analysis, installation, monitoring, administration and tuning for database management systems
  • Perform troubleshoot Service broker queues, messages flow, and stuck messages flow.
  • Perform BizTalk SQL server support and SME to support messages SLA.
  • Performs data analysis to provide management with timely and accurate information and predict future requirements
  • Develops, implements and tests database backup and recovery policies and procedures.
  • Creates and maintains documentation for database policies, procedures, and processes.
  • Performs/schedules routine maintenance on databases to keep them running at peak performance.
  • Monitors database performance, availability, and capacity
  • Review database storage utilization to ensure proper whitespace allocations
  • Review and develop trend analysis for incident remediation and prevention
  • Participates in continuous business process redesign to improve internal operations
  • Interfaces with user departments remotely and on-site to assist in the implementation of work requests and provide operational support
  • Troubleshoots issues and recommends solutions
  • Research and evaluate new RDBMS for possible implementation
  • Performs other duties as required

Knowledge And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
  • 9+ years of experience working with various database management systems in database design, testing, implementation, maintenance and administration in a multiple platform environment.
  • Required to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation
  • Expert level knowledge of SQL Server database management systems (2012, 2014, 2017, & 2019 and 2022 [SQL 2025 is a plus])
  • Expert level knowledge SQL performance and tuning
  • Expert level knowledge of Microsoft Distributed Availability Group (DAG), Always-On Availability Groups in local and geographically dispersed data centers
  • Extensive knowledge of task automation
  • Strong database design and analysis skills
  • Expert level Knowledge of backup and recovery operations for database management systems
  • Expert level Knowledge of database encryption such as Always Encrypted, Protegrity, TDE, and TLS
  • Expert level Knowledge of OS, storage, and network layers for troubleshooting purposes
  • Expert level Knowledge of relational database concepts and terminology
  • Ability to monitor and tune databases and instances
  • Ability to maintain and monitor availability, security, and integrity of databases
  • Ability to focus on production and customer needs and deliverables
  • Ability to adapt to the use of new software tools as they are acquired or adopted within IT
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be self-motivated, a team player, and have a strong track record in customer satisfaction
  • Demonstrated experience with successful system and project implementations
  • Experience with Service Broker and BizTalk SQL Server integration
  • Familiarity with Mainframe flat file ingestion architecture and cross-platform data workflows
  • Familiarity with DB2 to SQL Server migration

Preferred Knowledge And Experience

  • Knowledge of Scripting and Automation
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure RDBMS
  • Knowledge of OLA Hallengren maintenance plans
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment with minimal supervision
  • Ability to learn and apply new skills in a constantly changing technical environment
  • Knowledge of leveraging AI for SQL server admin and support.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Description

At DANE, we keep great people by treating them well: generous PTO from your first day, comprehensive benefits, and support to keep learning. You’ll join a sharp, mission-driven team where your input matters and your work makes a direct impact.

We are seeking an experienced Senior SQL Database Administrator (DBA) to support enterprise database operations, where reliability, security, performance, and availability are critical to mission success. You will be responsible for managing and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server databases, including installation, configuration, administration, backup and recovery, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. This role requires close collaboration with project teams and stakeholders to support application requirements, implement database solutions, and ensure optimal database performance across enterprise production environments. You will bring extensive experience in SQL Server administration, a strong understanding of database best practices, and the ability to support complex, high-availability environments while ensuring data integrity and security. This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Washington, DC. We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Apply today!

Responsibilities

  • Manage, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases in enterprise production environments.
  • Install, configure, upgrade, and patch SQL Server instances to ensure optimal performance and security.
  • Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies to improve system efficiency.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery plans and procedures.
  • Ensure database security through access controls, permissions management, encryption, and compliance with organizational policies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database-related incidents, outages, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate with application developers, system administrators, and project teams to support application and database requirements.
  • Plan and execute database migrations, upgrades, and environment refresh activities.
  • Design and maintain high-availability and failover solutions to minimize downtime and support business continuity.
  • Create and maintain database administration documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical guides.
  • Support data integrity, data quality, and database lifecycle management activities.
  • Conduct capacity planning and recommend hardware, storage, and database architecture improvements.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior database administrators and support staff.
  • Participate in system audits, security assessments, and compliance reviews as needed.
  • Support on-call and after-hours maintenance activities when required to maintain critical database services.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of database administration experience supporting enterprise environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
  • Strong experience with SQL Server installation, configuration, administration, and maintenance.
  • Experience with database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  • Proficiency in SQL Server performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and tuning, including query optimization and indexing strategies.
  • Experience managing high-availability solutions such as Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, and Log Shipping.
  • Knowledge of database security best practices, including user access management, encryption, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience performing database migrations, upgrades, and patch management activities.
  • Strong understanding of database architecture, capacity planning, storage management, and data integrity principles.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical applications and databases with high availability requirements.
  • Proficiency in SQL, T-SQL scripting, and database automation techniques.
  • Experience working with development, infrastructure, and application support teams in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Certifications / Experience

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent Microsoft SQL Server certification.
  • Experience supporting federal government or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or cloud-based database platforms.
  • Knowledge of PowerShell scripting and database automation tools.
  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS).
  • Experience implementing database monitoring tools such as SolarWinds DPA, Redgate SQL Monitor, Quest Foglight, or SentryOne.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and database deployment methodologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior DBAs and providing technical leadership on database initiatives.


Location

  • Washington, DC
  • Hybrid – 100% on-site for first 2 months, then 2 days on-site / 3 days telework (USCP may increase on-site days)


Clearance

  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Ability to pass a USCP criminal history check and fingerprinting for badge access.


Hours

  • 40 hours per week
  • 8 hours per day


Employment Classification

  • Employment Classification Eligibility – W2


Relocation

  • Not eligible for relocation benefits


Benefits

  • Benefits: Benefits package includes options for health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401k contribution options. Full benefits brochure available for review.


DANE LLC is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Flexible work from home options available.

SQL Server DBA GURU - Kansas City Residents (ONLY)

Location: Kansas City, MO (ONLY)

Type: Full-time


WHO IS VINCUE

You know that moment when a single spark ignites an unstoppable blaze? In business, that’s called an inflection point, and we’ve hit ours. We recently closed a series c capital raise of nearly $100M.


We’re VINCUE, a founder-led automotive tech SaaS company based in Kansas City, and we’re redefining the industry. After years of refining our vision and perfecting product-market fit, we’ve entered a phase of tremendous growth and extraordinary opportunity.


We’re big enough to attract game-changing partnerships, yet still small enough to reject bureaucracy and corporate fluff. Our culture is built on authenticity, momentum, and a shared belief in doing meaningful work — together.


If you're looking for a true rocket ship - one that values empowered teams, thrives on fun, and puts people first — we’d love to connect. Let’s talk and explore if there’s a mutual fit. Because at VINCUE, you won’t just find a job you’ll find a team, a mission, and a place to thrive.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for a SQL Server performance expert who wants to be more than just a database tutor or a ticket-taker fixing slow queries on demand. We seek someone who wants to own the performance of a real commercial product and be an integral part of what makes it exceptional. You'll join a team delivering a serious Inventory Management platform that businesses depend on every day — and your work will directly determine how fast, how smooth, and how reliable that experience feels to every one of our customers. If you get genuine satisfaction from hunting down a bad execution plan, eliminating a blocking chain, or shaving seconds off a query that runs ten thousand times a day, this is the role for you.


ABOUT THE PRODUCT & DEVELOPMENT TEAM

VINCUE’s Product & Development Team is a fast-moving, high-impact group of engineers, product thinkers, and problem-solvers who thrive on building real solutions for real users. We work hard and play hard, balancing intense focus and drive with a culture that celebrates creativity, camaraderie, and wins of every size.


We’re scrappy by design. We do more with less, lean into constraints, and build with purpose. Our team members are trusted with autonomy and ownership from day one because we believe the best people don’t need to be micromanaged; they just need the right direction and support. Our team enjoys solving messy problems, loves building things that matter, and prefers action over endless meetings.


MUST HAVES (CORE DBA)

  • SQL Server replication expert: transactional, merge, snapshot, peer-to-peer; setup, troubleshooting, latency, re-initializing, distributor/subscriber management
  • Experience across SQL Server 2014–2022, including upgrades and mixed-version setups
  • Backup/restore strategy: full/diff/log, point-in-time recovery, testing restores, RPO/RTO
  • Index and statistics maintenance: fragmentation, rebuild/reorg, fill factor, missing/unused indexes
  • SQL Agent jobs: build, schedule, monitor, alert on failure
  • Moving data between servers: SSIS, linked servers, BCP, backup/restore, log shipping
  • Monitoring and performance: wait stats, blocking/deadlocks, DMVs, Query Store, disk/TempDB/log growth
  • HA/DR: Always On, log shipping, failover planning
  • Security: logins, roles, permissions
  • Strong T-SQL


NICE TO HAVES

  • Building pre-aggregated reporting tables for developers
  • Designing and monitoring 3rd-party data feed imports (SSIS, flat files, APIs)
  • PowerShell / dbatools automation
  • Azure SQL / cloud exposure


TRAITS

  • Calm under pressure; owns production incidents
  • Proactive: finds problems before users do
  • Documents everything to share information
  • Explains things clearly to developers and management
  • Careful with change control on production


EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years as a production SQL Server DBA
  • Proven hands-on replication work, not just exposure

descriptionHtml:
About impact.com:

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

As a Database Administrator at impact.com, you will work with the latest technologies that enable near-real time processing of datasets in the Terabytes range and the exciting challenges that come with working with massive amounts of data. You will have the freedom to experiment with the latest technologies with the ultimate goal of scaling our systems linearly.

If you have great ideas and like to think outside the box, we will encourage it and support you, giving you the tools to be successful as we scale Impact. At impact.com, your career path is yours to shape, as we encourage cross training into other technologies.

What You'll Do:

  • Administer and support multiple MySQL database clusters
  • Administer and support sharded MySQL database clusters
  • Manage database capacity and usage. Pro-active capacity planning.
  • Query optimization
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Develop backup and recovery procedures
  • Essential Database administration - install, configure, upgrade, backup, partitioning and monitoring of MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB and Clickhouse database clusters
  • ProxySQL administration
  • Work with developers during application development life cycle in the design and planning of schema, tables, data types, indexes, procedures and functions
  • Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and database risks

Senior Database Administrator

📍 Boca Raton, Florida (Onsite)

💼 Full-Time

💰 $110,000 - $140,000 Base Salary

Build, Optimize, and Protect Critical Data Infrastructure

We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator to take ownership of a hybrid Microsoft database environment spanning both on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure. This role is ideal for a hands-on SQL Server professional who thrives in high-availability environments and enjoys solving complex performance, scalability, and disaster recovery challenges.

As the organization's primary Database Administrator, you will be responsible for the health, performance, security, recoverability, and growth of business-critical SQL Server platforms. You will work closely with Infrastructure, Security, and Operations teams to ensure databases remain highly available, optimized, protected, and prepared for any recovery scenario.

This position offers the opportunity to have a direct impact on enterprise database architecture while driving continuous improvement across availability, disaster recovery readiness, automation, capacity planning, and cloud-based database services.

What You'll Be Doing

Database Administration & Cloud Operations

  • Administer and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments across on-premises and Azure platforms.
  • Perform database installations, upgrades, patching, configuration management, and platform optimization.
  • Manage Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance environments.
  • Support ongoing database modernization and cloud initiatives.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly available database architectures.
  • Support technologies including:
  • Always On Availability Groups
  • Failover Clustering
  • Replication
  • Log Shipping
  • Develop and execute disaster recovery testing and validation procedures.
  • Ensure database recovery strategies align with business continuity objectives.

Backup, Recovery & Data Protection

  • Own database backup and recovery processes across production environments.
  • Validate recoverability through restoration testing and recovery verification.
  • Ensure critical databases meet recovery and retention requirements.
  • Partner with infrastructure teams to align database protection strategies with enterprise backup solutions.

Performance Optimization

  • Identify and resolve database bottlenecks impacting application performance.
  • Perform:
  • Query optimization
  • Index tuning
  • Execution plan analysis
  • Wait-statistics analysis
  • Capacity planning
  • Resource governance
  • Recommend and implement proactive performance improvements as data volumes and business demands grow.

Security & Compliance

  • Maintain database security controls and access governance.
  • Implement encryption and data protection best practices.
  • Support auditing, compliance initiatives, and remediation activities.
  • Partner with security teams to ensure proper role-based access controls and least-privilege access models.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop automation using PowerShell and T-SQL.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation and recovery runbooks.
  • Serve as the escalation point for database-related incidents, outages, and recovery events.
  • Drive ongoing improvements to monitoring, reporting, performance, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of SQL Server administration experience in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises database infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with:
  • Microsoft SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Hands-on experience building and supporting high-availability solutions.
  • Deep understanding of:
  • Backup and recovery strategies
  • Disaster recovery planning
  • Business continuity practices
  • Recovery Time Objectives (RTO)
  • Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)
  • Advanced database performance tuning and optimization skills.
  • Strong PowerShell and T-SQL scripting experience.
  • Understanding of Windows Server administration and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure Database Administration certifications.
  • Azure Infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience with VMware-based SQL Server environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise backup and recovery platforms.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-driven environments.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

✅ Enterprise-level SQL Server ownership

✅ Hybrid cloud and Azure-focused environment

✅ Significant influence on architecture and database strategy

✅ High visibility across infrastructure and technology teams

✅ Opportunity to lead disaster recovery and business continuity initiatives

✅ Competitive salary of $110K - $140K

Questions for the Hiring Manager Before Launching the Search

Based on the additional information received, I would seek further clarity on the following:

Must-Have vs. Trainable Skills

Of the following technologies, which are absolute requirements and which could be learned on the job?

  • SQL Server Administration
  • Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Always On Availability Groups
  • Disaster Recovery Planning & Testing
  • Performance Tuning & Optimization
  • PowerShell Automation
  • Veeam Backup Integration
  • VMware Infrastructure

Top Business Challenges

What are the primary initiatives or pain points driving this hire?

  • Database performance optimization?
  • Azure migration efforts?
  • High availability improvements?
  • Disaster recovery readiness?
  • Capacity planning and scalability?
  • Consolidation of SQL environments?
  • Automation and operational efficiency?
  • Compliance and audit requirements?

Target Candidate Profile

Would you prefer:

  • A true SQL Server specialist with deep DBA expertise, or
  • An Infrastructure Engineer / Systems Administrator with strong SQL administration experience?

Environment & Scope

  • How many SQL Server instances are currently managed?
  • What percentage of the environment resides in Azure versus on-prem?
  • Are there upcoming cloud migration or modernization projects?
  • What database monitoring tools are currently utilized?

These answers will help significantly refine sourcing strategy and prevent recruiters from over-indexing on Azure, VMware, or backup technologies if the true priority is SQL performance, HA/DR ownership, and operational excellence.
