Job Description


BAE Systems, a top-ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of Defense, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence & Security provides services and products to the Department of Defense, the government, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world.

At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie and a shared ambition to lead the world in defense technologies and national security services. We offer flexible work environment to support the balance in your life and keep you performing at your best. Be a part of a company that is part of the community; driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.

We are looking for experienced Database Administrators to join our technology-based program supporting a key government customer. This program will deliver engineering services for network infrastructure as well as sophisticated enterprise computing infrastructure including end-point devices, data center hosted servers, multi-Cloud services as well as virtualized applications, and storage systems. Enterprise Computing Engineering services include modern application technology including containerized solutions with orchestrated workflow that function both on customer premise, and via remote Cloud services. Network infrastructure engineering services are comprised of core infrastructure, voice and video engineering, field engineering, application management and development for networks, network analytics, firewalls, network access controls and bandwidth service delivery. This is a fast paced, challenging, and career rewarding experience to recruit and develop provide top talent and solutions on one of the most complex and high profile programs within the government.

ABC



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


A Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees are preferred with a minimum of six (6) year’s relevant experience. Two (2) additional years experience for a total of eight (8) years is acceptable in lieu of a degree. Bachelor's or Master’s Degree are preferred in one or more of the disciplines described below where specific skills may include the following:

  • Monitoring and managing database environments with regard to data import, data availability, data accuracy, and general database performance.
  • Installing, upgrading, and configuring databases.
  • Supporting performance tuning of database queries and code
  • Troubleshooting database issues and data related problems
  • Maintaining and tuning backup and recovery processes.
  • Supporting implementation and configuration if database security architecture, software, and controls.
  • Supporting requirements analysis, technical design, and implementation of databases based on functional specifications
  • Providing Database Administrator (DBA) support for application developers.
  • Commercial database technology (e.g., Oracle, SQL)
  • Open Source-Available Database technologies (e.g. MongoDB, MariaDB, MySQL)
  • Database tools such as SQL Developer, TOAD, DBArtisan
  • Solaris, Linux, Windows environments



Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Demonstrated experience with Oracle Database administration
  • Demonstrated experience with implementing and maintaining Oracle Golden Gate and Oracle Global Data Services to enable High-Availability Microsoft SQL Services
  • Demonstrated experience utilizing and configuring Oracle Enterprise Management
  • Demonstrated experience or familiarity with MariaDB and CassandraDB
  • Demonstrated experience working on an application built upon a client t/server-based architecture
  • Demonstrated experience installing and configuring database environment systems
  • Demonstrated experience performing back-up and restoration activities
  • Demonstrated experience installing security updates and patches
  • Demonstrated experience with maintaining REMEDY infrastructure
  • Demonstrated experience or familiarity with Red Hat, CentOS and Rocky.


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $130355 - $221603

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Intelligence & Security (I&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

descriptionHtml:
The Principal Database Administrator will support multiple product teams across Dealer Solutions and play a key role in working on (managed and optimized enterprise database systems) cloud migration initiatives.This role will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and re-architecting the current on-premises database environment. As a key technical enabler of the organization's cloud strategy, the Senior Database Administrator will first stabilize and remediate the existing database infrastructure, then design and execute a safe, phased migration to AWS.

This position bridges the gap between the current aging, monolithic on-premises database environment running on on-prem infrastructure and a future-state scalable, cost-efficient, cloud-native database platform.

The ideal candidate is a technical leader who serves as the organization's primary database authority. They are responsible for defining database strategy, driving cloud modernization efforts, advising architects and software engineers on data architecture decisions, ensuring high availability and security of enterprise platforms, and leading complex migration, resiliency, and performance initiatives. They possess deep expertise across both traditional relational databases and modern cloud-native data platforms while influencing technical direction across multiple engineering teams.

Min Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline with 10+ years of experience in database administration, database engineering, or related technical roles. The right candidate may also have a Master's degree with 8+ years of experience, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience, or 14+ years of directly related experience.
  • Experience in database design, database code development, database administration, and systems engineering to build high-performance, fault-tolerant database systems and infrastructure for database-centric applications.
  • 8+ years of experienced with multiple AWS RDS database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL services such as DynamoDB, understanding trade-offs between AWS-managed variants.
  • Experience supporting 24x7 production systems with strict SLAs and uptime requirements.
  • Expertise in high-availability and disaster-recovery technologies (clustering, replication, failover, backup/restore strategies) to reduce risk and downtime across critical systems. Strong background in high-availability/disaster-recovery technologies (e.g., clustering, log shipping, GoldenGate, Always On, replica sets).
  • Perform logical and physical database design, data modeling, performance management/monitoring architecting and building databases from business requirements through planning, testing, and production deployment.
  • Provide expert-level leadership for Microsoft SQL Server environments, serving as the highest-level technical authority across database architecture, platform strategy, modernization, upgrades, migrations, cloud transformation, high availability, disaster recovery, replication, clustering, and backup/recovery ensuring resilient, scalable platforms with minimal business disruption and downtime.
  • 8 years of performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and execution plan analysis.
  • Drive innovation through implementation across functional teams, both internal and external, to meet business requirements.
  • Ability to design and support solutions spanning relational databases and microservice architectures, selecting the right technology for the right workload.
  • Strong collaboration with software engineers and architects on application and data architecture decisions, ensuring systems are built for scalability, resilience, and performance.
  • Use of observability tools and operational intelligence platforms to proactively monitor database health and drive data-informed operational decisions.
  • 8+ years Building and maturing CI/CD practices for database changes (schema migrations, deployment automation, version control, automated testing).
  • Mentor database administrators, influence architects and developers, review complex technical designs, lead strategic initiatives, and define the long-term evolution of the database platform.
  • Strong communication skills translating technical trade-offs for engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments (Scrum, Kanban, or similar), collaborating within sprint-based delivery cycles.

USD 178,200.00 - 297,000.00

Compensation

Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $178,200.00 - $297,000.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship.

General summary:

Working under close supervision, this role assists with the design, development, and implementation of database solutions and provides day-to-day administrative support to ensure efficient departmental operations. Responsibilities include configuring database parameters, defining data repository and warehousing requirements, and ensuring data standardization and consistency.

Acting as a liaison between database users, technical representatives, application administrators, and other stakeholders, this role ensures effective communication and data management. Additionally, the position supports the implementation of security measures to protect databases in compliance with organizational standards and regulations. The role also involves monitoring database performance, generating reports, and performing data backup and recovery processes using Database Management Systems.

  • THIS POSITION IS HYBRID and requires some on site work in Greensboro, NC.
  • Support the administration, maintenance, and optimization of databases to ensure data security, integrity, and availability.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24x7 support of database systems.
  • Design, develop, and implement database solutions as required.
  • Provide day-to-day administrative support for efficient system-wide database operations.
  • Design and support data repositories working closely with Infrastructure team.
  • Work closely with Data Archivist to ensure regulatory compliance for medical data retention.
  • Design, test, and implement strategies to improve database performance, capacity, and scalability.
  • Act as a liaison between database users, technical teams, application administrators, and other stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and data management.
  • Participate in planning and implementing new systems and upgrades of existing systems in close cooperation with Project Management.
  • Support implementation of security measures to protect databases in compliance with best-practice standards and regulations.
  • Monitor database performance, generate reports, and perform data backup and recovery processes using Database Management Systems

COMPETENCIES:

  • Expertise in SQL Server high-availability technologies
  • Expertise in rapid response to database emergencies, including catastrophic failures.
  • Expertise in Disaster Recovery
  • Expertise in database designs to properly segregate data from binary logs.
  • Expertise configuring tempdb to maximize performance
  • Working familiarity with modern RDMS systems such as Oracle, Mariadb, SAP ASE and PostgreSQL
  • Ability to keep current with evolving database technologies, tools, and best practices to improve skills and departmental operations.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Systems/Sciences, or a related field, with an emphasis on database design, development, and data management
  • Excellent communication skills, healthcare knowledge preferred. Strong English language competency.
  • Minimum 3 or more years’ experience as a senior SQL Server DBA
  • Strong background in database administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience with database migration, upgrades, and consolidation
  • Significant Experience with backups, restores and recovery models as designer and process owner.
  • Experience working with Windows Server OS.
  • Significant experience with database design and troubleshooting

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection is required for all remote/hybrid positions.
  • Must have access to stable Wi-Fi with sufficient bandwidth to support video conferencing, cloud-based tools, and other online work-related activities.
  • A HIPAA-compliant work environment is required, including a secure workspace free from unauthorized access or interruptions, no use of public Wi-Fi unless connected through a secure company-provided VPN, and compliance with all applicable HIPAA privacy and security regulations.

Benefits

The base compensation range for this position is:

$94,683.20 - $142,024.79

Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.

Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. Compensation may increase over time based on performance, experience, and tenure.

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage
  • HSA with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care accounts
  • Wellness platform with premium incentives
  • Employee assistance support and additional voluntary supplemental plans including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and child disability insurance
  • Robust and flexible paid time off offerings and company paid holidays
  • 401(k) plan with discretionary employer match opportunities
  • Professional development opportunities

Position Overview

The Senior SQL Database Administrator (DBA) is a strategic technical leader responsible for the design, optimization, security, and scalability of enterprise database platforms. This role partners closely with engineering, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure high-performing, resilient, and secure database environments that support mission-critical applications.

This individual serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for SQL Server environments, drives best practices, leads complex initiatives (cloud, automation, modernization), and mentors junior DBAs.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead database architecture & strategy
  • Design, implement, and optimize SQL Server database solutions across on-premises and cloud environments (Azure).
  • Drive database modernization initiatives, including cloud migration and hybrid architectures.
  • Own performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization for large-scale, high-transaction systems.
  • Proactively identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Architect and maintain HA/DR solutions (Always On Availability Groups, replication, backups, failover strategies).
  • Ensure business continuity and compliance with uptime SLAs in a 24x7 environment.
  • Lead database security strategy including access controls, encryption, auditing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner with security teams to ensure adherence to data governance standards.
  • Drive adoption of Azure database services, including performance optimization, cost management, and scaling strategies.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar tools to streamline operations and reduce manual effort.
  • Oversee monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis using enterprise tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Azure Monitor).
  • Improve operational processes, documentation, and runbooks for consistency and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, and application teams to optimize database interactions and support product delivery.
  • Serve as escalation point for complex database issues.
  • Mentor junior DBAs and contribute to team development and knowledge sharing.
  • Influence technical direction and establish database best practices across the organization.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience administering and optimizing SQL Server environments in enterprise-scale environments
  • Deep expertise in SQL Server (2014–2022), including performance tuning, HA/DR, and troubleshooting
  • Strong experience with Azure SQL / cloud database platforms, including migration, scaling, and cost optimization
  • Experience with hybrid environments and data replication technologies (e.g., Oracle GoldenGate)
  • Familiarity with Oracle environments (nice to have, not primary focus)
  • Advanced scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, etc.)
  • Strong experience with monitoring, alerting, and incident management tools
  • Experience with data warehousing and BI concepts
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Successful completion of the Nlets fingerprinting background assessment.

Prefered Skills

  • Experience leading database strategy or large-scale transformation projects
  • Strong expertise in performance tuning for high-volume transactional systems
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders or product leadership
  • Exposure to DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code)

Personal Skills And Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset with the ability to navigate complex technical environments
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to lead initiatives independently and influence across teams
  • Adaptable in fast-paced, evolving environments
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on reliability and quality

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Verra Mobility is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
The Database Systems team plays a critical role in supporting our database platforms which includes Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, and AWS Postgres. The team manages data security and privacy including data integrity, conducts data backup and recovery, tunes database performance, and improves query processing performance. This team is a collection of well-rounded database administrators supporting and maintaining the database environment to ensure high performance to avoid any business disruptions.

This role is hybrid (Mon through Thu on-site / Fri remote) at the UMB Technology & Operations Center located in downtown Kansas City, MO.

As a Senior Database Administrator, you will manage our SQL Server, Oracle, and Snowflake databases. Your collaboration with teammates and other technical team members will allow you to identify and mitigate any potential issues with the data. In turn, this will ensure the integrity of the bank’s data and it is secure.

How you will spend your time

  • Interacting with users and technical teams to ensure data integrity and data security.
  • Conducting database change management.
  • Proactively monitoring databases and their performance and tuning the databases accordingly to ensure peak performance.
  • Tending to regular database backups and performing any recovery activities when required.
  • Installing, configuring, maintaining and upgrading the applicable database software on the corresponding hardware platforms.

We are excited to talk if you have

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related field and at least 4 years of database administration experience, OR at least 7 years of database administration experience.
  • Solid experience using SQL Server (2016/2019/2022), Oracle (19c, 23ai, 26ai) and/or Snowflake experience are valuable, but this is a SQL Server position first, with heavy emphasis on Snowflake. We prefer individuals that have experience with multiple databases including supporting them.
  • Solid knowledge of UNIX, the databases, and related tools to support, administer or diagnose the RDBMS.

Bonus Points If

  • You have experience with AWS cloud-based databases.

Applicants must have legal authority to work in the United States. Work Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and maintenance of Oracle databases. This role requires expertise in database performance tuning, high availability, security, and disaster recovery. The Senior Oracle DBA will work closely with developers, system administrators, and business stakeholders to ensure database systems are optimized, secure, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration & Maintenance

  • Install, configure, and upgrade Oracle databases (including RAC, ASM, and Data Guard).
  • Monitor and optimize database performance, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Perform backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning using RMAN and other tools.
  • Troubleshoot database-related issues, working closely with application and infrastructure teams.

Performance Tuning & Optimization

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks using tools like AWR, ADDM, and SQL Tuning Advisor.
  • Optimize SQL queries and database indexing strategies for improved performance.
  • Implement partitioning, compression, and other techniques to enhance efficiency.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement database security policies, user access controls, and encryption techniques.
  • Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery

  • Configure and manage Oracle RAC, Data Guard, and GoldenGate for HA and replication.
  • Develop and test disaster recovery plans, ensuring minimal downtime in case of failures.

Automation & Scripting

  • Develop scripts using Shell, PL/SQL, or Python for database automation and monitoring.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions for database provisioning and maintenance.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work with developers to optimize database schemas and queries.
  • Document database architecture, configurations, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior DBAs and support teams.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 4 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 2 years' experience; a Ph.D. and up to 1 year of experience; or 8 years' experience in a related field.
  • Expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle 19c/21c, Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and Exadata.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, PL/SQL, and performance tuning techniques.
  • Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) for monitoring and administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Unix/Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Ansible, Terraform) for database automation.
  • Exposure to NoSQL or other RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL) is an advantage.
  • Certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or Oracle Certified Master (OCM) are a plus.

USD 101,500.00 - 169,100.00 per year

Compensation

Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $101,500.00 - $169,100.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

EOE, including disability/vets

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Location: Candidates must be able to work from one of Wabtec’s office locations

Who will you be working with?

You will join Wabtec’s Digital Technology team in one of our hub locations, reporting to Vice President of DI, Database & Enterprise Tools. This team is responsible for delivering mission-critical database and Oracle EBS solutions.

How will you make a difference?

Wabtec is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Oracle DBA to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll help power the global delivery of manufacturing solutions by ensuring our database environments are secure, high-performing, and highly available. You’ll be a key contributor to technical and business teams to drive innovation and operational excellence.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings creative problem-solving to the table, and leverages deep technical expertise to support mission-critical systems. If you're passionate about database architecture and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, this is the opportunity for you.

What do we want to know about you?

You must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise Oracle environments (12c or higher)
  • Expertise in Oracle 19c administration and related tools
  • Proven experience implementing Oracle 19c GRID/RAC architecture on RedHat Enterprise Linux
  • Proficiency in SSH/KSH/BASH scripting
  • Advanced Data Guard expertise (switchover and debugging)
  • Experience with cloud environment technologies, preferably AWS, OCI
  • Knowledge of Oracle security best practices and patching methodologies
  • Strong understanding of Oracle tuning and operational support best practices
  • Operations mindset - understanding, implementation, and operation of ITSM at scale

What will your typical day look like?

  • Install, upgrade, configure, tune, debug, and patch all components of the Oracle 19c technology stack, including Oracle GRID, ASM, Clusterware, and database instances
  • Install, upgrade, configure, tune, and debug all aspects of Oracle DataGuard
  • Monitor and tune Cloud databases and components
  • Monitor, patch, tune and debug Oracle EBS
  • Monitor database performance, space utilization, identify potential problems and ensure database availability
  • Install, upgrade, configure, and patch Oracle Enterprise Manager 13c
  • Install, upgrade, configure, and patch Oracle pluggable database configurations using 19c
  • Designs, implements, and maintains database and database infrastructure security
  • Provide evaluation, architecture, and integration skills to support COTS and/or developed products within the Oracle database framework
  • Implement architected HA/DR solutions to ensure application availability
  • Identify and develop automation of repetitive processes to minimize errors and maximize service delivery using Linux scripting, SQL, PL/SQL and cron jobs
  • Interface and communicate effectively across various support teams and with senior management
  • Support 24/7/365 applications based in local data centers, the cloud (AWS & OCI)
  • Research technology, support business requirements, propose changes, and develop migration and implementation
  • Manage the general contractor DBA team to ensure they follow standards and meet SLAs
  • Manage ticketing and incidents in ServiceNow to ensure SLAs are met or exceeded
  • Other duties as assigned

What about the physical demands of the job?

  • Frequently communicating with others to exchange information
  • Frequently remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Frequently repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Frequently assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned

Work Environment:

  • The employee will normally work in a temperature-controlled office environment
  • Minimal travel requirements: most work can be accomplished via conference and video calls, team chats, etc.

Not eligible for relocation assistance.

Additional Information

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $104800-149300 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

Job Description

Be part of a dynamic team where your distinctive skills will contribute to a winning culture and team.

As a Data Engineer III at JPMorganChase within Neovest, you are a seasoned member of an agile team responsible for designing and delivering trusted solutions for data collection, storage, access, and analytics in a secure, stable, and scalable manner. You will engineer and administer secure, scalable, and highly available database platforms, while supporting critical data pipelines and reporting systems.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as the platform administrator for PMS SQL Server databases in both production and non-production environments.
  • Design, maintain, and enhance platform architectures for on-premises, Azure VM, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) SQL Server instances.
  • Establish and enforce standards for database availability, performance, security, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Install, configure, patch, and maintain SQL Server instances in on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Manage performance tuning, indexing, replication, encryption, and secure configuration standards.
  • Oversee high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including Always On and clustering.
  • Implement and maintain database monitoring, capacity planning, cost optimization, and scaling strategies.
  • Administer backup and restore processes using SQL Server tools, PowerShell, and automation frameworks.
  • Provision, configure, and support GCP database services.
  • Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate data pipeline/design analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
  • Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices to strengthen SDLC-quality routines for data pipelines (e.g., test generation and control validation), ensuring traceability/auditability and alignment to resiliency and security expectations.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience in Microsoft SQL Server engineering and administration.
  • Strong knowledge of Always On Availability Groups, Windows Server Failover Clustering, backup/restore, and performance tuning.
  • Advanced T-SQL skills, including troubleshooting complex scenarios.
  • Experience managing large fleets of production databases across multiple customer environments.
  • Proficiency with Git-based source control and database change workflows.
  • Ability to lead production incident response and conduct postmortem analysis.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with statistical data analysis and selecting appropriate tools and methods.
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support data engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted outputs (e.g., query suggestions, test ideas, or model change summaries) before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling requirements.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience supporting portfolio management, trading, or financial systems.
  • Background in database DevOps, CI/CD pipeline design, and release governance.
  • Familiarity with Azure and GCP SQL Server VM operations.
  • Experience defining platform programs, charters, KPIs, and operational metrics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Experience with report development using SQL Server Reporting Services, Excel, or Metabase.
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into technical specifications.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

This position is hybrid in Peachtree Corners, Georgia and sits within our IT Infrastructure division, which handles the combined set of software, hardware, networks, and facilities used to develop, test, deliver, monitor, control, or support IT Services.

The Opportunity

The Sr. Database Administrator is the principal technical authority for ConstructConnect’s database platforms, a hybrid on-premises and cloud environment running 24/7 across SQL Server 2012–2025, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Azure SQL, and AWS RDS. The role owns the platform beneath the databases, not just the databases themselves: architecting, building, and operating Windows Server Failover Clusters (WSFCs), SQL Server Failover Clustered Instances (FCIs), Availability Groups (AGs) and Distributed AGs, log shipping, and transactional replication. The Sr. DBA owns disaster recovery planning and RTO/RPO accountability, database security and SOX compliance, performance monitoring, and capacity planning, and sets the standard for how engineering teams use the database: reviewing schemas, developing and refactoring stored procedures, and guiding developers on query optimization and data access patterns. This is a technical lead role without direct reports.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Administer and maintain SQL Server (2012–2025), PostgreSQL, MySQL, Azure SQL, and AWS RDS environments in a 24/7 production setting
  • Architect, build, and operate WSFCs and FCIs, including shared storage, quorum, networking, patching, and failover testing
  • Design, implement, and troubleshoot AGs across on-premises and cloud environments, including listeners, synchronization health, and planned and unplanned failover
  • Configure and maintain log shipping and transactional replication, including monitoring latency, resolving replication errors, and managing publisher, distributor, and subscriber components
  • Design and provision relational database environments, including instance configuration, storage layout, high availability and clustering architecture, backup strategy, and security design
  • Own disaster recovery and backup strategies, including cross-site recovery using Distributed AGs and log shipping, with responsibility for design, testing, and documentation
  • Lead database security and compliance efforts, including SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and access management
  • Monitor and optimize database performance using SolarWinds and Idera; identify and resolve bottlenecks proactively
  • Plan capacity across all database platforms, forecasting storage, compute, and licensing needs
  • Automate routine administration such as patching, health checks, deployments, and provisioning using PowerShell, dbatools, and infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Design and review database schemas, stored procedures, functions, and triggers to meet business requirements
  • Partner with development teams on query optimization, indexing strategies, data access patterns, and source-controlled schema change management
  • Maintain runbooks and documentation for high availability, disaster recovery, and recovery procedures
  • Manage and track database-related tasks and incidents using Jira
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for after-hours production database issues
  • Provide technical mentorship and day-to-day guidance to DBA and engineering team members
  • Evaluate and support cloud database migrations and hybrid infrastructure improvements
  • Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot,) to accelerate day-to-day administration, scripting, and troubleshooting
  • Ensure database platforms are ready for AI-driven application workloads, including vector search and high-concurrency data access, in support of the company’s AI strategy
  • This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones team members may be required to perform.

Required

 Qualifications

  • 6+ years of database administration experience, including 4+ years administering Microsoft SQL Server (2017–2025) in a 24/7 production environment.
  • Hands-on experience building and supporting WSFCs and FCIs
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting AGs
  • Hands-on experience with log shipping and transactional replication
  • Proven ownership of disaster recovery planning, backup/restore operations, and DR testing
  • Experience implementing and maintaining database security controls in a SOX-compliant environment
  • Working knowledge of the infrastructure that database platforms depend on, including Windows Server, storage, networking, and virtualization
  • Experience hosting databases in cloud environments (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Azure,)
  • Working familiarity with PostgreSQL administration
  • Strong command of Transact-SQL, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SQL Agent automation
  • Proficiency with database performance monitoring and tuning
  • Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, dbatools, or equivalent)
  • Strong communication skills; ability to collaborate with developers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Technical lead experience with the ability to operate as both a leader and individual contributor

Preferred

  • Experience administering MySQL, Azure SQL, or AWS RDS
  • Experience with SolarWinds/Idera monitoring platforms
  • Experience with Cohesity or similar enterprise backup platforms
  • Experience using CDC (Change Data Capture) for incremental data loads
  • Experience using source control (GitLab or similar) for database scripts and schema changes
  • Experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day engineering work
  • Familiarity with Jira for task and incident tracking

Physical Demands And Work Environment

  • The physical activities of this position include frequent sitting, telephone communication, and working on a computer for extended periods. Visual acuity is required to perform activities close to the eyes.
  • Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated and ergonomically appropriate remote workspace.
  • Team members who live within commuting distance of one of our office location (Atlanta, Georgia) are expected to work in a hybrid capacity, with regular in-office presence as determined by the team or department.
  • All team members must reside and perform their work within the United States

E-Verify Statement

ConstructConnect utilizes the E-Verify program with every potential new hire. This makes it possible for us to make certain that every employee who works for ConstructConnect is eligible to work in the United States. To learn more about E-Verify you can call 1-800-255-7688 or visit their website. E-Verify® is a registered trademark of the United States Department of Homeland Security.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Database Administrator, you will specialize in managing and optimizing databases to ensure the smooth operation and efficient performance of applications relying on databases. Your focus will be on installing, configuring, and maintaining databases, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies and performing performance tuning.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install and Configure Databases: Install, configure, and maintain databases to ensure high availability and optimal performance. This includes setting up database systems, defining database structures, and configuring database parameters.
  • Implement Disaster Recovery Strategies: Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies to minimize data loss and ensure business continuity in the event of a disaster.
  • Perform Performance Tuning: Analyze database performance and implement tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Maintain Database Systems: Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as backups, upgrades, and patches, to ensure database systems remain secure and up-to-date.
  • Ensure High Availability: Implement measures to ensure high availability, including clustering, replication, and failover systems, to minimize downtime and ensure continuous access to databases.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Database Management Experience: Exposure to managing and optimizing databases using products such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, and Teradata, with a focus on ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
  • System Administration Knowledge: Experience working with system administration concepts, including installing, configuring, and maintaining database systems, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies.
  • Programming Understanding: Exposure to programming concepts and their application in database management, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • Database Concepts Familiarity: Experience working with database concepts, including database structures, database parameters, and data modeling.

Job Purpose

The Senior Database Administrator ensures the stability, security, and performance of the organization's Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments. This role owns database administration, high availability and disaster recovery, and performance tuning for systems that power key business applications, and serves as a primary responder for database incidents as part of an on-call rotation. The Senior DBA also supports ETL and reporting through SSIS and SSRS, partners with business stakeholders to turn requirements into technical solutions, and mentors other team members while helping set database standards and best practices.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Administration & Operations
    • Manage backup, recovery, and high availability/disaster recovery strategies, including Always On Availability Groups, log shipping, and PostgreSQL streaming replication.
    • Handle database security, including access control, permissions, and auditing.
    • Plan and perform patching, upgrades, and capacity planning.
    • Respond to SQL Server and PostgreSQL outages and incidents, including after-hours and weekends, as part of a weekly on-call rotation.
  • Performance & Troubleshooting
    • Lead performance tuning efforts using execution plans, indexing and statistics strategy, wait analysis, and query optimization.
    • Use SQL Server tools such as SSMS, Extended Events, Query Store, DMVs, and PerfMon, as well as PostgreSQL tools such as EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pg_stat_statements, system catalogs, and VACUUM/autovacuum tuning to diagnose and resolve issues.
    • Perform root-cause analysis, working backward from known issues to identify and permanently resolve underlying problems.
  • Database Development & Design
    • Design, write, and optimize database code across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, tables, indexes, partitions, and constraints.
    • Review new and existing database code to ensure it meets company standards for readability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
    • Build new code and processes to support a growing business and evolving application needs.
  • Automation, ETL & Reporting
    • Design, develop, deploy, and monitor SSIS packages and SQL Agent jobs for ETL and operational automation.
    • Create, maintain, and deploy reports in SSRS.
  • Business Partnership & Leadership
    • Facilitate requirements sessions with stakeholders and translate business needs and change requests into technical deliverables.
    • Mentor junior and mid-level DBAs and developers and help define database best practices and standards.
Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in database administration and development in Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments, including installation, configuration, security, backup and recovery, and ongoing support.
  • Deep expertise in performance tuning, including query analysis, execution plans, index strategy, statistics maintenance, and blocking, deadlock, and wait analysis.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve database integrity, performance, replication, connectivity, and security issues in production environments.
  • Experience with High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions for SQL Server (e.g., Always On Availability Groups, log shipping) and PostgreSQL (e.g., streaming replication, failover).
  • Hands-on experience with SSIS package development, deployment, and troubleshooting, and SSRS report design, deployment, and subscription setup.
  • Experience automating operational tasks with scripting (e.g., PowerShell, T-SQL, Python, or Bash).
  • Experience with source control (Git/GitHub) and the full software development lifecycle.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical documentation and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative approach, with experience mentoring or guiding other team members.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, or PostgreSQL certification.Experience with SQL Server 2019 and newer, including migrating or upgrading from older versions.
  • Experience with cloud database platforms, such as AWS RDS, Aurora, or SQL Server on EC2.
  • Experience with database tooling such as Redgate or Idera, and work tracking tools such as Jira.Familiarity with C# or other application languages for supporting development teams.

descriptionHtml:
Your journey as a Principal Database Administrator starts here! This role is essential to maintaining the stability, security, and availability of GovCloud database environments that support Epicor customers. The Principal Database Administrator design, implement, and support databases to meet business requirements, develop database strategies, and ensure robust system monitoring. You will play a key role in advising management, mentoring team members, and driving best practices for database management. We are seeking applicants with strong leadership, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Advise management on database concepts and functional capabilities, translating data models or user specifications into designs that comply with standards, guidelines, procedures, and processes.
  • Install, configure, and maintain database management system product software on database and application servers.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex databases, including access methods, access time, device allocation, validation checks, organization, protection, and security.
  • Apply telemetry and observability practices to interpret database metrics, and other operational signals using Datadog or comparable monitoring tools; identify patterns, anomalies, and potential root causes to improve database reliability and performance.
  • Deliver formal and informal training, mentorship, and support to other Database Admins.
  • Recommend and implement best practices, keeping up with external trends to incorporate into products and processes.
  • Lead and manage database projects, ensuring deadlines are met and schedules are maintained.

What You Will Likely Bring

  • 8+ years’ applicable experience and demonstrated success/knowledge, including 3+ years of specialized or industry experience.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to propose and implement new ideas, lead a team to meet deadlines, and manage schedules effectively.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to mentor others.
  • Analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Recognized as a thought leader and change agent.
  • Expertise in running Microsoft Access queries and updates, with broad database management experience.

Sponsorship

This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without Epicor sponsorship.

Export Control

This position requires access to customer information subject to U.S. export-control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by applicable law or otherwise eligible to obtain any required U.S. government authorization to access such information. Any offer of employment is contingent upon Epicor’s determination that the candidate can lawfully be provided the access required for the position. For these purposes, a U.S. person generally includes a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
  • Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
  • Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
  • Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
  • Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
  • Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Description

We are seeking a MySQL and Postgres Database Admin to lead enterprise database environments to AWS Cloud. The position requires expertise in AWS MySQL, with strong hands-on experience in MySQL cluster (no exception) administration, PostgreSQL database technologies, including installation, configuration, maintenance, replication, backup/recovery, and performance tuning of enterprise database systems across both on-premises and AWS cloud environments.

This role ensures the security, availability, reliability, and scalability of mission-critical PostgreSQL and MySQL databases supporting enterprise applications. The Senior DBA will drive database architecture, capacity planning, high availability design, disaster recovery strategies, automation of operational workflows, and enforcement of robust security practices across AWS environments.

The candidate must be able to work independently and collaborate closely with stakeholders, application teams, and infrastructure engineers to streamline deployments, improve database reliability, and ensure consistent data operations across multiple environments. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills are essential.

Must be able to multitask effectively and perform well under pressure in a fast-paced, high-urgency environment. Ability to prioritize competing tasks, manage multiple incidents concurrently, and maintain attention to detail in a high-tempo operations setting. Comfortable working under tight deadlines, handling frequent context switches, and remaining calm during critical production incidents.

Job Description And Duties

  • Full time, on-site position at DOT Headquarters, Washington, DC.
  • Provide in-person support several days per week, with availability for either the early shift (starting 700 AM) or late shift (ending 700 PM) as needed.
  • Install, configure, and maintain enterprise-level PostgreSQL and MySQL database platforms and support infrastructure across on-premises and AWS cloud environments.
  • Configure, manage, and optimize AWS database services including Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for MySQL, Amazon Aurora, and MySQL Cluster environments.
  • Plan and execute migrations of PostgreSQL and MySQL databases from on-premises environments to AWS cloud platforms (IaaS and PaaS).
  • Design, implement, and maintain MySQL clustering, replication, failover, and high-availability solutions.
  • Contribute to database architecture and capacity planning to ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
  • Design, implement, and maintain disaster recovery strategies for PostgreSQL and MySQL environments hosted on AWS.
  • Monitor the performance, integrity, and security of all database platforms and investigate anomalies and production incidents.
  • Perform routine database maintenance tasks including index optimization, query tuning, statistics updates, backups, and consistency checks.
  • Plan and perform database upgrades, patching, and migrations for standalone, clustered, and cloud-hosted database servers.
  • Oversee and lead migration projects, including lift-and-shift, modernization, and re-platforming efforts to AWS cloud environments.
  • Manage database accounts, roles, and permissions according to least privilege and compliance requirements.
  • Audit database activity and maintain comprehensive logs of configuration and schema changes for compliance and forensic analysis.
  • Implement encryption, secure connectivity (TLS/SSL), and other security controls for data at rest and data in transit.
  • Maintain detailed, version-controlled documentation for database environments, architecture diagrams, configurations, operational procedures, and runbooks.
  • Generate regular reports on database performance, capacity growth, availability, and usage trends for stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with development, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to streamline deployments and accelerate incident resolution.
  • Mentor junior DBAs and establish operational best practices for AWS database administration, automation, and cloud migration initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success managing enterprise PostgreSQL and MySQL environments in hybrid (on-premises and AWS cloud) infrastructures.
  • Proven expertise in planning and executing cloud migration projects with strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud platforms.
  • Must be able to multitask effectively and perform well under pressure in a fast-paced, high-urgency environment while managing multiple priorities and production incidents concurrently.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • AWS Certified preferred.
  • Strong expertise in MySQL Cluster (No exception) and PostgreSQL administration across on-premises and AWS cloud environments.
  • In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in PostgreSQL and MySQL installation, configuration, optimization, clustering, replication, backup/recovery, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Proven ability to manage PostgreSQL and MySQL environments across multiple platforms including VMware, AWS EC2, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with MySQL Cluster, replication technologies, failover configurations, and high-availability database architectures.
  • Capability to troubleshoot database performance issues, analyze execution plans, optimize SQL queries, and implement database performance tuning strategies.
  • Experience implementing database security solutions including encryption, IAM integration, SSL/TLS, and secure access controls.
  • Hands-on experience migrating PostgreSQL and MySQL clusters to AWS cloud environments, including assessments, planning, and providing technical recommendations.
  • Experience with backup and recovery tools, monitoring solutions, automation scripting, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotations and perform mandatory maintenance activities during scheduled maintenance windows.

Preferred Skills And Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Aurora MySQL highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS networking, storage, security, and infrastructure services supporting database environments.
  • Experience automating database administration tasks using shell scripting, Python automation tools.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch and Prometheus.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise database environments with strict uptime and performance requirements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in high-pressure production environments.

Note Candidate must be a U.S. citizen or green card holder who has resided in the U.S. for at least 3 years and the ability to obtain a public trust.

Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Location: Beavercreek, OH (Relocation assistance available)

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Active Top Secret to apply

More about your role:

At NASK, we’re growing, building great teams, and doing exciting work supporting the Intelligence and Defense communities.

We are looking for an experienced Principal Database Administrator / Lead DBA who enjoys getting hands-on with complex database environments and taking ownership of their performance, reliability, security, and day-to-day operations. This role is ideal for a senior DBA who can troubleshoot challenging database issues, optimize performance at scale, and ensure critical data systems remain available, secure, and responsive.

You will lead the administration, maintenance, monitoring, performance tuning, and optimization of enterprise database systems supporting demanding mission requirements. You’ll work directly with database engines, Linux environments, cloud infrastructure, and engineering teams to resolve issues, improve efficiency, plan capacity, and support evolving customer needs.

The ideal candidate brings deep practical experience administering and tuning relational and NoSQL databases, managing high-availability environments, troubleshooting resource-intensive workloads, and supporting large-scale data platforms. You should be comfortable working at the command line, analyzing database performance, identifying bottlenecks across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, and implementing solutions that improve system stability and throughput.

While this is primarily a hands-on DBA role, you will also contribute to database architecture, infrastructure planning, migrations, and modernization efforts. You’ll help establish database standards and best practices, guide technical decisions, and collaborate across engineering and systems teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, such as engineering, computer science, or information technology.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise database administration, operations, and performance engineering.
  • Strong experience installing, configuring, administering, maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise database systems.
  • Deep, hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning at least one enterprise database platform: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, or MongoDB.
  • Proven experience with database performance tuning, query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies, and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • Strong SQL skills and a deep understanding of relational database concepts, schema design, transactions, and data integrity.
  • Experience managing database availability, replication, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  • Experience monitoring database health, diagnosing production issues, resolving performance problems, and implementing preventive maintenance.
  • Experience administering databases in Linux/Unix environments, including command-line tools, scripting, and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, I/O, networking, and database configuration affect performance and reliability.
  • Experience supporting large-scale databases, including multi-terabyte data environments, capacity planning, and growth management.
  • Experience administering high-availability or distributed database systems.
  • Experience deploying, operating, or monitoring databases in cloud or containerized environments, including Kubernetes.
  • Experience supporting database migrations, upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and platform modernization.
  • Ability to develop scripts or tools, preferably using Python on Linux, to automate database administration and operational tasks.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering teams.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Security clearance: Active TS/SCI w/poly
  • Security+ (or higher) certification
  • Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications like Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, or AWS Certified Database
  • Operating system, networking, storage administration experience highly desired
  • Experience administering and supporting multiple database platforms across relational, NoSQL, and distributed database environments.
  • Experience/knowledge of C/C++
  • Experience with cloud database technologies (AWS RDS, Oracle, MS SQL, Azure)
  • Familiarity with AWS Cloud products (EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda, Aurora, Dynamo DB, EMR, DMS data migration, Athena, Glue, Kinesis, SQS/SNS, etc.)
  • A strong understanding of the cloud computing model as it relates to enterprise productivity

Description

Are you looking for a forward focus environment where you are continually challenged, and the atmosphere is affirming? Do you want to be a part of a team where you are often out of your comfort zone, but you wake up excited to go to work each day? How about a place where people are growing because they desire change and growth is modeled and expected?

WHO WE ARE:

Premier Trailer Leasing is a 'USA Today Top Workplace' and one of the largest trailer leasing and rental companies in the nation, specializing in long-term leasing and short-term rental services for over-the-road vans, flatbeds, refrigerated equipment and chassis with an inventory of 70,000 trailers and a growing network of locations across the United States. At Premier you will find an environment where you are seen, heard and valued. Join us and experience what it means to live a culture of C.A.R.E!

JOB SCOPE:

Premier Trailer Leasing is advancing its data architecture into a modern hybrid ecosystem. As our Senior SQL Server DBA , you will assume primary operational ownership of our SQL Server estate, hosted on Microsoft Azure virtual machines.

This is a senior, hands-on ownership role for someone who enjoys SQL Server internals, query performance, PowerShell automation, reliability engineering, and database lifecycle management. You will inherit a stable, generally well-maintained estate and have broad latitude to reduce operational friction, modernize database deployment practices, strengthen observability, and improve resilience.

As Premier’s broader data platform evolves, SQL Server will remain a vital part of the enterprise architecture. You will lead the continuing operation and improvement of this estate while helping prepare the relational data layer to integrate reliably with our future-state platform.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Estate & Performance Ownership: Drive database health, capacity planning, indexing strategy, query performance, storage management, and resource utilization across large and VLDB-class SQL Server environments.
  • VLDB Operations: Improve backup, restore, integrity-check, maintenance, migration, and nonproduction refresh strategies for databases exceeding 1 TB, including a primary database approaching 4 TB.
  • PowerShell & Pipeline Automation: Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve production PowerShell scripts used for database administration, maintenance automation, monitoring, and operational data movement.
  • Database Lifecycle & Upgrades: Plan, test, and execute SQL Server version upgrades, patch management, database migrations, and server transitions across the estate.
  • Azure VM & Infrastructure Coordination: Manage SQL Server configuration and performance considerations within Microsoft Azure virtual machines, including compute sizing, storage design, disk throughput, networking, availability, backup integration, and coordination with infrastructure and security teams.
  • BC/DR & Reliability: Own business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including backup, recovery, failover, and restoration workflows aligned with SLA requirements.
  • Security & Access Governance: Manage privileged access, service accounts, database permissions, auditing, and SQL Server security configuration in partnership with infrastructure and security teams.
  • Observability & Custom Tooling: Manage, evolve, and modernize SQL Server alerting and observability using proven community and open-source solutions, including tools such as Erik Darling’s Performance Monitor and diagnostic scripts, dbatools, sp_WhoIsActive, and Ola Hallengren maintenance scripts.
  • SDLC & CI/CD Modernization: Establish mature Git-based version control, review, release, and rollback practices for database changes, and transition manual deployment processes into reliable automated pipelines.
  • Collaborative Triage & Partnership: Partner with our Senior SQL Developer on T-SQL code reviews, stored procedure optimization, dataset development, load routines, and application-team support.
  • Documentation & Operational Maturity: Maintain architecture diagrams, recovery procedures, operational runbooks, upgrade records, and support documentation to reduce key-person dependency and ensure repeatable administration.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • Experience: 7+ years as a Production Database Administrator in multi-server Microsoft SQL Server environments, with proven success managing large or VLDB-class databases.
  • Azure Infrastructure Experience: Hands-on experience operating SQL Server on Microsoft Azure virtual machines, including VM sizing, storage and disk configuration, network connectivity, monitoring, availability, and coordination with cloud infrastructure teams.
  • Workload Management: Experience supporting mixed transactional and reporting workloads in business-critical environments.
  • PowerShell Mastery: Strong proficiency with PowerShell for database administration, maintenance automation, monitoring, and operational scripting.
  • Upgrade & Migration Expertise: Demonstrated experience planning and performing SQL Server major-version upgrades, patching, and database migrations. Experience with SQL Server 2022 or later, along with earlier supported and legacy versions.
  • BC/DR Design: Hands-on experience designing, testing, documenting, and executing SQL Server backup, recovery, failover, and disaster recovery plans.
  • SQL Server Internals: Deep understanding of DMVs, wait statistics, Query Store, Extended Events, locking, blocking, memory management, storage behavior, and transaction log management.
  • T-SQL & Optimization: Expert-level T-SQL troubleshooting, execution-plan analysis, and stored procedure optimization.
  • Source Control Knowledge: Familiarity with Git-based platforms such as Bitbucket or GitHub for tracking database schemas and objects, with an interest in establishing automated deployment practices.
  • Communication & Ownership: Ability to independently investigate complex issues, recommend practical solutions, communicate risk clearly, and operate with broad ownership.
  • Location: Must be based in, or willing to commute to, the Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week.

PREFERRRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Familiarity with consuming third-party SaaS REST APIs through PowerShell or Python for lightweight operational data movement.
  • Experience managing SQL Server back ends supporting ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics GP or enterprise CRM systems.
  • Experience establishing automated database deployment and migration tooling through GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with Change Data Capture (CDC) and the operational requirements of using SQL Server as a source for modern ingestion platforms.

WHY JOIN US?

You are not stepping into a distressed environment. You are taking ownership of a stable, generally well-maintained SQL Server estate that is central to Premier’s operations. You will have broad operational ownership and the opportunity to improve automation, deployment maturity, observability, security, resilience, and VLDB operations. SQL Server will remain a critical part of Premier’s architecture as we build a modern enterprise data platform, giving you the opportunity to serve as the operational anchor for our core relational systems during an important period of growth and modernization.
