descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Database Administrator, you will specialize in managing and optimizing databases to ensure the smooth operation and efficient performance of applications relying on databases. Your focus will be on installing, configuring, and maintaining databases, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies and performing performance tuning.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install and Configure Databases: Install, configure, and maintain databases to ensure high availability and optimal performance. This includes setting up database systems, defining database structures, and configuring database parameters.
  • Implement Disaster Recovery Strategies: Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies to minimize data loss and ensure business continuity in the event of a disaster.
  • Perform Performance Tuning: Analyze database performance and implement tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Maintain Database Systems: Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as backups, upgrades, and patches, to ensure database systems remain secure and up-to-date.
  • Ensure High Availability: Implement measures to ensure high availability, including clustering, replication, and failover systems, to minimize downtime and ensure continuous access to databases.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Database Management Experience: Exposure to managing and optimizing databases using products such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, and Teradata, with a focus on ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
  • System Administration Knowledge: Experience working with system administration concepts, including installing, configuring, and maintaining database systems, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies.
  • Programming Understanding: Exposure to programming concepts and their application in database management, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • Database Concepts Familiarity: Experience working with database concepts, including database structures, database parameters, and data modeling.
  • Performance Tuning Skills: Exposure to analyzing database performance and implementing tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Database Concepts: Exposure to advanced database concepts, including data warehousing, data governance, and data quality, would be beneficial in this role.
  • Scripting and Automation: Experience with scripting languages, such as Python, PowerShell, or SQL, and automation tools would be advantageous in automating database tasks and workflows.
  • Cloud Database Services: Familiarity with cloud-based database services, such as Amazon RDS or Azure SQL Database, would be valuable in managing and optimizing cloud-based databases.
  • Preferred Skills: Oracle Database Administration, Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, Python

descriptionHtml:
Description

The City of Lynchburg is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The City of Lynchburg is seeking a Database Administrator I to join our Information Technology team! This position is responsible for supporting the design, security, performance, and reliability of the City's enterprise SQL Server environment. The Database Administrator I (DBA I) supports mission-critical systems used by City departments and citizen-facing services, helping ensure data integrity, regulatory compliance, and high availability.

This position may be eligible for hybrid remote work after six months of employment and successful completion of the department's in-person orientation and training, subject to departmental approval and operational needs.

Essential Duties

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties to provide direct or indirect service to the citizens may be assigned.

  • Assists in the design, development, implementation, maintenance, and support of the City's databases and related application systems.
  • Installs, configures, patches, and upgrades Microsoft SQL Server databases and related software in accordance with established procedures.
  • Creates and maintains database tables, queries, reports, and other database objects; assists in developing logical and physical data models.
  • Monitors database performance, identifies potential issues, and assists with query optimization, indexing, and system troubleshooting.
  • Maintains development, testing, and production database environments in accordance with established change management procedures.
  • Assists in implementing and maintaining database security measures, including user access controls, permissions, encryption, and data protection.
  • Performs database backups, recovery testing, and routine maintenance to support data integrity, system availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Assists in implementing and maintaining database high-availability solutions.
  • Develops and maintains scripts and automated processes to support database administration, monitoring, and routine maintenance.
  • Supports data imports, exports, and integrations between databases, applications, and other systems, including ETL processes.
  • Assists with the installation, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of purchased software applications and related database systems.
  • Troubleshoots database and application issues, coordinating with internal technical staff and software vendors to resolve problems.
  • Collaborates with City departments to identify business needs, evaluate technical solutions, and support system improvements and integrations.
  • Maintains technical documentation related to database configurations, procedures, security, backup and recovery, and system changes.
  • Participates in technology projects, system upgrades, and procurement evaluations as assigned.
  • Provides technical support for scheduled maintenance and database-related emergencies outside normal business hours, as needed.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

When unusual situations occur and/or the City Manager declares a State of Emergency, all City employees may be required to accept special assignments and perform as needed to ensure appropriate service delivery.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities but may provide occasional project leadership for smaller-scale projects.

Minimum Education And Experience Required

Associate's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and at least one year of experience in database administration, SQL Server support, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience sufficient to demonstrate the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Working knowledge of relational database management systems, particularly Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Knowledge of SQL and T-SQL, database design, performance optimization, and backup and recovery procedures.
  • Familiarity with database security, access controls, and data integrity practices.
  • Ability to diagnose technical problems, analyze system performance, and implement effective solutions.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical staff.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate with City departments and external vendors.

Additional Requirements

  • Must successfully complete any required background check consistent with City policy and applicable law.
  • Possession of valid driver's license issued by the Commonwealth of Virginia and acceptable driving record according to the City's Driving Criteria.
  • Must successfully complete IS100 and IS700 National Incident Management System (NIMS) training within 90 days of employment. May also be required to complete higher levels of NIMS training as determined appropriate for the position.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work is primarily performed in an office environment and involves prolonged periods of computer use, including sitting, typing, and viewing electronic screens. The position may require occasional movement between workstations, offices, and equipment areas, as well as handling or moving computer equipment. Description

The City of Lynchburg is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

The City of Lynchburg is seeking a Database Administrator I to join our Information Technology team! This position is responsible for supporting the design, security, performance, and reliability of the City's enterprise SQL Server environment. The Database Administrator I (DBA I) supports mission-critical systems used by City departments and citizen-facing services, helping ensure data integrity, regulatory compliance, and high availability.

This position may be eligible for hybrid remote work after six months of employment and successful completion of the department's in-person orientation and training, subject to departmental approval and operational needs.

Essential Duties

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Other duties to provide direct or indirect service to the citizens may be assigned.



- Assists in the design, development, implementation, maintenance, and support of the City's databases and related application systems.
- Installs, configures, patches, and upgrades Microsoft SQL Server databases and related software in accordance with established procedures.
- Creates and maintains database tables, queries, reports, and other database objects; assists in developing logical and physical data models.
- Monitors database performance, identifies potential issues, and assists with query optimization, indexing, and system troubleshooting.
- Maintains development, testing, and production database environments in accordance with established change management procedures.
- Assists in implementing and maintaining database security measures, including user access controls, permissions, encryption, and data protection.
- Performs database backups, recovery testing, and routine maintenance to support data integrity, system availability, and disaster recovery.
- Assists in implementing and maintaining database high-availability solutions.
- Develops and maintains scripts and automated processes to support database administration, monitoring, and routine maintenance.
- Supports data imports, exports, and integrations between databases, applications, and other systems, including ETL processes.
- Assists with the installation, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of purchased software applications and related database systems.
- Troubleshoots database and application issues, coordinating with internal technical staff and software vendors to resolve problems.
- Collaborates with City departments to identify business needs, evaluate technical solutions, and support system improvements and integrations.
- Maintains technical documentation related to database configurations, procedures, security, backup and recovery, and system changes.

- Working knowledge of relational database management systems, particularly Microsoft SQL Server.
- Knowledge of SQL and T-SQL, database design, performance optimization, and backup and recovery procedures.
- Familiarity with database security, access controls, and data integrity practices.
- Ability to diagnose technical problems, analyze system performance, and implement effective solutions.
- Ability to maintain technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical staff.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate with City departments and external vendors.

Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled DB2 Administrator (DBA) to provide technical leadership and operational support across enterprise database platforms spanning both legacy and modern technology environments. This role requires deep expertise in IBM DB2 for z/OS, DB2 LUW, and Microsoft SQL Server, with exposure to modern cloud-based data platforms and data modernization initiatives.


The ideal candidate will possess strong experience supporting mission-critical, high-volume transactional systems while helping guide the evolution of enterprise data platforms toward cloud-native and analytics-driven architectures, including PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and BigQuery.


Essential Functions

Database Administration & Operations

  • Provide senior-level administration and operational support for IBM DB2 for z/OS, IBM DB2 LUW, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud-based database platforms.
  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, monitor, and maintain enterprise database environments.
  • Ensure database availability, reliability, security, and performance across supported platforms.
  • Support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions.

Performance Optimization

  • Analyze and tune database performance across large-scale production environments.
  • Optimize SQL statements and application database interactions.
  • Perform execution plan analysis and access path reviews.
  • Develop and maintain effective indexing strategies.
  • Manage statistics collection, database maintenance activities, capacity planning, and resource optimization.

Database Engineering & Support

  • Design and implement database solutions supporting enterprise applications.
  • Manage and maintain database objects including tables, indexes, views, stored procedures, packages, constraints, and security controls.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and conduct root cause analysis.

Collaboration & Modernization

  • Partner with application development, integration, infrastructure, and data engineering teams.
  • Support enterprise modernization efforts involving migration and integration of legacy database platforms into cloud environments.
  • Provide guidance on database architecture, governance, standards, and best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging database technologies and recommend modernization strategies.


Additional Functions

  • PostgreSQL administration and support.
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and cloud-native data services.
  • Hybrid cloud and on-premises data architectures.
  • Database migration, replication, and modernization programs.
  • Enterprise ETL, data integration, and data pipeline technologies.
  • Data warehousing and analytical processing environments.
  • Database replication technologies.
  • Database automation and monitoring tools.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and cloud operations concepts.
  • API-driven and event-driven data architectures.
  • Collaboration with development teams on database design and application optimization.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of enterprise database administration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering IBM DB2 for z/OS.
  • IBM DB2 for z/OS architecture and administration.
  • Experience with DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, RECOVER, LOAD, and UNLOAD.
  • SQL performance tuning and access path analysis.
  • Working knowledge of z/OS, JCL, TSO/ISPF, and COBOL application environments.
  • Extensive experience with DB2 LUW include database configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience administering Microsoft SQL Server including installation and configuration, performance tuning, backup and restore, security and access management, production support, and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced SQL skills with the ability to analyze complex workloads and optimize performance.
  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical transactional systems.


Working Conditions & Physical Demands

  • Availability to work a varied, flexible schedule to meet business demands
  • Ability to monitor computer screens for long periods of time
  • Ability to work a hybrid schedule as established by the division (4 days on-site, 1 day remote)


Core Competencies

  • Communicate Effectively: Communicates thoughts and ideas in a well-organized manner, encouraging two-way communication.
  • Build Relationships: Creates cross-functional partnerships through the development and maintenance of constructive and cooperative relationships.
  • Stay Competitive: Demonstrates a mindset of continuous improvement while exhibiting passion and enthusiasm for their work.
  • Embrace Change: Looks for new ways of working by supporting advancements in processes and technology.
  • Develop You: Identifies and capitalizes on opportunities for personal and professional career growth.
  • Drive for Results: Supports divisional and strategic objectives through achievement of work goals.


Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $125,000-175,000. Placement in the range depends on several factors, including experience, skills, education, geography, and budget considerations.


Wakefern is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of our Associates. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match & annual company contribution, paid time off, holidays, and parental leave. Associates also enjoy access to wellness and family support programs, fitness reimbursement, educational and training opportunities through our corporate university, and a collaborative, team-oriented work

descriptionHtml:
Are you a database professional who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and driving operational excellence? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your expertise can influence technical strategy and support business-critical platforms?

Are you passionate about improving database performance, mentoring others, and researching emerging technologies? Join us and help deliver reliable, scalable database solutions that make a meaningful impact.

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below,

https://risk.lexisnexis.com

About Our Team

The team is a geographically distributed DBA/technology team with roughly 20 members across home-based, office-based, and contractor roles. The team includes both employees and contractors and provides database/infrastructure coverage across multiple locations, with a mix of operational support and technical expertise.

About The Role

This position is a senior role within the database administration team. This position requires total proficiency in all aspects of database administration and design. This position is expected to mentor and oversee junior members of staff and will work closely with the development teams to provide high-quality business solutions and play an active role in projects from inception to delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve performance issues and root cause resolution.
  • Ensure clear and early communication, in particular ensuring that the line manager and/or relevant parties are kept informed of progress, issues, and difficulties.
  • Train junior-level DBA staff as necessary, ensuring they are up to speed on critical processes and technologies.
  • Lead research into new or alternative technologies.
  • Review and sign off recommendations for upgrades or changes to the back-office infrastructure environment.
  • Engage with Technical Architects and other senior members of Development teams to provide technical designs and guidance to the Database Operations team, taking responsibility for the implications and impact of their design decisions.
  • Responsible for maintenance and “bug fix” activities for existing database infrastructure and equipment.
  • Undertake research into new or alternative technologies and make recommendations for upgrades or changes to the database infrastructure environment.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of DBA experience
  • BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required
  • Experience as a MySQL DBA along with PostgreSQL or SQL Server is beneficial.
  • Proficient in Terraform and Github, Cloud experience such as AWS or Azure (preferably Azure).
  • Strong understanding of database infrastructure, maintenance, administration, and design.
  • Ability to complete root cause analysis on database-related issues.
  • Strong problem-solving skills in multiple operating environments.
  • Ability to complete impact analysis on database-related issues.
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues that involve database infrastructure.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $95,300 - $158,800. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates. This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

Amazon Leo Builder Product Services is seeking an experienced Senior Database Engineer to lead the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of our Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments supporting Siemens Teamcenter PLM and related platform services. You will collaborate across PLM Application, Infrastructure, and Integration teams to improve database performance, reliability, and scalability. You will ensure the database architecture is performant, highly available, and observable as the platform scales.

Key job responsibilities

  • Support MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL database solutions for Teamcenter PLM and adjacent platform services across development, test, and production environments; work with Infrastructure teams on high availability, clustering, replication, and disaster recovery deployments
  • Perform day-to-day DBA responsibilities including database provisioning, user and role management, access control, capacity planning, patching, and health monitoring across both MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments
  • Develop and implement database migration strategies for Teamcenter upgrades, PostgreSQL adoption initiatives, and performance optimization as the platform scales to support additional product lines and integrations
  • Design and optimize database schemas, stored procedures, functions, and queries across MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL, ensuring consistency and performance across both platforms
  • Establish best practices for MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration, backup/recovery, replication, and high availability in the context of Teamcenter's data model and enterprise integrations

A day in the life

Join KBPS and play a pivotal role in building the digital thread for satellite production. As a Senior Database Engineer, you'll focus on architecting and maintaining robust Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments that support our Siemens Teamcenter PLM platform and related services. Your day might include analyzing query performance metrics, designing schema improvements to enhance system reliability, or working with application teams to troubleshoot database connectivity issues. You'll participate in infrastructure planning sessions, mentor colleagues on database best practices, and contribute to documentation that helps the broader organization understand our database strategy. Beyond routine administration, you'll take on strategic initiatives like evaluating new database technologies or implementing monitoring solutions that give us deeper visibility into system health.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 5+ years of database administration and engineering experience with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Expert knowledge of MS SQL Server architecture, including query optimization, indexing strategies, memory management, table partitioning, Always On Availability Groups, and backup/recovery procedures
  • Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture, query planning, indexing strategies, partitioning, WAL configuration, and backup/recovery
  • Strong experience with performance tuning and optimization of complex queries and stored procedures/functions across MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Proven experience with high-availability and disaster recovery solutions for MS SQL Server and PostgreSQL (streaming replication, logical replication, failover mechanisms)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent SQL Server certification
  • PostgreSQL certification or demonstrated equivalent expertise (e.g., EDB PostgreSQL Associate/Professional)
  • Experience with Siemens Teamcenter data model architecture (BMIDE, Item/ItemRevision structures, BOM management, workflow/lifecycle objects)
  • Experience with AWS database services (RDS for SQL Server, RDS for PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with PostgreSQL connection pooling tools and monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of additional database platforms (Oracle)
  • Experience with database monitoring and observability tools (SQL Server Management Studio, Performance Monitor, extended events, Grafana, CloudWatch, third-party monitoring)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Company Description

Citizant is a leading provider of professional IT services to the U.S. government. We seek to address some of our country’s most pressing challenges in Agile application development, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, and Program Management support services. We strive to hire only ethical, talented, passionate and committed “A Players” who already align with the company’s core values: Drive, Delivering Excellence, Reputation, Responsibility, and a Better Future. No matter how large we grow, Citizant will retain its collaborative, supportive, small-company culture, where successful team effort to address external and internal customer challenges is valued above all else.

This position is for a near-term opportunity.

Position Summary

  • Join our dynamic team as a Senior SQL Database Administrator, where you will play a vital role in managing and supporting SQL Server databases that are essential to the operations of the USCP Enterprise Applications Management Division. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a mission-critical environment, ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and availability of vital data systems in a highly sensitive law enforcement setting.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan, install, configure, and maintain SQL Server databases across development, test, and production environments.
  • Perform routine and advanced database administration tasks, including backup and recovery, failover, clustering, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Conduct performance monitoring and tuning activities to ensure optimal query execution, resource utilization, and overall database health.
  • Work with application development and business teams to design and implement data models, schemas, and stored procedures that support EAMD solutions.
  • Implement and enforce database security policies, roles, and permissions consistent with USCP security and privacy requirements.
  • Troubleshoot database-related issues impacting applications and services and drive root-cause analysis and resolution.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of database configurations, processes, and standards and participate in cross-training and knowledge transfer.

Experience

Required Qualifications:

  • General Experience: At least 7 years of professional database administration experience.
  • Specialized Experience: Minimum of 5 years administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise production environments.
  • Local to the D.C. area

Technical Skills & Competencies

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server architecture, configuration, and management.
  • Strong experience with backup/restore strategies, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Proficiency in performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server environments and integration of SQL Server with enterprise applications.
  • Understanding of data security, encryption, access control, and audit requirements in a federal context.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with developers, system administrators, and business stakeholders.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Certifications: (If Required)

  • Microsoft SQL Server or Azure data-related certifications preferred but not required.

Security Clearance

  • Ability to successfully pass USCP criminal history check, fingerprinting, and badging requirements and adhere to all USCP data protection and confidentiality obligations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting databases for law enforcement or other public safety organizations.
  • Familiarity with Azure SQL Managed Instance or other cloud-based database services.
  • Experience with DevOps practices related to database deployment and version control.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills for explaining complex database issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Work Environment

  • Location: On-site at USCP facilities in Washington, DC, with hybrid work; full on-site during acclimation followed by a minimum of 2 days per week on-site and up to 3 days telework, subject to USCP direction.
  • Schedule: Full-time; normal business hours 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with occasional off-hours and weekend support for deployments, special events, and maintenance windows.

Citizant Offers a Competitive Benefits Package, Including

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Assistance & Professional Development Program

Additional Information

Citizant strives to be an employer of choice in the Washington metropolitan area. Citizant associates accept challenging and rewarding work and, in return, receive excellent compensation and benefits, as well as the opportunity for personal and professional development.

Citizant is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Salary Description

$112,000 - $124,000/yearly

About This Role

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to manage, maintain, and support Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments across Development, UAT, and Production.

The DBA will be responsible for ensuring database availability, security, performance, backup and recovery readiness, replication reliability, and operational automation.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration, T-SQL development, PowerShell scripting, troubleshooting, and production support. Experience working with cloud platforms—preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP)—is highly desirable. Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices is also preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and optimize high volume Microsoft SQL Server instances and PostgreSQL systems (including Cloud SQL) in highly available environments.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain SQL Server instances and databases.
  • Manage database security, including user access, roles, permissions, and Active Directory integration.
  • Perform database backups, restores, recovery testing, and snapshot activities.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance, availability, storage, data files, and transaction logs.
  • Execute SQL scripts for application deployments, schema changes, data population, and remediation.
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate routine DBA tasks, including health checks, backups, maintenance, job monitoring, disk-space validation, and reporting.
  • Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot automated database administration jobs and SQL Agent jobs.
  • Respond to monitoring alerts related to disk space, transaction log growth, failed jobs, database availability, and performance issues.
  • Investigate and resolve database connectivity, permissions, replication, and performance incidents.
  • Support and maintain Fivetran HVR replication channels for on-premises-to-cloud data movement.
  • Troubleshoot replication failures and ensure data consistency across source and target systems.
  • Support database change requests, technical requirement deployments, UAT testing, and production releases.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, application support, and data teams.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance windows and occasional after-hours production support.
  • Create and maintain DBA documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Microsoft SQL Server DBA and Postgres experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent work experience required.
  • Experience supporting SQL Server 2016, 2019, and/or 2022.
  • Strong T-SQL scripting, query optimization, and performance-tuning skills.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for SQL Server administration and operational automation.
  • Experience with SQL Server backup, restore, recovery, and disaster-recovery processes.
  • Strong knowledge of database security, user access management, roles, and permissions.
  • Experience with SQL Server monitoring tools such as Idera SQL Diagnostic Manager (SQL DM) or similar platforms.
  • Experience managing database storage, transaction logs, file growth, and capacity planning.
  • Knowledge of database replication and data-integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting production incidents, root-cause analysis, and change-management processes.
  • Experience with any cloud solution (GCP preferred)
  • Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Git/version-control practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Fivetran HVR data replication.
  • Experience supporting data migration and on-premises-to-cloud integration projects.
  • Experience in regulated, financial services, or other highly controlled environments.
  • Knowledge of formal change-management processes, including DCRs and technical deployment requirements.

    • Postgres

    • Windows Server

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to manage, maintain, and support Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments across Development, UAT, and Production.

The DBA will be responsible for ensuring database availability, security, performance, backup and recovery readiness, replication reliability, and operational automation.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration, T-SQL development, PowerShell scripting, troubleshooting, and production support. Experience working with cloud platforms—preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP)—is highly desirable. Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices is also preferred.

- Administer and optimize high volume Microsoft SQL Server instances and PostgreSQL systems (including Cloud SQL) in highly available environments.

- Manage database security, including user access, roles, permissions, and Active Directory integration. 
- Perform database backups, restores, recovery testing, and snapshot activities. 
- Monitor and optimize database performance, availability, storage, data files, and transaction logs. 
- Execute SQL scripts for application deployments, schema changes, data population, and remediation. 
- Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate routine DBA tasks, including health checks, backups, maintenance, job monitoring, disk-space validation, and reporting.

- Investigate and resolve database connectivity, permissions, replication, and performance incidents. 
- Support and maintain Fivetran HVR replication channels for on-premises-to-cloud data movement. 
- Troubleshoot replication failures and ensure data consistency across source and target systems. 
- Support database change requests, technical requirement deployments, UAT testing, and production releases. 
- Collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, application support, and data teams. 
- Participate in scheduled maintenance windows and occasional after-hours production support. 
- Create and maintain DBA documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks.

- 8+ years of hands-on Microsoft SQL Server DBA and Postgres experience. 
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent work experience required. 
- Experience supporting SQL Server 2016, 2019, and/or 2022. 
- Strong T-SQL scripting, query optimization, and performance-tuning skills. 
- Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for SQL Server administration and operational automation. 
- Experience with SQL Server backup, restore, recovery, and disaster-recovery processes. 
- Strong knowledge of database security, user access management, roles, and permissions. 
- Experience with SQL Server monitoring tools such as Idera SQL Diagnostic Manager (SQL DM) or similar platforms. 
- Experience managing database storage, transaction logs, file growth, and capacity planning. 
- Knowledge of database replication and data-integration technologies. 
- Experience supporting production incidents, root-cause analysis, and change-management processes. 
- Experience with any cloud solution (GCP preferred) 
- Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Git/version-control practices. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with Fivetran HVR data replication. 
- Experience supporting data migration and on-premises-to-cloud integration projects. 
- Experience in regulated, financial services, or other highly controlled environments. 
- Knowledge of formal change-management processes, including DCRs and technical deployment requirements.

Job Summary

The Advanced Database Administrator serves as a senior technical expert responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of the organization's database environments. This role ensures data integrity, security, availability, and performance across complex, multi-platform, on-premises, and cloud database systems. The Advanced DBA supports database architecture and capacity planning, implements performance tuning, and maintains high-availability and disaster recovery solutions. Acting as a technical leader within the team, this role provides guidance to junior staff, collaborates across IT domains, and contributes to best practices, standards, and operational improvements to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing database services.

Responsibilities

  • Contributes to database architecture and design within assigned environments, supporting scalable, secure, and high-performing database platforms for critical business applications.
  • Serves as a technical subject matter expert (SME) on multiple database technologies, providing guidance on integration, optimization, and modernization projects.
  • Supports database technology roadmaps and platform improvements, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and business requirements.
  • Resolves complex database performance, scalability, and resilience issues, coordinating troubleshooting and implementing effective remediation solutions.
  • Evaluates emerging database technologies to support future platform enhancements, providing recommendations to senior leadership or project teams.
  • Collaborates with business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data to improve business processes and system performance.
  • Designs, engineers, and documents database solutions and technical standards, ensuring alignment with business objectives and architectural guidelines.
  • Implements and maintains disaster recovery and high-availability solutions for supported database platforms to minimize service disruption.
  • Develops and executes database backup strategies, including scheduling, validation testing, and documentation, meeting recovery objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Plans and coordinates database installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities, ensuring reliable operations and consistent performance.
  • Provides technical guidance and mentoring to junior or mid-level DBAs, promoting best practices and efficient workflows.
  • Ensures data consistency, integrity, and availability through robust database design, configuration, and lifecycle management practices.
  • Monitors database performance using diagnostic tools and metrics, identifying trends and proactively addressing potential issues.
  • Performs advanced SQL optimization, including query tuning, indexing strategies, and configuration adjustments across platforms.
  • Implements automation and scripting solutions to proactively identify and remediate performance bottlenecks and reduce manual administrative effort.
  • Conducts system health checks and recommends operational or configuration improvements to optimize resource utilization.
  • Implements and maintains backup and recovery solutions aligned with defined RTO and RPO objectives.
  • Supports high-availability and resiliency architectures, including replication, clustering, mirroring, and failover setups.
  • Participates in disaster recovery testing exercises, validating procedures, documenting results, and supporting continuous improvement efforts.
  • Supports data protection and business continuity initiatives through redundancy and fault-tolerance implementations.
  • Implements database security policies, access controls, encryption, and authentication procedures in accordance with standards.
  • Participates in security audits and vulnerability assessments, assisting with remediation of identified risks.
  • Maintains confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) of sensitive data assets within assigned environments.
  • Configures and maintains monitoring frameworks to track database performance, availability, and usage trends.
  • Responds to incidents affecting database performance, connectivity, or data integrity, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Performs root cause analysis for recurring or systemic database issues and implements corrective actions.
  • Automates database operations using scripting and orchestration tools (e.g., Shell, Python, Ansible) to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Supports integration with enterprise identity platforms, such as Active Directory, to ensure secure and centralized authentication.
  • Executes cross-platform data transport, including transportable tablespaces, endian conversion, and platform migration support.
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards
  • May be required to work hours outside regular work hours, as applicable
  • Observes the work performed by contractors, as applicable
  • Reviews invoices and approves them if the work has contractual standards, as applicable
  • Addresses performance issues with the contractor when possible, as applicable
  • Escalates issues to other parties when needed, as applicable

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS). An additional 4 years of combined education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Requires at least one certification in the current platform/domain/technical skill. Possible certifications could be, but are not limited to:
    • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
    • AWS Certified Solution Architect - Associate & Professional 
    • Azure Administrator Associate 
    • Fundamental knowledge of Oracle AWS RDS or Azure cloud
    • Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect 
    • Microsoft Azure Administrator 
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate 
    • Oracle Database Administrator certification (e.g., OCP or OCE)
Technical Skills

  • Expertise installing, configuring, and administering Oracle Database platforms (11g, 12c, 19c) in complex enterprise environments.
  • Proficient in managing multiple relational database platforms, including Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, with a focus on cross-platform integration and interoperability.
  • Skilled in database provisioning, cloning, and migration using DBCA, SQL scripting, and Oracle Data Pump to support multi-environment deployments.
  • Advanced experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and cloning strategies using RMAN, Flashback technologies, and Recovery Catalogs to meet RTO/RPO objectives.
  • Expert in database security and compliance, including user and role management, privilege assignment, auditing, and implementing regulatory controls.
  • Advanced SQL performance tuning and query optimization using AWR, ASH, ADDM, and SQL Monitor reports to ensure high performance across multiple environments.
  • Strong expertise in query execution plan analysis using EXPLAIN PLAN, DBMS_XPLAN, SQL Trace, and TKPROF, including cross-instance performance troubleshooting.
  • Database and instance performance tuning expertise, including SGA, PGA, I/O optimization, and parallel execution, with experience in proactive monitoring and predictive tuning.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, patching, and troubleshooting Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC) environments for high availability and scalability.
  • Implementation and management of Oracle Data Guard and Active Data Guard solutions, including monitoring, switchover, failover, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Configuration and administration of Oracle GoldenGate replication, including conflict detection, resolution, and cross-environment synchronization.
  • Design, implementation, and maintenance of Automatic Storage Management (ASM) environments to optimize storage performance and reliability.
  • Proficient in provisioning and managing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) database services, including Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud Service, and OCI DB Systems, with operational integration across hybrid environments.
  • Experience leveraging automation and scripting (e.g., Shell, Python, Ansible) to streamline database management, performance monitoring, and maintenance processes.
  • Participates in capacity planning, performance benchmarking, and advanced diagnostic activities to ensure sustained database availability and efficiency.

Behavioral Skills

Job Description


At BAE Systems, we're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to drive innovation and make a meaningful impact. Our team is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our government customer's mission-critical objectives. We're now seeking a highly skilled Database Administrator to join our dynamic team and help us manage our databases.

We're looking for a talented Database Administrator to play a key role in designing, developing, and managing databases, optimizing queries, ensuring data backup and security compliance. As a Database Administrator, you will be responsible for documenting data models and schemas, monitoring performance, and producing compliance policies.



Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and manage databases, optimize queries, ensure data backup and security compliance
  • Document data models and schemas, monitor performance, and produce compliance policies
  • Support leading and overseeing complex database activities to design, develop, and manage databases, optimize queries, ensure data backup and security compliance
  • Document data models and schemas, monitor performance, and produce compliance policies


#ISOSINT



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in an area related to the labor category (i.e., IT, Computer Science, Information Science, Data Science/Engineering) from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education
  • 8 years of experience conducting Database Administration, with at least a portion of the experience within the last 2 years
  • Oracle DBA experience or MYSQL



Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Intelligence Community experience preferred
  • Sybase DBA


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $79365 - $134921

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Job Description:

Senior PostgreSQL Database Administrator

We are seeking an experienced Senior PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) to join a collaborative and high-performing team supporting mission-critical systems. The Senior PostgreSQL DBA will be responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and ongoing administration of secure, highly available PostgreSQL.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable PostgreSQL database environments.
  • Architect and implement database high availability and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Perform advanced database administration tasks including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and migration of PostgreSQL clusters and related components.
  • Monitor and tune database performance, including query optimization, index strategy, memory and storage configuration, and operating system–level tuning.
  • Implement and enforce database security best practices.
  • Design and maintain backup and recovery strategies to meet RPO/RTO objectives, including regular testing of restore procedures and documentation.
  • Collaborate with application development and DevOps/DevSecOps teams to support schema design and data modeling, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
  • Support and improve databases for provisioning, configuration management, and operational workflows.
  • Troubleshoot complex database incidents and performance issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing durable corrective actions.
  • Develop, maintain, and communicate database standards, best practices, and operational procedures.
  • Provide advanced technical guidance and mentoring to development and operations teams on effective use of PostgreSQL, data access patterns, and performance optimization.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technology discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering) and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience; additional relevant experience may be substituted for education.
  • Significant hands-on experience in the design, deployment, operation, and maintenance of PostgreSQL databases in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with:
    • PostgreSQL installation, configuration, and lifecycle management across multiple environments.

Who We Are

At Lawelawe, our mission is to deliver innovative solutions that empower organizations and enhance their operational efficiencies. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative environment where technical excellence meets strategic vision. Our dedication to quality and client satisfaction drives us to exceed expectations and deliver impactful results.

The Team

Lawelawe Technology Services is a forward-thinking solutions provider dedicated to delivering excellence through innovation and collaboration. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about technology and committed to making a difference. We work together to solve complex challenges and drive successful outcomes for our clients.

You Are

You are an experienced SQL Server database administrator who takes ownership of database reliability, performance, and recovery. You approach troubleshooting methodically and communicate technical issues clearly. You take ownership of your work, protect sensitive information, and keep stakeholders informed when issues affect service or delivery.

How You Will Make An Impact

You will contribute by maintaining the SQL Server databases that support a federal law enforcement customer’s enterprise applications. Working within a team of application, database, infrastructure, and business analysis professionals, you will help maintain dependable services and implement changes that meet approved customer needs.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and support SQL Server database environments.
  • Monitor database performance and perform tuning to address identified issues.
  • Administer database backups and recovery processes and validate recovery readiness.
  • Troubleshoot database availability and performance issues with application and infrastructure teams.
  • Maintain database configuration, maintenance, and recovery documentation.
  • Review database health indicators and investigate errors, resource constraints, and recurring performance issues.
  • Coordinate database changes with application developers and infrastructure staff to support application compatibility.
  • Support authorized database access and configuration changes in accordance with customer security procedures.
  • Document incidents, corrective actions, and maintenance activities to support continuity and knowledge transfer.

Here’s What You Need

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of SQL experience.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server installation, performance tuning, backup, and recovery.
  • Ability to diagnose database issues and document administrative procedures.
  • Experience monitoring database health and identifying causes of performance degradation.
  • Ability to plan and document database maintenance and recovery activities with attention to service continuity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical staff and customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage assigned priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and follow customer security and change procedures.
  • Ability to successfully to complete required criminal history checks and fingerprinting,

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time onsite position located in Washington, D.C. Hybrid or telework may be available but subject to approval. Typical days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and may require overtime occasionally. Evening and weekend hours required, as required by business need.

This position is contingent upon contract award.

What You Will Do

Supporting a premier law enforcement agency, the Database Administrator will lead the migration and on-going support of the MREF database architecture, the Oracle to Microsoft SQL or DB2 migration, data migration execution, and the backup and recovery posture.

  • Support and execute the migration of the Oracle database to MSSQL or DB2
  • Develop the Data Migration Plan covering data inventory, mapping, transfer rules, data cleansing strategy, staging validation, rollback procedures, and government acceptance criteria.
  • Execute at least three mock data migration runs prior to Go-Live and validate migration accuracy in staging with government-approved reconciliation reports before any production migration event.
  • Coordinate production migration timing with project leads to minimize operational impact and execute the data movement from the government data center to the cloud environment at cutover.
  • Archive and store original system data in the data warehouse in hot storage per the client's data retention policy, with potential migration to cold storage, and preserve legacy TRIRIGA data for reporting needs during decommissioning.
  • Design and implement data replication supporting the 4-hour RTO and 4-hour RPO and create required materialized and business views and replication to the data warehouse and reporting systems.
  • Perform and validate regular backups per the clients retention and recovery policy.
  • Maintain and annually test disaster recovery and business continuity procedures.
  • Provide ongoing database support in sustainment and contribute the database internal data flow and backup descriptions and diagrams to the as-built architecture.
  • Contribute to creation and maintenance of the MREF data dictionary supporting the business intelligence and data warehouse efforts.

What You Will Need

  • Eight years of experience as a Database Administrator, including database design.
  • Microsoft SQL Server or DB2 and Oracle administration
  • Bachelor's degree (FOUR (4) additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for formal education or advanced degree).
  • US Citizenship is required.
  • An ACTIVE and MAINTAINED TOP SECRET Federal or DoD security clearance

What Would Be Nice To Have

  • Eight (8) years of database administration experience, including three (3) years supporting IBM Maximo, MREF, or TRIRIGA databases and two (2) years in a Federal accredited environment.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, DB2 and Oracle administration at enterprise scale, including cross-platform migration from Oracle to Microsoft SQL or DB2
  • TRIRIGA and MREF schema structures; performance tuning and execution plan analysis.
  • ETL and bulk data migration tooling, staging design, rollback procedures, and reconciliation reporting.
  • Replication design supporting defined RTO and RPO objectives; materialized and business view design.
  • Encryption, database auditing, and privileged access separation of duties under FBI IT security policy.
  • Data retention, archival, hot and cold storage tiering, and legacy data preservation for decommissioning.
  • Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL or DB2 Database Administrator related; Oracle Certified Professional.

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000.00-$188,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

(SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

Role Description

We are seeking a highly skilled SQL Server DBA Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience administering, supporting, and optimizing enterprise SQL Server environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server platform administration, high availability and disaster recovery solutions, database security, cloud technologies, automation, and operational support within mission-critical environments. This position will be located in Charlotte, NC office. You will work in a fast-paced environment to provide support to the trading business for Front/Middle/Back office.

Role Objectives

  • Provide expert administration and support for SQL Server 2019, SQL Server 2022, and SQL Server 2025 environments across on-premises virtual machines, Microsoft Azure, and AWS platforms.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL Server environments running on Windows-based virtual machines.
  • Manage and support Azure SQL Database (PaaS), Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Virtual Machines, AWS RDS and AWS EC2 SQL Server ensuring high availability, performance, security, and operational excellence.
  • Administer, maintain, and support Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS).
  • Design, implement, and support High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions utilizing SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and related replication technologies.
  • Manage and support database backups, recovery processes, failover testing, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity initiatives within mission-critical environments.
  • Strong experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for SQL Server administration, monitoring, patching, reporting, and operational tasks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports for database health, compliance, capacity planning, performance metrics, and operational reporting.

Qualifications And Skills

Hands-on experience with Ansible automation for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployment, and operational standardization.

  • Experience using ServiceNow (SNOW) for incident management, problem management, change management, request fulfillment, and workflow automation.
  • Develop and implement database security controls including authentication, authorization, access management, encryption, security monitoring, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and operations teams to support database migrations, upgrades, patching, modernization initiatives, and production support activities.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to ensure adherence to security standards, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and internal policies.
  • Participate in periodic Technology Recovery (TR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities and provide support through on-call rotation.
  • Support planned maintenance activities including installations, patching, upgrades, migrations, and system maintenance, which may require evening and weekend work.
  • Work effectively within a hybrid work environment and be available onsite as required by organizational policy and business needs.

Additional Requirements

SMBC’s employees participate in a Hybrid workforce model that provides employees with an opportunity to work from home, as well as, from an SMBC office. SMBC requires that employees live within a reasonable commuting distance of their office location. Prospective candidates will learn more about their specific hybrid work schedule during their interview process. Hybrid work may not be permitted for certain roles, including, for example, certain FINRA-registered roles for which in-office attendance for the entire workweek is required.

SMBC provides reasonable accommodations during candidacy for applicants with disabilities consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please let us know at accommodations@smbcgroup.com.

Job Description

The Role

Fidelity Architecture & Engineering's Institutional Brokerage Database Services team is adding a Principal Database Administrator in Boston.

In this role, you will design, engineer, and support highly resilient, high-performing database platforms that power critical business applications. This role focuses on administering and optimizing enterprise database environments, partnering with application teams, and driving database performance, reliability, and scalability initiatives. You will troubleshoot complex production issues, support cloud and distributed database technologies, and establish database standards and best practices. This position offers the opportunity to work with modern database platforms, cloud technologies, automation tools, and emerging technologies across a large-scale enterprise environment.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 8+ years of database administration, database engineering, or database platform support experience; or Master's degree with 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Deep expertise in Oracle database administration, including performance tuning, resiliency engineering, replication, and database architecture
  • Experience designing and supporting highly available, scalable database platforms across Linux environments and engineered systems such as Oracle Exadata
  • Experience with cloud-hosted database platforms and services; AWS experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of additional database technologies such as PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, Snowflake, Cassandra, Microsoft SQL Server, or other distributed databases
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues in Oracle RAC, Exadata, and large-scale database environments
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience using infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Chef, or similar technologies
  • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or related tools
  • Experience supporting modern software delivery practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD)
  • Strong Linux administration and shell scripting skills preferred
  • Ability to develop technical standards, influence engineering practices, and collaborate across technology teams
  • Strong communication, documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

The Team

The Institutional Brokerage Database Services team, part of Fidelity Architecture & Engineering, serves as a centralized Database Center of Excellence supporting Fidelity's Institutional business. We design, engineer, and support enterprise database solutions that enable critical business applications and client services across a diverse technology landscape. Our team partners closely with application development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, site reliability engineering, and capacity planning teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable database platforms. We have a relentless commitment to our clients and leverage innovative technologies to help Fidelity deliver exceptional experiences while maintaining the performance, availability, and resiliency of our most important systems.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $107,000-216,000 USD per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

As an Oracle DBA the role will focus on day-to-day DBA support, production troubleshooting, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and high availability. You'll work with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team on the shared full stack ownership of a collection of services and/or technology areas and understand the end-to-end configuration, technical dependencies, and overall behavioral characteristics of production services.

Responsible for the design and delivery of the mission critical stack, with focus on security, resiliency, scale, and performance. Authority for end-to-end performance and operability. Partner with development teams in defining and implementing improvements in service architecture.

Articulate technical characteristics of services and technology areas and guide Development Teams to engineer and add premier capabilities to the Oracle Cloud service portfolio. Understand and communicate the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of the service and technology stack. Demonstrate clear understanding of automation and orchestration principles. Act as ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Utilize a deep understanding of service topology and their dependencies required to troubleshoot issues and define mitigations.

Understand and explain the effect of product architecture decisions on distributed systems. Professional curiosity and a desire to develop a deep understanding of services and technologies.

This Position will require being available for Shifts and Weekends

Manage, maintain, and optimize mission-critical Oracle database environments.

This role is responsible for ensuring database availability, performance, security, and recoverability across on-premises and/or cloud-based systems.

descriptionHtml:
About Adaptiva


Adaptiva is a Gartner-recognized Leader in the Endpoint Management market.


We are a small, high-performance team, playing at the top end of this rapidly expanding market (TAM: $50B+, CAGR: 11%). Our customers include some of the world’s biggest and most respected companies, who rely on our technology to manage vast fleets of computers in their global environments. Our largest deployment scales to 450,000 devices in a complex worldwide network spanning 17,000 locations.


We provide a fast-paced and collaborative environment where driven, intellectually curious professionals come together to do the best work of their lives while growing quickly alongside the company.


Our success is fueled by a set of four core values: Integrity, Excellence, Work Ethic, and Dignity of Labor.


As we scale, we are expanding our team to bring our highly differentiated Agentic AI product suite to market, capitalizing on a significant first-mover advantage. For the right candidate, this represents a rare opportunity to help shape a category-defining company while accelerating their own professional trajectory.


We offer an industry-leading benefits package, including 100% company-paid health insurance, performance-based bonuses, a 401(k) retirement plan, and generous stock options that allow employees to participate in the company’s long-term success.


Shape the Future of Enterprise Data Platforms at Adaptiva


Adaptiva is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Database Administrator to join our growing engineering organization. Based in our Kirkland, Washington office, this full-time role offers the opportunity to lead the design, development, and optimization of mission-critical database solutions powering innovative enterprise products used by global organizations.


As a senior member of the development team, you will play a key role in optimizing performance for large-scale applications. Additionally, you will serve as the primary point of contact in supporting enterprise database systems across development, staging, and production environments. This role ensures database availability, reliability, scalability, security, and performance while supporting application development and business-critical data operations. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges and influencing the technical direction of critical database operations.


What You'll Do


In this role, you will:

Operations

  • Monitor database health, availability, resource utilization, and operational performance
  • Manage database capacity planning and infrastructure requirements
  • Troubleshooting and Optimization
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex SQL queries to improve database performance and system scalability
  • Demonstrate expertise of a pure DBA including strong troubleshooting and maintaining on-prem (PostgreSQL and SQL Server) and cloud databases
  • Database Design and Development support experience

All other basic DBA duty experiences: Database (PG and SQL Server) Installation, configuration and upgrades

  • Backup, migration and recovery plan and implementation
  • Routine code review to identify areas of SQL pertaining to security and vulnerabilities

Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with QA, customer support, and cross-functional teams to identify root cause for all reported bugs
  • Work with customers directly on/off call to find the bottleneck of DB issues and pain points and resolve it


What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline.
  • Expertise in PostgreSQL, experience in MSSQL is a plus.
  • Expertise in complex SQL development, schema design, indexing, and query optimization
  • Experience with managing Postgres replication
  • Experience diagnosing and improving performance in large-scale or high-growth systems
  • Hands-on experience of DB performance improvement techniques including indexing, partitioning, database schema improving, scaling and SQL query optimization (not limited)
  • Deep expertise of functional SQL development including PL/pgSQL and T-SQL along with scripting languages like Bash for automation and configuration
  • Strong knowledge of database schema design (ERD) and data modeling techniques (DW)
  • Basic knowledge of data ingestion (Scalability and reliability), transformation and loading techniques (ETL/ELT, incremental loading, etc.)


Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with CloudNativePostgres Kubernetes operator
  • Familiarity with log aggregation tools such as Elasticsearch and Loki
  • Familiarity with gitOps and Infrastructure as Code principles
  • Ability to track and tune databases within a Kubernetes cluster, which may include hundreds to thousands of replicas and primary nodes
  • Experience with manage and troubleshoot Postgres clusters including failover and data replication
  • Some experience managing a database cluster hosted in a cloud SaaS environment


How to apply

Please submit your resume and cover letter in PDF format to careers@adaptiva.com.

The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 – $120,000, depending on experience and qualifications.


We do not provide visa sponsorship for this position and participate in E-Verify for work authorization.


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or other legally protected status.
