About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

The SQL Developer/Database Engineer will support a large-scale federal IT program by designing, developing, and optimizing database structures and SQL logic for mission-critical applications. This role requires strong SQL expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot complex data and performance issues. The candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional technical teams operating in an Agile environment and will ensure data integrity, reliability, and scalability across multiple systems.

Location: On-site three days per week in Colorado Springs, CO.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and database objects to support application and reporting needs.
  • Analyze and optimize existing SQL code for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement database schemas, tables, indexing strategies, and data structures aligned to system requirements.
  • Troubleshoot database issues, including performance bottlenecks, data integrity problems, and SQL defects.
  • Collaborate with application developers, architects, business analysts, and DevOps teams to refine data requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support data migration, transformation, and integration activities across systems.
  • Follow Agile processes, participate in sprint ceremonies, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide on-call or flexible support during weekend or after-hours windows as needed for deployments or system maintenance.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data protection, and federal program standards.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or an Associates degree and 14 years of experience or a High School diploma/eqivalent and 16 years of experience.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing, writing, and optimizing SQL queries, stored procedures, and database scripts.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing relational database structures, including tables, schemas, and indexes.
  • Experience troubleshooting SQL performance issues, resolving data integrity issues, and supporting database development and optimization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting large-scale federal IT programs.
  • Familiarity with the SAFe Agile delivery framework.

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

The Lead Database Administrator is a senior member of the database team responsible for the advanced operational support, performance optimization, and architectural maintenance of the firm's database environments, including the legacy hub-and-spoke data distribution framework. This role independently resolves complex, high-impact issues, mentors other database administrators, and serves as a key technical escalation point for the team. The Lead Database Administrator also helps guide the team's transition toward cloud-native and modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks) as those initiatives mature.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex SQL Server performance, replication, availability, and database infrastructure issues, including support of the firm's hub-and-spoke data distribution framework.
  • Design, maintain, and enhance the firm's hub-and-spoke data distribution architecture, including staging tables, MERGE-based sync procedures, intermediary databases, and related SQL Server ETL/data integration solutions
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to Database Administrators through guidance on query tuning, performance optimization, ETL design, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Lead root cause analysis for recurring database issues, recommend long-term improvements, and participate in database capacity planning and infrastructure roadmap initiatives.
  • Develop, implement, and support enterprise reporting, data integration, and automation solutions using SSRS, SSIS, Visual Studio, PowerShell, and related SQL Server technologies.
  • Monitor, optimize, and maintain database performance, availability, backup and recovery, security, and disaster recovery technologies, including replication, log shipping, failover clustering, and SQL Server Availability Groups.
  • Perform SQL Server administration, including patching, cumulative updates, version upgrades, documentation, and support for Azure-based SQL Server environments.
  • Evaluate and support modernization initiatives by piloting Azure-native and Databricks-based solutions, including database migrations across on-premises and cloud environments in partnership with database leadership.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 on-call schedule and provide off-hours support as required to ensure the availability and reliability of critical database systems.

Required

Education and/or Experience:

descriptionHtml:
SQL DATABASE ADMINISTRATOR (SQL DBA)

$100,000-$110,000K Annual + Bonus Potential | Hybrid | Charlotte, NC

Your SQL expertise deserves to make an impact.

Looking for a role where you can solve challenging database problems, improve performance, collaborate directly with developers, and actually see the difference your work makes?

Meet Retirement Clearinghouse

A Charlotte Magazine top workplace for three consecutive years (2024-2026)!

At RCH, we use innovative technology to help millions of Americans preserve their retirement savings. We’re a collaborative team that values fresh ideas, technical excellence, work-life balance, and people who take pride in what they do.

As a SQL Database Administrator, you’ll play an important role in keeping our business-critical databases performing at their best. You’ll have opportunities to troubleshoot complex issues, tune queries, improve reliability, and work closely with our application support and development teams. As a key member of our technical team, you’ll help keep our databases secure, efficient, and dependable while supporting the applications our customers rely on.

What You Will Do

Solve real-world technical problems. Respond to technical requests from end users of RCH systems and products, investigate issues, analyze available data, and quickly identify root causes.

Manage SQL Server environments. Install, configure, and maintain SQL Server database environments.

Optimize database performance. Analyze execution plans, Dynamic Management Views (DMVs), and other diagnostic tools to identify bottlenecks and improve query performance, scalability, and efficiency.

Protect production performance. Review and tune queries flagged as potentially harmful to production systems, helping maintain stability, availability, and reliability.

Collaborate with developers and application support. Work directly with application support specialists and developers to implement database changes in accordance with company standards and change management policies.

Support quarterly releases. Partner with the application support team to prepare for and execute quarterly application releases.

Support SQL Server upgrades and improvements. Evaluate new SQL Server features, trace flags, and operational changes before database migrations and version upgrades.

Maintain clear technical documentation. Create and update database diagrams, operational procedures, data standards, data definitions, and reports.

  • Database performance analysis and tuning.
  • Backup and recovery practices.
  • Database security and access control.

  • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery and database modernization is desirable.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • At least 7 years of database administration experience.
  • At least 5 years of Microsoft SQL Server experience in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong SQL Server administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience supporting production databases and business-critical applications.
  • Experience with database backup and recovery.
  • Experience with database performance tuning.
  • Ability to successfully complete the Government-required criminal-history check, fingerprinting and badging process.


About TeleSolv:
Join the TeleSolv Team on our mission to provide quality and unparalleled service to our clients.   • Support audit readiness, compliance requirements, and security assessments for enterprise database environments.

In 1991, NASK connected Poland to the Internet. Since December 1993, NASK has been a research & development organization and a leading Polish data networks operator. We offer state-of-the-art telecommunications and data solutions to business, administration and academic customers. 

Comprehensive Solutions

The NASK integrated service package comprises broadband Internet access, corporate networks, data transmission, collocation and hosting, videoconference, as well as network security services. Corporate networks of international range are built in cooperation with global operator: BT INFONET.

Scientific Activity

We carry out scientific and research & development activities in cooperation with the Faculty of Electronics and Information Technology of Warsaw University of Technology. Our projects centre on telecommunications & data quality and security of IT systems, with a particular focus on biometric identification methods. We are an active member of many international organizations and associations and participate in European Union projects. 

Internet Domains

NASK is the Polish national registry of Internet names in the .pl domain. On the initiative of NASK, the Polish Chamber of Information Technology and Telecommunications has established a court of arbitration that mediates in Internet domain name cases.
www.dns.pl

CERT Polska

CERT Polska is the first Polish computer emergency response team. Active since 1996 in the response teams community, it has become a recognized and experienced entity in the field of computer security. Since its launch, the core of the team’s activity has been handling security incidents and cooperation with similar units worldwide. 
www.cert.pl

Dyżurnet

The Dyżurnet.pl team is a point of contact that has been functioning within the framework of NASK since 2005. It responds to anonymous reports received from Internet users about potentially illegal material, mainly related to sexual abuse of children.
www.dyzurnet.pl

Position: Principal Database Administrator / Lead DBA

Location: Beavercreek, OH Job Id: 600-3

# of Openings: 2 Principal Database Administrator / Lead DBA Location: Beavercreek, OH (Relocation assistance available) Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Active Top Secret to apply More about your role: At NASK, we’re growing, building great teams, and doing exciting work supporting the Intelligence and Defense communities. We are looking for an experienced Principal Database Administrator / Lead DBA who enjoys getting hands-on with complex database environments and taking ownership of their performance, reliability, security, and day-to-day operations. This role is ideal for a senior DBA who can troubleshoot challenging database issues, optimize performance at scale, and ensure critical data systems remain available, secure, and responsive. You will lead the administration, maintenance, monitoring, performance tuning, and optimization of enterprise database systems supporting demanding mission requirements. You’ll work directly with database engines, Linux environments, cloud infrastructure, and engineering teams to resolve issues, improve efficiency, plan capacity, and support evolving customer needs. The ideal candidate brings deep practical experience administering and tuning relational and NoSQL databases, managing high-availability environments, troubleshooting resource-intensive workloads, and supporting large-scale data platforms. You should be comfortable working at the command line, analyzing database performance, identifying bottlenecks across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, and implementing solutions that improve system stability and throughput. While this is primarily a hands-on DBA role, you will also contribute to database architecture, infrastructure planning, migrations, and modernization efforts. You’ll help establish database standards and best practices, guide technical decisions, and collaborate across engineering and systems teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, such as engineering, computer science, or information technology. * 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise database administration, operations, and performance engineering. * Strong experience installing, configuring, administering, maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise database systems. * Deep, hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning at least one enterprise database platform: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, or MongoDB. * Proven experience with database performance tuning, query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies, and identifying performance bottlenecks. * Strong SQL skills and a deep understanding of relational database concepts, schema design, transactions, and data integrity. * Experience managing database availability, replication, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity. * Experience monitoring database health, diagnosing production issues, resolving performance problems, and implementing preventive maintenance. * Experience administering databases in Linux/Unix environments, including command-line tools, scripting, and system-level troubleshooting. * Understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, I/O, networking, and database configuration affect performance and reliability. * Experience supporting large-scale databases, including multi-terabyte data environments, capacity planning, and growth management. * Experience administering high-availability or distributed database systems. * Experience deploying, operating, or monitoring databases in cloud or containerized environments, including Kubernetes. * Experience supporting database migrations, upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and platform modernization. * Ability to develop scripts or tools, preferably using Python on Linux, to automate database administration and operational tasks. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills. * Ability to communicate technical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications: * Security clearance: Active TS/SCI w/poly * Security+ (or higher) certification * Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications like Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, or AWS Certified Database * Operating system, networking, storage administration experience highly desired * Experience administering and supporting multiple database platforms across relational, NoSQL, and distributed database environments. * Experience/knowledge of C/C++ * Experience with cloud database technologies (AWS RDS, Oracle, MS SQL, Azure) * Familiarity with AWS Cloud products (EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda, Aurora, Dynamo DB, EMR, DMS data migration, Athena, Glue, Kinesis, SQS/SNS, etc.) * A strong understanding of the cloud computing model as it relates to enterprise productivity * Experience migrating large-scale legacy databases to modern, distributed architectures. Who we are: Our people are the core of who we are and what we do. NASK has two decades of experience delivering innovative solutions to the tough technical challenges facing our partners in the Intelligence and Defense communities. Our subject matter experts collaborate with junior developers and analysts, bringing fresh approaches to solve the toughest mission problems. Benefits: At NASK, our employees are the backbone of our company, so we provide unsurpassed benefits and work-life balance. Employees are provided with individual offices and collaboration spaces to foster individual and team success. We have a casual yet professional work environment – Employees work hard, and NASK offers a competitive benefits package that equates to 50% on top of your annual base salary. This is split between a tax-qualified profit-sharing retirement plan that NASK contributes to (up to allowable IRS limits) and a cafeteria plan for benefits. For a comprehensive overview of our benefits, visit the benefits tab under our careers page: https://nask.world/company/careers/ Compensation: NASK Incorporated considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the role and responsibilities, work experience, education, training, certifications, geographic location, and market data. These are general guidelines and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Please be aware that many of our positions require the ability to obtain or maintain a U.S security clearance which requires U.S citizenship. EEO Statement: **NASK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfers, leaves of absence, as well as compensation and training. ** MC08 600-2 Apply for this Position

The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for administering, securing, and optimizing Microsoft SQL Server databases running in a Windows ecosystem and across public cloud platforms. This role installs, configures, maintains, patches, and tunes databases and the underlying Windows and cloud infrastructure that support them; designs and enforces standards; performs backup and recovery and disaster-recovery planning and testing; provides Level-2/Level-3 escalation support for critical partner and internal applications; and designs and operates cloud and hybrid application architectures and database platforms. The Senior DBA collaborates with application developers, cloud and infrastructure engineers, storage, and network teams to ensure reliable, performant, secure, and cost-effective data platforms.

Your Core Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install, configure, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server instances and related components across Windows and cloud platforms.
  • Implement and enforce database security measures to protect data across on-prem and cloud deployments, including encryption, access controls, and cloud IAM integrations.
  • Monitor database performance, diagnose problems, and apply tuning, indexing, and query optimization to maintain application performance in both environments.
  • Perform backup and recovery operations; design and test DR plans using cloud provider capabilities (snapshots, managed backups, cross-region replication) and on-prem strategies.
  • Maintain and enforce standards for database environments and technical documentation; ensure cloud governance, tagging, and change management procedures are followed.
  • Provide Level-2/Level-3 escalation support and troubleshooting for production incidents and participate in an on-call rotation as required.
  • Collaborate with application and cloud/infrastructure teams to design cloud architectures, optimize database costs and performance, and support deployments.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Position Specific Job Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture & Operations: Design, implement, and operate database platforms across public clouds and hybrid architectures — selecting managed services, sizing instances, configuring networking, and implementing secure connectivity (VNet/VPC, private endpoints, peering, VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect).
  • Managed & Native Services: Operate and optimize managed cloud database services (Azure SQL, RDS/Aurora, Cloud SQL), NoSQL/document databases (Cosmos DB, DynamoDB), and analytics platforms (Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery). Implement best practices for scalability, availability, and cost.
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead and execute database migration efforts (assessment, schema/data migration, cutover, validation), refactoring where appropriate for cloud-native usage, and runbook updates post-migration.
  • Automation & IaC: Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation) and automations (PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI) to deploy, configure, and manage databases and related cloud infrastructure reproducibly.
  • Observability & Cost Management: Create monitoring and alerting (cloud native + SQL monitoring) and own cost governance for database workloads (rightsizing, autoscaling, and reserved instance/commitment strategies).
  • Security & Compliance: Implement cloud security controls, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, key management, IAM policies, and assist with compliance assessments and evidence collection.
  • Hybrid Operations: Manage hybrid topologies that span on-prem Windows servers and cloud services, orchestrate failover and DR between on-prem and cloud as needed, and ensure consistent configuration and documentation.
  • Collaboration & Leadership: Act as technical lead on cloud database projects, mentor junior staff, and work with application owners to migrate and modernize application database dependencies.

Flexibility, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Computing Services. Inclusion, collaboration, and cultural sensitivity are valued competencies at CMU. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Preferred - Master’s degree or advanced coursework in databases, cloud computing, systems, or information security.
  • 3–5 years of database administration experience and 3–5 years of systems administration experience in on-premise and public cloud vendor environments. Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Windows Server is required.

Type Of Required Experience

  • Hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration (installation, configuration, upgrades, patching) across on-prem and cloud-hosted deployments (e.g., SQL Server on Windows VMs, SQL Server in containers, SQL Server on Azure/AWS managed VMs).
  • Experience with container storage, cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob), monitoring and capacity planning tools, automation (PowerShell, Python, Ansible), and operational tooling (ServiceNow).
  • Experience with cloud-managed relational databases and cloud database paradigms, including but not limited to:
  • Managed relational: Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance, Amazon RDS / Aurora, Google Cloud SQL.
  • Data warehouse / analytics: Azure Synapse, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery.
  • NoSQL / document / key-value: Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DynamoDB, Cloud Firestore, or equivalent.
  • Caching & in-memory: Azure Cache for Redis, Amazon ElastiCache.
  • Proven experience with HA/DR and scaling in the cloud (multi-AZ, read replicas, geo-replication, managed backups, point-in-time restore, cross-region replication).
  • Experience with T-SQL development and debugging, query optimization, index design and maintenance, statistics and plan-analysis in both on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Experience with cloud application architectures: microservices, serverless, containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS/AKS/GKE), and patterns for connecting applications securely to databases (VPC/VNet, service endpoints, private link).
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation: Terraform, ARM templates, CloudFormation, Azure CLI / PowerShell / AWS CLI, CI/CD pipelines for database change management.
  • Experience with cloud networking and identity integration: VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, VPC/VNet design, Azure AD / IAM roles and policies, key management services and cloud KMS integration for encryption.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and cost governance in cloud: Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Stackdriver, cloud cost tools and tagging strategies.
  • Experience performing migrations from on-premises to cloud, hybrid configurations, lift-and-shift and refactor approaches, and validating performance and security after migration.
  • Familiarity with storage/IO tuning for cloud disks and cloud storage (managed disks, EBS, cloud file shares), and cloud backup/restore tooling and retention policies.
  • Experience with ITSM/change-management in cloud and hybrid environments, and with secure design practices and compliance controls for cloud data platforms.

Helpful: ITIL Foundation, security certifications (CompTIA Security+, CISSP).

Position Specific Licenses/Certifications

Preferred / Helpful Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Database Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Terraform Associate.

Physical And Mental Requirements

  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, pay attention to detail and maintain composure when dealing with difficult situations. Able to prioritize multiple tasks and work as part of a team.

Decision Making

  • Decisions affect operational reliability, cloud architecture choices, migration approaches, and cost/performance tradeoffs. Accountable for availability, integrity, recoverability, and cost efficiency of assigned database services.

Working Conditions

  • Normal office environment with flexibility for off-hours response for production incidents and participation in on-call rotations. Works with general direction and exercises independent judgment to implement cloud and on-prem solutions.

Accountability

  • Not responsible for formal supervision (Senior level) but provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff and contractors. Accountable for the successful completion of individual goals and priorities.

Direction

  • Receives little instruction on day-to-day work and receives general instructions on new assignments.

Supervision

  • Not responsible for supervising others.

Requirements

  • Successful background check.

  • Design, administer, and manage enterprise database environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, ensuring optimal performance, security, and availability.
  • Monitor and tune database systems to achieve maximum reliability and efficiency.
  • Investigate, evaluate, test, and implement state-of-the-art database technologies to support existing and future business needs.
  • Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot database environments to ensure uninterrupted service.
  • Establish and execute growth and capacity plans to support enterprise expansion.
  • Analyze and resolve complex database and production issues quickly and efficiently.
  • Participate in and support 24x7 on-call rotation to maintain system availability.
  • Identify potential system issues proactively and implement preventive solutions.
  • Coordinate disaster recovery processes and support business continuity initiatives.

Exceptional Skills And Qualifications

Applicants for this position should be able to collaborate with others in a team setting, have excellent communication skills, and a positive attitude toward problem-solving.

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Experience with Oracle Database administration or support is preferred but not required.
  • Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and security.
  • Experience supporting high-availability, mission-critical database systems.
  • Expert-level understanding of enterprise database technologies and performance capabilities.
  • Strong Microsoft SQL Server administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

Work Arrangement

  • This position will be a hybrid role if you reside within a 60-mile radius of 7260 Shadeland Station, Indianapolis, IN 46256. Hybrid expectations include in-office work once to twice a week and/or on an as needed basis per the needs of the hiring department.
  • This position will allow the flexibility to work remotely if you reside outside of the 60-mile radius parameter of 7260 Shadeland Station, Indianapolis, IN 46256. descriptionHtml:
Company Description

About Syngenta

At Syngenta Seeds Field Crops, we're shaping the future of agriculture and empowering farmers to meet the ever-growing demand for food and fuel. We’re a global Ag Tech powerhouse, headquartered in the United States, with passionate, local experts collaborating with farmers to deliver solutions that create market opportunities. Our seeds help mitigate risks such as disease, insect, weed, and extreme weather pressures, all while promoting sustainable farming practices that protect and enhance our planet. Join our mission of revolutionizing food security and transforming agriculture.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator in Durham, NC. In this role, you will be responsible for the administration, optimization, security, modernization, and strategic direction of enterprise database platforms that support critical applications and business processes. This role provides technical leadership for cloud-hosted and enterprise database environments and is accountable for improving availability, performance, scalability, cost efficiency, data protection, and long-term platform sustainability.

The successful candidate will partner with application teams, cloud engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate business and technical needs into practical database strategies, standards, modernization plans, and measurable delivery outcomes. This position combines hands-on database administration with strategic platform ownership, automation, governance, and cross-team execution.

Accountabilities

  • Administer, optimize, secure, and monitor enterprise database platforms across AWS-hosted and enterprise environments, including Amazon RDS, Aurora PostgreSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and related technologies.
  • Define database strategy, standards, governance, service catalog expectations, ownership metadata, operational documentation, and multi-year roadmaps aligned to business priorities, operational needs, and compliance requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex incidents and resolve performance, replication, connectivity, availability, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and reliability issues for mission-critical database services.
  • Lead database modernization initiatives from assessment through execution, including migration to cloud-native and managed database services and improvement of long-term platform sustainability.
  • Manage data sources, change data capture, replication, synchronization, transformation, data modeling, and normalization practices to support reliable data flow and trusted business outcomes.
  • Maintain security controls, encryption standards, access controls, vulnerability remediation, audit support, automation, change management, and operational standards for database environments.
  • Partner with application, cloud, infrastructure, vendor, and business teams while mentoring junior database administrators through coaching, standards, knowledge sharing, and practical database administration guidance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience administering enterprise database platforms in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud database services, including Amazon RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • Advanced SQL, database architecture, query execution plan analysis, indexing, partitioning, clustering, performance tuning, replication, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, data modeling, normalization, and roadmap execution expertise.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex application, database, and infrastructure issues supporting mission-critical services.
  • Experience with database monitoring, operational support, incident response, change management, and problem management processes.
  • Strong scripting, automation, analytical, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and independent execution skills, with the ability to work under minimal supervision and proficiency using database administration tools and utilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Oracle, MongoDB, and other database technologies beyond the core AWS, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server platforms.
  • Experience leading database migration and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Experience working with AWS infrastructure and cloud-native services.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Knowledge of database security, compliance, and governance best practices.
  • Experience supporting scientific, research, manufacturing, commercial, or other data-intensive business environments.
  • AWS or database-related professional certifications.

Additional Information

prosource.it is a global IT Managed Service provider working with Medium to Enterprise level, global clients and looking for a Senior SQL Database Administrator who is interested in joining a global, enterprise level team who are delivering technical solutions to our internal business partners to drive processes and meet business requirements.

We understand that we need exceptional talent to accomplish our mission - therefore we place great emphasis on the people component of IT, and we strive constantly to attract, develop, and retain the best people. We cultivate an ethos and environment within which our people are focused, nurtured, and continually challenged to develop and improve their competencies in a fun and rewarding culture. 

 

OVERVIEW:

We are looking to hire a skilled senior-level SQL Server Database Administratorto join an established team, that supports one of our major oil and gas customers. The successful candidate will be expected to join the team onsite at the downtown Houston office. However, there is an opportunity for some remote work.

The candidate will have extensive knowledge and experience in SQL Server administration in Microsoft Azure and on-premises environments and understand IT and software development life cycle processes. The successful candidate will manage all aspects of database administration in a single and clustering environment including but not limited to planning, installation, configuration, security configuration, backup and restore, optimization, and monitoring of SQL Server databases.

Requirements


·       Design and implement fault-tolerant SQL Server solutions using highly availability patterns for scalability and stability in on-premises and Microsoft Azure

·       Design and deploy Microsoft SQL PaaS solutions in Microsoft Azure

·       Monitor and maintain database storage, and database health, performance, sustainability and security

·       Monitor and maintain SQL server Mirroring, Log shipping, backups, ETL SSIS jobs, and encryption

·       Provide SQL Server administration in MS SQL Server 2016, 2017 and/or 2019

·       Plan and implement database backup strategies and perform recovery in case of disaster

·       Analyze SQL query plans, suggest and implement solutions to support developers in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

·       Install, configure and upgrade database management systems and software including clustering environment

Qualifications:

·       BS degree in Computer Science or Information Technology; an advanceddegree is preferred

·       A minimum of seven (7) years of experience in the management and administration of enterprise level SQL databases in SQL Server 2016 or 2017    

·       Experience designing fault-tolerant MS SQL solutions

·       A minimum of three (3) years of experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).

·       A minimum of seven (7) years of experience with the planning and implementation of MS SQL database disaster recovery for enterprise level application

·       Knowledge of physical database design, database changes, enforcement of data integrity, and security management

·       Knowledge of query languages, T-SQL

·       Ability to troubleshoot and fix issues, and work well across functional teams

·       Ability to install, configure and patch database management systems and software  

·       Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative, teamwork and problem solving

·       Strong attention to detail, and good oral and written communication skills 

BENEFICIAL BUT NOT REQUIRED

·       Knowledge of PowerShell DSC is preferred

·       Knowledge of Power BI is preferred

·       Experience on SQL Server 2019 Administration is preferred

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

 

Location:                   Houston, Texas (DOWNTOWN)

Model:                        Hybrid. However, required to be primarily onsite.

Start Date:                 Monday 4th January 2027

Engagement:           W2 Salary (Exempt from OT)

Salary:                        $120k-$156K depending on experience


Benefits

To all our full-time staff members, we provide an exceptional benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, long term disability, short term disability, 401k contribution, paid holidays, and PTO.

Summary Of This Role

Plans Db2 for z/os databases, including base definition, structure, documentation, long-range requirements, operational guidelines and protection. Ensures accuracy, completeness and availability of data using various IBM support tools. Establishes and maintains security and integrity controls. Formulates and monitors policies, procedures and standards relating to database management. Proposes and implements enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system. Researches and resolves database issues. The Lead DBA has more knowledge and experience in the inner mechanics of Db2, & who talks with IBM on DB2 issues. The Lead will be involved in mentoring and passing on that knowledge to less experienced DBAs

What Part Will You Play?

  • Performs testing of database software, IBM utilities and fixes within a test (sandbox) environment prior to production roll out. Identifies and resolves issues while in the sandbox and upper environments. Performs the migration of tested/approved structures, utilities, and fixes to the production environment. Develops basic to moderately complex database configurations by creating database objects per specified business requirements according to standards and the necessary sandbox environments for testing. Works in close liaison with application developers and tech support to ensure best practices are applied to mitigate potential impacts or risks to the various user groups and/or other database configurations
  • Coaches less experienced Database Administrators (DBAs) as they begin to perform routine/basic database administration tasks
  • Schedules database tasks and ensures proper completion of scheduled tasks
  • Execute database recovery tasks during a disaster recovery scenario and/or disaster recovery exercise
  • Improve the reliability and efficiency of database processes and services
  • Ensure the high availability of the supported database(s) by actively monitoring database performance to identify bottlenecks, such as inefficient queries, inconsistent and/or corrupt indexes, database design, and provide recommendations for corrective actions
  • Applies routine database tuning and optimization techniques, such as rebuilding indexes, to maintain database performance. Monitor database statistic reporting on a regularly scheduled basis
  • Works closely with the Applications Team while performing troubleshooting to determine the source of application failures. Assists in the development of solutions to minimize the potential of future application failures. Supports the implementation of solutions
  • Produces and maintains operational database documentation, such as Disaster Recovery, Recovery Presentation, Naming Standards, Performance and Tuning, to ensure database configurations are well documented in preparation for disaster recovery
  • Assists in the training and familiarization of less experienced team members regarding company policies and procedures, techniques and current server/database configurations
  • Participate in Oncall rotation and occasional outages

Minimum Qualifications

  • Relevant Experience
  • Typically, Minimum 8-10 Years Relevant Exp in Db2 for z/os
  • Installation, customization, testing, and maintenance of database systems within a production environment
  • Critical thinking leading to solution-oriented approaches
  • Takes the initiative to work a task or issue
  • Operates independently who owns the task at hand
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate across technical teams and application teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • LUW Db2 experience is a plus
  • Programming, operations or tech support experience is a plus

What We Offer You

A career at FIS is more than just a job. It’s the change to shape the future of fintech. At FIS, we offer you~

  • A voice in the future of fintech
  • Always-on learning and development
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Opportunities to give back
  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Consult with developers and stakeholders to ensure optimal database usage.
  • Implement event triggers, stored procedures, and performance alerts.
  • Monitor transaction volumes, concurrency, response times, and other performance indicators.
  • Perform housekeeping tasks such as tuning, indexing, and data cleanup.

  • Hands-on experience with database management systems (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, database architecture, backup/recovery, and security best practices.
  • Experience with cloud database technologies (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Cloud SQL).
  • Experience with performance tuning, query optimization, and capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with programming languages, APIs, and database design principles.
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking with attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of compliance-heavy environments (healthcare, finance, government).

Position Summary

Responsible for maintaining and supporting the relational database systems in Linux and Microsoft Windows environments. The Senior Database Administrator is an integral part of the Information Technology Department and is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the corporation’s electronic data. The Senior Database Administrator must maintain highly available, stable, secure and recoverable databases.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

All duties and responsibilities are to be performed in accordance with VITAS Healthcare Corporation’s policies, procedures, guidelines, contractual commitments and governmental regulations.


  • Maintain stable test, training, reporting and production database environments.
  • Provide on-call support and for the timely and accurate resolution of problems for all non-development database systems.
  • Participate in all phases of projects that interact with the database systems.
  • Work with application programmers on the use of database tools, techniques and concepts.
  • Assist application developers with writing efficient SQL.
  • Plan, install, coordinate and implement programs, interfaces, scripts, products and tools that ease the administration and monitoring of databases.
  • Develop and maintain standards to effectively monitor system performance.
  • Maintain adequate backups of all critical databases according to disaster recovery procedures.
  • Keep current on all new DBMS releases to exploit new functionality.

descriptionHtml:

Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

descriptionHtml:
About SkyWest

SkyWest is the largest regional airline in the United States and partners with four major airline carriers. More importantly, we’re known for our reliability, service, and our professional employees who operate flights each day throughout North America. We have been esteemed as one of America’s Best Employers by Forbes and are known for an industry-leading workforce, an exceptional leadership team, and our continued solid operational and economic performance.

SkyWest employees enjoy a distinctive and unmatched culture of teamwork, respect, quality, and professionalism, along with world-class benefits such as:

  • 401(k) match
  • Performance Rewards and Profit Sharing
  • Health care (medical, dental, and vision)
  • Discounted worldwide flight benefits and free on available open seating for you and your family with four of our major airlines (Delta, United, Alaska, and American)

Primary Job Duties

  • Administers, maintains, and supports Microsoft SQL Server database environments used throughout SkyWest Airlines.
  • Designs and maintains SQL Server architecture standards to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Develops and executes database capacity planning strategies to support current and future business growth.
  • Designs, implements, and supports High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions, including failover and recovery procedures.
  • Monitors database performance and proactively identifies opportunities for optimization and improvement.
  • Creates, maintains, and optimizes database objects including tables, views, indexes, functions, and stored procedures.
  • Performs performance tuning and query optimization for business-critical applications.
  • Installs, configures, upgrades, and patches SQL Server environments.
  • Collaborates with software developers, infrastructure teams, and business partners to design and support database solutions.
  • Leads database migrations, upgrades, and implementation projects.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves complex database and application performance issues.
  • Develops and maintains technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Ensures database environments comply with company security, governance, and retention requirements.
  • Provides support for production systems and participates in after-hours maintenance and support activities as required

Minimum Requirements

  • Four-year Computer Science, Computer Information Services, Information Systems, or related degree
  • OR 5+ years experience as a SQL Server Database Administrator
  • Minimum 2 years experience preferred
  • Microsoft SQL Server Certifications preferred

Physical And Other Requirements

  • Sitting for long periods of time
  • Position in SGU
  • This is not a Department of Transportation safety-sensitive position.

Role Overview:


  • The person will be part of the Global Technology team supporting database platforms and data infrastructure for a leading client. The role will be responsible for administering, optimizing, and modernizing enterprise database environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  • The individual will work closely with Data Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Application Development, and Business teams to ensure database performance, availability, scalability, and security.
  • The position will play a key role in cloud migration initiatives, database modernization programs, and operational excellence efforts.
  • The candidate should have 5+ years of experience in SQL Server Database Administration with strong expertise in cloud database technologies and automation.
  • Experience in Insurance, Financial Services, or highly regulated environments is preferred but not mandatory.


Key Responsibilities & Skillsets:


  • Common Skillsets:
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to independently manage technical issues and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives while maintaining operational stability.


Database Administration & Cloud Technologies

  • Administer and support SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Manage cloud database platforms including Azure SQL, AWS RDS, and Snowflake.
  • Lead migration of SQL Server workloads from on-premises environments to cloud platforms.
  • Design and implement highly available, scalable, and secure database solutions.
  • Configure and manage SQL Server replication technologies including transactional, snapshot, and merge replication.
  • Develop, test, and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Implement database monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and performance optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure adherence to database security standards including encryption, auditing, and role-based access controls.
  • Support data warehousing and analytics workloads within cloud database environments.


Performance Engineering & Automation

  • Analyze and optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, and workload management.
  • Monitor database health and proactively identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Automate routine database administration tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or related scripting tools.
  • Utilize version control and deployment best practices through Git-based workflows.
  • Implement operational best practices to improve platform reliability, resiliency, and efficiency.


Cloud Cost Optimization & Governance

  • Monitor database infrastructure utilization and cloud consumption.
  • Provide recommendations for rightsizing resources and optimizing cloud expenditures.
  • Establish governance standards and best practices for database operations and cloud database management.
  • Support compliance requirements and audit readiness initiatives.


Collaboration & Architecture

  • Partner with Data Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams to define database strategies and platform roadmaps.
  • Contribute to architectural reviews and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Mentor team members and promote database administration best practices.
  • Support strategic planning and continual improvement of enterprise data platforms.



Candidate Profile:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline preferred.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in SQL Server Database Administration.
  • Proven experience managing production database environments supporting enterprise applications.
  • Experience migrating SQL Server workloads to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Strong experience in performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting both on-premises and cloud-based database solutions.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.


Technical Skills:

  • Microsoft SQL Server Administration.
  • T-SQL Development and Query Optimization.
  • Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance.
  • AWS RDS for SQL Server.
  • Database Replication Technologies.
  • Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR).
  • Database Security, Encryption, and Access Management.
  • PowerShell, Python, and Bash Scripting.
  • Git and Source Control Management.
  • Snowflake (preferred).
  • Docker and Kubernetes (preferred).

descriptionHtml:
Brief Description

About GoAuto Insurance

GoAuto is a Louisiana-headquartered personal auto insurance company with operations spanning eight states, 68 branch locations, and approximately 440 employees. Our mission is simple: to make auto insurance accessible and affordable for everyone.

As we continue to grow, we are investing in the technology, systems, and talent that support our operations and deliver reliable service to our customers. Data plays a critical role in every aspect of our business, from quotes and policy administration to claims processing. As a Database Administrator, you will play an essential role in maintaining the security, integrity, performance, and reliability of the data and systems our employees and customers depend on every day.

Position Summary

GoAuto Insurance is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator to own the availability, performance, security, and recoverability of the Microsoft SQL Server environments that run our policy administration, claims, premium finance, and reporting systems.

This is a hands-on senior role with broad ownership, spanning day-to-day administration, database security, performance, and the reporting data layer. The person in this role will set the standards for how database work is done here and will be the company's primary technical authority on the database environment.

As an auto insurance organization operating across eight states, our data supports underwriting and rating decisions, claim handling, regulatory filings, and financial reporting. Database integrity, availability, and security are business-critical, and this role is central to all three.

Key Responsibilities

Availability, Backup, and Recovery

  • Own the backup strategy across production and non-production database instances, including full, differential, and transaction log backups aligned to recovery point and recovery time objectives
  • Own scheduled restore testing and document that backups are recoverable
  • Own high availability and disaster recovery for the database environment, selecting and maintaining the appropriate technologies
  • Plan and lead failover exercises, and document results and follow-up items
  • Participate in on-call response for database incidents; lead root cause analysis and post-incident documentation

Database Security and Access Administration

  • Own database security administration, including logins, roles, permissions, and periodic least-privilege access reviews
  • Implement and maintain encryption at rest and in transit, and evaluate data masking or tokenization where appropriate
  • Configure and maintain database-level auditing sufficient to support internal control reviews and state Department of Insurance examinations
  • Support the company's information security program as it applies to database systems, including controls for nonpublic personal information under the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act safeguards requirements and the insurance data security laws of the states in which GoAuto operates
  • Define and enforce data retention and secure disposal practices for database systems, in coordination with Compliance and Legal
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on database security in audits, examinations, and vendor security reviews

Performance, Capacity, and Platform Modernization

  • Own database monitoring and alerting, including performance baselines for CPU, memory, I/O, blocking, deadlocks, and wait statistics
  • Analyze and tune slow-running queries and stored procedures using execution plans, statistics, and query store
  • Own index strategy, including design, maintenance, fragmentation management, and removal of unused or duplicate indexes
  • Perform capacity planning for storage and compute growth, and communicate infrastructure needs ahead of constraints
  • Lead database version upgrades and cloud or hybrid migrations as needed, including assessment, compatibility testing, cutover planning, and rollback strategy

Data, Reporting, and Integration

  • Own the reporting and analytics data layer, including any data warehouse, data marts, and reporting databases
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL and data integration processes using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent
  • Support Power BI and other reporting platforms as the owner of data sources, refresh schedules, and semantic model performance
  • Partner with business analysts and business owners to ensure reporting data is accurate, timely, and reconcilable to source systems
  • Support data extracts required for statistical reporting, state filings, carrier and reinsurer reporting, vendor integrations, and audit requests
  • Own data quality and reconciliation controls

Standards, Documentation, and Technical Leadership

  • Maintain the inventory of database instances, databases, and their business owners
  • Own and enforce database standards covering naming conventions, change control, schema versioning, and promotion through development, test, and production environments
  • Review and approve database changes proposed by application developers, including schema changes, stored procedures, and query patterns
  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation for critical database procedures
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to developers and analysts on database design, query efficiency, and safe data handling
  • Advise leadership on database architecture, licensing, and infrastructure investment

Required Qualifications

  • Seven or more years of hands-on database administration in a production environment, with deep Microsoft SQL Server experience
  • Demonstrated ownership of backup and recovery, including documented experience performing real restores and recovering from failure
  • Direct experience implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery solutions
  • Strong performance tuning skills: execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, wait statistics, and resolution of blocking and deadlocking
  • Hands-on experience administering database security, permissions, encryption, and auditing
  • Experience migrating or upgrading SQL Server across major versions, and experience with cloud or hybrid database platforms such as Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Advanced T-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, and production troubleshooting
  • Experience with ETL development and maintenance, such as SSIS or Azure Data Factory
  • Experience supporting a business intelligence or reporting platform as a data source owner
  • Proven ability to work in a regulated environment subject to audit or examination
  • Strong written documentation skills; able to produce runbooks and procedures others can follow
  • Ability to communicate database risk and status clearly to non-technical business leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience administering PostgreSQL or MySQL in addition to Microsoft SQL Server
  • Experience in insurance, particularly personal auto, or another regulated financial services environment
  • Familiarity with policy administration, claims, billing, or premium finance systems
  • Understanding of insurance data concepts such as policy lifecycle, claim reserves, premium transactions, and statistical reporting
  • Experience supporting Department of Insurance examinations or similar regulatory reviews
  • Familiarity with the NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or comparable state insurance data security requirements
  • PowerShell scripting for database automation
  • Microsoft certification in database administration, data engineering, or Azure
  • Experience mentoring developers or leading a small technical team

As we continue to grow, we are investing in the technology, systems, and talent that support our operations and deliver reliable service to our customers. Data plays a critical role in every aspect of our business, from quotes and policy administration to claims processing. As a Database Administrator, you will play an essential role in maintaining the security, integrity, performance, and reliability of the data and systems our employees and customers depend on every day.

Position Summary

GoAuto Insurance is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator to own the availability, performance, security, and recoverability of the Microsoft SQL Server environments that run our policy administration, claims, premium finance, and reporting systems.

This is a hands-on senior role with broad ownership, spanning day-to-day administration, database security, performance, and the reporting data layer. The person in this role will set the standards for how database work is done here and will be the company's primary technical authority on the database environment.

As an auto insurance organization operating across eight states, our data supports underwriting and rating decisions, claim handling, regulatory filings, and financial reporting. Database integrity, availability, and security are business-critical, and this role is central to all three.

Key Responsibilities

Availability, Backup, and Recovery



-  Own the backup strategy across production and non-production database instances, including full, differential, and transaction log backups aligned to recovery point and recovery time objectives
-  Own scheduled restore testing and document that backups are recoverable
-  Own high availability and disaster recovery for the database environment, selecting and maintaining the appropriate technologies
-  Plan and lead failover exercises, and document results and follow-up items
-  Participate in on-call response for database incidents; lead root cause analysis and post-incident documentation

Database Security and Access Administration



-  Own database security administration, including logins, roles, permissions, and periodic least-privilege access reviews
-  Implement and maintain encryption at rest and in transit, and evaluate data masking or tokenization where appropriate
-  Configure and maintain database-level auditing sufficient to support internal control reviews and state Department of Insurance examinations
-  Support the company's information security program as it applies to database systems, including controls for nonpublic personal information under the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act safeguards requirements and the insurance data security laws of the states in which GoAuto operates
-  Define and enforce data retention and secure disposal practices for database systems, in coordination with Compliance and Legal
-  Serve as the subject matter expert on database security in audits, examinations, and vendor security reviews

Performance, Capacity, and Platform Modernization



-  Own database monitoring and alerting, including performance baselines for CPU, memory, I/O, blocking, deadlocks, and wait statistics
-  Analyze and tune slow-running queries and stored procedures using execution plans, statistics, and query store
-  Own index strategy, including design, maintenance, fragmentation management, and removal of unused or duplicate indexes
-  Perform capacity planning for storage and compute growth, and communicate infrastructure needs ahead of constraints
-  Lead database version upgrades and cloud or hybrid migrations as needed, including assessment, compatibility testing, cutover planning, and rollback strategy

Data, Reporting, and Integration



-  Own the reporting and analytics data layer, including any data warehouse, data marts, and reporting databases
-  Design, build, and maintain ETL and data integration processes using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent
-  Support Power BI and other reporting platforms as the owner of data sources, refresh schedules, and semantic model performance
-  Partner with business analysts and business owners to ensure reporting data is accurate, timely, and reconcilable to source systems
-  Support data extracts required for statistical reporting, state filings, carrier and reinsurer reporting, vendor integrations, and audit requests
-  Own data quality and reconciliation controls

Standards, Documentation, and Technical Leadership



-  Maintain the inventory of database instances, databases, and their business owners
-  Own and enforce database standards covering naming conventions, change control, schema versioning, and promotion through development, test, and production environments
-  Review and approve database changes proposed by application developers, including schema changes, stored procedures, and query patterns
-  Maintain runbooks and operational documentation for critical database procedures
-  Provide technical direction and mentorship to developers and analysts on database design, query efficiency, and safe data handling
-  Advise leadership on database architecture, licensing, and infrastructure investment

Required Qualifications



-  Seven or more years of hands-on database administration in a production environment, with deep Microsoft SQL Server experience
-  Demonstrated ownership of backup and recovery, including documented experience performing real restores and recovering from failure
-  Direct experience implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery solutions
-  Strong performance tuning skills: execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, wait statistics, and resolution of blocking and deadlocking
-  Hands-on experience administering database security, permissions, encryption, and auditing
-  Experience migrating or upgrading SQL Server across major versions, and experience with cloud or hybrid database platforms such as Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance
-  Advanced T-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, and production troubleshooting
-  Experience with ETL development and maintenance, such as SSIS or Azure Data Factory
-  Experience supporting a business intelligence or reporting platform as a data source owner
-  Proven ability to work in a regulated environment subject to audit or examination
-  Strong written documentation skills; able to produce runbooks and procedures others can follow
-  Ability to communicate database risk and status clearly to non-technical business leadership

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience administering PostgreSQL or MySQL in addition to Microsoft SQL Server
-  Experience in insurance, particularly personal auto, or another regulated financial services environment
-  Familiarity with policy administration, claims, billing, or premium finance systems
-  Understanding of insurance data concepts such as policy lifecycle, claim reserves, premium transactions, and statistical reporting
-  Experience supporting Department of Insurance examinations or similar regulatory reviews
-  Familiarity with the NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or comparable state insurance data security requirements
-  PowerShell scripting for database automation
-  Microsoft certification in database administration, data engineering, or Azure
-  Experience mentoring developers or leading a small technical team
