descriptionHtml:
Established in 2018, Clicklease is dedicated to empowering small business owners frequently overlooked by traditional lenders. Our headquarters are located in the vibrant city of Draper, UT, with operations extending to Radial, Alajuela, Costa Rica. We've cultivated a dynamic environment where equipment financing goes beyond being a mere service; it acts as the gateway to realizing entrepreneurial dreams.

Our Core Values:

  • We Are A Happy Company: At Clicklease, happiness is not just a byproduct; it's a fundamental value. Join a workplace where positivity and joy are cultivated, creating an environment where you can bring your best self to work every day.
  • We Celebrate Collective Intelligence: We thrive on the brilliance of collaboration. Clicklease is a space where diverse minds come together, combining their intelligence to create solutions that matter. Your ideas are not just heard; they're celebrated.
  • We Practice Empathy: Empathy isn't just a word in our dictionary; it's a daily practice. Join a team that values understanding and compassion. At Clicklease, we recognize the human side of business and foster a culture where empathy is a guiding principle.
  • We Listen & Learn: Growth is a continuous journey at Clicklease. We believe in listening and learning from one another. Your insights and experiences contribute to our collective knowledge, making us stronger as a team.

Our Mission:

At Clicklease, we have a clear purpose - to fulfill the capital needs of underserved entrepreneurs and their Main Street Businesses. We achieve this mission through simple, fast, and innovative equipment leasing solutions. This is not just a statement; it's the driving force behind everything we do.

As a member of our Data Engineering team, you’ll be a technical owner of the databases that power our lending platform, risk and decisioning systems, and customer-facing services. You’ll work alongside our DBA and Data Engineers, in close partnership with our DevOps team, who own our cloud infrastructure, to keep production databases fast, secure, and reliable.

Our databases are self-hosted on AWS EC2: Microsoft SQL Server with a failover replica, and PostgreSQL in a primary/replica configuration, alongside Snowflake as our data warehouse. We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in SQL Server or PostgreSQL and strong hands-on experience with the other.

You won’t just keep the lights on. You’ll help shape how we build, deploy, and operate our data platform, including bringing our database tooling under infrastructure-as-code.

What You'll Be Doing

Keep Our Databases Available & Recoverable

  • Keep production databases stable and resilient, with reliable failover, replication, and disaster-recovery plans.
  • Own backup and recovery strategy and automate regular testing of restores and failover.
  • Refresh non-production environments from production data safely and repeatably.

Drive Performance & Scalability

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune database performance, from queries and indexes to server and instance configuration.
  • Partner with engineers on schema design, query optimization, and efficient data processing.
  • Plan for capacity and growth before they become problems.

Operate & Monitor Production

  • Build and maintain monitoring, dashboards and alerting that surface issues early.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, responding to and resolving database incidents, then following up with fixes that prevent repeats.
  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade self-hosted database servers on EC2, using scripted, repeatable processes.

Protect Sensitive Financial Data

  • Manage access using least-privilege principles, and audit roles and permissions regularly.
  • Implement encryption, secure connections, and auditing to protect sensitive financial and personal data.

Improve How We Ship Database Changes

  • Review and deploy database changes and maintain and enforce best practices for database deployments.
  • Improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines for database changes, making releases safer, faster, more automated, and SOC 2 compliant.
  • Write and review production data fixes with care.
  • Automate routine tasks with Python and scripting and keep runbooks and documentation current.

Support Engineering & Data Teams

  • Provision new databases as new services come online.
  • Support data engineering pipelines, including AWS DMS replication and orchestration, that move operational data into Snowflake.
  • Help developers with database access, troubleshooting, and best practices.

Use AI to Work Better & Faster

  • Use modern AI tools and agents to accelerate performance analysis, troubleshooting, scripting, and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve database operations and reliability.
  • Share effective AI workflows and techniques with the team.

Improve How We Ship Database Changes

  • Bring our AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) resources, including replication instances, endpoints, and tasks, under infrastructure-as-code with Terraform.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on the EC2 instances, storage, and networking for our databases.
  • Build repeatable, automated processes for database provisioning, patching, and failover.

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of administering SQL Server or PostgreSQL in production, with strong hands-on skills in the other.
  • High availability, disaster recovery, and backup/restore, including failover replicas, streaming replication, and point-in-time recovery.
  • Running self-hosted databases on AWS EC2 and Linux, in partnership with DevOps.
  • Performance tuning and query optimization, plus strong T-SQL and SQL, including stored procedures and functions.
  • Instance configuration, security, roles, and routine maintenance across both engines.
  • Automation with Python and working knowledge of PowerShell and Bash, using Git-based workflows with code review and staged deployments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a calm approach to production incidents.
  • Strong written communication for runbooks, documentation, and tickets.
  • Using AI-assisted tools for database analysis and operations.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Designing database architecture that scales with the business, such as partitioning, read scaling, and capacity planning.
  • Windows Server administration in support of SQL Server and its services.
  • Monitoring and observability with tools like Zabbix and Grafana.
  • Building or improving CI/CD pipelines for database changes.
  • Terraform, especially bringing existing resources under infrastructure-as-code.
  • AWS DMS or other change-data-capture and replication tools.
  • Data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), ETL/ELT pipelines, or workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Prefect, Airflow).
  • Supporting SOC 2 or similar compliance audits.
  • Fintech, lending, payments, banking, or another highly regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like

You'll Be Successful When

  • Our databases are stable, fast, and recover predictably when something goes wrong.
  • Performance problems are caught early and fixed at the root.
  • Database changes ship safely and routinely through automated pipelines.
  • Database infrastructure is defined in code, and changes are repeatable and reviewable.
  • Access to sensitive data is controlled and auditable.
  • Engineers trust the data platform and know where to go for help.
  • Database knowledge is documented and shared rather than concentrated with a few individuals.

The Person We're Looking For

You are an owner first.

You enjoy digging into execution plans and wait stats, but you also understand that the goal is reliable systems for the business.

You think about what happens when a server fails, a restore is needed, or a deployment goes wrong, not just when everything works.

You’d rather automate a task than do it twice.

Most importantly, you want the systems you run to keep performing reliably and scale as Clicklease grows.

We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in SQL Server or PostgreSQL and strong hands-on experience with the other.

You won’t just keep the lights on. You’ll help shape how we build, deploy, and operate our data platform, including bringing our database tooling under infrastructure-as-code.

What You'll Be Doing

Keep Our Databases Available & Recoverable



- Keep production databases stable and resilient, with reliable failover, replication, and disaster-recovery plans.
- Own backup and recovery strategy and automate regular testing of restores and failover.
- Refresh non-production environments from production data safely and repeatably.

Drive Performance & Scalability



- Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune database performance, from queries and indexes to server and instance configuration.
- Partner with engineers on schema design, query optimization, and efficient data processing.
- Plan for capacity and growth before they become problems.

Operate & Monitor Production



- Build and maintain monitoring, dashboards and alerting that surface issues early.
- Participate in an on-call rotation, responding to and resolving database incidents, then following up with fixes that prevent repeats.
- Install, configure, patch, and upgrade self-hosted database servers on EC2, using scripted, repeatable processes.

Protect Sensitive Financial Data



- Manage access using least-privilege principles, and audit roles and permissions regularly.
- Implement encryption, secure connections, and auditing to protect sensitive financial and personal data.

Improve How We Ship Database Changes



- Review and deploy database changes and maintain and enforce best practices for database deployments.
- Improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines for database changes, making releases safer, faster, more automated, and SOC 2 compliant.
- Write and review production data fixes with care.
- Automate routine tasks with Python and scripting and keep runbooks and documentation current.

Support Engineering & Data Teams



- Provision new databases as new services come online.
- Support data engineering pipelines, including AWS DMS replication and orchestration, that move operational data into Snowflake.
- Help developers with database access, troubleshooting, and best practices.

Use AI to Work Better & Faster



- Use modern AI tools and agents to accelerate performance analysis, troubleshooting, scripting, and documentation.
- Identify opportunities where AI can improve database operations and reliability.
- Share effective AI workflows and techniques with the team.

Improve How We Ship Database Changes



- Bring our AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) resources, including replication instances, endpoints, and tasks, under infrastructure-as-code with Terraform.
- Collaborate with DevOps on the EC2 instances, storage, and networking for our databases.
- Build repeatable, automated processes for database provisioning, patching, and failover.

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of administering SQL Server or PostgreSQL in production, with strong hands-on skills in the other.
- High availability, disaster recovery, and backup/restore, including failover replicas, streaming replication, and point-in-time recovery.
- Running self-hosted databases on AWS EC2 and Linux, in partnership with DevOps.
- Performance tuning and query optimization, plus strong T-SQL and SQL, including stored procedures and functions.
- Instance configuration, security, roles, and routine maintenance across both engines.
- Automation with Python and working knowledge of PowerShell and Bash, using Git-based workflows with code review and staged deployments.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and a calm approach to production incidents.
- Strong written communication for runbooks, documentation, and tickets.
- Using AI-assisted tools for database analysis and operations.

What Will Make You Stand Out



- Designing database architecture that scales with the business, such as partitioning, read scaling, and capacity planning.
- Windows Server administration in support of SQL Server and its services.
- Monitoring and observability with tools like Zabbix and Grafana.
- Building or improving CI/CD pipelines for database changes.
- Terraform, especially bringing existing resources under infrastructure-as-code.
- AWS DMS or other change-data-capture and replication tools.
- Data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), ETL/ELT pipelines, or workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Prefect, Airflow).
- Supporting SOC 2 or similar compliance audits.
- Fintech, lending, payments, banking, or another highly regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like

You'll Be Successful When



- Our databases are stable, fast, and recover predictably when something goes wrong.
- Performance problems are caught early and fixed at the root.
- Database changes ship safely and routinely through automated pipelines.
- Database infrastructure is defined in code, and changes are repeatable and reviewable.
- Access to sensitive data is controlled and auditable.
- Engineers trust the data platform and know where to go for help.
- Database knowledge is documented and shared rather than concentrated with a few individuals.

The Person We're Looking For

You are an owner first.

You enjoy digging into execution plans and wait stats, but you also understand that the goal is reliable systems for the business.

You think about what happens when a server fails, a restore is needed, or a deployment goes wrong, not just when everything works.

You’d rather automate a task than do it twice.

Most importantly, you want the systems you run to keep performing reliably and scale as Clicklease grows.

Requisition Id 17431

Overview

We seek an experienced Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA)/Developer for the Neutrons Systems Engineering and Support group to design, maintain and optimize our Oracle database environment. The Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group provides technical expertise and computing support to Neutron Science Directorates (NScD) and the Neutron Upgrades Project Office (NUPO). NScD operates the High Flux Isotope Reactor (HFIR) and the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS), the world’s most powerful pulsed accelerator-based neutron source.

As a DBA/developer, you are responsible for a deep administrative expertise with strong development skills making it ideal for someone who can architect reliable data solutions while collaborating closely with our end users, application developers, and infrastructure teams.

This position reports directly to the Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group lead, in the Research Computing Support Division (RSCD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).

What We're Looking For

A self-motivated professional who takes ownership of database reliability and application delivery, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and brings a continuous improvement mindset to everything they do.

Major Duties/Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Database environments (19c/26ai preferred) in both standalone and Oracle Database Appliance environments.
  • Design, develop, and optimize PL/SQL stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and views.
  • Design, develop, and deploy low-code web applications using Oracle APEX, including custom themes, interactive reports, forms, and REST-enabled data services.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional APEX applications.
  • Manage APEX workspaces, application security, and user access controls.
  • Integrate APEX applications with external systems via RESTful web services and Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Maintain and upgrade APEX environments across development, test, and production instances.
  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and query optimization using tools such as AWR, ADDM, and Explain Plan.
  • Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN; ensure RPO/RTO targets are met.
  • Implement and maintain Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and/or ASM environments.
  • Monitor database health, availability, and security; respond to and resolve incidents.
  • Develop and enforce database standards, naming conventions, and change management procedures.
  • Collaborate with developers to review schema designs, indexing strategies, and data models.
  • Support data migrations and integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical database support, as needed.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications

  • A BS in information technology, information systems, computer science, computer engineering, business, science, or a related field of study and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of Oracle DBA/Developer experience in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development and SQL tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications in Oracle APEX (version 22.x or later preferred).
  • Proficiency with ORDS for REST API development and deployment.
  • Familiarity with APEX security models, session state, and authentication schemes.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle security best practices (roles, privileges, auditing, TDE).
  • Experience with Oracle 19c or later.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix system administration in a database context.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with APEX plug-ins, Universal Theme customization, and JavaScript/CSS extensions.
  • Oracle APEX certification or demonstrated portfolio of delivered APEX applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible).
  • Knowledge of complementary databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) a plus.
  • Experience working at a high energy physics facility or DOE lab.

Special Requirements

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation.
  • To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

About ORNL

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

SR. Oracle Database Administrator - with TS Clearance and Security + certification

Location: Bellevue, NE (On-site 5 days a week)


The Senior Oracle Database Administrator will be responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Oracle database systems to ensure high performance, security, and availability. In this role, the Senior Database Administrator will design and implement database schemas, monitors database health, and performs routine backups and recovery operations to safeguard mission-critical data. Additionally, the Senior Database Administrator will troubleshoot database-related issues, manage user access and permissions, and optimize queries to enhance system performance. In this role, the individual will ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry standards while staying current on updates, patches, and advancements in Oracle technologies. The Database Admin will build, support, administer, and sustain a clustered-server database platform hosted in an enterprise IT environment. The Database Administrator will provide technical support for incident response, service degradations, outages, and other service interruptions. Investigate hardware and software problems related to the database-hosting infrastructure and perform corrective actions.


Major Activities (Typical Duties/Responsibilities)

  • Architects, designs, engineers, and document Oracle databases and associated infrastructure in clustered, stand-alone, and/or appliance-hosted configurations, which fulfill mission requirements, service specifications, and cyber security mandates
  • Investigates hardware and software problems related to the database-hosting infrastructure and perform corrective actions
  • Implements robust backup, restoration, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitors, fine-tune, and optimize database performance for minimal downtime and maximum efficiency
  • Establishes and enforces stringent database security protocols and access controls
  • Collaborate closely with application development teams to design and optimize Oracle databases.
  • Oracle RAC: Grid Infrastructure/ASM administration, installation, patching, configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Develops, executes and oversees data migration initiatives when required
  • Performance Tuning: AWR, ASH, statspack analysis, SQL tuning, optimizer statistics, and execution plan analysis
  • Data replication and migration: Oracle GoldenGate, Data Pump (expdp/impdp), and Data Guard
  • Spearheads scalability and high availability efforts for Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics, and other cloud-based databases while managing cloud resources and optimizing cost-effectiveness
  • Maintains comprehensive documentation detailing database configurations, procedures, and best practices
  • Regularly generates performance and usage reports to support informed decision-making
  • Drives problem resolution and root cause analysis across the technology stack
  • Participates in the resolution of database availability, capacity, and performance issues.
  • Participates in infrastructure and organizational initiatives across multiple IT disciplines.
  • Sustains fleet of physical and virtual database-hosting servers running a mix of operating systems (Open Systems and Windows Systems) in multiple network environments
  • Performs daily operations, onsite support, and on-call support for all aspects of database architecture, database platforms, and database management software
  • Works with original equipment manufacturers and/or third-party vendors to resolve performance degradations and outages
  • Supports and participates in projects relating to the move of systems and services to modernized hosting environments and Cloud capabilities
  • Provides expert advice on configuring database systems to meet the environment and boundary requirements and customize services to meet new performance goals.
  • Works with original equipment manufacturers and/or third-party vendors to resolve performance degradations and outages.
  • Supports and participates in projects relating to the move of systems and services to modernized hosting environments and Cloud capabilities
  • Provides expert advice on configuring database systems to meet the environment and boundary requirements and customize services to meet new performance goals.


Minimum Requirements

  • Must have an active Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Possesses a B.S. in a related field and 10+ years of database administration experience including experience with Oracle databases.
  • ITIL v4 Certification
  • Oracle Database Administration (12c-21c): Installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
  • A strong understanding of data and databases, Python, the ability to translate customer requirements, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Multitenant: Installation, configuration, patching, troubleshooting.
  • RMAN: Backup and recovery and recovery catalog management.
  • Automation & scripting: Shell (Bash), Ansible, and/or Perl.
  • Oracle Data Guard: Physical/logical standby implementation and failover/failback procedures.
  • Monitoring: Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) management, patching, and configuration.
  • Security & Compliance: TDE, auditing, and STIGs.
  • Oracle Apex: Installation, configuration, patching, and security.
  • ORDS: Installation, configuration, and patching.
  • OS: Linux navigation, vi, awk, sed, sudo/ksu, cron, top, sar, and parameter configurations for Oracle implementations.

Are you an experienced MySQL professional who enjoys solving complex database challenges? Are you skilled at improving performance, protecting critical data, and keeping database environments running reliably?

LCS is seeking a MySQL Database Administrator to develop, maintain, and optimize the databases that support our business-critical software. In this role, you will manage database architecture, configure database hosts, maintain access privileges, tune queries, and help ensure the security, availability, and reliable operation of our database servers. This is an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a collaborative technology environment while working with large-scale systems and modern database tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform day-to-day database administration, including designing, implementing, configuring, and maintaining MySQL databases.
  • Install, maintain, and configure MySQL database architecture and related systems.
  • Monitor database performance, security, integrity, and availability.
  • Manage database access and privileges to help ensure company information is stored securely.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain database backup and recovery processes.
  • Monitor server resource usage and troubleshoot performance or capacity concerns.
  • Analyze and optimize queries, indexes, configurations, and database processes.
  • Test new versions and features of MySQL and plan and execute database upgrades and migrations.
  • Configure and maintain database replication.
  • Automate routine database administration and maintenance tasks.

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data.   • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing

Requirements

Recommended Qualifications

  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)

Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to support a Department of War (DoW) agency. The DBA will be responsible for the design, implementation, security, performance, and maintenance of mission-critical database systems supporting analytics, reporting, and business process applications, as well as development and maintenance of the DSR Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Manual. This position requires a candidate with an active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph and demonstrated experience ranging from mid-level to advanced/top-tier DBA skill sets.

Location: Washington, D.C. (JBAB)

Compensation Range: The pay range for this position is $150,000-$165,000 annually. Kentro determines compensation by evaluating current government contracting and commercial market conditions, as well as the role’s specific requirements. Final salary placement within this range will be based on the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, location, and security clearance level, where applicable.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain relational database management systems (RDBMS) in a secure, classified environment.
  • Design and implement database schemas, indexing strategies, and data models to support application and analytics requirements.
  • Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize queries, stored procedures, and jobs for efficiency.
  • Perform routine backup, recovery, and disaster recovery testing to ensure data integrity and availability.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, including access permissions, encryption, and auditing, in accordance with DoW/IC security requirements (STIGs, RMF, ATO documentation).
  • Support data migrations, integrations, and ETL processes between systems.
  • Collaborate with developers, systems administrators, and data analysts to support dashboard and reporting tool requirements (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SharePoint-integrated data sources).
  • Develop and maintain documentation for database architecture, standard operating procedures, and configuration baselines.
  • Participate in capacity planning and forecasting for database growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Respond to and resolve database-related incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Support patching, vulnerability remediation, and compliance activities tied to program security requirements.
  • Develop and update the DSR Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Manual, drawing on demonstrated prior experience authoring procedure manuals for database systems.

Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph (required at time of application — non-negotiable).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience programming, operating, and maintaining databases.
  • Demonstrated prior experience and expertise in developing procedure/SOP manuals for database systems.
  • Proficiency with one or more RDBMS platforms: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Experience with database security hardening in accordance with DISA STIGs.
  • Solid understanding of backup/recovery strategies, replication, and high-availability configurations.
  • Experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Familiarity with scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for routine DBA tasks.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Certificates and/or education in the following are highly desired:
    • Java
    • Oracle
    • Tableau
    • Biometrics SQL
    • NoSQL
    • High-Performance Computing (HPC)

Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment?

At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Integration Engineers (SQL Server DBA) who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies to join our team. As an Integration Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a domain expert and advisor on database architecture, infrastructure design, security posture, and overall data management strategy.
  • Establish, document, and enforce database operational best practices, change control standards, and process improvements across the DBA team.
  • Act as the escalation point for high-severity database incidents, architectural risks, and security vulnerabilities, driving swift resolution and root-cause analysis.
  • Upskill and mentor junior and mid-level DBAs to cultivate technical expertise and foster a culture of continuous learning.
  • Ensure strict adherence to enterprise risk management, SOX, and PCI compliance requirements and change management frameworks.
  • Architect and tune large-scale, mission-critical OLTP database environments to maintain high throughput and low latency.
  • Design, deploy, and maintain robust high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions utilizing Always-On Availability Groups, Replication, and continuous recovery strategies.
  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution for large-scale database patching, version upgrades, backups, restores, and decommissioning strategies.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • At least 4 years of experience designing and maintaining cross-platform or cloud integrations
  • At least 3 years of experience automating system configuration or data workflows

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience with SQL Server database administration, high-volume performance tuning, and database architecture.
  • 6+ years of experience configuring and maintaining SQL Server Always-On Availability Groups and transactional replication.
  • 6+ years of experience with database security, audit readiness, and compliance frameworks (SOX, PCI).
  • 6+ years of experience with enterprise monitoring, alerting, and automated database management platforms.
  • 1+ years of experience working in a cloud-based environment (AWS, Azure, GCP)

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Chicago, IL: $149,800 - $171,000 for Integration Engineer 4

Riverwoods, IL: $149,800 - $171,000 for Integration Engineer 4

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

descriptionHtml:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

TITLE: Principal Database Engineer

LOCATION: Atlanta, GA or Dallas, TX

Principal Database Administrator (SQL Server & PostgreSQL)

Senior technical leader responsible for end‑to‑end architecture, operations, security, and modernization of enterprise database platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and compliance.

Role Summary

The Principal DBA will provide technical leadership and strategic stewardship of the organization's database platforms, including Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments, across on-prem, cloud (GCP, Azure), and hybrid deployments. This role blends deep hands‑on expertise with strategic leadership, setting standards, designing resilient architectures, leading migrations, and driving automation to improve operational efficiency and business value

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Strategy: Design and implement scalable, high‑availability database architectures for SQL Server and PostgreSQL; define reference models and governance standards
  • Operations: Ensure 24×7 availability, monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and execute disaster recovery plans
  • Observability & Reliability: Define database SLOs/SLAs, implement monitoring and telemetry standards, establish proactive alerting, capacity planning, and reliability practices.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize workloads, tune queries, and improve system throughput; analyze bottlenecks and implement solutions
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and enforce security policies, data protection measures, and audit controls; ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Data Protection and Cyber Recovery: Implement database security controls including encryption, privileged access management, vulnerability remediation, cyber recovery planning, auditing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Backup & Recovery: Oversee backup strategies, recovery testing, and business continuity planning
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead complex migrations, schema evolutions, and cloud adoption initiatives
  • Capacity & Cost Management: Forecast growth, optimize infrastructure utilization, and drive database cost-efficiency initiatives across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  • Collaboration: Work with application teams, data engineers, SRE, security, and business stakeholders to align database solutions with business goals
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor DBAs, engineers, and developers; provide architectural guidance; lead incident reviews; and drive adoption of database best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive database administration, architecture, and engineering experience, including leadership of large-scale enterprise initiatives.
  • Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL (Expertise with SQL Server Always on Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication technologies, PostgreSQL streaming/logical replication, partitioning, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and performance optimization)
  • Cloud platforms: Experience designing and supporting managed database platforms including Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, and hybrid architectures.
  • Establish database standards, lifecycle management processes, naming conventions, operational runbooks, and governance frameworks across the enterprise.
  • Scripting & automation: Proficiency in T‑SQL, PL/pgSQL, PowerShell
  • Soft skills: Strong communication, problem‑solving, and cross‑functional leadership abilities
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

Success Metrics (KPIs):

  • Database uptime and availability targets met.
  • Reduction in incident resolution time.
  • Successful migrations and performance improvements.
  • Compliance and security audit pass rates.
  • Automation coverage and efficiency gains

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”

descriptionHtml:
Join Mizuho as a Senior Database Administrator (SQL Server & Azure Data Platform)!

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior SQL Server DBA with deep expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and Azure data platform technologies. The ideal candidate will also have solid exposure to PostgreSQL. This role is responsible for the design, administration, automation, security, performance, and resiliency of mission-critical database platforms supporting enterprise business applications.

The ideal candidate combines traditional DBA expertise with modern cloud, automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code capabilities. This individual will serve as a senior escalation point for database operations while driving platform modernization, operational excellence, cloud adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The successful candidate will have a strong ownership mindset, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across application, infrastructure, security, and cloud engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration & Operations

  • Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments from SQL Server 2016 through SQL Server 2025, and Azure-resident database platforms.
  • Provide L3 operational support and serve as a senior escalation resource for complex database incidents and service requests.
  • Ensure database platform availability, reliability, performance, and recoverability for business-critical systems.
  • Manage database lifecycle activities including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting production database environments.

High Availability, Disaster Recovery & Resiliency

  • Design, implement, and support high availability and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Administer technologies including:
    • SQL Server Availability Groups
    • Log Shipping
    • Transactional Replication
    • Failover Cluster Instances
    • Azure-based DR architectures
  • Validate and regularly test recovery procedures to ensure compliance with business RTO and RPO objectives.
  • Manage enterprise backup, recovery, and retention strategies.
Azure Database Platform

  • Architect, deploy, and support database solutions across:
    • Azure SQL Database
    • Azure SQL Managed Instance
    • SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
    • Azure Storage and backup services
  • Assess existing workloads and develop migration strategies for cloud adoption and modernization.
  • Implement and optimize Azure-native capabilities, including monitoring, security, Azure Elastic Jobs, Azure Automation Runbooks, and Cloud Shell automation.
  • Partner with cloud engineering teams to ensure database platforms align with enterprise Azure standards and landing zone requirements.
  • Plan, architect, and execute seamless database migrations from on-premises environments to Azure Cloud, as well as reverse migrations from Azure Cloud to on-premises environments.
  • Perform performance and cost engineering to optimize cloud resource utilization across Azure SQL tiers.
Performance Engineering & Optimization

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex database and application performance issues.
  • Partner with development teams to optimize schema design, indexing strategies, stored procedures, ETL processes, and application queries.
  • Establish proactive performance monitoring and capacity planning practices.

Automation & Platform Engineering

  • Automate operational processes using:
    • PowerShell
    • dbatools.io
    • Azure Automation
    • Git-based source control workflows
  • Develop repeatable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
  • Support Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management initiatives where applicable.
  • Drive continuous improvement through scripting, self-service capabilities, and operational automation.
Monitoring, Observability & Capacity Management

  • Proactively monitor database health, availability, capacity, and performance using enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Support and optimize tools such as:
    • OpsRamp
    • SQL Sentry
    • Azure Monitor
    • Log Analytics
  • Identify trends and risks before they impact service delivery.
  • Lead storage growth forecasting and capacity planning efforts.
Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Implement database security best practices and regulatory controls.
  • Partner with Information Security teams to address vulnerabilities, hardening standards, and remediation activities.
  • Support audit requests and regulatory examinations as required.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
  • Mentor junior DBAs and contribute to team knowledge sharing and technical development.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and provide database design guidance for new initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standards, procedures, and architecture documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SQL Server administration experience in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Deep expertise administering SQL Server 2016 through SQL Server 2025.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Azure SQL Database
    • Azure SQL Managed Instance
    • SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across the database, operating system, storage, and network layers.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
  • Experience with database monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, and security principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with dbatools and large-scale SQL Server fleet administration.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and database DevOps practices.
  • Exposure to Delphix, Redgate, or similar database lifecycle management platforms.
  • Knowledge of Azure governance, landing zones, and enterprise cloud operating models.
  • Financial services or highly regulated industry experience.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL is a plus.
    • Implement PostgreSQL HA and DR strategies using WAL archiving, physical and logical streaming replication, and cross-region replication.
    • Expertise in PostgreSQL authentication, row-level security, role-based access control, pgAudit, logging, and automated compliance enforcement.
    • Good understanding of PostgreSQL extensions such as pgvector, pg_cron, and pg_stat_statements.
Success Profile

The Ideal Candidate Is

  • Azure-fluent.
  • Automation-minded and focused on eliminating manual work.
  • Highly skilled in database performance and availability engineering.
  • Comfortable operating in complex hybrid environments.
  • Security and compliance conscious.
  • Customer-focused with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Capable of driving modernization initiatives while maintaining operational excellence.

The expected base salary ranges from $112,000 - $185,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, including Medical, Dental and 401K plans, successful candidates are also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Other Requirements

Mizuho has in place a hybrid working program, with varying opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role, needs of your department, as well as local laws and regulatory obligations. Roles in some of our departments have greater in-office requirements that will be communicated to you as part of the recruitment process.

Company Overview

Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is the 15th largest bank in the world as measured by total assets of ~$2 trillion. Mizuho's 60,000 employees worldwide offer comprehensive financial services to clients in 35 countries and 800 offices throughout the Americas, EMEA and Asia. Mizuho Americas is a leading provider of corporate and investment banking services to clients in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Through its acquisition of Greenhill , Mizuho provides M&A, restructuring and private capital advisory capabilities across Americas, Europe and Asia. Mizuho Americas employs approximately 3,500 professionals, and its capabilities span corporate and investment banking, capital markets, equity and fixed income sales & trading, derivatives, FX, custody and research. Visit www.mizuhoamericas.com.

Mizuho Americas offers a competitive total rewards package.

We are an EEO/AA Employer - M/F/Disability/Veteran.

We participate in the E-Verify program.

We maintain a drug-free workplace and reserve the right to require pre- and post-hire drug testing as permitted by applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Ft. Belvoir, VA Clearance Required: TS/SCI minimum (US Citizen) Employment Type: Full-Time About Praescient Analytics: Praescient Analytics is a leader in delivering advanced analytic, data engineering, and technology integration solutions in support of the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community, and federal law enforcement. Our mission is to empower analysts and decision-makers through data-driven insights, enabling faster and more effective mission outcomes. Position Overview: Praescient Analytics is seeking a Senior SQL Database Administrator to provide comprehensive database management for the Data Capabilities Division (DCD). You will lead the administration of approximately nine Relational Database Management Systems (RDMS) hosting twenty databases across five distinct networks (NIPR, SIPR, JWICS, BICES, and CENTRIXS-K). This role ensures the performance, integrity, and security of databases supporting custom .NET applications within the Army Intelligence enterprise. Key Responsibilities:

  • Systems Maintenance: Perform and record daily system checks (approximately 15 checks) to ensure 100% of findings are tracked via the DCD IT Portal.
  • High Availability: Maintain healthy and reliable data replication using technologies such as Availability Groups.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply the latest DISA STIGs within 30 calendar days of release and implement "least privileged access" security requirements.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize code and stored procedures to provide fast query responses and assist application developers with database requirements.
  • Disaster Recovery: Develop and test backup and recovery plans, performing monthly integrity testing on at least 10% of database backups.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain logical architecture diagrams, entity relationship diagrams (ERD), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Operational Support: Respond to unscheduled system outages within 30 minutes and provide after-hours on-site support with a 2-hour response time when notified of malfunctions. Required Qualifications:
  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in SQL database administration supporting production environments.
  • Technical Expertise: 5 years of experience installing and configuring Microsoft SQL Server in High Availability Group configurations.
  • Scripting: 5 years of experience with T-SQL, including writing scripts, stored procedures, triggers, and views to automate maintenance.
  • Leadership: 3 years of experience serving as a team leader, managing task progress, and mentoring junior personnel.
  • Security: 3 years of experience implementing security measures in accordance with industry best practices and DISA STIGs.
  • Active TS/SCI Level Security Clearance (U.S. Citizen) Certifications:
  • Current DoDD 8140.01 (formerly DoDD 8570.01-M) certification – IAT Level II (or higher). Examples Include: CompTIA Security+ CE, CompTIA CySA+, CompTIA Cloud+, GIAC Security Essentials Certification (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MSCA) or SQL Server 2016 or SQL Database Administration Certification What you can expect from us:
  • Real opportunity for career growth in an environment where your achievements will be celebrated
  • Constant collaboration with numerous teams to ensure client success
  • A team that respects and embraces your ideas and expertise
  • Coworkers that are motivated by pursuing excellence, rather than the prospect of personal gain
  • A workplace dedicated to supporting and bettering public safety and government agencies Benefits:
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
  • Comprehensive, Company paid healthcare for you (We pay your premiums and deductibles)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Travel & performance incentives
  • 3 weeks paid time off (plus Federal Holidays) * $5K annual training allowance * $500 book allowance
  • Tuition reimbursement program Praescient Analytics is a Certified Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) with over a decade of expertise in advanced analytics, engineering, and DevOps, specializing in transforming complex data into actionable intelligence for informed decision-making. Since 2011, we have supported over 40 organizations across diverse domains, including military intelligence operations, financial and fraud investigations, and insider threat detection. Our team of experts—skilled in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, DevOps, and engineering—brings deep experience in solving complex challenges. With a proven track record in federal contracting, we deliver tailored, high-impact solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency, ensure mission success, and address the evolving needs of our clients. Praescient's innovative and adaptive approach makes us a trusted partner in delivering data-driven insights and technological excellence for critical missions. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. US Citizenship Required Interested Candidates: Please forward your resume to and please visit our website to apply online at www.praescientanalytics.applicantstack.com/x/openings.

What You’ll Do:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • At least 4 years of experience designing and maintaining cross-platform or cloud integrations
  • At least 3 years of experience automating system configuration or data workflows

  • 6+ years of experience configuring and maintaining SQL Server Always-On Availability Groups and transactional replication.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a cloud-based environment (AWS, Azure, GCP)

descriptionHtml:
FinQuery stands at the forefront of accounting automation, driven by a deep specialty in contract-driven accounting. Our AI-enabled platform transforms how controllers and finance teams operate, seamlessly managing and accounting for the complex financial contracts—like leases, prepaids, and accruals—that are the backbone of modern business. We are not just a software provider; we are the unified subledger that eliminates time-intensive, error-prone technical accounting workflows, ensuring financial reports are accurate and empowering our customers to focus on strategic, high-value tasks.

FinQuery is the global leader in lease accounting (as recognized on G2.com ) and serve more than 8,700 customers worldwide. Our growth trajectory has been consistently validated by the Inc 5000, which has recognized us as one of the fastest-growing private companies for five consecutive years.

FinQuery is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, lifecycle management, and continuous enhancement of enterprise database platforms across our growing fintech organization. You will hold ultimate accountability for system availability, performance, recoverability, and security across global infrastructure, while playing a key role in modernizing and supporting PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, and cloud-native technologies. As a hands-on technical leader with design authority, you will drive engineering standards and operational excellence company-wide.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Lead the architecture, implementation, and operational management of enterprise database platforms, focusing on PostgreSQL (including AWS Aurora) and MS SQL Server.
  • Own the upgrade program. Plan and execute major-version upgrades across the fleet with minimal downtime, and keep engine versions current enough that they never gate replication or recovery capability.
  • Raise the bar on schema-change governance - review standards for migrations, index and locking review, and automated guardrails so unsafe changes are caught before they reach production.
  • Partner with security and compliance on encryption, row-level security, least-privilege access, and the evidence our SOC 1/2 and regulatory obligations depend on.
  • Be a senior escalation point for database-driven incidents, and turn each one into a durable fix, a runbook, or an alert rather than a repeat.
  • Build automation and AI-assisted tooling that makes routine database work self-serve for product engineers, and mentor engineers across the org on data modeling, query design, and operating databases at scale.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance analysis, capacity planning, tuning, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Establish database monitoring and reliability frameworks while driving IaC adoption with Terraform and integrating CI/CD for automated provisioning, deployments, upgrades, and testing.
  • Collaborate with software engineering, DevOps, Analytics and product teams to provide architecture guidance, technical consultation, and platform support.
  • Define and implement database engineering standards, configuration management practices, governance processes, and operational procedures.
  • Evaluate emerging database technologies by using proof-of-concepts, and modernization initiatives.
  • Use AI agents, LLM-powered tools, and automation to handle routine work like query analysis, schema reviews, documentation, and troubleshooting more efficiently
  • Champion Kanban delivery practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across database engineering services.
  • Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership.

The Expertise You'll Bring

  • At least 7-8 years administering production PostgreSQL, including databases that the business depends on around the clock.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep expertise in PostgreSQL internals (MVCC, vacuum behavior, replication, and query planning) and query/workload tuning, alongside comfort utilizing AI assistants, copilots, and LLM-powered tools.
  • Proven experience operating PostgreSQL on AWS RDS/Aurora (instance sizing, parameter groups, monitoring, engine upgrades) and designing/testing high availability and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Solid Linux administration and scripting in Bash and/or Python.
  • Experience working within a formal change management process in a regulated, audited or otherwise controlled environment.
  • The ability to explain database risk and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and to senior management.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.
  • A team-first mindset where success is defined by what we accomplish together
  • A proactive, curious attitude and a genuine desire to keep learning

Nice to Have Qualities

  • Database & Platform Expertise: Experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, containerized PostgreSQL on Kubernetes (persistent storage, backups, failover), and cloud infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible.
  • Modern Data & AI Integration: Proficiency in AI best practices (e.g., Claude) and deploying AI agents to automate database workflows alongside hands-on experience with Snowflake, ElastiCache/Redis, or OpenSearch.
  • Enterprise Delivery & Compliance: Proven track record supporting large-scale data migrations, platform integrations, and maintaining compliance within audited environments such as SOC 1 or SOC 2.

Tech Stack that You'll Work With

  • Hosting & Administration: AWS RDS and Aurora
  • Database Systems: PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server
  • Languages: SQL, Python, and Shell Scripting
  • AI & Agentic Tools: LLM-powered assistants like Gemini, Claude, and GitHub Copilot, alongside AI-driven automation workflows
  • Data Warehouses & Integration: Snowflake, FiveTran, Celigo, and Boomi
  • Build & Deployment: GitHub Actions, Terraform, Liquibase, and Jenkins
  • Analytics & Logging: DataDog and Power BI
  • Communication: Atlassian Jira and Slack

Benefits

For Your Financial Well-being:

401(k) plan with employer matching

Signing stipend for a work-from-home setup

For Your Health & Wellness

Great health benefits with multiple plan option

Flexible PTO (including 11 holidays and your birthday off)

Free gym membership at our office (Atlanta HQ)

Casual dress environment (when in office)

Catered lunches every Tuesday & Thursday (when in office)

For Your Family & Life

Parental Leave Benefits

Fertility/Adoption Assistance

Annual tutoring stipend for your children

FinQuery maintains a drug-free workplace.

  • Document lessons learned, help maintain knowledge database

  • Champion current trends in the industry partnering with Engineering and Architecture Services
  • Driving technical solutions in alignment with architectural roadmaps

  • 5 + years of experience in database version upgrades and cross-platform migrations.
  • Experience migrating from on-prem databases to AWS Aurora
  • Proficient in different replication technologies/high availability solutions for databases.
  • Strong UNIX knowledge and proficiency in shell scripts.
  • Working knowledge of PERL, Python and other similar scripting languages.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good understanding of hardware performance, memory and I/O.
  • Experience with DBMS specific tools for query/explain plans, database advisors, query snapshots, ability to understand them and troubleshoot the problems.
  • Strong understanding of database interfacing technologies such as ODBC, JDBC and DBMS Native clients.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake and data pipelines is a plus.

  • Good interpersonal, communication, relationship building and team working skills
  • Proven ability to communicate optimally with various teams, both business and technical, to achieve goals.

Introduction

The Consolidated Court Automation Programs (CCAP) for the Wisconsin Court System is seeking qualified candidates for a full-time Database Administrator. If you have experience updating, supporting and maintaining the security and integrity of system databases and application servers used in development, test and production environments we encourage you to apply. This position is available starting January 11, 2026.

Position Summary

LOCATION: Madison, WI. Certain positions with this Department may allow remote work for a portion of their work schedule, depending on the needs of the position and the work unit. This topic may be discussed in the interview process. The position is headquartered in Wisconsin and selected candidates may be expected to report to office locations in Wisconsin on short notice. Employees residing outside the state of Wisconsin are not eligible for full-time remote work.

SALARY: $100,900 - $121,100 annually with a State of Wisconsin benefits package. Salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience.

Job Details

  • Conduct regular database upgrades, performance audits, and backups 2) Support development projects with data model updates and deployments 3) Support both CCAP staff and customers by monitoring and fixing errors proactively and producing training materials 4) Keep databases up-to-date with the latest security practices and conduct regular security audits 5) Support business continuity with disaster recovery plans

Qualifications

Required: 1) Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2) Minimum of one years’ experience developing enterprise-grade applications with the ability to write and understand complex queries, procedures, functions, and triggers. 3) Excellent knowledge of: structured query language (SQL); relational database management systems; database schema development and normalization; release management practices for enterprise environments; security best practices, including encryption, access control and identity management, and vulnerability management. 4) Good knowledge of Linux as a server and development platform. 5) Skill in research and analysis. 6) Ability to use common programming languages and scripting languages to effectively develop software utilities and applications at an advanced level. 7) Ability to work with networking concepts including routing and network security. 8) Experience with database administration including database security and data integrity. 9) Experience in database issue resolution in an enterprise environment. 10) Experience designing database schemas for complex software applications. 11) Experience with release management in production, test, and development environments. 12) Experience developing tools to assist with DBA tasks. 13) Experience with database backup, recovery and disaster recovery management. 14) Experience with DevOps methodologies and tools.

Preferred: 1) Experience with PostGreSQL in an enterprise environment. 2) Experience with Ansible.

Special Requirements

  • Employment will require a criminal background check. 2) The Wisconsin Court System does not sponsor work visas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States, and to complete the required employment eligibility form upon hire.

How To Apply

Please submit a cover letter and resume in a single .pdf document indicating the position #26-2648 Database Administrator to human.resources@wicourts.gov. All materials should address your relevant education, experience, and skills as it relates to the qualifications and special requirements listed above. Failure to follow these procedures may result in your disqualification.

Deadline to Apply

In order to be assured consideration, applications must be received by 11:59 PM on November 23, 2026. The Wisconsin Court System will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants when requested. For additional information on the court system visit our website at www.wicourts.gov.

Notice: Upon request, all prospective employees can obtain a copy of the Equal Employment Opportunity Utilization Report.
