descriptionHtml:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing complex database environments to ensure security, integrity, and high availability. This role provides advanced support for mission-critical systems, leads performance tuning initiatives, and contributes to strategic improvements in database architecture. This role operates with minimal supervision and collaborates across teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.

The Senior Database Engineer at Zelis is a hands-on technical role responsible for the engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational reliability of enterprise database platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role supports business-critical databases with a focus on performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management. A key priority is modernizing the Zelis database estate, including migrating and re-platforming applications from Microsoft SQL Server to strategic platforms such as PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The Senior Database Engineer will work directly with application and engineering teams to assess schemas, queries, stored procedures, dependencies, and data access patterns and execute the technical work required to migrate, optimize, and operate these workloads. This position requires deep hands-on database engineering and DBA expertise, strong production troubleshooting skills, and experience with cloud database technologies, automation, monitoring, and Infrastructure as Code.

As a Senior Database Engineer at Zelis, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational support of enterprise database platforms across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role is focused on the day-to-day engineering and operation of business-critical databases, including database performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management.

A primary focus of this role over the next two to three years will be the hands-on migration and re-platforming of applications away from Microsoft SQL Server where appropriate, with an emphasis on PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. You will work directly with application and engineering teams to analyze existing databases, schemas, queries, stored procedures, and data access patterns and perform the technical work required to migrate and optimize workloads on strategic database platforms.

This position requires strong hands-on DBA and database engineering skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve database issues in production environments. You will spend the majority of your time working directly with database platforms, SQL, automation, monitoring, Infrastructure as Code, migrations, performance tuning, and operational tooling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, administer, maintain, and support enterprise database platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for SQL Server, SQL Server on Amazon EC2, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.
  • Perform hands-on database performance engineering, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, schema tuning, index design and optimization, statistics maintenance and analysis, stored procedure optimization, database configuration, and analysis of application data access patterns.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production database issues involving performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, locking, resource contention, CPU, memory, storage, connectivity, capacity, availability, and database configuration.
  • Perform hands-on migration and re-platforming of databases and applications from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and other strategic database platforms.
  • Execute database migration activities including discovery, compatibility assessment, schema conversion, data migration, remediation, testing, performance validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration optimization.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments while ensuring database platforms remain current, supportable, secure, and compliant with established standards.
  • Configure, maintain, test, and troubleshoot database high availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, replication, resiliency, and recovery capabilities.
  • Implement and maintain database telemetry, observability, monitoring, and alerting using IDERA, AWS-native monitoring capabilities, and other database monitoring tools.
  • Analyze database telemetry and performance data to proactively identify query performance problems, capacity constraints, resource contention, configuration issues, and emerging operational risks.
  • Participate in 24x7 production support and on-call rotations, responding to database incidents, troubleshooting problems, restoring service, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for database provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, patching, upgrades, and other repeatable database engineering activities.
  • Use Git, GitHub, CI/CD, VS Code or other IDEs, peer review, and version control to develop and maintain database scripts, SQL code, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and engineering assets.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot to assist with SQL development, troubleshooting, performance analysis, scripting, automation, migrations, and documentation.
  • Work directly with application engineers to identify and remediate inefficient queries, database schemas, indexes, stored procedures, data access patterns, and other application-related causes of database performance problems.
  • Create and maintain accurate technical documentation within Confluence, enterprise wikis, or equivalent platforms, including database configurations, operational procedures, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, migration documentation, upgrade procedures, and disaster recovery processes.

Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on Microsoft SQL Server experience in business-critical production environments with demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex database problems, including performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, resource contention, failed jobs, availability issues, and production incidents.
  • Demonstrated database performance tuning expertise, including the ability to analyze execution plans, identify inefficient queries, tune T-SQL and stored procedures, design and optimize indexes, evaluate statistics and cardinality, troubleshoot locking and blocking, and identify schema or application data access patterns contributing to poor performance.
  • AWS experience is required, with hands-on production experience operating databases on Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, and/or Amazon EC2. Experience with PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience performing database migrations, upgrades, or re-platforming, including assessment, schema and compatibility analysis, data migration, testing, performance validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration troubleshooting. Experience migrating Microsoft SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate database engineering and operational tasks using scripting and Infrastructure as Code rather than relying primarily on manual administration. Experience with Git, GitHub, CI/CD, APIs, command-line tooling, and modern development environments such as VS Code is expected.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting database monitoring, telemetry, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery. Experience using IDERA, AWS-native observability services, or comparable database monitoring platforms is preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure VMs, is preferred but not required. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or GitHub Copilot to improve troubleshooting, scripting, automation, and engineering productivity is also preferred.

Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Location and Workplace Flexibility

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.

While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

Base Salary Range

$105,000.00 - $133,000.00

At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing complex database environments to ensure security, integrity, and high availability. This role provides advanced support for mission-critical systems, leads performance tuning initiatives, and contributes to strategic improvements in database architecture. This role operates with minimal supervision and collaborates across teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.

The Senior Database Engineer at Zelis is a hands-on technical role responsible for the engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational reliability of enterprise database platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role supports business-critical databases with a focus on performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management. A key priority is modernizing the Zelis database estate, including migrating and re-platforming applications from Microsoft SQL Server to strategic platforms such as PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The Senior Database Engineer will work directly with application and engineering teams to assess schemas, queries, stored procedures, dependencies, and data access patterns and execute the technical work required to migrate, optimize, and operate these workloads. This position requires deep hands-on database engineering and DBA expertise, strong production troubleshooting skills, and experience with cloud database technologies, automation, monitoring, and Infrastructure as Code.

As a Senior Database Engineer at Zelis, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational support of enterprise database platforms across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role is focused on the day-to-day engineering and operation of business-critical databases, including database performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management.

A primary focus of this role over the next two to three years will be the hands-on migration and re-platforming of applications away from Microsoft SQL Server where appropriate, with an emphasis on PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. You will work directly with application and engineering teams to analyze existing databases, schemas, queries, stored procedures, and data access patterns and perform the technical work required to migrate and optimize workloads on strategic database platforms.

This position requires strong hands-on DBA and database engineering skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve database issues in production environments. You will spend the majority of your time working directly with database platforms, SQL, automation, monitoring, Infrastructure as Code, migrations, performance tuning, and operational tooling.

Key Responsibilities



-  Engineer, administer, maintain, and support enterprise database platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for SQL Server, SQL Server on Amazon EC2, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.
-  Perform hands-on database performance engineering, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, schema tuning, index design and optimization, statistics maintenance and analysis, stored procedure optimization, database configuration, and analysis of application data access patterns.
-  Troubleshoot and resolve production database issues involving performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, locking, resource contention, CPU, memory, storage, connectivity, capacity, availability, and database configuration.
-  Perform hands-on migration and re-platforming of databases and applications from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and other strategic database platforms.
-  Execute database migration activities including discovery, compatibility assessment, schema conversion, data migration, remediation, testing, performance validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration optimization.
-  Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments while ensuring database platforms remain current, supportable, secure, and compliant with established standards.
-  Configure, maintain, test, and troubleshoot database high availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, replication, resiliency, and recovery capabilities.
-  Implement and maintain database telemetry, observability, monitoring, and alerting using IDERA, AWS-native monitoring capabilities, and other database monitoring tools.
-  Analyze database telemetry and performance data to proactively identify query performance problems, capacity constraints, resource contention, configuration issues, and emerging operational risks.
-  Participate in 24x7 production support and on-call rotations, responding to database incidents, troubleshooting problems, restoring service, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
-  Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for database provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, patching, upgrades, and other repeatable database engineering activities.
-  Use Git, GitHub, CI/CD, VS Code or other IDEs, peer review, and version control to develop and maintain database scripts, SQL code, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and engineering assets.
-  Use AI-assisted engineering tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot to assist with SQL development, troubleshooting, performance analysis, scripting, automation, migrations, and documentation.
-  Work directly with application engineers to identify and remediate inefficient queries, database schemas, indexes, stored procedures, data access patterns, and other application-related causes of database performance problems.
-  Create and maintain accurate technical documentation within Confluence, enterprise wikis, or equivalent platforms, including database configurations, operational procedures, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, migration documentation, upgrade procedures, and disaster recovery processes.

Qualifications



-  Strong hands-on Microsoft SQL Server experience in business-critical production environments with demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex database problems, including performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, resource contention, failed jobs, availability issues, and production incidents.
-  Demonstrated database performance tuning expertise, including the ability to analyze execution plans, identify inefficient queries, tune T-SQL and stored procedures, design and optimize indexes, evaluate statistics and cardinality, troubleshoot locking and blocking, and identify schema or application data access patterns contributing to poor performance.
-  AWS experience is required, with hands-on production experience operating databases on Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, and/or Amazon EC2. Experience with PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is strongly preferred.
-  Demonstrated experience performing database migrations, upgrades, or re-platforming, including assessment, schema and compatibility analysis, data migration, testing, performance validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration troubleshooting. Experience migrating Microsoft SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is strongly preferred.
-  Demonstrated ability to automate database engineering and operational tasks using scripting and Infrastructure as Code rather than relying primarily on manual administration. Experience with Git, GitHub, CI/CD, APIs, command-line tooling, and modern development environments such as VS Code is expected.
-  Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting database monitoring, telemetry, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery. Experience using IDERA, AWS-native observability services, or comparable database monitoring platforms is preferred.

Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or GitHub Copilot to improve troubleshooting, scripting, automation, and engineering productivity is also preferred.

descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. PostgreSQL Database Engineer I, you’ll work as part of a collaborative and high-performing team providing your expertise to deliver technical solutions within the highest levels of the federal government by providing PostgreSQL expertise supporting highly visible, mission-critical applications; taking deep technical ownership of database platforms; executing disciplined operational practices; and maintaining database stability, performance, and security under constant operational demand.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, administer, and optimize databases in on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Perform database performance tuning, backups, replication, and recovery.
  • Enforce access controls, auditing, governance, and retention policies.
    Manage schemas, indexes, stored procedures, and permissions.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters and support containerized database and application operations.
  • Administer CI/CD pipelines and automation supporting database and application delivery.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborative delivery activities.
  • Support production operations with urgency and operational discipline.
  • Communicate technical risks, issues, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong customer trust through technical expertise, responsiveness, and reliability.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Active Top Secret clearance with current or previously held SCI access.
  • 8+ years of hands-on database administration or engineering with PostgreSQL as the primary database platform.
  • 2+ years using GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions to automate database deployments, schema changes, validation, or maintenance tasks.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; relevant experience may substitute.
  • Certification meeting applicable DoD 8140 requirements, such as Security+, GSEC, or higher.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, manage, troubleshoot, and tune PostgreSQL databases in enterprise production environments.
  • Extensive hands-on Ubuntu/Linux administration experience, including system configuration, patching, security hardening, troubleshooting, and performance tuning to support PostgreSQL production workloads.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and managing distributed PostgreSQL environments and high-availability architectures, including replication, clustering, failover, and troubleshooting across database nodes.
  • Hands-on ownership of PostgreSQL high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery configurations.
  • Ability to enforce database security controls, including encryption, key management, access controls, and compliance-aligned auditing.
  • Ability to independently own core PostgreSQL responsibilities on day one and quickly learn program-specific tooling in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.

 

This position is designated as essential personnel supporting continuity of operations and may require work during government shutdowns, emergencies, or other critical situations.

SALARY RANGE:  $138,000 - $175,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including: 

  • The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
  • The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
  • Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
  • This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
    • Performance-based bonuses
    • Company-paid training and/or certifications
    • Referral bonuses

Application Deadline:  Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

Additional Compensation: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

Benefits: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Parental Leave and dependent care
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, we are big fans of our people. That’s why we offer a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

 What we want you to know:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

🚀 We're Hiring: Senior DB2 Database Administrator (z/OS)

💻 Specialisation: Mainframe DB2 | DB2 z/OS | IBM DB2 Tools & Architecture

🏢 Work Arrangement: On-site 3–4 days per week

🎁 Benefits: Excellent benefits package + bonus opportunities

🇺🇸 Visa Sponsorship: H-1B sponsorship is being considered (ONLY FOR New Jersey candidates)


Get in touch with me at charneet@omtechllc.com


About the Opportunity

Are you an experienced Mainframe DB2 Database Administrator who enjoys solving complex database challenges, optimising performance, and supporting mission-critical enterprise applications?

We're looking for a skilled Senior DB2 Application DBA with strong hands-on experience in DB2 for z/OS, IBM DB2 tools, database architecture, performance tuning, and database administration.

In this role, you'll work closely with application development, systems programming, storage, and security teams to ensure database reliability, performance, availability, and security across a demanding enterprise environment.


🔑 Key Responsibilities

Database Administration: Design, implement, configure, and maintain DB2 z/OS application databases and database objects across development, testing, and production environments.

  • Database Design: Create and modify database tables, indexes, stored procedures, and other DB2 objects while ensuring data integrity and performance.
  • Performance Monitoring & Tuning: Monitor database performance, identify bottlenecks, optimise complex SQL queries, and fine-tune application workloads.
  • IBM DB2 Tools & Utilities: Leverage IBM DB2 tools, utilities, and monitoring solutions for day-to-day database administration and production support.
  • Backup & Recovery: Develop and execute backup, recovery, and restore strategies to ensure data protection and business continuity.
  • Database Maintenance: Perform database reorganisations, RUNSTATS, index maintenance, loads, unloads, and other routine maintenance activities.
  • Security & Access Management: Manage database access controls, user privileges, encryption, auditing, and other security measures.
  • Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate database, utility, and performance-related issues using diagnostic tools, logs, and DB2 utilities.
  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Support and implement solutions that maintain database availability and operational resilience.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with application developers, DB2 and MVS systems teams, storage, security, and data centre teams.


🎯 Required Qualifications & Experience

. + years of hands-on experience as a Mainframe DB2 Database Administrator.

  • Strong expertise in DB2 for z/OS, database architecture, and IBM DB2 tools.
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 utilities, MVS, and JCL.
  • Strong knowledge of database design, DB2 object implementation, and detailed design validation.
  • Proven experience in application performance tuning and optimisation of complex SQL statements.
  • Practical experience with database backup, recovery, restores, REORG, RUNSTATS, LOAD, and UNLOAD utilities.
  • Knowledge of database security best practices, including encryption and auditing.
  • Experience supporting high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a global, high-demand environment.
  • Willingness to provide 24×7 support when required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.


⭐ Nice to HaveDB2 certifications.

  • Hands-on experience with IBM Data Studio.
  • Knowledge of IBM Q Replication.
  • Exposure to COBOL, REXX, Java, SAS, CICS, USS, or WebSphere.
  • Previous experience in the financial services industry.
  • Project management experience and the ability to lead, mentor, and support team members.


🌟 Why Consider This Opportunity?

Work on enterprise-level Mainframe DB2 environments.

  • Take ownership of critical database performance, availability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with experienced cross-functional technical teams.
  • Competitive benefits package and bonus opportunities.
  • H-1B sponsorship is being considered.


Interested in taking the next step in your DB2 career? Let's connect!

📩 Share your updated resume or reach out directly to learn more.

We are seeking a hands-on Database Administrator to execute and validate the migration of Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and PostgreSQL databases supporting COTS applications from on-premises environments to Azure. Supporting the Migration Planning, Migration Execution, and Application Operations workstreams, the successful candidate brings deep expertise in one primary platform (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL) and will ensure data integrity, optimize performance, and resolve connectivity issues before, during, and after each migration wave.

descriptionHtml:
Entarian is looking for a Database Administrator to support the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).

Responsibilities Include, But Not Limited To

  • Creating new database solutions and implementing them properly based on overall project requirements.
  • Monitoring overall database performance to ensure end users are receiving the information needed in as little time as possible.
  • Troubleshooting performance issues, identifying the problem and promptly fixing it.
  • Running tests on the new solution to ensure it functions correctly before fully rolling it out. Testing involves creating test scenarios to immediately identify and correct problems.
  • Controlling access and permissions for accessing customer databases including verifying access requests and revoking access as directed by the customer.
  • Creating and maintaining all database documentation including documenting data policies and procedures as well as data standards.
  • Performing security related maintenance such as security patching, software patching and database upgrades within set maintenance windows.
  • Working with storage engineers to expand/reclaim DB space as needed.
  • Providing support creating and maintaining databases associated with AWS-specific DB technologies such as RDS, AWS RedShift and MySQL.
  • Supporting a 24x7x365 ops team as part of a rotating on-call schedule.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years of experience monitoring, updating/patching, data recovery and general maintenance
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate
  • Experience with Oracle, MS SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redshift database technologies; hands-on SQL DBA (not a managerial position)
  • Server troubleshooting experience (OS is Linux/Windows/VMware/AWS/Azure)
  • Knowledge of day to day SQL database operations, deployments and development
  • Extensive database experience with RDS, AWS Redshift or MySQL
  • Hands-on experience with database standards and end user applications
  • Minimize database downtime and manage parameters to provide fast query responses
  • Experience SQL and Performance tuning
  • Determine, enforce, and document database policies, procedures, and standards
  • Quick learner, self-starter with strong troubleshooting and communication skills
  • Strong customer service skills and ability to work in team environment
  • Clearance: Able to provide proof of U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain Public Trust Level 6 required

Desired Qualifications

  • Extensive database experience with RDS, AWS Redshift, MySQL, SQL, Oracle
  • Knowledge of AWS CLI, Snapshot, Route 53, S3, EC2
  • AWS certified Solutions Architect and/or AWS Certified Database

About Us

Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. We don't just support modernization; we define it.

Join the Mission and Start your Career Journey: Apply Directly via our Careers Portal Connect, Referrals & Inquiries? Email the team: careers@entarian.com

Entarian is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

descriptionHtml:
Amentum is seeking a full-time Senior Database Administrator to support a Department of War (DoW) customer in Spokane, Washington. The successful candidate will provide enterprise database administration and SharePoint infrastructure support in a secure DoW environment. This position requires extensive experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, SharePoint 2019 on-premises, Windows Server technologies, cybersecurity compliance, and enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a highly structured mission-focused environment. This posting allows for the initiation or upgrade of a US government security clearance.

Main Responsibilities:

Database Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server 2019 – 2025 environments across development, test, and production systems.
  • Design, implement, and support secure, highly available database solutions.
  • Monitor database health, performance, and capacity; perform query tuning, index optimization, and routine maintenance.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle activities.
  • Configure and maintain high availability technologies including Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering.
  • Implement database security through access controls, encryption, auditing, and STIG compliance.
  • Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, replication, and integrity issues.
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and T-SQL to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with developers on database design, schema changes, stored procedures, and application performance optimization.
  • Create custom reports based on customer requirements.

SharePoint Administration

  • Administer and support SharePoint Server 2019 on-premises environments, including installation, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, and upgrades.
  • Manage SharePoint farms, site collections, service applications, content databases, permissions, and Active Directory integration.
  • Support SharePoint customizations using ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET MVC, C#, CSOM, and SharePoint Server APIs.
  • Configure and maintain document libraries, lists, workflows, and enterprise collaboration features.
  • Perform SharePoint backup, restoration, disaster recovery testing, and system maintenance.
  • Provide technical support to site owners and end users while resolving SharePoint-related issues.

Security, Operations & Collaboration

  • Apply DoD STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Monitor system availability and participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and change management activities.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and implementation plans.
  • Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and architecture diagrams.
  • Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, developers, cybersecurity personnel, and government stakeholders to support mission objectives.
  • Provide technical mentoring, knowledge transfer, and occasional after-hours support during maintenance windows or operational requirements.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain an active Top Secret US Government Security Clearance with SCI eligibility. Note: US Citizenship is required to maintain a Top Secret Clearance.
  • 7 or more years of experience administering Microsoft SQL Server and SharePoint 2016/2019 in an enterprise on-premises environment; or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 4 years of relevant experience.
  • Must fully meet all qualification requirements for the 421-Database Administrator work role at the Advanced proficiency level IAW the DoD 8140 Cyber Workforce Qualification Program.
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and security.
  • Strong experience with SharePoint Server 2016/2019 administration and enterprise farm management.
  • Experience with SharePoint Designer, InfoPath, and third-party utilities such as Quest and Bamboo.
  • Experience implementing STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and DoD cybersecurity compliance.
  • Strong understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, and data modeling.
  • Experience with PowerShell, T-SQL, and automation scripting.
  • Experience performing database migrations, upgrades, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity operations.
  • Experience developing database design documentation including Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), functional specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Experience supporting structured testing, validation, configuration management, and change management processes.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex database and infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and technical documentation, especially related to their integration with SharePoint and use of macros.
  • Ability to work independently or within a multidisciplinary technical team under demanding operational schedules.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams and government stakeholders.

Other requirements:

  • This is a non-remote, full-time on-site position located in Spokane, Washington.
  • Standard work schedule is 40 hours per week/8 hours per day with the occasional need to flex hours based on customer support needs.
  • Some after-hours or short-term shift work may be required to support urgent customer requirements, including weekends and holidays.
  • Occasional travel may be required (0-10%).
  • Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods of time working in an office environment.
  • Must be able to lift various sizes of materials and equipment (up to 50lbs).

Compensation & Benefits:

HIRING SALARY RANGE: $120,000 to $150,000 (Annual rate to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This position includes a competitive benefits package. Benefits to include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k.
  • Paid time off (PTO) accrued weekly at 2.31 hours per week. Accruals are based on years of service.
  • 11 Paid holidays.

Compensation Details:

$120,000 - $150,000

10/09/2026 - Until Filled

descriptionHtml:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as a Senior Database Administrator located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a remote basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems.

Position Summary

The Senior Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for architecting, administering and optimizing all enterprise SQL Server databases, ensuring security, reliability, and scalability. The DBA collaborates with application owners and IT teams to support business operations and provides technical guidance to users accessing enterprise data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintains all enterprise SQL database operations including SQL server updates and patches
  • Maintains database security and compliance with company, industry and government standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)
  • Reviews current architecture and updates and optimizes all the firm's enterprise database systems
  • Architects and implements new database systems
  • Proactively monitors database performance and performs database tuning for optimal performance
  • Troubleshoots enterprise database servers and related systems
  • Supports system audits and provides documentation as required
  • Plans testing and implementation of DR and backup processes to ensure continuous operation
  • Creates custom queries, data-driven SSRS subscriptions, migration scripts, and executes other tasks as needed

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

  • Sound understanding of SQL Server technology features and limitations
  • In-depth, advanced knowledge of SQL Server database structures, security, storage solutions, virtualization, replication, and clustering
  • Ability to create performance projections based upon hardware, OS, databases design, query structures and interactions between external systems with the database servers
  • Ability to evaluate and recommend technological changes in the database environment to support business objectives
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to effectively communicate technical details to persons without technical experience
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to accurately follow documented procedures and a strong aptitude for learning new technologies as they are incorporated into the computing environment

Education & Prior Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years’ experience in design, development, administration, and maintenance of enterprise-level MS SQL Server database systems
  • Demonstrable experience configuring, operating and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server, both on-prem and cloud environments
  • Demonstrable experience in database design, creating standards and processes, capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, accessibility, scalability and documentation for SQL Server
  • Demonstrable experience in development of complex queries, SSIS Packages and SSRS reports

The expected pay range for this position is: $123,371 - $136,060 Per year Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience, location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, short term disability, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, 401K, vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary critical illness and cancer insurance and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs may also be available in certain markets.

GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace committed to merit-based consideration and review without regard to an individual’s race, sex, or other protected characteristics and to the principles of non-discrimination on any protected basis.

*This is a fully on-site role. Hybrid/remote work is not available at this time*

*We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time*

RIVO is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator to own the design, performance, and reliability of our Microsoft Azure SQL database environment.

We're looking for a builder. Someone who can assess where we are today, define where we need to be tomorrow, and help lead the journey.

As our Senior Database Administrator, you'll own our database architecture end to end: data modeling, performance, security, availability, and the pipelines that move data across the organization. You'll be the go-to expert for how our data is stored, accessed, and scaled.

As both a strategic architect and hands-on engineer, you'll play a key role in transforming a legacy database and data structure into a scalable, high-performing platform built for the future.

If you're energized by ownership, attracted to complex challenges, and motivated by the opportunity to build something lasting, we'd love to hear from you!



Job Description

What You'll Do

Database Architecture & Design

  • Own the architecture of our Azure SQL environment (Azure SQL Databases), including service tier and capacity strategy.
  • Design scalable data models and schemas for new and existing applications.
  • Assess and modernize legacy database structures, stored procedures, and data access patterns.
  • Define database development standards, naming conventions, and code review practices.

Performance Tuning & Query Optimization

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks using execution plans, Query Store, and Extended Events.
  • Design and maintain indexing, partitioning, and statistics strategies.
  • Optimize T-SQL, stored procedures, and application queries in partnership with developers.
  • Proactively monitor workloads, blocking, deadlocks, and resource utilization.

Reliability, Security & Operations

  • Own backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery (point-in-time restore, geo-replication, failover groups).
  • Implement database security, including Entra ID authentication, role-based access, encryption, and auditing, protecting PII data.
  • Automate schema changes, deployments, and maintenance
  • Manage Azure database cost, scaling, and capacity planning.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or similar tools.
  • Design CDC and incremental load strategies to move data reliably between systems.
  • Establish data quality, reconciliation, and monitoring processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to define data requirements and priorities.
  • Translate business needs into scalable database solutions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on database architecture, performance, and data governance.

Qualifications

Must Have Qualifications

  • Database Administration Experience: 8+ years as a DBA, Database Engineer, or Database Developer in Microsoft SQL Server environments, including 3+ years with Azure SQL Database
  • Database Design & Architecture: Deep expertise in relational modeling, normalization, and schema design, and in architecting databases for scale, availability, and maintainability.
  • Performance Tuning & Query Optimization: Advanced T-SQL with a proven track record tuning queries and workloads using execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, indexing, partitioning, and statistics.
  • High Availability, Recovery & Security: Hands-on experience with backup and restore, geo-replication, access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Data Engineering: Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or similar), CDC, and incremental processing.
  • Automation: Experience with database CI/CD and scripting

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Data Warehousing: Experience designing enterprise data warehouses using dimensional modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension Tables).
  • Modern Data Platforms: Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, or lakehouse architectures.
  • Analytics & BI: Experience supporting Power BI, Tableau, semantic models, and self-service reporting.
  • Near Real-Time & Data Science Workloads: Experience supporting low-latency data environments and ML pipelines.
  • Data Governance: Experience with data classification, lineage, and retention (e.g., Microsoft Purview).
  • Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300) or equivalent.

Additional Information

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you will be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this job is $160,000.00 to $200,000.00. Individual salaries within those ranges take into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to education; experience and training; licensure and certifications; knowledge and skill sets; and other business and organizational needs.

RIVO Holdings, LLC is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, citizenship status, disability, age (40 years old or older) and genetic information (including family medical history), past or present military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

Verizon Connect has an immediate need for an experienced Database Administrator based in the Atlanta Georgia region to join our Global Database Services team. The ideal associate will be a highly competent, results driven as well as a highly self-motivated individual.

This DBA role requires a service oriented mentality, high sense of ownership of the problems and requests assigned, focus on managing and resolving issues in a prompt & efficient manor, establishing and maintaining communication with technology customers to keep them updated with status of their requests, initiating and performing changes on production systems and proactively escalating any issues that cannot be resolved within the established timeframes.

Responsibilities

  • Owning, tracking and resolving database related incidents and requests.
  • Fulfilling requests and resolving incidents within SLAs.
  • Reviewing service-related reports (e.g. database backups, maintenance, monitoring) on a daily basis to ensure operational issues are identified and resolved promptly.
  • Responding to database related alerts and escalations and working with database engineering to come up with strategic solutions to recurring problems.
  • Enhancing automation for database platform provision process
  • Enhancing database monitoring & alerting platforms to ensure proactive alerting is always achieved.

Please note that this is a hybrid role requiring on-site presence in Alpharetta, GA for part of the week. Candidates who are unable to commute to this location will not be considered

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Four or more years of relevant Database administration experience in a large data environment
  • Deep understanding of SQL Server database architecture and internal components with particular focus on :-
    • Re-indexing (high transaction throughput OLTP platform)
    • Statistics
    • Partition maintenance (high transaction throughput OLTP platform)
    • H/A implementations
    • Backups, restores & Point-in-time recovery
    • Security
    • Monitoring & alerting
  • Advanced knowledge of Database Administration on the SQL Server (2019 & 2022)
  • Advanced knowledge of Troubleshooting and resolving database problems in a high transaction OLTP environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Database Performance Tuning & Optimization and Query cost management
  • Advance knowledge of writing, debugging and tuning of T-SQL code
  • Experience in Managing SQL Server in an AWS RDS environment.
  • Significant operational and support experience with large data platforms
  • Experience with scripting/automation (Powershell / Python / sparc preferred).
Even Better If You Have

  • Experience with other management & support activities with other relational database platforms (PostgreSQL, MySQL) in an AWS environment.
  • Experience with ownership & management of ElasticSearch in AWS
  • Experience with ownership & management of Redshift in AWS
  • Experience in working as part of a geographically dispersed team
  • Ability to learn new technologies and scripting languages
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high volume, agile environment.
  • Ability to approach problems with a sense of ownership, enthusiasm and innovation

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

- Statistics

Senior Database Administrator

Job Profile Title

Database Administrator Senior

Job Description Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to lead the administration, optimization, and ongoing support of our SQL Server databases, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), and Snowflake cloud data environment. This role will also support research and data science initiatives by ensuring the availability, quality, and integrity of datasets used in artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), including data cleansing, transformation, and preparation for machine learning and deep learning applications.

The Senior DBA will collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders, including IT support staff, researchers, data scientists, information security professionals, application development teams, financial staff, and institutional leadership, to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient access to data across the organization.

As part of the Penn Vet community, this position supports the technology and data needs of faculty, staff, and students across a dynamic academic and clinical environment, including classrooms, veterinary hospital facilities, and research laboratories. The successful candidate must be comfortable working in an environment where animals are present.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead the administration, maintenance, optimization, and ongoing support of SQL Server databases, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), and the Snowflake cloud data environment.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize database performance, ensuring high availability, reliability, and scalability of enterprise data systems.
  • Develop, maintain, and support reporting solutions and data management processes to meet organizational and operational needs.
  • Ensure the availability, quality, integrity, and security of institutional data across database and reporting platforms.
  • Support research, analytics, and data science initiatives by managing datasets used for artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) projects.
  • Perform data cleansing, transformation, validation, and preparation activities to support machine learning and deep learning applications.
  • Implement and maintain data management best practices, standards, and governance procedures.
  • Collaborate with researchers, data scientists, and technical teams to identify data requirements and deliver reliable data solutions.
  • Partner with information security professionals to ensure data protection, compliance, and secure access to institutional information.
  • Work closely with application development teams to support database integration, application functionality, and system performance.
  • Provide technical support and consultation to IT staff, financial teams, researchers, faculty, and institutional leadership regarding database and reporting solutions.
  • Develop and maintain database documentation, processes, procedures, and operational standards.
  • Ensure reliable, secure, and efficient access to data for stakeholders across the organization.
  • Support the technology and data needs of faculty, staff, and students within academic, clinical, and research environments.
  • Provide database and reporting support for classrooms, veterinary hospital facilities, research laboratories, and other organizational operations.
  • Participate in strategic planning and continuous improvement efforts related to database administration, reporting, analytics, and data architecture.
  • Work effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions and support institutional objectives.
  • Perform duties in an environment that includes classrooms, research facilities, clinical settings, and areas where animals may be present.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field experience (Master’s preferred). 3 - 5 years of experience in database administration, engineering, or related technical roles.
  • Certifications: SQL Server certification or equivalent is strongly preferred.


Skills

  • Strong expertise with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, optimization, indexing, replication, clustering).
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Proven experience in healthcare and/or university data environments.
  • Demonstrated skills in report development and SQL-based data extraction.
  • Experience preparing datasets for AI, machine learning, and deep learning, including data cleansing and transformation.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, FERPA, data privacy, and security best practices.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with monitoring tools, backup systems, and ITSM platforms.
  • Strong verbal & written communication skills, collaboration skills, and ability to work under minimal supervision within the context of their job responsibilities required.
  • Vendor management experience.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to align projects and programs with the strategic goals and vision.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility in managing changing priorities and unforeseen challenges in a dynamic environment.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Our mission at Penn Vet is to train the next generation of veterinary leaders to advance healthcare outcomes and access, ensure global health, bolster sustainable agriculture, create and support interdisciplinary career paths, and foster community and wellness in the profession.

Our Vision — A world with exceptional and vastly more integrated health of animals, people, and the environment.

Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

As a DBA/developer, you are responsible for a deep administrative expertise with strong development skills making it ideal for someone who can architect reliable data solutions while collaborating closely with our end users, application developers, and infrastructure teams.

This position reports directly to the Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group lead, in the Research Computing Support Division (RSCD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).

What We're Looking For:

A self-motivated professional who takes ownership of database reliability and application delivery, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and brings a continuous improvement mindset to everything they do.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Database environments (19c/26ai preferred) in both standalone and Oracle Database Appliance environments.
  • Design, develop, and optimize PL/SQL stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and views.
  • Design, develop, and deploy low-code web applications using Oracle APEX, including custom themes, interactive reports, forms, and REST-enabled data services.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional APEX applications.
  • Manage APEX workspaces, application security, and user access controls.
  • Integrate APEX applications with external systems via RESTful web services and Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Maintain and upgrade APEX environments across development, test, and production instances.
  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and query optimization using tools such as AWR, ADDM, and Explain Plan.
  • Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN; ensure RPO/RTO targets are met.
  • Implement and maintain Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and/or ASM environments.
  • Monitor database health, availability, and security; respond to and resolve incidents.
  • Develop and enforce database standards, naming conventions, and change management procedures.
  • Collaborate with developers to review schema designs, indexing strategies, and data models.
  • Support data migrations and integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical database support, as needed.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A BS in information technology, information systems, computer science, computer engineering, business, science, or a related field of study and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of Oracle DBA/Developer experience in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development and SQL tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications in Oracle APEX (version 22.x or later preferred).
  • Proficiency with ORDS for REST API development and deployment.
  • Familiarity with APEX security models, session state, and authentication schemes.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle security best practices (roles, privileges, auditing, TDE).
  • Experience with Oracle 19c or later.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix system administration in a database context.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with APEX plug-ins, Universal Theme customization, and JavaScript/CSS extensions.
  • Oracle APEX certification or demonstrated portfolio of delivered APEX applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible).
  • Knowledge of complementary databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) a plus.
  • Experience working at a high energy physics facility or DOE lab.

Special Requirements:

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation.
  • To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

About ORNL:

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.
