Location: New York, Hybrid role

Cognizant is seeking an Oracle Database Administrator for overseeing complex hybrid model initiatives that optimize data management using Delphix and Oracle Database while aligning technology demand with business priorities in cards and payments. Role focuses on orchestrating scalable solutions enabling resilient operations and ensuring secure compliant data usage that advances company objectives and delivers reliable value to customers.

About Cognizant’s CIS Practice

Cognizant’s CIS (Cognizant Infrastructure Services) Practice is a global leader in providing IT infrastructure services. We deliver innovative solutions to optimize and transform IT infrastructure, ensuring business agility and operational efficiency. Our services include cloud computing, data center management, network services, and cybersecurity. We focus on understanding client needs and delivering customized solutions to drive business success.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive continuous optimization of Oracle Database configurations for geospatial workloads, tuning queries, indexes, and storage strategies to reduce latency and improve responsiveness for map based applications
  • Manage enterprise geospatial data platforms that rely on Delphix and Oracle Database to deliver consistent and reliable mapping services to internal and external stakeholders, ensuring optimal performance and scalability across hybrid environments
  • Coordinate with product and engineering teams to define geospatial data models, standards, and governance practices that ensure data quality, consistency, and regulatory compliance across all mapping solutions
  • Implement robust Delphix data virtualization and masking strategies for geospatial datasets, safeguarding sensitive attributes while allowing agile development and testing of spatial solutions
  • Lead planning and prioritization of database and data virtualization initiatives by evaluating business value technical feasibility and resource capacity to ensure that the most impactful work is scheduled and executed effectively.
  • Drive optimization of Delphix data virtualization platforms by defining environments templates and policies that reduce provisioning time improve data refresh cycles and support efficient testing for cards and payments applications.
  • Manage Oracle Database operations by guiding configuration tuning backup and recovery strategies to ensure stable performant and secure data platforms that underpin critical transaction processing and reporting.
  • Coordinate hybrid work collaboration between onsite and remote team members by establishing clear communication routines shared artifacts and transparent progress tracking so that demand related tasks are delivered consistently during day shifts.
  • Monitor demand pipeline health by reviewing intake queues capacity forecasts and delivery milestones to identify bottlenecks and implement mitigation actions that maintain predictable throughput and reliability.
  • Ensure adherence to governance risk and compliance expectations by embedding controls in demand workflows so that data operations remain auditable resilient and aligned with regulatory obligations impacting financial services.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across technology operations and business teams to provide insight into demand trends capacity utilization and delivery outcomes while promoting decisions that enhance customer experience and societal trust in digital payments.
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to team members on best practices in demand analysis environment management and data provisioning so that collective expertise grows and the organization can respond effectively to changing priorities.
  • Coordinate change and release activities associated with Delphix and Oracle Database environments by aligning schedules risk assessments and validation steps to minimize service disruption and preserve data integrity.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Possess extensive hands on experience working with Delphix platforms including environment setup provisioning refresh workflows and data masking to support complex application testing and development scenarios.
  • Demonstrate strong Oracle Database expertise encompassing design implementation performance tuning backup and recovery to maintain robust and efficient data stores for mission critical workloads.
  • Exhibit proficiency with incident and change coordination practices ensuring that modifications to Delphix and Oracle Database environments are tested communicated and deployed in a controlled manner.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Requirements

Annual compensation between $90,000-$115,000 is being offered for the role. Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave

About The Role

As a Progress OpenEdge (4GL) Database Administrator (DBA), you will make an impact by managing, maintaining, and optimizing OpenEdge database environments to ensure availability, performance, data integrity, and recoverability. You will be a valued member of the database administration and application support team, working collaboratively with application teams, developers, infrastructure partners, and business stakeholders who support 4GL/ABL applications.

In This Role, You Will

  • Administer Progress OpenEdge databases across development, test, and production environments, including installation, configuration, maintenance, startup/shutdown parameters, and broker configurations.
  • Monitor database health and availability using promon and related diagnostic tools, responding to incidents involving performance, connectivity, or production availability.
  • Design and execute backup, restore, and disaster recovery strategies using probkup, prorest, After-Image areas, and documented recovery procedures.
  • Tune and optimize database performance, including buffer pools, lock tables, I/O, index rebuilds/compaction, fragmentation reduction, blocking, deadlocks, and slow-running queries.
  • Manage database structures and schema support activities, including storage areas, extents, .st files, dump/load operations, triggers, data model changes, and collaboration with development teams.
  • Support application connectivity and server components such as AppServer, WebSpeed, or PASOE brokers, including agent pools and session models.
  • Plan and support OpenEdge upgrades, patches, service packs, compatibility testing, compliance controls, user access, auditing, and operational documentation.

What you need to have to be considered

  • 8+ years of experience administering Progress OpenEdge/4GL databases in production or enterprise environments
  • Strong working knowledge of OpenEdge utilities such as proutil, probkup, prorest, and promon.
  • Hands-on experience with database backup/recovery strategies, After-Image management, restores, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Understanding of ABL/4GL applications and how they interact with the OpenEdge database layer.
  • Experience supporting OpenEdge database performance tuning, index optimization, table analysis, BI/AI file management, and production issue resolution.
  • Familiarity with SQL-92 access to OpenEdge databases through ODBC/JDBC and experience with Linux/Unix and/or Windows Server environments.

These will help you stand out

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with OpenEdge Replication or other high-availability configurations.
  • Knowledge of PASOE (Progress Application Server for OpenEdge), AppServer, or WebSpeed administration.
  • Experience implementing or maintaining OpenEdge Auditing and database security best practices.
  • Scripting skills using Shell, PowerShell, or similar tools to automate database administration tasks.
  • Prior experience supporting Progress OpenEdge environments used in ERP-heavy industries such as manufacturing, distribution, or healthcare.

Work model

Remote from United States

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer

The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Position Description

Are you an experienced Mainframe DB2 Database Administrator who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and supporting mission critical applications? CGI is seeking a skilled and motivated Mainframe DB2 DBA to join our team in Salt Lake City, Utah.

In this role, you will serve as the primary onsite DBA point of contact for database administration, production support, performance optimization, security, and disaster recovery activities. You will collaborate with application developers, architects, QA teams, DevOps, integration teams, offshore delivery teams, and third party partners to design, maintain, and support reliable DB2 environments for enterprise clients.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on challenging client engagements, contribute to modernization and cloud related initiatives, and grow your career within a collaborative consulting environment that values technical excellence, initiative, and continuous learning.

Work Model: Onsite in Salt Lake City, Utah

On Call Support: This role may require participation in an on-call support rotation.

Your future duties and responsibilities

How you'll make an impact

As a Mainframe DB2 DBA, you will help ensure the performance, stability, security, and availability of enterprise database environments. Your responsibilities will include:

Database Design and Architecture

  • Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for DB2 database administration and related activities.
  • Collaborate with application developers and architects to translate logical data models into efficient physical DB2 database designs.
  • Execute DDL for the creation and modification of tables, views, storage groups, and other database objects.
  • Safely manage schema evolution through complex DB2 ALTER activities.
  • Implement and maintain Universal Table Spaces, including PBG and PBR structures, to support effective storage and partitioning strategies.
  • Design, create, and manage DB2 indexes to support data integrity and optimize application access paths.

Performance Tuning and Monitoring

  • Write, review, and tune complex SQL queries to improve application performance and minimize CPU consumption.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot DB2 performance issues, including access path concerns, locking, buffer pools, and SQL execution.
  • Analyze EXPLAIN output and other diagnostic information to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Use Real Time Statistics (RTS) to monitor database health and schedule maintenance activities proactively.
  • Support performance optimization and continuous improvement initiatives across production environments.

Database Operations and Automation

  • Execute and monitor DB2 utilities, including LOAD, UNLOAD, REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, and RECOVER.
  • Manage DB2 space allocation, including PRIQTY and SECQTY, and monitor VSAM datasets to help prevent storage shortages.
  • Develop and maintain JCL and REXX scripts to automate batch processing and routine DBA activities.
  • Use DB2 command level functions to manage database threads, statuses, and operational activities.
  • Leverage DB2 administration and monitoring tools, such as DB2 Admin Tool and Query Monitor, to support efficient database management.
  • Provide production support, investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate timely issue resolution.

Security and Business Continuity

  • Administer DB2 security, including GRANT and REVOKE privileges, in alignment with enterprise access policies.
  • Support database security, audit, compliance, and data protection requirements.
  • Develop, test, and execute disaster recovery strategies to support business continuity.
  • Manage image copies, DB2 logs, backup processes, and recovery activities to help ensure timely restoration following an outage.
  • Participate in production readiness reviews, recovery exercises, and operational support activities.

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Coordinate with architects, SMEs, development teams, QA, DevOps, integration teams, offshore resources, and third party vendors.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to team members and offshore delivery teams.
  • Support application releases, database changes, maintenance activities, and production deployments.
  • Document database designs, operating procedures, troubleshooting steps, and recovery processes.
  • Communicate technical issues, risks, recommendations, and status updates clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent technical experience may be considered.
  • At least 6 years of experience in mainframe database administration, maintenance, and production support.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering IBM DB2 for z/OS, including database design, performance monitoring and tuning, backup and recovery, security, and production support.
  • Working knowledge of mainframe technologies, including COBOL, JCL, CICS, and VSAM, and an understanding of how applications interact with DB2 databases.
  • Experience with DB2 utilities and administration activities, including RUNSTATS, REORG, COPY, RECOVER, LOAD, and UNLOAD.
  • Experience analyzing and resolving DB2 performance issues, including SQL performance and access path concerns.
  • Experience supporting multiple applications within a large enterprise or production environment.
  • Experience coordinating with offshore teams and providing technical direction or guidance.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to make informed technical decisions.
  • Ability to evaluate and recommend solutions for moderate to complex database and production support issues.
  • Ability to work onsite in Salt Lake City and collaborate directly with client and delivery teams.
  • Availability to participate in on call support activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Endevor.
  • Experience using mainframe debugging and diagnostic tools.
  • Experience supporting large scale enterprise modernization or database transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Consulting or client facing experience in a technology services environment.

descriptionHtml:
The Consolidated Court Automation Programs (CCAP) for the Wisconsin Court System is seeking qualified candidates for a full-time Database Administrator. If you have experience updating, supporting and maintaining the security and integrity of system databases and application servers used in development, test and production environments we encourage you to apply. This position is available starting January 11, 2026.


LOCATION: Madison, WI. Certain positions with this Department may allow remote work for a portion of their work schedule, depending on the needs of the position and the work unit. This topic may be discussed in the interview process. The position is headquartered in Wisconsin and selected candidates may be expected to report to office locations in Wisconsin on short notice. Employees residing outside the state of Wisconsin are not eligible for full-time remote work.

SALARY: $100,900 - $121,100 annually with a State of Wisconsin benefits package. Salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

1) Conduct regular database upgrades, performance audits, and backups 2) Support development projects with data model updates and deployments 3) Support both CCAP staff and customers by monitoring and fixing errors proactively and producing training materials 4) Keep databases up-to-date with the latest security practices and conduct regular security audits 5) Support business continuity with disaster recovery plans


QUALIFICATIONS:

Required: 1) Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2) Minimum of one years’ experience developing enterprise-grade applications with the ability to write and understand complex queries, procedures, functions, and triggers. 3) Excellent knowledge of: structured query language (SQL); relational database management systems; database schema development and normalization; release management practices for enterprise environments; security best practices, including encryption, access control and identity management, and vulnerability management. 4) Good knowledge of Linux as a server and development platform. 5) Skill in research and analysis. 6) Ability to use common programming languages and scripting languages to effectively develop software utilities and applications at an advanced level. 7) Ability to work with networking concepts including routing and network security. 8) Experience with database administration including database security and data integrity. 9) Experience in database issue resolution in an enterprise environment. 10) Experience designing database schemas for complex software applications. 11) Experience with release management in production, test, and development environments. 12) Experience developing tools to assist with DBA tasks. 13) Experience with database backup, recovery and disaster recovery management. 14) Experience with DevOps methodologies and tools.


Preferred: 1) Experience with PostGreSQL in an enterprise environment. 2) Experience with Ansible.


SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

1) Employment will require a criminal background check. 2) The Wisconsin Court System does not sponsor work visas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States, and to complete the required employment eligibility form upon hire.


TO APPLY:

Please submit a cover letter and resume in a single .pdf document indicating the position #26-2648 Database Administrator to human.resources@wicourts.gov. All materials should address your relevant education, experience, and skills as it relates to the qualifications and special requirements listed above.Failure to follow these procedures may result in your disqualification.


DEADLINE:

In order to be assured consideration, applications must be received by 11:59 PM on November 23, 2026. The Wisconsin Court System will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants when requested. For additional information on the court system visit our website at www.wicourts.gov.


Notice: Upon request, all prospective employees can obtain a copy of the Equal Employment Opportunity Utilization Report.

Job Title: Cloud Database Administrator Engineer

Workplace Type: Hybrid-3 Days Onsite (Charlotte, NC)

Employment Type: Direct Hire


Overview:

Join a leading financial services organization as a Cloud Database Administrator Engineer, where you'll play a pivotal role in managing and modernizing enterprise database systems across cloud and on-premises environments. By leveraging your expertise in database architecture, automation, and high availability, you'll support mission-critical payment systems and drive innovative solutions in a fast-paced, regulated industry. This is an exciting opportunity to lead large-scale modernization initiatives and develop resilient, scalable database environments that uphold the highest standards of security and performance.


Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL, Db2, and AWS cloud services
  • Extensive experience with Db2 LUW, Microsoft SQL Server, and cloud-native database platforms within AWS
  • Strong knowledge of high availability and disaster recovery solutions including Db2 HADR, Q Replication, and SQL Server Always On
  • Demonstrated expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
  • Proven track record managing large-scale database migration and modernization projects
  • Familiarity with cloud management tools like CloudWatch, AWS Backup, VPC, IAM, and security configurations
  • Ability to design scalable, secure, and high-performing database solutions aligned with enterprise standards


Nice to Have Skills:

  • AWS Certified Database Specialty or Solutions Architect certifications
  • Experience with Azure database services, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or cloud-native database solutions
  • Knowledge of observability platforms like Splunk, Grafana, or Datadog
  • Background working within regulated financial environments and supporting compliance frameworks such as PCI-DSS and NIST


Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of enterprise database administration and engineering experience
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide database modernization and migration initiatives


Other Requirements:

  • This role requires onsite presence three days per week, with flexibility to adapt to changing onsite requirements as needed.
  • Candidates should be prepared to support highly available, mission-critical systems with stringent uptime requirements.
  • Strong communication skills and leadership abilities are essential for mentoring team members and interacting with senior stakeholders.


Step into a leadership role where your database expertise will shape the future of critical financial infrastructure—apply now to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, innovative environment!

descriptionHtml:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together

TELUS Health Retirement and Benefits Solutions powers the pension and benefits plans for nearly 9 million members across Canada and the United States. We've been doing this for almost 30 years—since our Ariel administration platform revolutionized the industry—and today, we continue to lead through innovation and unwavering commitment to our clients.

Our Client Services and Post-Implementation team is the backbone of what we do. While our clients design and deliver benefits programs, we're behind the scenes ensuring seamless transitions, resolving issues in real time, and supporting them every step of the way. We manage a robust ticketing system that keeps client requests flowing smoothly, and our team collaborates across departments to deliver solutions that keep millions of members' benefits running smoothly.

As a SQL Server Database Administrator, you'll be a critical member of this team. You'll be the expert who keeps our data flowing, our systems secure, and our clients' most important information protected. Your work directly impacts our ability to serve corporate clients, government organizations, multi-employer plans, and more—all while earning the trust of the employees and retirees whose financial futures depend on our reliability.

What you'll do

Database Infrastructure & Support


  • Install, configure, maintain, and secure SQL Server databases that support mission-critical client operations
  • Proactively monitor database infrastructure, respond to alerts, and resolve issues before they impact our clients
  • Execute database backups, configure backup policies, and lead disaster recovery activities to ensure business continuity
  • Perform routine database maintenance, including performance tuning, patching, and resiliency optimization


Collaboration & Client Focus


  • Work closely with our client services and administration teams to understand their needs and resolve database-related requests quickly
  • Manage ticket queues with a focus on meeting incident and SLA deadlines—your responsiveness directly impacts client satisfaction
  • Partner with deployment teams on software releases and infrastructure upgrades
  • Respond to both internal stakeholders and external clients with professionalism and clarity


Documentation & Knowledge Sharing


  • Create and maintain technical documentation that helps the team operate efficiently and reduces dependency on any single person
  • Keep our configuration management database (CMDB) current and reliable as a source of truth for system infrastructure


What you bring

Essential


  • 5–7 years of hands-on SQL Server database administration experience
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server 2016 and later versions
  • Solid SQL and PL/SQL skills; familiarity with MySQL is a plus
  • Comfort working in Windows O/S environments and Microsoft Office tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills—you can explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A customer service mindset; you understand that our clients' success is our success
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; you can troubleshoot issues systematically and implement lasting solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work both independently and collaboratively
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality in everything you deliver


Nice to Have


  • Experience with cloud-based backup and recovery solutions (Rubrik, eVault, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or Microsoft Azure
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ticketing systems


Salary Range: $75,000 - $100,000 USD

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.

TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:


  • Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
  • Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
  • Generous company matched pension
  • Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
  • Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills
  • And much more…


Job Type: This is for a current vacancy.

What makes this role special: You'll work with a talented team that values reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Your expertise will directly support millions of members and help our clients focus on what they do best. If you're someone who takes pride in keeping critical systems secure and running smoothly, and you're motivated by knowing your work matters—this is the role for you.

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

Louisiana Blue is a company on a mission: to improve the health and lives of Louisianians. We take that mission very seriously and apply it to everything we do. But, we also like to have fun! After all, we live and work in a state known for its joie de vivre, its great food and its friendly people. That joy for life also affects everything we do as we strive to give our members the best possible experience and the best possible outcomes. Our company was founded here in 1934 and has remained Louisiana-owned and operated.

Our vision is to be the statewide leader in healthcare, improving quality, value and experience through transformation of the delivery system in partnership with providers committed to positive change, and by serving Louisianians across all major market segments by 2020. That means it’s an exciting time to be part of our family. Every day, we are seeking innovative ways (and people) to achieve our vision and stay true to our Louisiana roots.

descriptionHtml:
Position Details


Lakeland Regional Health is a leading medical center located in Central Florida. With a legacy spanning over a century, we have been dedicated to serving our community with excellence in healthcare. As the only Level 2 Trauma center for Polk, Highlands, and Hardee counties, and the second busiest Emergency Department in the US, we are committed to providing high-quality care to our diverse patient population. Our facility is licensed for 910 beds and handles over 200,000 emergency room visits annually, along with 49,000 inpatient admissions, 21,000 surgical cases, 4,000 births, and 101,000 outpatient visits.


Lakeland Regional Health is currently seeking motivated individuals to join our team in various entry-level positions. Whether you're starting your career in healthcare or seeking new opportunities to make a difference, we have roles available across our primary and specialty clinics, urgent care centers, and upcoming standalone Emergency Department. With over 7,000 employees, Lakeland Regional Health offers a supportive work environment where you can thrive and grow professionally.


Active - Benefit Eligible and Accrues Time Off

Work Hours per Biweekly Pay Period: 80.00

Shift: On-Site M-F with Call Rotation

Location: 210 South Florida Avenue Lakeland, FL

Pay Rate: Min $83,803.20 Mid $104,759.20


Position Summary


The IS Epic Cache Database Administrator will be responsible for implementing and supporting Epic Database Solutions that take into account appropriate redundancy, availability, scalability, security and manageability requirements of Lakeland Regional Health’s IS Department. This individual will be part of a team that is responsible for the technical strategy, vision, architecture and evolution of LRH’s Epic implementation(s), infrastructure and ancillary technologies. This is a technical position providing analysis, configuration, maintenance, modification and monitoring of all Epic Caché and SQL databases. The ideal individual understands and supports best practices and requirements for data storage, database architecture, tuning, maintenance and reporting, ensuring hardware and software compatibility and optimization. This individual assists in and supports personnel in determining databases are available, backed up regularly, and can be restored. Participates in, and evaluates installations (server and database binaries), tests, and implementations of system hardware, clustering technologies, software, manufacturer’s maintenance releases and utilities. Analyzes system performance to ensure it is meeting availability and performance objectives. Evaluates and recommends team personnel in resolution of hardware and operating system, and application software problems. Develops and maintains documentation on design specifications and system/software development life cycle for development projects.


Position Responsibilities


People At The Heart Of All That We Do

  • Fosters an inclusive and engaged environment through teamwork and collaboration.
  • Ensures patients and families have the best possible experiences across the continuum of care.
  • Communicates appropriately with patients, families, team members, and our community in a manner that treasures all people as uniquely created.


Safety And Performance Improvement

  • Behaves in a mindful manner focused on self, patient, visitor, and team safety.
  • Demonstrates accountability and commitment to quality work.
  • Participates actively in process improvement and adoption of standard work.


Stewardship

  • Demonstrates responsible use of LRH's resources including people, finances, equipment and facilities.
  • Knows and adheres to organizational and department policies and procedures.


People At The Heart Of All We Do

  • Fosters an inclusive and engaged environment through teamwork and collaboration.
  • Ensures patients and families have the best possible experiences across the continuum of care.
  • Communicates appropriately with patients, families, team members, and our community in a manner that treasures all people as uniquely created.


Standard Work: IS Epic Cache Database Administrator

  • Implements, manages and maintains the Epic SQL Database infrastructure, including installing/upgrading and/or deploying Epic applications on servers and clients using Kuiper, and System Pulse. Installs database software (e.g. Oracle, SQL Server or InterSystems Caché)
  • Manage and maintain Epic databases for Hyperspace, EPS, Web BLOB, Hyperspace Web, BCA, MyChart, Carelink\Healthy Planet, Haiku, Rover, Care Everywhere, Home Health, Kuiper, and System Pulse services
  • Performs technical analysis, configuration, maintenance, modification and monitoring of databases on a variety of platforms including SQL, Cache, Windows Server OS and Linux
  • Uses processes for monitoring performance of installed systems or services and takes corrective actions when necessary. Uses tools for capacity planning, reporting, and proactive problem solving. Screen and analyze application performance for potential bottlenecks, specify possible solutions, and act jointly with developers to apply those fixes
  • Acts as a technical resource to evaluate evolving infrastructure technology and perform as a consultant interface to the business and clinical units for new company initiatives. Gather requirements from functional teams for their integrations with third party products
  • Supports third party software implementation as a technical resource and maintains private and public cloud infrastructure
  • Identify, repair, and resolve any Epic Database system hardware or software failures within the enterprise, in a timely manner and following company procedures and standards
  • Evaluate applicable requirements to provide appropriate technical specifications and solutions for new and existing implementations
  • Work closely with other departments, teams and engineers to build and troubleshoot system problems and software implementations
  • Develops and maintains systems documentation and technical procedures, user guides and run-books


Competencies & Skills


Essential:

  • Knowledge of database administration including analysis, architecture, configuration, maintenance, modification, monitoring, performance tuning and reporting. Primary support for Caché, MS SQL Server and Oracle databases
  • Knowledge of data modeling, repository and warehousing concepts and best practices. Advanced knowledge of database development and reporting tools (i.e. Oracle Designer, Oracle Developer, PL/SQL, Crystal Enterprise/Crystal Reports, etc.)
  • Knowledge of supported software development tools and programming languages (i.e. Visual Studio .NET, C# and/or VB.NET, ASP.NET, Web Services; Java and C++; PC and UNIX system administration)
  • Proficiency in Windows operating system administration, engineering and hardening, 2012, 2016, 2019 and Windows 10. Microsoft SQL server administration to include high availability clustering
  • Technically proficient, and aware of self-limitations with experience in one or more Epic technologies


Nonessential:

  • Experience in Epic MyChart, Epic-Link, Epic Hyperspace Web, Epic interconnect servers, Epic FIPS servers, BCA and Web deployment, Kuiper, Haiku, and Canto Database Administration and Configuration
  • Problem resolution, including ownership and communication through resolution
  • Experience in a larger, highly available healthcare environment (500+ servers and multiple sites). Health Level 7 (HL7), ANSI and other healthcare system standards with knowledge of Health Care regulatory environment
  • Understanding of computer and healthcare related concepts and vernacular with proficiency in oral and written communication
  • Proven competence in troubleshooting and critical thinking skills. Problem resolution, including ownership through resolution specific to electronic health record (EHR) systems


Qualifications & Experience


Essential:

  • Associate Degree


Nonessential:

  • Bachelor Degree


Essential:

  • Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, Information Management, or related field


Other information:

Experience Essential:

- Minimum three years of experience in IT infrastructure engineering to include: Inter-operational relationships of various infrastructure components, such as server systems, storage technology and software applications and database administration

- Engineering and administrative experience on Windows Servers 2012 and up, MS SQL, Cache, Oracle and related technologies

- Experience in administering a highly available and secure database environment

- Backup management, Disaster Recovery, vulnerability management, patch management and hot fixes on hardware, server OS and database applications

- Experience managing and maintaining an electronic health record (EHR) in a large hospital environment with the ability to document systems and write procedures for EHR system staff


Experience Preferred:

- Server Hardware management with Cisco UCS Systems and/or HP ProLiant Servers OneView

- Knowledge of enterprise system monitoring, log management and event analysis with an emphasis on performance tuning and application optimization

- Ability to work efficiently under pressure and make independent decisions. Ability to work independently under limited supervision and take initiative

- Certification in one or more of the following: Microsoft SQL Server, Cache, Linux Operating System, Epic MyChart, Epic-Link, Epic Hyperspace Web, Epic interconnect servers, Epic FIPS servers, BCA and Web deployment, Kuiper, Haiku, and Canto

- Problem resolution, including ownership through resolution


Certifications Essential:

- Microsoft Certified DBA, Cache Certified DBA


Certifications Preferred:

- Microsoft MCSE and one or more of: VMware VCP, Citrix CCEA or CCIA, Microsoft MCP, MCSA, or Other, Cisco CCNA, Palo Alto PCCSA

descriptionHtml:
Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA

The Senior Database Administrator is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for ensuring the availability, integrity and performance of complex and critical data assets and works closely with cross functional teams to support data-driven applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement robust backup and recovery strategies.

The Senior Database Administrator works closely with Change Control, Release Management, Asset and Configuration Management and Capacity and Availability Management to establish the needs of users, monitoring user access and security.

This role assists in controlling access to databases environments through permissions and privileges.

Key responsibilities:

  • Performs the installation, configuration, and maintenance of complex database management systems (DBMS), including SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or others, as required.
  • Collaborates with software developers/architects to design and optimize database schemas, data models, and database-related applications.
  • Participates in the writing of database documentation, including data standards, data flow diagrams, standard operating procedures and definitions for the data dictionary (metadata).
  • Monitors database performance, identifies performance bottlenecks, and optimizes queries and indexing for optimal database performance.
  • Designs and implements robust backup and disaster recovery strategies to ensure data availability and business continuity.
  • Monitors production databases regularly or respond to any database issues by bringing down the database or taking the database offline.
  • Proactively supports the development of database utilities and automated reporting.
  • Works closely with the Change Control and Release Management functions to commission and install new applications and customizing existing applications in order to make them fit for purpose.
  • Plans and executes database software upgrades and applies patches to keep systems up-to-date and secure.
  • Communicates regularly with technical, applications and operational employees to ensure database integrity and security.
  • Implements and manages security measures to safeguard databases from unauthorized access, data breaches, and data loss.
  • Conducts regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to maintain compliance with data protection standards and regulations.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, network engineers, and business stakeholders, to support database-related initiatives.
  • Provides technical support to end-users, assists with database-related enquiries, and conducts training sessions as needed.
  • Performs any other related task as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be U.S.-based and satisfy Massachusetts client security requirements.
  • Senior Oracle DBA with 7-12 years of experience managing complex environments, including automation, disaster recovery, performance tuning, and team mentoring.
  • Prior MMIS (Medicaid Management Information System) domain experience.
  • Strong experience with AWS RDS and Oracle Multitenant environments.
  • Proven automation expertise, with Ansible strongly preferred.

Role Expectations

The client is seeking a senior DBA who can provide strong technical leadership while driving continuous improvement within a complex AWS-hosted Oracle environment. Key responsibilities include:

  • Identifying and implementing automation opportunities and operational efficiencies.
  • Supporting ongoing DDI enhancement and operational support efforts.
  • Leading strategic modernization initiatives.
  • Driving RDS consolidation to improve database organization and reduce costs.
  • Managing database archiving activities across both MMIS and Data Warehouse platforms.
  • Supporting the transition to an immutable infrastructure model.
  • Contributing to long-term architecture and operational strategy.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization.

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Advanced proficiency in database administration tasks, including database installation, configuration, maintenance, and performance tuning.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL (Structured Query Language) to write complex queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Advanced understanding of database security principles, access controls, and data encryption methods.
  • Advanced working knowledge in database backup and recovery strategies to ensure data availability and business continuity.
  • Ability to monitor database performance, identify and resolve issues, and optimize database operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently while maintaining a high level of attention to detail on each project.
  • Ability to learn new technologies as needed to provide the best solutions to all stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex IT information in simplified form depending on the target audience.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Advanced proficiency understanding of the principles of data architecture and data services.
  • Advanced knowledge of application development lifecycle and data access layers.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to troubleshoot database-related issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent analytical skills related to working with unstructured datasets
  • Ability to manipulate, process and extract value from large, disconnected datasets.

Academic qualifications and certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering, information technology or related field.
  • Relevant certification, such as MCSE DBA, oracles associate or equivalent preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified; Azure Database Administrator Associate; Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) - Database Administrator; MySQL Database Administrator; PostgreSQL Certified Professional preferred.
  • Completion of database management courses covering topics like database administration, data modelling, SQL, and performance tuning can provide foundational knowledge.

Required experience:

  • Advanced demonstrated experience working as a Database Administrator within an Information Technology organization.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience with database backup and recovery best practices.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience running and creating health assessment reports.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience working with suppliers to deliver solutions.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience in Oracle Enterprise.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience managing databases.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for U.S.-based positions. The starting pay range for this remote role is 80,000.00 - 114,000.00 - 148,000.00 USD Annual. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

Remote Working

Introduction:

Maryland Benefits (MD Benefits) is a dynamic, cloud-based platform.   • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree is a plus. Will accept 7 years of experience in lieu of education
  • 5+ Years of proven experience as a Database Administrator, with a focus on managing cloud-based databases such as RDS Postgres, RDS Aurora for Postgres, and RDS SQL Server in AWS cloud environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of AWS cloud services such as Networking, Security, and Alerts and Monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling principles, governance, and security practices.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing data integration solutions and optimizing data processing performance.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Database Administrator Position Description:

Database Administrators (DBAs) play a vital role in addressing the challenges associated with a shared platform environment where multiple applications and tools use the same databases, ETL processes, and reporting tools. DBAs contribute significantly to the reliability, performance, stability, and observability of the shared platform. Their proactive monitoring, optimization efforts, and collaboration with various stakeholders help create a robust and well-maintained data infrastructure, facilitating smooth operations for all applications and tools sharing the platform.


Responsibilities:

  • Performance Monitoring and Tuning: DBAs continuously monitor database performance, identifying bottlenecks and proactively optimizing query execution plans, indexes, and database configurations to ensure optimal performance. This ensures efficient use of resources and enhances overall system performance.
  • Resource Allocation and Management: DBAs manage database resources, such as CPU, memory, and storage, to prevent resource contention and ensure fair distribution among applications and tools.
  • Backup and Recovery: DBAs implement robust backup and recovery strategies to safeguard data integrity and ensure rapid data recovery in the event of failures or disasters. This ensures the reliability and stability of the shared platform.
  • Security and Access Controls: DBAs enforce security measures, access controls, and encryption to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access, ensuring data privacy and compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Database Provisioning and Scaling: DBAs handle the provisioning of new databases and scaling of existing databases to meet the evolving demands of applications and tools on the shared platform. This ensures scalability and flexibility in data storage.
  • Data Replication and High Availability: DBAs configure database replication and high availability mechanisms to minimize downtime and provide continuous access to critical data for applications and users.
  • Query Optimization and Troubleshooting: DBAs optimize complex queries, identifying and resolving performance issues. They collaborate with application developers to troubleshoot and resolve database-related problems.
  • Version and Change Management: DBAs manage database schema changes and versioning to coordinate updates and ensure compatibility between different applications and tools.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: DBAs establish monitoring and alerting systems to proactively identify issues and respond promptly to potential problems on the shared platform, ensuring observability and facilitating quick incident resolution.
  • Capacity Planning: DBAs conduct capacity planning to forecast future resource requirements and ensure that the shared platform can meet growing demands while maintaining optimal performance.
  • Collaboration with Data Architects and Developers: DBAs work closely with data architects and application developers to understand data requirements and recommend improvements to database design, enhancements to data modeling, and best practices.
  • Database Security Audits: DBAs conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to maintain a secure database environment and address potential security risks.

As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States.

We have an exciting opportunity for a SQL Server Database Administrator / Developer to join the team!

The SQL Server Database Administrator / Developer will:



- Own the health, performance, and availability of the organization's SQL Server environment and the Windows servers that host it
- Perform proactive server and database maintenance, including patching, backups, restore testing, integrity checks, index maintenance, statistics updates, and transaction log management
- Monitor server and database performance, and identify and resolve issues before they affect users
- Tune database performance by analyzing execution plans, designing and maintaining indexes, and optimizing queries and stored procedures
- Design, write, and maintain complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions that support applications and reporting
- Build, schedule, and maintain data synchronization jobs between corporate databases and local systems using SQL Agent, SSIS, or similar tools, with monitoring and failure alerting
- Develop, deploy, and maintain SSRS reports, and support the reporting needs of business users
- Work with application developers to design efficient database schemas and data access patterns for .NET applications
- Manage database security, including logins, roles, and permissions, in line with organizational and contract requirements
- Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures, and document the database environment and operational runbooks

- Experience building and supporting data integration and sync jobs with SQL Agent and/or SSIS

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience managing large-scale Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases while providing strategic guidance for database architecture, performance tuning, disaster recovery, and data security initiatives.

The Database Administrator III will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure database systems support business objectives, maintain optimal performance, and adhere to organizational security and compliance requirements. This position also serves as a technical leader and mentor for database-related projects and initiatives.

Database Performance & Availability

  • Manage and maintain enterprise Oracle and SQL Server database environments.
  • Monitor database performance and proactively identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and uptime of critical database systems.
  • Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks, system issues, and database failures.

Database Design & Implementation

  • Design, implement, and maintain database architectures that support business and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate and recommend database technologies and solutions that improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Support application development teams in database design, optimization, and implementation.

Data Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain database security standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Manage user access controls, permissions, encryption, and auditing mechanisms.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational, regulatory, and industry data protection standards.

Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Develop, maintain, and test backup and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Ensure database recovery objectives meet business continuity requirements.
  • Perform regular recovery validation exercises and disaster recovery testing.

Database Upgrades & Maintenance

  • Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, patching, and maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate and apply security updates and performance enhancements.
  • Minimize business disruption during system maintenance and upgrade activities.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

  • Monitor database growth and resource utilization trends.
  • Develop long-term capacity planning strategies to ensure scalability.
  • Recommend hardware and software improvements to support future business needs.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for database technologies and best practices.
  • Mentor junior database administrators and provide technical guidance.
  • Lead database-related projects and support enterprise technology initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams.
  • Participate in strategic planning and enterprise architecture discussions.
  • Support mission-critical business applications and operational systems.

Troubleshooting & Support

  • Provide advanced-level support for database-related incidents and issues.
  • Participate in on-call support rotations and provide 24x7 support coverage when required.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to automate administrative tasks and improve operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain database documentation, standards, and procedures.
  • Stay current with emerging database technologies and industry best practices.

The Database Administrator II plays a significant role in developing and implementing database management strategies that align with organizational IT and business objectives. This includes:

  • Developing database performance, capacity, and scalability strategies.
  • Supporting digital transformation and cloud adoption initiatives.
  • Driving improvements in database security, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Recommending technology solutions that enhance business outcomes.
  • Leading implementation efforts for strategic database initiatives and modernization projects.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of hands-on experience administering large-scale Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server database environments.
  • Proven experience with database performance tuning, backup and recovery, security management, and high availability solutions.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical enterprise systems and applications.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in Oracle Database Administration.
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server Administration.
  • Experience with database monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Knowledge of database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Experience implementing database security controls and compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Tibero Database experience is a plus

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to interact professionally with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to support 24x7 operational environments and work overtime as needed.

Preferred Certifications

  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP)
  • Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional
  • Oracle Certified Professional, MySQL Database Administrator

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional domestic travel may be required.
  • Some international travel may be required based on business needs.

At Hyundai AutoEver America, the team culture is built on collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. Employees work in a dynamic global environment where IT and business teams partner closely to deliver impactful solutions that support Hyundai's growing manufacturing operations. Team members are encouraged to take ownership, challenge conventional thinking, and contribute to strategic initiatives that drive operational excellence across the organization.

Team Culture Highlights

  • Collaborative & Global Mindset – Partner closely with HR, IT, business stakeholders, external partners, and Korea Headquarters to achieve shared goals and deliver world-class solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement Focus – Embrace innovation, challenge the status quo, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes, systems, and the employee experience.
  • Customer-Centric Approach – Prioritize service excellence by building strong relationships, understanding business needs, and delivering reliable, high-quality SAP solutions.
  • Ownership & Accountability – Take initiative, solve complex problems, and drive projects from concept through implementation while maintaining a commitment to operational excellence and business results.

Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

Versant is seeking a SQL Database Administrator II to help ensure the reliability, performance, security, and ongoing improvement of our database environment across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

In this Level 2 role, you’ll administer and troubleshoot SQL Server environments while also supporting relational database platforms such as MySQL and PostgreSQL. You’ll partner closely with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to strengthen database operations through proactive monitoring, performance optimization, automation, observability, and resilient backup and disaster-recovery practices.

Success in this role means maintaining highly available database platforms, identifying and mitigating operational risks, resolving complex production issues, and continuously improving the tools and practices that support reliable database engineering.

Why This Role Matters: Our database platforms support critical applications and workflows across Versant. Your work will directly contribute to the stability, scalability, security, and recoverability of the systems our teams rely on to operate effectively.

This is a remote role based in Florida. While the position is primarily remote, employees should expect opportunities for in-person collaboration, team meetings, or company events approximately 10% of the time.

Qualifications

What You’ll Do

  • Own the health and reliability of SQL Server environments across Production, Staging, and Development, including SQL Server hosted on AWS RDS, maintaining availability in accordance with established SLAs, SLOs, RTOs, and RPOs.
  • Support and administer additional relational database platforms, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, as needed across cloud and on-premises environments, applying consistent standards for reliability, security, performance, backup, and recovery.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance and capacity using execution plans, Query Store, wait statistics, Extended Events, indexing analysis, observability platforms, and other diagnostic tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Strengthen database security and resilience by administering access and permissions using least-privilege practices and designing, implementing, testing, and validating backup, restore, high-availability, and disaster-recovery strategies.
  • Partner with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to improve T-SQL, query and schema design, indexing, CI/CD workflows, automated deployments, data migrations, integrations, and post-deployment validation.
  • Automate repeatable database operations and improve production support using infrastructure-as-code, PowerShell, and other scripting technologies while enhancing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, incident response, root-cause analysis, and technical documentation.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on SQL Server transactional database administration experience, including production database environments.
  • Strong SQL Server administration expertise across configuration, security, permissions, maintenance, backups, restores, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Strong experience with AWS database and infrastructure services, particularly RDS, Secrets Manager, S3, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Advanced SQL Server performance analysis and optimization capabilities, including execution plans, Query Store, index design, wait statistics, blocking analysis, query tuning, Extended Events, and related diagnostic technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server concurrency and transaction behavior, including isolation levels, locking, blocking, and deadlocks.
  • Experience designing and supporting high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including Always On Availability Groups, backup and restore strategies, and RTO/RPO planning.
  • Strong proficiency in T-SQL and PowerShell, with experience using automation to improve database administration and operational workflows.
  • Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL administration, including configuration, monitoring, security, backup and restore, and troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Experience with source control and database CI/CD practices using Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex production database issues, perform root-cause analysis, manage assigned work, communicate risks and blockers, and escalate appropriately.
  • An associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

How We Do It

  • Trust: Exercise sound judgment when managing production data, access, credentials, and critical database infrastructure.
  • Teamwork: Partner effectively with Software Development, Data Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and other teams to solve problems and improve shared systems.
  • Transparency: Communicate database health, risks, incidents, blockers, and technical recommendations clearly and proactively.
  • Agility: Adapt to changing operational priorities, respond effectively to production incidents, and continuously improve database environments as business and technology needs evolve.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Look for opportunities to automate manual work, improve database engineering practices, and build scalable solutions rather than relying on one-time fixes.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Python or Bash.
  • Experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in AWS-managed services such as Amazon RDS or Aurora.
  • Experience operating and optimizing heterogeneous database environments that include SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building infrastructure-as-code or other repeatable database provisioning and configuration workflows.
  • Experience supporting data integration, migration, or replication across systems and environments.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll have the opportunity to work on database platforms that support Versant’s portfolio of media and entertainment businesses while collaborating with experienced technology teams across multiple disciplines.

This role offers meaningful ownership of database reliability and engineering practices, with opportunities to improve automation, observability, performance, security, and operational resilience across SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL environments.

As a remote Florida-based employee, you’ll primarily work remotely while participating in in-person collaboration opportunities, team gatherings, or company events approximately 10% of the time.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

For LA County and City Residents Only: VERSANT Media will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

descriptionHtml:
Dentons US LLP is currently recruiting for a Senior Enterprise Database Administrator. This position reports to the Enterprise Business Systems team and is responsible for the reliability, modernization, security, and performance of the Firm’s database platforms and the enterprise applications that depend upon them.

This is a hybrid database platform and enterprise application support role. The successful candidate will provide advanced SQL Server administration, support application troubleshooting and implementation activities, and help lead the transition of appropriate database workloads from traditional infrastructure to Azure-managed database services, including Azure SQL Managed Instance and Azure SQL Database.

The role will take ownership of production issue resolution, database and application performance, cloud database migration, platform lifecycle management, technical documentation, and the implementation of tactical and strategic initiatives supporting core business functions.

Responsibilities

  • Assess database platform needs and develop and implement tactical and long-term strategic initiatives for production databases in collaboration with data owners and business stakeholders.
  • Design, implement, secure, and manage resilient on-premises and cloud database environments, including SQL high-availability clusters, mirroring, synchronization, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, data archiving, access controls, and retention requirements.
  • Partner with Infrastructure teams and application stakeholders to ensure databases and critical data are protected in accordance with business requirements and the Firm’s security, disaster recovery, compliance, and data retention policies.
  • Provide day-to-day administration and advanced support for the Firm’s SQL systems and dependent applications, proactively monitoring and tuning database and application performance and taking ownership of production issues through resolution.
  • Plan and coordinate data migrations, database upgrades, and platform modernization initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Design, implement, administer, secure, and optimize Azure SQL Managed Instance and Azure SQL Database environments, including connectivity, resiliency, backup, recovery, and compliance configurations.
  • Develop and maintain testing and change-control processes for database, application, infrastructure, and patching activities, ensuring proposed changes are appropriately tested and include rollback plans.
  • Support enterprise application implementations from initiation through completion, including installation and configuration of middle-tier application components when required.
  • Provide timely third-line support by troubleshooting and resolving escalated database and application issues and fulfilling backup, restore, mirroring, synchronization, access, and availability requests.
  • Participate in platform lifecycle maintenance, patching activities, technical documentation, and the on-call rotation supporting the Firm’s operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to fully meet the requirements of the position.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant certifications.
  • At least five years of experience serving as a technical subject-matter expert in a 24 x 7 global support environment; law firm or professional services experience is preferred.
  • Expert knowledge of SQL clustering, high-availability implementations, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery concepts for database systems.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, administering, securing, optimizing, and migrating workloads to Microsoft Azure SQL Managed Instance and Azure SQL Database.
  • Demonstrated expertise in SQL Server security administration, including permissions, access controls, authentication, auditing, and compliance across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Strong SQL Server and application performance-tuning skills, including query analysis, proactive monitoring, and resolution of complex performance issues.
  • Working knowledge of Transact-SQL, stored procedures, SQL Mail, SSRS, triggers, and the client/server application stack.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, DNS, DHCP, and Active Directory.
  • SQL Server administration experience with versions 2019 and later, including database upgrades and migrations to newer versions.
  • Ability to develop and maintain clear processes, procedures, technical diagrams, and organizational data-flow documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues, present options, independently take ownership of complex production issues, and drive them through effective resolution.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and client-service skills, with the ability to collaborate tactfully and effectively with individuals at all levels.
  • Sound judgment, accuracy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to work independently, remain calm under pressure, prioritize competing demands, meet tight project deadlines, and participate in an on-call rotation.

Salary

Pursuant with states' laws, the salary range for this position is $125,000 - $163,000, based on experience and local market.

Dentons US LLP offers a competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, profit sharing, short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays and discretionary bonuses.

Dentons US LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Disability/Vet. Pursuant to local ordinances, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity at Dentons US, LLP, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please call our Talent Acquisition Lead at +1 314 259 5898 or contact us at dentonsusstaffrecruitment@dentons.com.

Collaborate with technology/infrastructure staff to identify data relationships and functional requirements; analyze and resolve issues related to information flow and content. Performs and/or sets up scheduled database audit procedures to track the who/when changes are made or new items are created within the database environment.
