Senior Database Administrator (Oracle EBS & Multi-Platform) Role Overview As a Senior Database Administrator, you will serve as the primary technical expert responsible for the stability, optimization, and security of our core Oracle Database infrastructure and our Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) 11i legacy environment. Because this enterprise environment operates under strict change-freeze and non-patching constraints, you will focus heavily on compensating security controls, network isolation, and proactive mitigation to protect vulnerable systems without altering core database code. While Oracle EBS and Oracle Database administration are the primary requirements for this role, additional experience managing MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server is a highly valued asset. Core Responsibilities Primary Focus: Oracle EBS 11i & Oracle Database Administration Legacy Environments & Compensating Security: Enforce strict security postures for non-patchable systems (e.g., Oracle EBS 11i) through virtual patching, database firewalls, and host-level security configurations. Network Isolation: Architect and maintain tight network segregation, ensuring Oracle database access is strictly restricted to authorized application servers and admin jump boxes. Advanced Monitoring & Auditing: Implement and oversee deep database auditing (monitoring SYS, SYSTEM, and APPS accounts) to detect and alert on anomalous activity or exploit attempts in real time. EBS 11i Maintenance: Troubleshoot, clone, and support the database backend for Oracle EBS 11i environments while ensuring absolute stability and zero disruption to legacy custom code. Performance & Query Tuning: Monitor system health, code complex SQL/PL-SQL queries, and optimize index structures and query plans to maximize speed without relying on version upgrades. High Availability & Recovery: Maintain, document, and test rigorous backup strategies (e.g., Oracle RMAN) and disaster recovery (DR) plans to ensure rapid recovery options. Plus Requirement: Multi-Platform Operations Cross-Platform Support: Provide secondary administrative support, general maintenance, and basic troubleshooting for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server environments as required. Strategic Planning & Collaboration Risk Advisory: Serve as the subject matter expert to management on the security risks of legacy infrastructure, presenting technical recommendations for future modernization or safe migration paths. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with developers, DevOps, and functional analysts to support infrastructure changes within a highly controlled environment. Job Requirements Eligibility Requirement Citizenship: (due to compliance/security requirements). Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience as a Database Administrator working in enterprise environments. Technical Skills & Expertise (Required) Oracle EBS Expertise: Deep administrative experience with Oracle EBS 11i (architecture, concurrent managers, cloning) and older Oracle database versions. Database Security Hardening: Proven experience securing databases using alternative methods when patching is not permitted (e.g., Database Firewalls, native auditing, network ACLs). Optimization & Scripting: Expert-level knowledge of advanced SQL, PL/SQL tuning, and Shell/Python scripting for automation. Technical Skills & Expertise (Highly Valued Pluses) General hands-on experience or familiarity with secondary database platforms: MySQL PostgreSQL MS SQL Server Soft Skills & Professional Attributes Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and legacy-system debugging skills under tight constraints. Excellent communication skills to articulate security risks and technical constraints clearly to both technical teams and leadership. Preferred Qualifications Experience planning migration paths from legacy systems (like EBS 11i) to modern cloud or hybrid infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP). Certifications in Database Security or platform-specific credentials (e.g., Oracle Certified Professional). . Why Join Us? At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Title: Oracle and PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA)

Location: Remote

Terms: Full-time

Salary: $120-140k DoE

Clearance: Qualified candidates must be US citizens AND have an active DHS Public Trust clearance

Travel: 0%

Position Description

We are seeking an Oracle and PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) who will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of database solutions using both Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms. The role involves working closely with application developers, business analysts, and system administrators to ensure data integrity, performance, and security across multiple database environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database objects (tables, views, indexes, stored procedures, functions, triggers) in both Oracle and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Write efficient, well-documented SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle) and PL/pgSQL (PostgreSQL) code to support application requirements.
  • Perform data modeling, database normalization, and schema design for new and existing applications.
  • Optimize and tune database queries and overall database performance.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, and loading.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with application developers and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Document database structures, processes, and procedures.
  • Monitor database health, usage, and capacity, and recommend improvements as needed.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies related to Oracle and PostgreSQL.

Position Description

The Senior PostgreSQL Database Engineer will join a program providing User-facing and Data Center Services supporting an Intelligence Community customer. Named one of the Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work every year since 2014 , Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: Onsite in St. Louis, MO pr Springfield, VA

Required Clearance: TS/SCI with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI Polygraph.

Required Education And Certifications

  • Bachelor's Degree and 5+ years of experience in systems administration. (Additional Education, Training, certifications, or Work Experience can be substituted in lieu of a degree or work experience).
  • 8140.01M IAT Level II certification.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting PostgreSQL databases.
  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, SQL, schema development, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience troubleshooting database issues and managing database users, roles, permissions, and configurations.
  • Experience with database backups, restores, upgrades, and routine maintenance.
  • Working knowledge of database high availability, replication, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to collaborate with developers and infrastructure engineers to resolve technical issues and improve system performance.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Desired Skills

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL in OpenShift, Kubernetes, containerized, or Linux-based environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL replication, failover, connection pooling, or high-availability technologies.
  • Experience with database monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting both transactional and analytical data workloads.
  • Experience with database automation, scripting, infrastructure as code, or repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with database security practices in regulated or classified environments.
  • Experience with Oracle database administration or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.

Responsibilities

  • Administer PostgreSQL databases: Manage database configuration, user accounts, roles, permissions, routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Design and improve database architectures: Develop and refine schemas, data models, indexing strategies, and data access patterns to support application functionality, performance, and evolving system requirements.
  • Optimize database performance: Analyze SQL queries and execution plans, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement improvements to queries, indexes, database configuration, and resource utilization.
  • Support database operations in OpenShift environments: Collaborate with platform and application teams to support PostgreSQL deployment, connectivity, configuration, monitoring, and operational integration with OpenShift-based systems.
  • Maintain database reliability and recoverability: Implement and maintain backup and restore procedures, validate recovery processes, and support existing high-availability, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Monitor database health: Configure and maintain database monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity tracking, and operational reporting to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with software developers: Advise on schema design, SQL development, transaction management, data access patterns, and database integration to ensure efficient and reliable application behavior.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Identify database performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability improvements; evaluate appropriate tools and approaches; and implement practical solutions.
  • Support database lifecycle management: Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and modernization efforts while minimizing operational risk and service disruption.
  • Establish and maintain standards: Document database architecture, configurations, security controls, operational procedures, and recommended engineering practices.
  • Maintain database security: Apply appropriate access controls, least-privilege permissions, auditing, and security practices in accordance with applicable customer and system requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance: Serve as the primary database technical resource for the engineering team, helping troubleshoot issues and make informed decisions about database design and operational practices.

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Database Administrator 3


Kwik Trip’s Network Services Department is seeking a Database Administrator 3.


What you’ll be doing…

As a Database Administrator 3, you will be an experienced technical member of the DBA team responsible for supporting, securing, and improving Kwik Trip’s database environment, primarily Microsoft SQL Server, both on-prem and Azure.

Responsibilities include:

  • Maintain, support, and continually improve Kwik Trip’s SQL Server and database environments.
  • Serve as a technical escalation resource for complex database incidents, performance issues, production problems, and high-risk changes.
  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, migrate, and maintain database platforms while supporting lifecycle and capacity planning.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance using Query Store, execution plans, indexing, statistics, monitoring tools, and other diagnostic techniques.
  • Design, support, and test backup, recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery solutions, including Always On Availability Groups and log shipping.
  • Work with Security and other IT teams to maintain database security, encryption, certificate, privileged access, and data protection standards.
  • Help create and maintain Database Administration standards, procedures, documentation, and the DBA technology roadmap.
  • Partner with application teams, business areas, infrastructure teams, and vendors to design, implement, and troubleshoot database solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring DBA activities and improve standardized database deployments through PowerShell, T-SQL, Flyway, CI/CD, and other automation technologies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other Database Administrators while promoting cross-training and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in project planning and provide technical input related to database architecture, performance, security, availability, and recoverability.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support for critical production database systems as needed.


You’ll need to have:

  • Associate degree in Information Systems, Network Administration, Computer Science, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant database administration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise production environments.
  • Experience with SQL Server installation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, patching, performance tuning, backup, and recovery.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server High Availability and Disaster Recovery technologies.

descriptionHtml:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

About Us:

eSimplicity is modern digital services company that work across government, partnering with our clients to improve the lives and ensure the security of all Americans—from soldiers and veteran to kids and the elderly, and defend national interests on the battlefield. Our engineers, designers and strategist cut through complexity to create intuitive products and services that equip Federal agencies with solutions to courageously transform today for a better tomorrow for all Americans.

This position is contingent upon award.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain database architectures supporting Electronic Warfare (EW), Information Warfare (IW), and other mission-critical systems.
  • Administer and maintain enterprise databases supporting our customer and associated legacy and next-generation systems.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize database solutions supporting EW applications and technologies.
  • Support the migration and conversion of legacy data into modern database structures and formats, including CSV, XML, JSON, and other structured data standards.
  • Install, configure, secure, document, and maintain database environments in accordance with organizational configuration management and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance database workflows and quality assurance processes supporting IW data management functions and products.
  • Collaborate with software developers, system administrators, network engineers, configuration managers, and Information System Security personnel to support database infrastructure and application development environments.
  • Coordinate with Navy organizations, DoD stakeholders, and other mission partners to integrate new Electronic Warfare database structures, data formats, and technical requirements into authoritative database environments.
  • Maintain, develop, document, and sustain Surface Electronic Warfare training databases, mission data repositories, and associated libraries.
  • Maintain, develop, document, and sustain databases and mission data libraries supporting undersea warfare capabilities.
  • Develop, test, verify, and validate database systems, applications, and data products to ensure data integrity, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery, backup, restoration, and continuity of operations capabilities for mission-critical database environments.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including database configurations, data models, standard operating procedures, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and iterative delivery of database enhancements and mission support capabilities.
  • Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, implement performance improvements, and ensure system availability and data integrity.
  • Ensure database administration activities comply with applicable security requirements, organizational policies, and DoD standards.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Five (5) or more years of experience developing and supporting relational database management systems, with experience using Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, and/or T-SQL.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications and databases. Experience with Microsoft Web Forms and/or MVC applications supported by an Oracle Enterprise Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) is required.
  • Experience developing .NET desktop and web applications.
  • Experience developing software solutions using Extensible Markup Language (XML), including XML Schema (XSD) and Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformations (XSLT), to parse and import external data into Oracle Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS).
  • Experience designing software applications and databases supporting the production and sustainment of Subsurface Electronic Warfare (EW) threat libraries, including systems such as SLQ-32 and BLQ-10B.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining the NIODB Desktop (stand-alone) application or comparable Microsoft .NET Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) applications utilizing XML data stores.
  • Current DoD 8140 Cybersecurity Workforce (CSWF) certification meeting position requirements, including Security+ certification, or the ability to meet certification requirements by the first day of assignment, as required for privileged access to development and production systems.
  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance required

Working Environment

The primary place of performance is Norfolk, VA. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., excluding federal holidays. Personnel are expected to work an eight-hour day.

Occasional travel for training and project meetings. It is estimated to be less than 5% per year.

Benefits

eSimplicity offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement benefits, paid time off, paid holidays, life and disability insurance, and additional wellness and employee support programs. Eligibility may vary based on employment status and applicable plan terms.

Reasonable Accommodation

eSimplicity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process. Applicants who need assistance or an accommodation should contact Human Resources.

Equal Employment Opportunity

eSimplicity is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

As a Database Administrator, you will play a critical role in managing the data infrastructure that powers our business operations. You will perform day-to-day administrative tasks, monitor system health, and implement performance-tuning strategies to ensure maximum uptime. Operating in a hybrid model, you will balance remote tasks such as query optimization and script development with in-office collaboration for architecture planning and security audits. This role requires a blend of technical expertise in SQL-based environments and the ability to communicate complex data structures to various stakeholders.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required. Business, Operations, Engineering, Construction Management or equivalent work experience

Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in database administration (SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL). SQL Server is preferred.

Travel: 10-15%

Work Schedule: Typical work hours are Monday-Friday, 8 AM - 5 PM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leverage strong SQL expertise, including scripting, stored procedure development, and advanced indexing strategies, to support database performance and reliability.
  • Apply knowledge of database security protocols, backup and recovery processes, and high-availability architectures to ensure data protection and system resilience.
  • Utilize experience with cloud-based database platforms, with a preference for Azure SQL, to support modern, scalable solutions.
  • Monitor and evaluate database performance, proactively identifying and implementing optimizations to ensure high availability, stability, and scalability.
  • Manage database security, including user access controls, data encryption, and compliance with internal and external audit requirements.
  • Execute and maintain robust backup strategies, and lead periodic disaster recovery testing to ensure data integrity and business continuity.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models that enhance application performance.
  • Apply patches, upgrades, and configuration changes to database management systems (DBMS) to maintain system security, reliability, and functionality.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including database configurations, maintenance procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Participation in an on-call rotation for system emergencies.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Database Administrator (DBA) to join an IT Production Support team in Hoboken, NJ. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end maintenance, configuration, security, and performance tuning of enterprise database systems—specifically MS SQL Server (2019/2022) and Oracle 19c.

This position is ideal for a versatile, self-directed DBA—particularly someone coming from a smaller to mid-sized financial institution—who thrives in a decentralized environment and is accustomed to owning day-to-day database operations, troubleshooting real-time production issues, and wearing multiple hats across development, release deployment, and L2 production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Performance & Monitoring: Monitor daily database processing, research exceptions, and proactively tune performance across MS SQL Server and Oracle environments.
  • Backup, Recovery & DR: Establish and oversee backup, recovery, and replication processes; partner with Business Continuity teams to execute disaster recovery (DR) testing.
  • Installations & Patching: Perform installations, upgrades, and patching for MS SQL Server and Oracle databases (with ASM running on Linux), including scheduled weekend maintenance windows.
  • Database Design & Deployment: Design and build databases for internal applications; write stored procedures; review and deploy database objects across environments in strict adherence to change management policies.
  • Security & Data Masking: Configure database access controls alongside Security Administration and execute data masking of production data before restoring to lower dev/test environments.
  • L2 Production Support: Serve as a key member of the L2 Production Support team (including on-call rotation), analyzing complex database internals (locking, wait events, logging, consistency) and communicating resolutions clearly to internal stakeholders and management.


Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on DBA experience managing MS SQL Server on Windows and Oracle on Linux.
  • Background: Prior experience within a financial services or banking environment (candidates from smaller/mid-sized institutions with broad, hands-on operational ownership are strongly preferred).
  • OS & Scripting: Proficiency across Windows, UNIX, and Linux operating systems; working knowledge of SQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL, and PowerShell (or similar scripting languages).
  • Architecture & Internals: Solid grasp of database architecture (networking, security, scaling, fault-tolerance), internals, MS SQL Server native auditing, and version control systems.
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and English communication skills; proven ability to work independently under pressure without relying on direct authority.


Preferred Qualifications (Pluses)

  • Experience with replication technologies (SQL Always-On, Double-Take, AWS DRS).
  • Hands-on familiarity with database monitoring tools (SolarWinds DPA, Idera Diagnostic Manager).
  • Experience using DataMasker for data masking workflows.
  • Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work directly on a W2 basis. We cannot accept Corp-to-Corp (C2C), third-party agency submissions, or W2 referrals for this position.

About the Company



Founded in 1992, Mi-Case is the industry leader in fully integrated offender management software solutions and provides industry expertise and consulting within Criminal Justice and Public Safety systems. Mi-Case leverages a unique combination of technical, functional and industry specialization as well as partnerships with key software vendors to deliver maximum value add projects.



About the Role



As a DBA, you will play a key role in administering and optimizing relational databases in AWS, with primary focus on Amazon RDS for Oracle, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and Amazon RDS for SQL Server. You will own provisioning, configuration, upgrades, performance, backup and recovery, security, and day-to-day operations. You will also provide leadership and guidance to a team of DBAs and developers, establish cloud database standards and runbooks, and automate health checks and reporting to ensure high performance, availability, and reliability.



Responsibilities



  • As a DBA, you will be responsible for administering Amazon RDS databases in AWS. You will drive automation, operational excellence, and proactive monitoring through repeatable runbooks and health check reporting.
  • AWS RDS and Aurora Provisioning: Design, deploy, and configure RDS DB instances and Aurora clusters, including instance and storage sizing, subnet and parameter groups, option groups, maintenance windows, Multi-AZ, and read replicas.
  • High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Implement and validate HA and DR strategies, including Multi-AZ, failover configuration, cross-region replication where applicable, and disaster recovery runbooks with defined RTO and RPO.
  • Backup, Restore, and Environment Refresh: Manage automated backups, manual snapshots, retention policies, and cross-region snapshot copies. Perform and document regular restore tests and support Dev, QA, and UAT refreshes using approved methods.
  • Performance Monitoring and Tuning: Use CloudWatch, Performance Insights, and Enhanced Monitoring to diagnose performance issues, analyze wait events and query behavior, and implement tuning actions across Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
  • Security and Compliance: Enforce least-privilege access using IAM and database roles, network isolation using VPC and security groups, encryption at rest using KMS and encryption in transit using TLS. Configure and retain audit and engine logs in CloudWatch Logs as needed.
  • Patching and Upgrades: Plan and execute minor and major engine upgrades with minimal downtime. Coordinate testing, apply patching within defined maintenance windows, and use blue/green or staged deployment patterns where supported.
  • Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Automate routine tasks using scripting and AWS CLI or SDKs. Partner with DevOps to manage RDS and Aurora changes using infrastructure as code (for example, Terraform or CloudFormation) and integrate database checks into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Migration and Data Movement: Support database migrations and upgrades using AWS DMS and AWS Schema Conversion Tool when applicable, plus native utilities such as Oracle Data Pump, pg_dump and pg_restore, and SQL Server native backup and restore to S3.
  • Engine-Specific Administration: Implement maintenance routines appropriate for each engine, such as Oracle statistics and maintenance windows, Aurora PostgreSQL vacuum and extension management, and SQL Server index and statistics maintenance and SQL Agent job scheduling, within the capabilities of RDS and Aurora.
  • Collaboration: Be the liaison between the database team and other technical and business units, ensuring alignment of database services with organizational goals.
  • Collaboration and Support: Work closely with developers, platform teams, and system administrators to optimize database design, resolve issues, and ensure database systems meet business needs.
  • Documentation and Best Practices: Document all database procedures in internal Wiki, including health check reporting, automation scripts, RDS and Aurora deployment standards, and operational runbooks, to ensure consistency and adherence to best practices.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • AWS Certified Database - Specialty, Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), and Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent experience



Required Skills



  • 5+ years of hands-on database administration experience in AWS, including Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora.
  • Strong experience administering Oracle on Amazon RDS, including backup and recovery workflows, parameter and option group management, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience administering Aurora PostgreSQL, including cluster design, failover behavior, reader scaling, parameter tuning, vacuum strategy, and extension management.
  • Strong experience administering SQL Server on Amazon RDS, including index and statistics maintenance, SQL Agent scheduling, and native backup and restore workflows.
  • Deep understanding of AWS networking and security for databases, including VPC design, security groups, IAM, KMS encryption, and TLS connectivity.
  • Proficiency with monitoring and diagnostics tools such as CloudWatch, Performance Insights, and engine logs for root cause analysis.
  • Scripting and automation skills using AWS CLI or SDKs plus languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Experience with database migrations and modernization using AWS DMS and AWS Schema Conversion Tool, plus native engine utilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a team, mentor junior staff, and collaborate across departments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.



Preferred Skills



  • Results - Consistently delivers required business results; sets and achieves achievable, yet aggressive, goals; consistently complies with quality, service and productivity standards and meets deadlines; maintains focus on company goals.
  • Technical/Functional Expertise - Demonstrates and effectively applies depth and breadth of knowledge and skill in a technical or functional area.
  • Professional Development - Demonstrates a commitment to professional development by proactively seeking opportunities to develop new capabilities, skills, and knowledge; acquires the skills needed to continually enhance his/her contribution to the company and to his/her respective profession.

Apogee has an exciting new opportunity for a Database Administrator SME to support cutting-edge database management, optimization, and security efforts for US Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) across three separate client-server systems in a program/classified environment. This role involves administering enterprise Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS)—including Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server, and Postgres—within virtualized and cloud environments, while ensuring strict information assurance compliance through DoD STIGs, database auditing, and security patching.

This is a full-time opportunity located at Offutt AFB, NE

Responsibilities

  • The Database Administrator manages, maintains, supports, and optimizes the database for three separate client-server systems in a program/classified environment. Use effective analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to resolve issues and inform leadership on health, growth, status, and potential issues for all three systems
  • Work closely with both STRATCOM and STRATCOM-supported personnel and contractors to maintain and optimize the database on all three systems.
  • Install, configure, patch, and maintain enterprise Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS)—primarily Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server, or Postgres—within virtualized and cloud environments.
  • Monitor database health, troubleshoot complex database-related issues, manage indexes, and optimize complex SQL queries to enhance system performance and prevent mission downtime.
  • Manage user access, privileges, and permissions. Implement DoD STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides), database auditing, and security patches to maintain strict information assurance compliance.
  • Design, test, and execute automated backup, recovery, and failover strategies to guarantee continuous operation of strategic mission systems.
  • Collaborate with Systems Engineers to configure secure data gateways, orchestrate ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, and maintain data schemas.
  • Identify requirements based upon need or as the result of a security database issue that puts organizations' systems at risk
  • Evaluate and recommend secure remote configurations for databases
  • Liaison to the Enterprise Architect, WAN, LAN, and Enterprise Management Teams to effectively communicate and architect database solutions
  • Develop documentation to support ongoing security database systems operations, maintenance, and specific problem resolution
  • Collaborate and coordinate appropriate IT staff to implement solutions which will meet or exceed customer expectations
  • Functions as database technical lead during a security incident response
  • Ensure that the design of hardware, operating systems, and software applications adequately address database requirements for the Computing Environment (CE), including testing cybersecurity mitigations
  • Develop and produce database documentation for program Secret, Top Secret, and JWICS networks
  • Perform technical assessments on new technologies and generate "Best Practices" for implementations of new technologies
  • Establish database processes that satisfy complex system-wide requirements

Qualifications

 Minimum Experience:

Citizenship: Must be a US citizen

Clearance: Must possess and maintain a TS w/SCI eligibility

Certifications

  • Possess a DoD 8140 equivalent to 8570 Information Assurance Technician (IAT) Level II certification (Security+, GSEC, etc.)
  • Certified Database Administrator (Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or better).

Education: BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline

Years of Experience: M inimum of 15 years of relevant experience, 5 years of which must be in the DoD, to include:

  • Strong knowledge and experience applying DoDD 8500.1 Information Assurance, DoDD 8520.1 Protection of SCI, DoDI 8510.01 Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD Information Technology, DoDM 8140.03 Cyberspace Workforce Qualification and Management Program, and DoDI 8580.1 Information Assurance in the Defense Acquisition Process used for the analysis of user, policy, regulatory, and resource demands
  • Extensive Linux knowledge/experience
  • Experience with one or more database query languages (SQL, NoSQL, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of database practices and USSTRATCOM database organization, operations, and objectives

Additional Information

Location: Offutt AFB, NE

On-site/Hybrid/Remote: On-Site

Travel: 10%

descriptionHtml:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

As a Senior Data Engineer / Senior Database Administrator within Optum Technology supporting OptumCare products-including Curo, Order Utility, and Optum Pro-you will design, implement, and maintain resilient Postgres and MySQL database solutions in an Azure cloud environment. You will solve complex data architectural challenges, drive database performance tuning, implement task automation, manage Snowflake administration and security, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support high-impact clinical and care delivery applications.

To support this mission, OSIT has initiated a multi‑year modernization program aimed at updating and enhancing enterprise technology systems in accordance with modern design standards.

If you reside in Schaumburg, Illinois, you will enjoy the flexibility of an office-based role as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and upgrade Postgres and MySQL databases in Azure across multiple environments to ensure optimal availability, scalability, and resilience
  • Design and implement database solutions, enhancements, and data architectures supporting OptumCare applications including Curo, Order Utility, and Optum Pro
  • Optimize and tune database performance through data model design, query tuning, indexing, and capacity planning
  • Perform Snowflake database administration, access controls, and security configuration
  • Eliminate team churn and operational waste by designing and implementing automation for routine database administration and menial tasks
  • Use enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement
  • Evaluate emerging trends and technologies to inform solution design, architectural updates, and strategic innovation
  • Enforce security standards, access controls, data encryption, and robust backup/disaster recovery strategies
  • Create and maintain technical documentation related to database architecture, design, and operational procedures
  • Work independently across multiple Scrum teams to collaborate on application architecture, decision-making, and cohesive solution delivery
  • Solve unique and complex database problems with broad business impact, effectively communicating and translating complex concepts for technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Present and demonstrate database solutions and project outcomes to technical peers, partner teams, and senior leadership
  • Mentor junior members of the engineering team to foster technical excellence and achieve key business objectives

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Postgres database administration, architecture, and configuration
  • 5+ years of experience using SQL for querying, data manipulation, and database management
  • 5+ years of experience optimizing database performance through indexing, query tuning, and database optimization techniques
  • 3+ years of experience in MySQL database administration
  • 3+ years of experience with Postgres Flexible Server on Microsoft Azure
  • 3+ years of experience in systems analysis
  • 3+ years of experience presenting and demonstrating technical solutions to peers and senior management
  • 2+ years of experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment
  • 2+ years of experience in Snowflake administration and security
  • United States citizenship is required for this position
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a suitability or determination of eligibility for a Confidential/Secret or Top-Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience working in a Healthcare environment or Medical Management domain
  • 3+ years of Care Management and Utilization Management domain experience
  • 2+ years of experience working in a cloud-based enterprise environment
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems
  • Experience working effectively within a distributed or virtual team environment
  • Experience with technical tools and technologies such as GitHub, Python, Java, Postgres, and Azure
  • All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 to $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

Position: SQL Database Administrator

Compensation: $100,000 - $130,000 annually, depending on experience

Location: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma

Inceed has partnered with a great company to help find a skilled SQL Database Administrator to join their team!

This is a fantastic direct hire opportunity for a DBA who enjoys keeping critical systems running smoothly and making a real impact behind the scenes. You’ll support a growing technology team, work with modern database environments, and help ensure reliable performance across production systems. This role was opened due to growth, offering a chance to step into an expanding team with strong long-term potential.

Key Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Monitor and maintain production databases.
  • Perform troubleshooting, upgrades, and installations.
  • Manage backups and restore processes.
  • Support database replication activities.
  • Assist with change management and system maintenance.
  • Help developers with data modeling needs.
  • Support large-scale database architecture design.
  • Ensure database systems run reliably and efficiently.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

  • At least 3 years of professional SQL DBA experience.
  • Strong Microsoft SQL or PostgreSQL experience.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including stored procedures.
  • Experience with distributed database processing.
  • Experience with database replication.
  • Background supporting large-scale systems.
  • Linux knowledge.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

  • PostgreSQL expertise.
  • Experience designing production-grade database architecture.
  • Background supporting application data modeling.
  • Experience in fast-paced, collaborative environments.
  • Exposure to iterative development processes.
  • Experience with database upgrades and installs.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401K with match.
  • Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
  • Profit sharing.
  • This opportunity includes a comprehensive and competitive benefits package—details will be shared during later stages of the hiring process.

Other Information:

  • Hybrid flexibility may be available.
  • The team currently includes two DBAs and one database developer.
  • Role reports into the CIO.
  • Stable, growing organization with strong technology focus.
  • Open due to company growth.

descriptionHtml:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.

What We Do

As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

The Opportunity

This role will engage across a full featured data process where disparate data sources are collected, collated and controlled to deliver direct value to internal and external technology solutions. The primary product under development, Cobalt (www.cobaltlp.com) is an industry leading diligence and analytics platform for the private markets. This opportunity is a DBA focused role to join an entrepreneurial spirited team set within a successful, supportive and innovate market leader. At Hamilton Lane, we are dedicated to delivering technology-driven solutions to our clients and your work will be directly and responsively visible.

We hire with the anticipation that all team members contribute across our entire technology stack. We seek skill, aptitude, drive to learn and culture fit. Your energy and drive to tackle new challenges with autonomy in a collaborative team environment will foster foundations for strong tailwinds in this mid-career position. Platform and architectural contributions, mentorship and best practice guidance, along with cross-team collaboration and communication are keys to success in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as primary DBA for Snowflake and SQL Server (including Azure SQL Managed Instance and Managed Instance Pools), with capacity to extend support to other critical business systems (e.g., Tidal scheduler) as priorities evolve
  • Monitor database performance, query efficiency, and resource utilization; optimize slow-running queries, warehouse configurations, and SQL Server indexing, execution plans, and instance and pool resource utilization
  • Manage user access, roles, and security policies in alignment with organizational compliance requirements
  • Establish and execute backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity procedures for Snowflake, SQL Server, and Managed Instance Pools
  • Oversee data loading processes (ELT/ETL) and job scheduling (including Tidal) and ensure data quality and integrity
  • Manage cost optimization through warehouse sizing, clustering strategies, Managed Instance Pool and vCore sizing, licensing, and resource allocation
  • Coordinate Snowflake, SQL Server, Managed Instance Pool, and other supported platform upgrades and apply patches while minimizing downtime
  • Document database schemas, configurations, standards, and operational procedures
  • Provide technical support to developers, analysts, and end users; mentor team on best practices
  • Monitor and respond to system alerts and incidents across Snowflake, SQL Server, Managed Instance Pools, and supported systems; maintain uptime SLAs
  • Partner with HL's Cobalt business unit to support its database, data platform, and operational needs as required

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a Database Administrator with 3+ years of hands-on experience each in Snowflake and SQL Server
  • Expert knowledge of Snowflake architecture, clustering, data sharing, and security features
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance administration, including Managed Instance Pools (provisioning, sizing, networking, high availability, and security)

Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.

The Database Administrator II is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing new technologies, as required, to support the technical capabilities at Landis+Gyr. To be successful in this role one must be able to work effectively in a fluid, fast-paced environment. This role requires good communication skills, both with team members and business contacts. In addition, the successful Database Administrator must be able to work with minimal supervision on multiple concurrent projects. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for administering, maintaining, and optimizing PostgreSQL/EDB databases across enterprise environments.
  • Key responsibilities include production support, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, database patching, upgrades, cloud migrations, security, monitoring, and automation.
  • Requires hands-on PostgreSQL experience, strong SQL and Linux skills, and the ability to troubleshoot database issues independently while collaborating with application and infrastructure teams.
  • Develop new or maintain existing databases based on specifications
  • Resolve database performance issues, database capacity issues, replication, and other distributed data issues.
  • Implement data models and database designs into physical databases.
  • Manage security of database structures and corporate data held within databases
  • Develop database procedures, triggers and SQL scripts in coordination with development teams.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of the assigned application(s), functional area(s) or project(s)

Company Values

  • Supports and adheres to Company’s core values.
  • Performs other duties or responsibilities as assigned or required.
  • Supports and adheres to Company’s Code of Conduct and Ethics Policy.
  • Represents Company in a positive, professional manner when working with both internal and external customers.

Education & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree

Minimum Years of Experience: 2+ years of database administration experience

Certifications:

  • PostgreSQL Certified DBA

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to work with demanding customers and demonstrate PostgreSQL professional skills in a consulting manner
  • Respond quickly and effectively to production issues and taking responsibility for seeing those issues through resolution
  • Decisions have moderate effect on business

Working Conditions:

  • Typical indoor office environment with the majority of time spent sitting and working on a computer using keyboard, mouse, and monitor. Occasional use of other devices such as: phone, copier/printer/fax, etc.

Physical Requirements:

  • Typical office setting. Required to stand; walk; crouch; or handle objects. Lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Ability to sit and view computer screen for long periods of time. The ability to see, hear, & speak in English. Reasonable accommodations provided for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Personal Protection Equipment/Other OHSA Safety Requirements:

  • Ensure the continued efforts and assist in achieving annual goals of health, safety, and environmental policies. Must be current with available OSHA/Safety Training provided by the Company. If required, must be able to work while wearing safety equipment such as hard hats, work boots, gloves, hearing protection, and others.

As a part of the Landis+Gyr family, employees are offered a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits including medical, dental and vision coverage, life insurance, and a 401(k)-retirement plan featuring a generous company match incentive.  Additionally, we offer three (3) weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) as well as eleven (11) paid holidays.  We also offer a tuition reimbursement program, optional pet insurance, supplemental medical coverage and a host of other perks to ensure the health, wellness, and enrichment of our team members. 

Pay is in the range of $92,000 - $116,300 per year.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, and certifications or other professional licenses held.  All candidates are encouraged to apply. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. 

We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy. #TeamGreen

Position Overview

Senior Oracle Database Administrator (Sr. DBA) plays a critical role in maintaining and optimizing the databases that support our corporate and municipal clients. This position operates under the guidance of the Database Manager and collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, secure, and scalable database solutions aligned with company initiatives.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and implement database architecture on Exadata systems (X4-X10) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Manage Oracle resources on Exadata systems, Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP-D) , and OCI Goldengate.
  • Oversee installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and maintenance of Oracle databases (19c or later).
  • Perform backup and recovery using RMAN, Data Guard, and OCI-native tools.
  • Optimize performance—SQL tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis, AWR/ASH reports.
  • Configure and maintain Oracle Active Data Guard, and disaster recovery environments.
  • Perform duties related to migrating on-prem Oracle databases into the Oracle Gov Cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform/Resource Manager.
  • Implement high availability strategies, autoscaling, and load balancing.
  • Enforce database security policies like encryption, auditing, access control, vault key management.
  • Manage user roles, privileges, authentication, and identity integration both On-prem and OCI (OCI IAM / IDCS).
  • Lead on-premises Oracle DB migrations to OCI using Data Pump / Transportable Tablespaces, GoldenGate, RMAN backup/restore workflows
  • Manage OEM environment including patching, upgrades etc.
  • Analyze incidents, troubleshoot issues, and implement root-cause fixes, resolve issues with external and internally developed database applications.
  • Perform database cloning operations from production to test and development environments on on-prem and OCI autonomous databases.
  • Implement DDL/DML scripts in support of SCRUM application release cycles.
  • Automate recurring tasks through a combination of SQL, PL/SQL, or scripting languages such as Perl, Bash, OCI CLI, Python, etc.
  • Basic knowledge and logical understanding of other databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Mongo databases etc.
  • Assess and suggest opportunities for application and process improvement
  • Promote adherence to departmental/software development standards.
  • Promote learning, understanding, and the general enablement of the DBA team.
  • Set a professional example for the team through model behavior, superior performance, and proper attendance.
  • Managing Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for both data at rest and data in transit.

Qualifications

  • BA in Computer Science or the equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • 8+ years of Oracle database administration experience, with a focus on both on-prem SQL Server and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • 3+ years of Oracle cloud Infrastructure (OCI) experience.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL are preferred.
  • Ability to own and manage tasks and/or projects with minimal direction
  • Ability to successfully troubleshoot issues/provide solutions with minimal direction
  • Ability to learn new technologies/applications with minimal direction
  • ‘Can do’ attitude towards solving problems and completing tasks
  • Capable of researching and resolving issues with technologies outside of core competency
  • Experience in Oracle RAC, ASM, Exadata (on-prem or cloud),Active Data Guard, Performance tuning, RMAN, OCI Goldengate Replication.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux OS administration.
  • Strong scripting skills such as OCI CLI, Python, Shell scripting, Perl, etc.
  • Backup and all facets of recovery (simple restore, point in time recovery, etc.
  • Successful completion of the Nlets fingerprinting background assessment.

Personal Skills And Attributes

  • Capable to research and resolve issues with technologies outside of core competency.
  • Strong technical and interpersonal skills with the ability to work with minimal supervision within a global staffing environment.
  • Proven analytical/problem solving skills irrespective of database technology.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with technical staff (applications development and technical services) and management.
  • Keen attention to detail.
  • Willing to support operations in a 24X7 environment, ensuring uptime and responsiveness.
  • Ability to learn new technologies/applications with minimal direction.
  • Extensive experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Must be locally located and comfortable working a 3 days in office hybrid model and 2 days remote.

This position is not eligible for sponsorship now or in the future.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Company Overview

At 4A Consulting, we turn complexity into opportunity. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Baltimore, MD, we are a women-owned, boutique consulting firm specializing in delivering innovative, data-driven solutions to both the Federal Government and Fortune 500 clients. Our team blends deep industry knowledge with advanced technologies to design tailored strategies that drive measurable and sustainable outcomes. We pride ourselves on an agile, collaborative approach that helps organizations navigate challenges and seize emerging opportunities in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. At 4A, we don’t just deliver projects, we build trusted partnerships that empower our clients to lead with confidence in the digital age.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Database Management Specialist (Senior) to provide advanced database management, administration, and technical expertise in support of the contract. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with database management systems (DBMS), relational database technologies, database application design, performance optimization, data integrity, and security.

The successful candidate will support enterprise GIS databases and geospatial systems used in public-safety environments. This role requires expertise in enterprise geodatabase administration, ArcGIS technologies, spatial-data management, database backup and recovery, and the integration of GIS data with mission-critical applications, including Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Records Management Systems (RMS), and mobile-computing solutions.

The Database Management Specialist (Senior) will evaluate database technologies, design and maintain database structures, implement security and recovery procedures, and ensure the availability, accuracy, integrity, and recoverability of critical data. The position will collaborate with GIS professionals, application developers, database administrators, public-safety stakeholders, and software vendors to support reliable and efficient geospatial data services.


Work Location: The primary place of performance is onsite in Pikesville, MD. Travel to other offices may be required as needed. Some teleworking may be permitted.

Interview: An in-person interview may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced technical expertise and support in the administration, design, implementation, and maintenance of database management systems.
  • Evaluate and recommend appropriate DBMS products and technologies to meet validated user requirements, application needs, and organizational objectives.
  • Design and maintain database structures, including file organization, indexing methods, schemas, relationships, and access controls.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain database backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery procedures to ensure data availability and recoverability.
  • Establish and maintain database security procedures and controls to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with applicable State requirements.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, security, and recoverability are incorporated into database applications and processing environments.
  • Administer and support enterprise GIS databases and geospatial systems used by public-safety organizations.
  • Use ArcGIS Pro to perform spatial-data editing, analysis, geoprocessing, cartographic production, data conversion, coordinate-system management, and data quality assurance.
  • Administer enterprise geodatabases supported by Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or comparable relational database platforms.
  • Design, configure, and maintain geodatabase schemas, feature classes, domains, subtypes, topology, versioned editing workflows, user permissions, and data-integrity controls.
  • Monitor database performance and capacity, troubleshoot database issues, and implement improvements to optimize query execution, indexing, storage, and overall system performance.
  • Coordinate database migrations, upgrades, backup and recovery activities, and changes to database structures and configurations.
  • Support ArcGIS Enterprise and/or ArcGIS Online, including publishing and maintaining map services, feature services, web maps, applications, organizational GIS content, user roles, and sharing permissions.
  • Develop and maintain GIS automation, integration, and data-transformation processes using Python, ArcPy, ModelBuilder, SQL, REST APIs, FME, or comparable technologies.
  • Maintain mission-critical public-safety GIS datasets, including address points, street centerlines, common-place locations, jurisdictional boundaries, response areas, map layers, geocoding, routing, and location-validation data.
  • Validate geospatial data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compatibility with enterprise applications and operational requirements.
  • Support GIS integrations with CAD, RMS, and mobile-computing environments, including dispatch mapping, geocoding, routing, mobile map delivery, and data-interface troubleshooting.
  • Investigate and resolve database, GIS application, integration, and data-quality incidents in coordination with technical teams and software vendors.
  • Maintain database documentation, data dictionaries, schema definitions, security configurations, operational procedures, and recovery plans.
  • Collaborate with application developers, GIS analysts, database administrators, and end users to translate business requirements into effective database and geospatial solutions.
  • Recommend improvements to database architecture, automation, data governance, security, performance, and operational reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with a major in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related scientific or technical discipline; or three (3) years of equivalent experience in a related field.
  • At least six (6) years of experience in database management system (DBMS) systems analysis and programming.
  • At least three (3) years of specialized experience using current DBMS technologies, designing applications utilizing various database management systems, and working with DBMS internals.
  • Strong knowledge of relational database concepts, database architecture, schema design, indexing, query optimization, data security, and data-integrity principles.
  • Experience developing and maintaining database backup, recovery, and security procedures.
  • Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams, application developers, GIS professionals, business stakeholders, and end users.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least three (3) years of recent experience administering and supporting enterprise GIS databases and geospatial systems for a public-safety organization.
  • Hands-on experience using currently supported versions of ArcGIS Pro for spatial-data editing, analysis, geoprocessing, cartographic production, data conversion, coordinate-system management, and quality assurance.
  • Experience administering enterprise geodatabases supported by Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or a comparable relational database platform. Experience should include schema design, feature classes, domains, subtypes, topology, versioned editing, user permissions, performance monitoring, data migration, backup and recovery coordination, and data-integrity controls.
  • Experience supporting ArcGIS Enterprise and/or ArcGIS Online, including publishing and maintaining map and feature services, web maps, applications, user roles, sharing permissions, and organizational GIS content.
  • Experience with modern GIS automation, integration, or data-transformation tools such as Python, ArcPy, ModelBuilder, SQL, REST APIs, FME, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience maintaining mission-critical public-safety GIS data, including address points, street centerlines, common-place locations, jurisdictional boundaries, response areas, map layers, geocoding, routing, and location-validation data.
  • At least one (1) year of direct experience supporting the GIS components and integrations of a law-enforcement or public-safety Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Records Management System (RMS), and mobile-computing environment. This experience should include troubleshooting data interfaces, dispatch mapping, geocoding, routing, mobile map delivery, application incidents, and vendor-related issues.

Why Join 4A

  • Contribute to critical public-sector technology initiatives that support law enforcement and public-safety operations.
  • Apply advanced database management and GIS expertise to mission-critical enterprise systems.
  • Help ensure the accuracy, integrity, security, and availability of essential geospatial and operational data.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop and maintain reliable, scalable, and data-driven solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement through database optimization, GIS automation, and modern geospatial technologies.

Equal Opportunity Statement

4A Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive hiring process. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability may contact accommodations@4a-consulting.com. This email is intended solely for accommodation requests.

Please note that 4A Consulting participates in the federal E-Verify program. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US. 4A Consulting will only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

General Function

Lead/Specialist is viewed as an expert in the administration and support of a database platform. Undertakes complex projects requiring additional technical knowledge and makes decisions on ambiguous administrative and support issues. Communicates common goals and direction for the team. May interface with management to provide project updates.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank’s risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • SQL Server Database Administration experience, automation (PowerShell) experience, and self-service (Jenkins/Ansible) desire and/or experience.
  • Performance tune complex queries and processes for both in-house and vendor applications.
  • Understands database development best practices.
  • Assess new SQL Server instances for an enterprise IT organization, maintaining inventory, and optimizing cost for required licenses.
  • Design and maintain IT infrastructure strategies to build database environments for both vendor and in-house supported applications, considering hardening, security, configuration, maintenance, and support.
  • Create and maintain documentation for audit, compliance, training, and other purposes.
  • Explain complex database concepts to non-technical people in an easily understood way.
  • Maintain the health of numerous SQL Server installations through monitoring and patching activities.
  • Ability to upgrade SQL Server from any version to any other newer version using multiple techniques, understanding the benefits and drawbacks of each technique.
  • Performs database system management functions (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, configuration management) for DBMS, SSAS, SSIS, and SSRS installations.
  • Documents, defines, and develops database standards, procedures, and architecture.
  • Facilitates project planning by establishing estimates, milestones and schedules.
  • Provides team with technical training and/or mentoring, but listens and learns when others provide training and/or mentoring.
  • Attend and participate in team discussions and meetings.
  • Readiness and willingness to work and learn.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, helping team-mates when needed.
  • Other duties as required.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of hands-on SQL Server database administration experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with database automation, scripting, performance tuning, upgrades, and infrastructure management.
  • Strong understanding of database architecture, security, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational best practices.


This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
