descriptionHtml:
20208 - Database Administrator III

Location: Savannah, GA – 5-days Onsite

Company Overview:

Hyundai AutoEver America (HAEA), the dynamic IT powerhouse behind Hyundai Motor Corporation, a Fortune 500 global leader in the automotive industry. As a key affiliate, we provide cutting-edge IT services and support to top brands including Kia, Genesis, Hyundai Translead, Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Capital, and Glovis.

HAEA offers a truly global and collaborative environment. Here, you’ll drive innovation, boost operational efficiency, and help shape the future of mobility for the Hyundai Motor Group.

At HAEA, we understand that IT is the cornerstone of today’s fast-evolving digital world. By uniting all IT resources under one roof, we deliver consistent, top-quality solutions while serving as the crucial information link between Hyundai’s Global Headquarters and North American operations.

If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a real impact at a world-class company, Hyundai AutoEver America is the place to grow your career. Join us and be part of the transformation that’s driving the future of automotive innovation.

Role Overview

The Database Administrator III is a senior-level technical role responsible for establishing and driving the strategy, standards, lifecycle management, design, implementation, and operational support of the organization's database infrastructure. This position serves as a subject matter expert for enterprise database environments, ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of critical systems.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience administering large-scale Oracle and SQL Server environments while supporting MariaDB and Tibero platforms across Unix/Linux and Windows systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, project management capabilities, problem-solving expertise, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and corporate headquarters on high-impact technology initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer, monitor, and maintain enterprise database environments, including Oracle, SQL Server, MariaDB, and Tibero.
  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and troubleshoot database systems across Unix/Linux and Windows platforms.
  • Perform daily database administration activities to ensure system availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Diagnose database performance bottlenecks and implement tuning and optimization strategies.
  • Manage database security administration, including user access controls, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL scripts, stored procedures, and database objects.
  • Create and maintain Unix/Linux shell scripts to automate operational tasks and improve efficiency.
  • Perform basic Unix/Linux system administration functions supporting database infrastructure.

Technical Leadership

  • Establish database infrastructure standards, best practices, and lifecycle management processes.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging database technologies and architectural solutions.
  • Design and contribute to enterprise-wide database infrastructure initiatives and implementation strategies.
  • Conduct technical analysis, business analysis, integration testing, and performance testing.
  • Collaborate with headquarters and internal stakeholders to align infrastructure strategies and solutions.
  • Provide guidance and technical expertise to project teams and operational staff.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple database-related projects, tasks, issues, and systems simultaneously.
  • Lead projects from requirements gathering through implementation and completion.
  • Ensure project documentation is maintained and updated throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Conduct and facilitate project meetings with technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.
  • Escalate issues appropriately when business needs exceed the scope of responsibility.

Documentation & Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain operational procedures, standards, and technical documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and IT governance standards.
  • Continuously improve operational processes and service delivery effectiveness.
  • Participate in on-call support and provide 24x7 operational support as required.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience supporting large-scale Oracle and SQL Server database environments.
  • Proven experience installing, configuring, upgrading, and troubleshooting enterprise database platforms.
  • Experience with database performance monitoring, tuning, and optimization.
  • Strong experience working within Unix/Linux and Windows server environments.
  • Experience managing multiple technical projects and priorities simultaneously.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in:
    • Oracle Database Administration
    • Microsoft SQL Server Administration
    • SQL development and performance tuning
    • Database security administration
    • Unix/Linux administration
    • Shell scripting
    • Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery methodologies
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Strong documentation and process development skills.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to work overtime and support 24x7 operations when required.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Database Administrator, you will specialize in managing and optimizing databases to ensure the smooth operation and efficient performance of applications relying on databases. Your focus will be on installing, configuring, and maintaining databases, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies and performing performance tuning.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install and Configure Databases: Install, configure, and maintain databases to ensure high availability and optimal performance. This includes setting up database systems, defining database structures, and configuring database parameters.
  • Implement Disaster Recovery Strategies: Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies to minimize data loss and ensure business continuity in the event of a disaster.
  • Perform Performance Tuning: Analyze database performance and implement tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Maintain Database Systems: Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as backups, upgrades, and patches, to ensure database systems remain secure and up-to-date.
  • Ensure High Availability: Implement measures to ensure high availability, including clustering, replication, and failover systems, to minimize downtime and ensure continuous access to databases.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Database Management Experience: Exposure to managing and optimizing databases using products such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, and Teradata, with a focus on ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
  • System Administration Knowledge: Experience working with system administration concepts, including installing, configuring, and maintaining database systems, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies.
  • Programming Understanding: Exposure to programming concepts and their application in database management, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • Database Concepts Familiarity: Experience working with database concepts, including database structures, database parameters, and data modeling.
  • Performance Tuning Skills: Exposure to analyzing database performance and implementing tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Database Concepts: Exposure to advanced database concepts, including data warehousing, data governance, and data quality, would be beneficial in this role.
  • Scripting and Automation: Experience with scripting languages, such as Python, PowerShell, or SQL, and automation tools would be advantageous in automating database tasks and workflows.
  • Cloud Database Services: Familiarity with cloud-based database services, such as Amazon RDS or Azure SQL Database, would be valuable in managing and optimizing cloud-based databases.
  • Preferred Skills: App DBA | Oracle Logical DBA, RAIS, OPUS, SURGE, cloud migr.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

seeking a highly skilled multi-platform Database Administrator (DBA) to manage and optimize our critical data infrastructure. You will be responsible for the health, performance, security, and availability of our Netezza data warehouse appliances, Oracle RAC databases, and DB2 systems. The ideal candidate will provide 24/7 production support and lead database upgrade/migration projects

Roles & Responsibilities

Netezza Administration: Perform NPS (Netezza Performance Server) administration, including grooming, Genstats, user management, and NzAdmin/NZMigrate tool usage.

Oracle Database Administration: Install, configure, upgrade, and patch Oracle 12c/19c/21c. Manage Oracle RAC (Real Application Clusters), ASM (Automatic Storage Management), and Data Guard for high availability.

DB2 Administration: Administer DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) or z/OS. Perform table space management, reorgs, runstats, and image copies.

Performance Tuning: Perform end-to-end SQL tuning and system optimization across all three platforms.

Backup & Recovery: Develop, test, and maintain automated backup/recovery strategies, ensuring strict RPO/RTO adherence.

Security & Compliance: Implement database security policies, manage user permissions, and ensure compliance with auditing standards.

Scripting & Automation: Automate repetitive DBA tasks using Shell scripting (Bash/Korn) or Python

Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 per year

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

  • Install, configure, and maintain Oracle database instances (All Versions/11g, 12c, 19c).
  • Perform routine database monitoring, including performance tuning and query optimization.
  • Configure and manage Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Data Guard, and RMAN.
  • Implement and manage backup, restore, and disaster recovery strategies using RMAN.

  • Automate administrative tasks using Oracle scripts (PL/SQL, Bash, Perl).

  • Deep expertise in Oracle performance tuning, backups, RMAN, and database optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, and ASM.
  • Proficient in PL/SQL scripting and automation.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Exadata, Oracle Cloud, and cloud-based solutions (OCI, AWS).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for complex database issues.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) and other monitoring tools.

Database Administration and SQL

  • Security and compliance: Strong understanding of roles, privileges, authentication, encryption, auditing, data protection and database security standards.

Database Design, Data Modelling and Analysis

  • Database design: Ability to translate functional and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable relational database designs.
  • Data modelling: Strong experience creating conceptual, logical and physical data models, entity-relationship diagrams, schemas, tables, keys, constraints and data dictionaries.
  • Normalisation: Sound knowledge of normalisation and denormalisation techniques, referential integrity, data quality controls and appropriate modelling patterns.
  • Data analysis: Ability to profile and analyse datasets, identify relationships and anomalies, validate data quality, reconcile results and support root-cause analysis.
  • Documentation: Experience maintaining database standards, design specifications, lineage, metadata and operational runbooks.

ETL and Data Integration

  • ETL development: Hands-on experience designing, developing, scheduling and supporting ETL workflows for extracting, transforming and loading data across heterogeneous sources and targets.
  • Data transformation: Strong knowledge of data mapping, cleansing, validation, deduplication, reconciliation, error handling and restart/recovery processes.
  • Performance and reliability: Ability to optimise batch loads, manage large data volumes, implement incremental and change-data-capture patterns, and monitor pipeline performance.
  • Production support: Experience troubleshooting database and ETL failures, conducting root-cause analysis, implementing permanent fixes and supporting controlled releases.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with applica tion, data engineering, architecture, infrastructure and business teams to deliver reliable data solutions.

  • Design and implement scalable relational database structures, including schemas, tables, keys, constraints, indexes and data dictionaries.
  • Develop, review and optimise complex SQL queries, views, stored procedures, functions and triggers for transactional and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor database health and performance; analyse execution plans and resolve query bottlenecks, locking, blocking and long-running transactions.
  • Manage backup, restore, point-in-time recovery, replication, high availability and failover processes, and regularly validate recoverability.
  • Perform capacity planning, storage management, routine maintenance and proactive monitoring to ensure database availability, scalability and reliability.
  • Create and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models; apply normalisation, denormalisation and referential-integrity standards.
  • Profile and analyse data, identify anomalies, validate data quality, reconcile results and support root-cause analysis.
  • Design, develop, schedule and support ETL workflows, including data mapping, cleansing, transformation, validation, deduplication and error handling.
  • Optimise batch and large-volume data loads, and implement incremental-load and change-data-capture patterns where required.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls covering roles, privileges, authentication, encryption, auditing and data protection.
  • Troubleshoot database and ETL incidents, implement permanent fixes, support controlled releases and maintain operational runbooks, metadata and data-lineage documentation.
  • Collaborate with application, data engineering, architecture, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver secure and reliable data solutions.

Salary Range: $90,000 to $130,000 per year

Job Description:

General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) is seeking a Senior PostgreSQL Database Engineer to support the operation, design, and continuous improvement of database capabilities for a mission-critical system.

This position combines hands-on PostgreSQL administration with database engineering and architecture. You will serve as the team's primary database subject matter expert, partnering with software developers and systems engineers to maintain reliable database operations while improving database performance, design, security, and maintainability.

Our environment uses PostgreSQL for both transactional and analytical data workloads and leverages OpenShift for application deployment. The ideal candidate enjoys solving practical database challenges, can independently troubleshoot operational issues, and can recommend and implement improvements to how databases are designed, deployed, monitored, and maintained.

What You'll Do

  • Administer PostgreSQL databases: Manage database configuration, user accounts, roles, permissions, routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Design and improve database architectures: Develop and refine schemas, data models, indexing strategies, and data access patterns to support application functionality, performance, and evolving system requirements.
  • Optimize database performance: Analyze SQL queries and execution plans, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement improvements to queries, indexes, database configuration, and resource utilization.
  • Support database operations in OpenShift environments: Collaborate with platform and application teams to support PostgreSQL deployment, connectivity, configuration, monitoring, and operational integration with OpenShift-based systems.
  • Maintain database reliability and recoverability: Implement and maintain backup and restore procedures, validate recovery processes, and support existing high-availability, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Monitor database health: Configure and maintain database monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity tracking, and operational reporting to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with software developers: Advise on schema design, SQL development, transaction management, data access patterns, and database integration to ensure efficient and reliable application behavior.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Identify database performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability improvements; evaluate appropriate tools and approaches; and implement practical solutions.
  • Support database lifecycle management: Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and modernization efforts while minimizing operational risk and service disruption.
  • Establish and maintain standards: Document database architecture, configurations, security controls, operational procedures, and recommended engineering practices.
  • Maintain database security: Apply appropriate access controls, least-privilege permissions, auditing, and security practices in accordance with applicable customer and system requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance: Serve as the primary database technical resource for the engineering team, helping troubleshoot issues and make informed decisions about database design and operational practices.

Required Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance and ability to obtain and maintain a polygraph. Polygraph sponsorship may be available.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent education, training, certifications, and experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in database administration, database engineering, database architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting PostgreSQL databases.
  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, SQL, schema development, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience troubleshooting database issues and managing database users, roles, permissions, and configurations.
  • Experience with database backups, restores, upgrades, and routine maintenance.
  • Working knowledge of database high availability, replication, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to collaborate with developers and infrastructure engineers to resolve technical issues and improve system performance.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL in OpenShift, Kubernetes, containerized, or Linux-based environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL replication, failover, connection pooling, or high-availability technologies.
  • Experience with database monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting both transactional and analytical data workloads.
  • Experience with database automation, scripting, infrastructure as code, or repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with database security practices in regulated or classified environments.
  • Experience with Oracle database administration or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent, as required by the applicable customer environment.

  • Location: On-site at the customer location.

Description

Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for a Principal Database Engineer in our INTEL SECTOR's Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA). Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos, we offer competitive benefits, including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more. Join us and make a difference in National Security!

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze system requirements to develop system architecture, design documentation, and technical specifications supporting large‑scale enterprise environments.
  • Create system configuration documentation including capacity planning, performance modeling, risk assessments, and analysis of alternatives for complex system challenges.
  • Provide database engineering leadership for large distributed systems, ensuring robust design, integration, and scalability across interconnected components.
  • Collaborate across Agile teams including integration engineers, testers, IA engineers, and technical managers to support end‑to‑end system delivery.
  • Design and administer databases ensuring normalized schemas, compliance with security standards, and alignment with industry best practices.
  • Implement and maintain database environments including installations, upgrades, patching, object creation (tables, indexes, views, stored procedures), and performance tuning.
  • Ensure system reliability by monitoring performance, resolving bottlenecks, validating backups, and documenting disaster recovery strategies.
  • Support long‑term planning by forecasting future database needs, advising development teams, preparing progress reports, and contributing to program increment planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors of Science Degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or a related field with at least 18+ years of related experience or a Master’s Degree with at least 15+ years of relevant experience. Will consider work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Active DoD Secret Clearance to be considered and be eligible to obtain up to a TS/SCI clearance in the future.
  • Experience in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
  • Minimum of 15 years of professional experience as a database administrator.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in developing database architectures.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and administering highly available relational database environments, including the development of functions, stored procedures, and triggers, using Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable enterprise database technologies
  • Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, database clustering, replication, load balancing, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery in production environments
  • Experience supporting database workloads in Kubernetes and AWS, Azure, or hybrid-cloud environments
  • Experience in supporting development efforts in all phases of the development life cycle.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic team environment, manage time effectively, meet schedules, and participate in Agile Scrum activities
  • DoD 8570 approved security certification (i.e., Security +) (Will be required 90 days after hire).

Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledgeable in Agile Methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Lean), particular to the incorporation of security / IA into the lifecycle.
  • Experience integrating security into a Continuous Integration Environment.
  • Knowledgeable on various web services / service-oriented architectures
  • Experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL high-availability, replication, and recovery technologies
  • Experience with cloud-based database services and containerized database platforms
  • Previous experience in Administration and Operations roles.

Pay Range $154,050.00 - $278,475.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). descriptionHtml:
Your journey as a Principal Database Administrator starts here! This role is essential to maintaining the stability, security, and availability of GovCloud database environments that support Epicor customers. The Principal Database Administrator design, implement, and support databases to meet business requirements, develop database strategies, and ensure robust system monitoring. You will play a key role in advising management, mentoring team members, and driving best practices for database management. We are seeking applicants with strong leadership, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Advise management on database concepts and functional capabilities, translating data models or user specifications into designs that comply with standards, guidelines, procedures, and processes.
  • Install, configure, and maintain database management system product software on database and application servers.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex databases, including access methods, access time, device allocation, validation checks, organization, protection, and security.
  • Apply telemetry and observability practices to interpret database metrics, and other operational signals using Datadog or comparable monitoring tools; identify patterns, anomalies, and potential root causes to improve database reliability and performance.
  • Deliver formal and informal training, mentorship, and support to other Database Admins.
  • Recommend and implement best practices, keeping up with external trends to incorporate into products and processes.
  • Lead and manage database projects, ensuring deadlines are met and schedules are maintained.

What You Will Likely Bring

  • 8+ years’ applicable experience and demonstrated success/knowledge, including 3+ years of specialized or industry experience.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to propose and implement new ideas, lead a team to meet deadlines, and manage schedules effectively.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to mentor others.
  • Analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Recognized as a thought leader and change agent.
  • Expertise in running Microsoft Access queries and updates, with broad database management experience.

Sponsorship

This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without Epicor sponsorship.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon Epicor’s determination that the candidate can lawfully be provided the access required for the position. At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology.   • Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer.

About Us

Augusta University is Georgia's innovation center for education and health care, training the next generation of innovators, leaders, and healthcare providers in classrooms and clinics on four campuses in Augusta and locations across the state. More than 12,000 students choose Augusta for educational opportunities at the center of Georgia's cybersecurity hub and experiential learning that blends arts and application, humanities, and the health sciences. Augusta is home to Georgia's only public academic health center, where groundbreaking research is creating a healthier, more prosperous Georgia, and world-class clinicians are bringing the medicine of tomorrow to patient care today. Our mission and values https://www.augusta.edu/about/mission.php make Augusta University an institution like no other.

Augusta University's distinct characteristics in education and research include real-world experiences and community engagement, as well as a culture of building community, corporate and government partnerships that address health, security, economic and societal concerns locally and across the state.

The University System of Georgia https://www.usg.edu/hr/orientation/welcome_to_the_board_of_regents_university_system_office is comprised of our 26 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8.2.18.1.2 and can be found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/#p8.2.18_personnel_conduct.

Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653 .

Location

Augusta University -

Our Health Sciences Campus:

1120 15th Street, Augusta, GA 30912

Our Summerville Campus:

2500 Walton Way, Augusta, GA 30904

College/Department Information

The Division of Information Technology's mission at Augusta University is to anticipate and respond effectively to a changing world with agile, innovative, robust and secure services that educate and inspire students, empower clinicians, educators, researchers and administrators, advance learning, discovery and care.

Job Summary

Administers, maintains, and supports Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server environments. Develops and implements database structures, data models, and data access solutions. Monitors database performance, availability, and capacity; troubleshoots database issues; and supports efforts to optimize performance, reliability, and resource utilization. Assists with installation, configuration, maintenance, patching, and upgrades of database software and related tools. Monitors and manages backups, transaction logs, recovery processes, and data restoration activities. Supports disaster recovery planning, testing, and documentation. Evaluates and tests new database technologies, software, hardware, and procedures. Collaborates with application developers, systems administrators, and support personnel to ensure effective use of database technologies, provide technical assistance related to data management and application security, and resolve technical issues. Implements and maintains database security controls, supports database migrations and upgrades, monitors scheduled jobs, ensures compliance with established standards and procedures, and maintains knowledge of database administration technologies, best practices, and emerging trends to support reliable and secure operations.

Responsibilities

The duties include but are not limited to:

DATA MODELING & DESIGN: Assists in the review, development, and maintenance of logical and physical data models using standard modeling and diagramming technicques in collaborarion with application development teams. Supports the translation of logical data models into efficient physical database structures and ensures compatibility with existing and proposed Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server database environments.

DATABASE ADMINISTRATION: Assists in monitoring and optimizing Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases to improve performance, availability, resource utilization, and operational efficiency. Supports database tuning, capacity planning, and physical database implementations, and assists in resolving database integration challenges. Assists with data migrations, database conversions, system upgrades, and the deployment of new applications.

DATABASE SECURITY & SUPPORT OR DATABASE SECURITY MANAGEMENT: Assists in monitoring and maintaining database security, access controls, and database software in collaboration with information security personnel and system administrators. Supports the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new procedures, software, hardware, and database technologies to enhance system reliability, security, and performance.

BACKUP & RECOVERY SUPPORT: Monitors and manages database backups, transaction logs, and recovery processes to ensure data integrity and availability. Installs, maintains, patches, and upgrades Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server database software and performs data restoration and recovery activities as required.

DATABASE TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical assistance to application developers, programmers, and systems support personnel regarding the effective use of database technologies, SQL, and database development tools. Assists with troubleshooting database-related issues, resolving data management challenges, supporting exception-processing requirements, and addressing application security concerns.

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Maintains current knowledge of database administration practices, emerging technologies, industry standards, and enterprise data management solutions. Participates in ongoing professional development to support the effective administration of Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server database environments.

OTHER: Perform all other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in from accredited college or university and three years of related experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience should include database backup and recovery, performance monitoring and tuning, security administration, troubleshooting, database maintenance, and the use of SQL and/or PL/SQL. Experience administering relational database management systems, with primary experience in Oracle Database and working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server. Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and demonstrated ability to develop, analyze, and optimize SQL queries are required. Experience supporting enterprise applications, databases, and information technology services within a higher education environment.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

KNOWLEDGE

Thorough knowledge of Oracle Database administration, including backup and recovery, performance monitoring and tuning, security administration, patching, and troubleshooting.

Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server administration and related database management tools.

Working knowledge of Linux and Unix operating systems, including command-line utilities, file systems, process management, and shell scripting.

Skills

High attention to detail

Excellent verbal/written communication, interpersonal, and public speaking skills.

Experience with multiple application systems including purchased packages, complex relational database systems, data warehouse reporting and web-based systems.

Experience with business systems applications in finance and/or human resources; business systems applications development and systems implementations, and problem diagnosis and troubleshooting techniques.

Experience with web-based business processes such as recruitment, employee self-serve, etc.

Knowledge of techniques and methods of systems analysis and design; IT security methods for managing confidential data.

Understanding of principles and practices of training.

Abilities

Ability to understand and relate to customer needs; rapidly isolate and solve application system problems.

Ability to exercise sound judgment; maintain confidentiality.

Shift/Salary/Benefits

Shift: Days; M-F (Work outside of the standard business hours may be required)

Pay Band: B14

Salary Range: $75,300/annually - $82,673/annually

Salary to be commensurate with qualifications of the selected candidate within the established range (generally minimum-midpoint) of the position

Recruitment Period: 11/6/2026 - Until Filled

Augusta University offers a variety of benefits to full-time benefits-eligible employees and some of our half-time (or more) employees.

Benefits that may be elected could include health insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, Teachers Retirement System (or Optional Retirement Plan), as well as earned vacation time, sick leave, and 13 paid holidays.

Also, our full-time employees who have been employed with us successfully for more than 6 months can be considered for the Tuition Assistance Program. Consider applying with us today!

Conditions of Employment

All selected candidates are required to successfully pass a Background Check review prior to starting with Augusta University.

If applicable for the specific position based on the duties: the candidate will also need to have a credit check completed for Positions of Trust and or approved departmental Purchase Card usage.

Motor vehicle reports are required for positions that are required to drive an Augusta University vehicle.

For Faculty Hires: Final candidates will be required to provide proof of completed academic degree(s) as well as post-secondary coursework in the form of original transcript(s). Those candidates trained by a foreign institution will also be required to provide an educational/credential evaluation.

All employees are responsible for ensuring the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of sensitive [patient, student, employee, financial, business, etc.] information by exercising sound judgment and adhering to cybersecurity and privacy policies during their employment and beyond.

Other Information

This position is also responsible for promoting a customer-friendly environment and providing superior service to our patients, students, faculty, and employees. "Augusta University is a patient-and family-centered care institution, where employees partner every day with patients and families for success."

Augusta University is a tobacco-free environment, and the use of any tobacco products on any part of the campus, both inside and outside, is strictly prohibited.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Augusta University is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, sex, or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

How To Apply

Consider applying with us today!

Applicants are encouraged to tailor their resumes to the position of interest by clearly highlighting relevant work experience and skills gained from previous employment. Resumes should reflect how your background aligns with the qualifications and responsibilities of the role.

https://www.augusta.edu/hr/jobs/

Select University Faculty & Staff > External Applicants if you are a candidate from outside the university.

Select University Faculty & Staff > Internal Applicants if you are a current university employee.

If you need further assistance, please contact us at 706-721-9365.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Database Administrator, you will specialize in managing and optimizing databases to ensure the smooth operation and efficient performance of applications relying on databases. Your expertise in database concepts, system administration, and programming will be crucial in delivering high-quality solutions.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install and Configure Databases: Install, configure, and maintain databases to meet business requirements, ensuring high availability and implementing disaster recovery strategies to minimize downtime.
  • Performance Tuning: Perform performance tuning to optimize database efficiency, leveraging your understanding of database concepts and system administration to identify areas for improvement.
  • Database Maintenance: Maintain databases to ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational standards, utilizing your knowledge of programming and database management best practices.
  • Disaster Recovery: Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity in the event of database failure or data loss, aligning with organizational requirements and industry standards.
  • System Administration: Collaborate with system administrators to ensure seamless integration of databases with overall system architecture, applying your understanding of system administration principles to drive efficient operations.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Database Management Experience: Experience with database management systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance of databases to meet business requirements, ensuring high availability and implementing disaster recovery strategies.
  • Performance Optimization: Experience in performance tuning to optimize database efficiency, leveraging understanding of database concepts and system administration to identify areas for improvement.
  • System Administration Knowledge: Experience with system administration principles, collaborating with system administrators to ensure seamless integration of databases with overall system architecture.
  • Database Security and Compliance: Experience in maintaining databases to ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational standards, utilizing knowledge of programming and database management best practices.
  • Disaster Recovery Planning: Experience in developing and implementing disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity in the event of database failure or data loss, aligning with organizational requirements and industry standards.
  • Preferred Skills: DB2 Mainframe DBA, Oracle system DBA

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Database Product Familiarity: Experience with various database products such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, and Teradata, with the ability to manage and optimize databases for high availability and performance.
  • Advanced Database Concepts: Experience with advanced database concepts, including performance tuning, disaster recovery strategies, and database security, to ensure efficient database operations and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Programming Skills: Experience with programming languages and database management best practices to maintain data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational standards.

descriptionHtml:
Stevens Capital Management LP (SCM) is committed to a workplace that values and promotes diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunity by ensuring that all employees are valued, heard, engaged and involved at work and have full opportunities to collaborate, contribute and grow professionally.


We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Database Administrator to join a research and trading development team responsible for developing and deploying leading edge mission critical financial trading applications. You will join in the management of proprietary and Sybase database systems to that facilitate management of large scale time series databases. As this environment continues to grow we seek a Database Administrator to work on all aspects of our databases, from high performance online transaction processing (2000tps) to data warehousing (250G+ servers) issues. This is a fast-paced/demanding environment. The user base consists of 20 technical and 20 non-technical users. SCM's selective hiring process considers only highly talented individuals with a history of exceptional professional and academic achievement, and solid real-world experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, monitor, and optimize database systems to ensure performance, availability, and reliability.
  • Design and support relational database structures using sound database design principles and best practices.
  • Perform database backup, restore, disaster recovery planning, and recovery operations.
  • Conduct capacity planning and proactively manage storage growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Monitor and tune database and server performance to maximize efficiency and system responsiveness.
  • Manage database security, including user administration, permissions, and access controls.
  • Troubleshoot database issues and perform root-cause analysis for incidents and performance bottlenecks.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools for administration and monitoring tasks.
  • Support and administer alternative data storage technologies and platforms.
  • Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to ensure database solutions align with business and technical requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • Solid understanding of SQL, relational database fundamentals, and database design principles.
  • Experience administering SAP ASE (Sybase/SAP) or other enterprise database systems.
  • Strong experience with database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server and/or Sybase/SAP ASE.
  • Working knowledge of:
  • Backup and Restore procedures
  • Capacity Planning
  • Server Performance Tuning
  • User Administration and Security Management
  • Experience with database performance monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of programming in both lower-level languages and scripting languages for automation and tooling.
  • Ability to administer and support alternative data storage technologies including:
  • Kafka
  • PostgreSQL
  • MySQL
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


The base pay for this position is anticipated to be between $100,000 and $200,000 per year. The anticipated annual base pay range is current as of the time this job post was generated. This position is eligible for other forms of compensation and benefits such as bonus, health and dental plans and 401(k) contributions, which includes a discretionary profit sharing program. An employee’s bonus and related compensation benefits can be a significant portion of total compensation. Actual compensation for successful candidates will be carefully determined based on a number of factors, including their skills, qualifications and experience.

  • Monitor database health, availability, capacity, and performance.

  • Support database maintenance, upgrade, and migration activities.

  • Support database performance tuning and optimization activities.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises

Job Description

Role - Database Admin

Experience Required -5+ Years

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, YugabyteDB, Aurora PostgreSQL, Aurora MySQL, and Spanner

Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP

IaC: Terraform

Configuration Management: Ansible

Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, ORACLE OEM

Containers: Docker, Kubernetes

Scripting: Shell, Python, PowerShell

Operating Systems: Linux/Unix/windows

Roles & Responsibilities

Provide 24x7 support for Production (E3) and lower environments; act as the first point of contact for database incidents, restore service, perform troubleshooting, and route issues when required.

Manage database startups, shutdowns, restarts, instance failover, switchover, parameter changes, and pre/post maintenance validations.

Monitor database availability, alert logs, OEM alerts, health checks, and infrastructure-related issues; perform root cause analysis for Sev1 and Sev2 incidents.

Troubleshoot database and SQL performance using AWR, ASH, explain plans, locks, deadlocks, blocking sessions, and long-running session reports.

Manage database, tablespace, ASM, archive log, backup, Oracle Home, and OS filesystem capacity; forecast space needs and coordinate storage additions.

Perform proactive and ad-hoc backups, restore points, flashback restores, RMAN table recovery, database restoration, and standby database rebuild.

Support OS and database patching, upgrades, migrations, server reboots, and application or database maintenance changes.

Schedule and maintain backup and database jobs using OEM and CRON; configure monitoring thresholds, alerts, reports, and Grafana dashboards.

Administer users, profiles, roles, privileges, schema unlocks, DBA IDs, application access, and required access for RFC execution.

Maintain database security, audit configuration, TDE, encryption, and object validity checks.

Monitor and support Data Guard, GoldenGate, PostgreSQL/SQL Server/YugabyteDB replication, replication lag resolution, DR activities, switchovers, and failovers.

Support export/import, data truncation, and application-requested database activities in accordance with change controls.

Develop self-service and automation tools.

Raise and coordinate vendor cases for DBMS software issues and work directly with application, infrastructure, development, and DBA teams.

Drive documentation, standardization, operational improvements, and DBA process automation.

Experience in scripting and AI related tools.

Experience on Public cloud environments.

Base Salary Range : $90,000 to $120,000 Per Annum

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Tra ining Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Standard Job Description

Implements and maintains smooth operation and physical design of databases. Reviews database design and integration of systems, provides backup recovery and makes recommendations regarding enhancements and/or improvements. Maintains security and integrity controls. Formulates policies, procedures, and standards relating to database management, and monitors transaction activity and utilization. Responsibilities include: database loading; development and management of operational procedures; environment management; database health (e.g. monitoring, proactive and reactive responses); resource planning; database upgrade planning; backup and recovery strategy planning and implementation; environment transition planning (development, test, stage, production).

Basic Qualifications

BS in Computer Science or related field.

5 years of experience working with Linux.

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government SECRET clearance.

Desired Skills

Active TS/SCI

Experience working with U.S. Special Operations Forces.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $94400.00 - $175200.00

descriptionHtml:
Your journey as a Principal Database Administrator starts here! This role is essential to maintaining the stability, security, and availability of GovCloud database environments that support Epicor customers. The Principal Database Administrator design, implement, and support databases to meet business requirements, develop database strategies, and ensure robust system monitoring. You will play a key role in advising management, mentoring team members, and driving best practices for database management. We are seeking applicants with strong leadership, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Advise management on database concepts and functional capabilities, translating data models or user specifications into designs that comply with standards, guidelines, procedures, and processes.
  • Install, configure, and maintain database management system product software on database and application servers.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex databases, including access methods, access time, device allocation, validation checks, organization, protection, and security.
  • Apply telemetry and observability practices to interpret database metrics, and other operational signals using Datadog or comparable monitoring tools; identify patterns, anomalies, and potential root causes to improve database reliability and performance.
  • Deliver formal and informal training, mentorship, and support to other Database Admins.
  • Recommend and implement best practices, keeping up with external trends to incorporate into products and processes.
  • Lead and manage database projects, ensuring deadlines are met and schedules are maintained.

What You Will Likely Bring

  • 8+ years’ applicable experience and demonstrated success/knowledge, including 3+ years of specialized or industry experience.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to propose and implement new ideas, lead a team to meet deadlines, and manage schedules effectively.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to mentor others.
  • Analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Recognized as a thought leader and change agent.
  • Expertise in running Microsoft Access queries and updates, with broad database management experience.

Sponsorship

This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without Epicor sponsorship.

Export Control

This position requires access to customer information subject to U.S. export-control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by applicable law or otherwise eligible to obtain any required U.S. government authorization to access such information. Any offer of employment is contingent upon Epicor’s determination that the candidate can lawfully be provided the access required for the position. For these purposes, a U.S. person generally includes a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
  • Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
  • Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
  • Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
  • Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
  • Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

The Opportunity

Make a difference and join an enthusiastic team dedicated to improving the lives of today's military! CACI is seeking a Senior Database Administrator/Developer (DBA). In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust database software, primarily utilizing SQL and advanced PL/SQL performance tuning to address user requirements and resolve existing software defects. Job Title: SQL Database Administrator / Database Performance Engineer – ServiceNow Platform

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: None

Type of Travel: None

* * *

We are seeking an experienced and motivated PostgreSQL Database Administrator / Database Performance Engineer to join our Federal IT Operations team. You will support and optimize a large-scale ServiceNow platform environment that is mission-critical to national security operations. The role focuses on PostgreSQL database performance, SQL optimization, data architecture, scalability, integrations, and troubleshooting of data-intensive workloads across the ServiceNow ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in enterprise relational databases and SQL, with deep, hands-on PostgreSQL experience. They have supported high-volume SaaS or application platforms. Familiarity with ServiceNow architecture and data models is preferred, as is experience with ServiceNow RaptorDB Professional. The role requires technical expertise, problem-solving ability, adaptability, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in a secure, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Database Administration & Performance Engineering:

  • Provide database and SQL expertise in support of enterprise ServiceNow environments, applications, integrations, and reporting workloads.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot database performance issues, including inefficient queries, large-table operations, indexing, transaction performance, and high-volume data access patterns.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements to queries, table structures, data models, archival strategies, and application design.
  • Review SQL and data-access patterns associated with integrations, reporting, analytics, ETL/data pipelines, APIs, and custom applications.
  • Monitor database and application performance, availability, and capacity metrics, and proactively identify trends and potential issues.
  • Support capacity planning and performance analysis for large and rapidly growing ServiceNow datasets.
  • Assist with data retention, archival, purge, and lifecycle-management strategies.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, and storage solutions.
  • Support database hardening, patching, and compliance with DoD/Federal security standards (STIGs, DISA, NIST).
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation (e.g., PL/pgSQL, PowerShell, Python, Bash) for database provisioning, configuration management, and routine maintenance.
  • Support and manage databases hosted on AWS EC2, including instance sizing, storage (EBS) performance, snapshots and backups, and network connectivity.

ServiceNow Platform Support

  • Advise development teams on database design, query optimization, normalization/denormalization, indexing, and efficient data-access practices.
  • Support ServiceNow upgrades, migrations, major platform changes, and database modernization initiatives.
  • Work with ServiceNow and internal engineering teams on RaptorDB-related performance, migration, analytics, and architecture considerations.
  • Support incident, problem, and root-cause analysis for performance and data-related production issues.

General Duties

  • Partner with ServiceNow platform architects, developers, administrators, network, security, infrastructure, and application teams to improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work within an Agile/Scrum team, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, and delivering database work in alignment with sprint priorities.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, performance baselines, and database best practices.
  • Participate in the on-call support rotation and provide occasional off-hours support as needed.
  • Respond to critical system alerts and incidents in a timely manner.
  • Support accreditation and certification activities in alignment with RMF (Risk Management Framework).

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience).
  • Experience in federal government or DoD environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GovCloud) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or relevant database certifications.
  • Current IAT Level II certification (Security+ or equivalent).
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) completed within 60 days of start date.
  • 5+ years of experience in database administration, database engineering, or SQL performance engineering, with at least 3 years focused on PostgreSQL administration and performance tuning.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy in database changes, configurations, and deliverables.
  • Ability to write clear, accurate, and usable documentation (e.g., runbooks, procedures, performance baselines) that others can follow and maintain.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with platform engineers, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a secure, team-oriented, mission-driven environment.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to translate database-level findings into actionable recommendations for ServiceNow developers and architects.
  • Proactive about performance, scalability, data quality, and operational reliability.

Desired Qualifications

  • ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, tables, and relationships, including large-table considerations.
  • Experience with ServiceNow RaptorDB Professional, including: o Understanding of its architecture, performance characteristics, and migration considerations. SQL-based data access, analytical workloads, column-store technologies, or large-scale operational analytics.
  • ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Workflow Data Fabric, or related data and analytics capabilities.
  • ServiceNow query and transaction performance, including how GlideRecord and application data-access patterns affect the database.
  • ServiceNow integration and data-load mechanisms (REST/SOAP integrations, Import Sets, and Transform Maps) and their impact on database load.
  • ServiceNow at enterprise scale, including environments with very large datasets, high transaction volumes, or significant reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Performance troubleshooting and optimization in a ServiceNow environment. Advanced SQL skills, with demonstrated experience analyzing and optimizing complex queries.
  • Strong understanding of relational database concepts, including:
  • Query execution and optimization.
  • Indexing strategies.
  • Data modeling.
  • Transactions and locking.
  • Database performance tuning.
  • Large-table and high-volume data management.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork
