descriptionHtml:
Description

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

At SCI Technology, a Sanmina Company, we serve those who serve by delivering innovative, trusted and comprehensive products and services that meet and exceed the unique needs of the Defense and Aerospace sector. From avionics to tactical and airborne communications, counter-UAS, integrated manufacturing and cradle-to-grave product life cycle support, we deliver high-reliability solutions that keep service members connected and protected in the field.

Our heritage dates to 1961, as an early supplier to the space program in Huntsville, Alabama. Today, SCI offers a complete range of Defense & Aerospace solutions through our three business segments – Products, Systems Build, and Life Cycle Services. It’s SCI summed up - ALL WE DO to serve those who serve.

As a Senior Database Administrator, you will serve as the primary technical expert responsible for the stability, optimization, and security of our core Oracle Database infrastructure and our Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) 11i legacy environment. Because this enterprise environment operates under strict change-freeze and non-patching constraints, you will focus heavily on compensating security controls, network isolation, and proactive mitigation to protect vulnerable systems without altering core database code. While Oracle EBS and Oracle Database administration are the primary requirements for this role, additional experience managing MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server is a highly valued asset.

What You'll Do

  • Legacy Environments & Compensating Security: Enforce strict security postures for non-patchable systems (e.g., Oracle EBS 11i) through virtual patching, database firewalls, and host-level security configurations.
  • Network Isolation: Architect and maintain tight network segregation, ensuring Oracle database access is strictly restricted to authorized application servers and admin jump boxes.
  • Advanced Monitoring & Auditing: Implement and oversee deep database auditing (monitoring SYS, SYSTEM, and APPS accounts) to detect and alert on anomalous activity or exploit attempts in real time.
  • EBS 11i Maintenance: Troubleshoot, clone, and support the database backend for Oracle EBS 11i environments while ensuring absolute stability and zero disruption to legacy custom code.
  • Performance & Query Tuning: Monitor system health, code complex SQL/PL-SQL queries, and optimize index structures and query plans to maximize speed without relying on version upgrades.
  • High Availability & Recovery: Maintain, document, and test rigorous backup strategies (e.g., Oracle RMAN) and disaster recovery (DR) plans to ensure rapid recovery options.
  • Cross-Platform Support: Provide secondary administrative support, general maintenance, and basic troubleshooting for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server environments as required.
  • Risk Advisory & Collaboration: Serve as the subject matter expert to management on the security risks of legacy infrastructure, presenting technical recommendations for future modernization or safe migration paths, and partner with developers, DevOps, and functional analysts.

What You'll Bring

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) with a minimum of 5–7 years of experience as a Database Administrator working in enterprise environments.
  • Compliance & Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship / U.S. Person status is required due to compliance, security, and export control regulations.
  • Oracle EBS Expertise: Deep administrative experience with Oracle EBS 11i (architecture, concurrent managers, cloning) and older Oracle database versions.
  • Database Security Hardening: Proven experience securing databases using alternative methods when patching is not permitted (e.g., Database Firewalls, native auditing, network ACLs).
  • Optimization & Scripting: Expert-level knowledge of advanced SQL, PL/SQL tuning, and Shell/Python scripting for automation.
  • Professional Attributes: Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and legacy-system debugging skills under tight constraints, along with excellent communication skills to articulate technical constraints and security risks.

How To Stand Out

  • General hands-on experience or familiarity with secondary database platforms (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server)
  • Experience planning migration paths from legacy systems (like EBS 11i) to modern cloud or hybrid infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Certifications in Database Security or platform-specific credentials (e.g., Oracle Certified Professional)

Why Join Us?

At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. All offers of employment are contingent on the applicant either 1) being a "U.S. Person," defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident, or (iii) other protected individual, such as a refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158; or 2) being eligible to obtain a timely export control license or license exception from the applicable U.S. federal agency.

descriptionHtml:
Amentum is seeking a full-time Senior Database Administrator to support a Department of War (DoW) customer in Spokane, Washington. The successful candidate will provide enterprise database administration and SharePoint infrastructure support in a secure DoW environment. This position requires extensive experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, SharePoint 2019 on-premises, Windows Server technologies, cybersecurity compliance, and enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a highly structured mission-focused environment.

Main Responsibilities:

Database Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server 2019 – 2025 environments across development, test, and production systems.
  • Design, implement, and support secure, highly available database solutions.
  • Monitor database health, performance, and capacity; perform query tuning, index optimization, and routine maintenance.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle activities.
  • Configure and maintain high availability technologies including Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering.
  • Implement database security through access controls, encryption, auditing, and STIG compliance.
  • Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, replication, and integrity issues.
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and T-SQL to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with developers on database design, schema changes, stored procedures, and application performance optimization.
  • Create custom reports based on customer requirements.

SharePoint Administration

  • Administer and support SharePoint Server 2019 on-premises environments, including installation, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, and upgrades.
  • Manage SharePoint farms, site collections, service applications, content databases, permissions, and Active Directory integration.
  • Support SharePoint customizations using ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET MVC, C#, CSOM, and SharePoint Server APIs.
  • Configure and maintain document libraries, lists, workflows, and enterprise collaboration features.
  • Perform SharePoint backup, restoration, disaster recovery testing, and system maintenance.
  • Provide technical support to site owners and end users while resolving SharePoint-related issues.
  • Security, Operations & Collaboration
  • Apply DoD STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Monitor system availability and participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and change management activities.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and implementation plans.
  • Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and architecture diagrams.
  • Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, developers, cybersecurity personnel, and government stakeholders to support mission objectives.
  • Provide technical mentoring, knowledge transfer, and occasional after-hours support during maintenance windows or operational requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Must have an active Top Secret US Government Security Clearance with SCI eligibility. Note: US Citizenship is required to maintain a Top Secret Clearance.
  • 7 or more years of experience administering Microsoft SQL Server and SharePoint 2016/2019 in an enterprise on-premises environment; or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 4 years of relevant experience.
  • Must fully meet all qualification requirements for the 421-Database Administrator work role at the Advanced proficiency level IAW the DoD 8140 Cyber Workforce Qualification Program.
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and security.
  • Strong experience with SharePoint Server 2016/2019 administration and enterprise farm management.
  • Experience with SharePoint Designer, InfoPath, and third-party utilities such as Quest and Bamboo.
  • Experience implementing STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and DoD cybersecurity compliance.
  • Strong understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, and data modeling.
  • Experience with PowerShell, T-SQL, and automation scripting.
  • Experience performing database migrations, upgrades, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity operations.
  • Experience developing database design documentation including Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), functional specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Experience supporting structured testing, validation, configuration management, and change management processes.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex database and infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and technical documentation, especially related to their integration with SharePoint and use of macros.
  • Ability to work independently or within a multidisciplinary technical team under demanding operational schedules.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams and government stakeholders.

Other requirements:

  • This is a non-remote, full-time on-site position located in Spokane, Washington.
  • Standard work schedule is 40 hours per week/8 hours per day with the occasional need to flex hours based on customer support needs.
  • Some after-hours or short-term shift work may be required to support urgent customer requirements, including weekends and holidays.

Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks

  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Database Administrator, you will specialize in managing and optimizing databases to ensure the smooth operation and efficient performance of applications relying on databases. Your focus will be on installing, configuring, and maintaining databases, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies and performing performance tuning.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Install and Configure Databases: Install, configure, and maintain databases to ensure high availability and optimal performance. This includes setting up database systems, defining database structures, and configuring database parameters.
  • Implement Disaster Recovery Strategies: Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies to minimize data loss and ensure business continuity in the event of a disaster.
  • Perform Performance Tuning: Analyze database performance and implement tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Maintain Database Systems: Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as backups, upgrades, and patches, to ensure database systems remain secure and up-to-date.
  • Ensure High Availability: Implement measures to ensure high availability, including clustering, replication, and failover systems, to minimize downtime and ensure continuous access to databases.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Database Management Experience: Exposure to managing and optimizing databases using products such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, and Teradata, with a focus on ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
  • System Administration Knowledge: Experience working with system administration concepts, including installing, configuring, and maintaining database systems, as well as implementing disaster recovery strategies.
  • Programming Understanding: Exposure to programming concepts and their application in database management, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • Database Concepts Familiarity: Experience working with database concepts, including database structures, database parameters, and data modeling.
  • Performance Tuning Skills: Exposure to analyzing database performance and implementing tuning measures to optimize database efficiency and responsiveness.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Database Concepts: Exposure to advanced database concepts, including data warehousing, data governance, and data quality, would be beneficial in this role.
  • Scripting and Automation: Experience with scripting languages, such as Python, PowerShell, or SQL, and automation tools would be advantageous in automating database tasks and workflows.
  • Cloud Database Services: Familiarity with cloud-based database services, such as Amazon RDS or Azure SQL Database, would be valuable in managing and optimizing cloud-based databases.
  • Preferred Skills: Telco Data: DBA, Oracle, Databricks, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, High Availability\

descriptionHtml:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as a Senior Database Administrator located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a remote basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems.

Position Summary

The Senior Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for architecting, administering and optimizing all enterprise SQL Server databases, ensuring security, reliability, and scalability. The DBA collaborates with application owners and IT teams to support business operations and provides technical guidance to users accessing enterprise data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintains all enterprise SQL database operations including SQL server updates and patches
  • Maintains database security and compliance with company, industry and government standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)
  • Reviews current architecture and updates and optimizes all the firm's enterprise database systems
  • Architects and implements new database systems
  • Proactively monitors database performance and performs database tuning for optimal performance
  • Troubleshoots enterprise database servers and related systems
  • Supports system audits and provides documentation as required
  • Plans testing and implementation of DR and backup processes to ensure continuous operation
  • Creates custom queries, data-driven SSRS subscriptions, migration scripts, and executes other tasks as needed

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

  • Sound understanding of SQL Server technology features and limitations
  • In-depth, advanced knowledge of SQL Server database structures, security, storage solutions, virtualization, replication, and clustering
  • Ability to create performance projections based upon hardware, OS, databases design, query structures and interactions between external systems with the database servers
  • Ability to evaluate and recommend technological changes in the database environment to support business objectives
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to effectively communicate technical details to persons without technical experience
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to accurately follow documented procedures and a strong aptitude for learning new technologies as they are incorporated into the computing environment

Education & Prior Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years’ experience in design, development, administration, and maintenance of enterprise-level MS SQL Server database systems
  • Demonstrable experience configuring, operating and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server, both on-prem and cloud environments
  • Demonstrable experience in database design, creating standards and processes, capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, accessibility, scalability and documentation for SQL Server
  • Demonstrable experience in development of complex queries, SSIS Packages and SSRS reports

The expected pay range for this position is: $123,371 - $136,060 Per year Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience, location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, short term disability, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, 401K, vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary critical illness and cancer insurance and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs may also be available in certain markets.

GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace committed to merit-based consideration and review without regard to an individual’s race, sex, or other protected characteristics and to the principles of non-discrimination on any protected basis.

Basic Qualifications :

  • High-availability
  • Clustering and automated failover
  • Architecture design and implementation
  • Implementing security technical implementation guidelines (STIGs)
  • Backup methodologies
  • Great interpersonal and effective communications skills working in a team environment
  • Experience working with multiple development teams and integrating product environments
  • Experience with RedHat OpenShift
  • Experience with KVM and VMWare virtualization platforms
  • Experience with Agile processes
  • Experience with satellite ground systems
  • OPIR program experience/exposure
  • Experience with configuration management and change management process implementation
  • Automated scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & unit test experience

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

As an IBM Mainframe DB2 Specialist, you will be responsible for the administration, optimization, and support of DB2 for z/OS environments that power critical enterprise applications. You will play a key role in ensuring database availability, performance, security, and resiliency while partnering with application, infrastructure, and operations teams to support business-critical workloads. You will be a valued member of the Cloud Infrastructure and Security team, working collaboratively with technical and business stakeholders to support modernization initiatives and drive operational excellence across the enterprise database landscape.

In this role, you will

  • Administer and maintain IBM DB2 databases within z/OS mainframe environments.
  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade DB2 subsystems and related components.
  • Perform database design reviews, schema management, and object creation.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance through SQL tuning, indexing strategies, RUNSTATS, REORG, and other DB2 utilities.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery planning, and recovery testing activities.
  • Administer database security, access controls, and compliance requirements.
  • Support application development teams with database design, SQL optimization, and issue resolution.
  • Perform capacity planning, storage management, and performance forecasting.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues impacting database services and applications.
  • Lead DB2 migration and version upgrade initiatives while minimizing operational risk.
  • Automate routine DBA activities using JCL, REXX, Python, and other automation tools.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and operations teams to ensure service availability and reliability.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Hartford, CT. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience administering IBM DB2 for z/OS in enterprise production environments.
  • Deep expertise with IBM Mainframe technologies, including z/OS, JCL, TSO/ISPF, and core DB2 administration tools.
  • Proven experience with DB2 performance tuning, SQL optimization, indexing strategies, RUNSTATS, REORG, and related database maintenance activities.
  • Experience planning and executing database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, migration, and version upgrade activities.
  • Strong knowledge of database security principles, RACF, access management, and compliance best practices.
  • Experience automating DBA processes using REXX, Python, JCL, or similar scripting technologies.
  • Experience supporting mainframe modernization initiatives, including transformation, migration, integration, or adoption of cloud-based technologies.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex database and application issues within mission-critical environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise scheduling and batch-processing tools such as CA7, TWS, or Control-M.
  • Strong understanding of database lifecycle management, change management, and production support processes.

These will help you stand out

  • Exposure to VSAM, CICS, IMS, and other IBM Z ecosystem technologies.
  • Experience supporting large-scale banking, insurance, or financial services environments.
  • Knowledge of high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Experience with SMP/E, release management, and enterprise change management processes.
  • IBM Certified Database Administrator for DB2 for z/OS or other IBM Z certifications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills in global 24x7 enterprise environments.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applications will be accepted until November 24, 2026.

The annual salary for this position is between $100,000 - $115,000 USD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as a Senior Database Administrator located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a remote basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems.

Position Summary

The Senior Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for architecting, administering and optimizing all enterprise SQL Server databases, ensuring security, reliability, and scalability. The DBA collaborates with application owners and IT teams to support business operations and provides technical guidance to users accessing enterprise data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintains all enterprise SQL database operations including SQL server updates and patches
  • Maintains database security and compliance with company, industry and government standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)
  • Reviews current architecture and updates and optimizes all the firm's enterprise database systems
  • Architects and implements new database systems
  • Proactively monitors database performance and performs database tuning for optimal performance
  • Troubleshoots enterprise database servers and related systems
  • Supports system audits and provides documentation as required
  • Plans testing and implementation of DR and backup processes to ensure continuous operation
  • Creates custom queries, data-driven SSRS subscriptions, migration scripts, and executes other tasks as needed

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

  • Sound understanding of SQL Server technology features and limitations
  • In-depth, advanced knowledge of SQL Server database structures, security, storage solutions, virtualization, replication, and clustering
  • Ability to create performance projections based upon hardware, OS, databases design, query structures and interactions between external systems with the database servers
  • Ability to evaluate and recommend technological changes in the database environment to support business objectives
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to effectively communicate technical details to persons without technical experience
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to accurately follow documented procedures and a strong aptitude for learning new technologies as they are incorporated into the computing environment

Education & Prior Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years’ experience in design, development, administration, and maintenance of enterprise-level MS SQL Server database systems
  • Demonstrable experience configuring, operating and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server, both on-prem and cloud environments
  • Demonstrable experience in database design, creating standards and processes, capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, accessibility, scalability and documentation for SQL Server
  • Demonstrable experience in development of complex queries, SSIS Packages and SSRS reports

The expected pay range for this position is: $123,371 - $136,060 Per year Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience, location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, short term disability, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, 401K, vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary critical illness and cancer insurance and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs may also be available in certain markets.

GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace committed to merit-based consideration and review without regard to an individual’s race, sex, or other protected characteristics and to the principles of non-discrimination on any protected basis.

Job Description


We believe your career should be filled with innovation and discovery. And that's exactly what you'll find at BAE Systems. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team making a big impact on a global scale. As part of our team, you’ll join a diverse group of driven professionals who design the products and systems that support enhanced military capabilities, protect national security, and keep critical information and infrastructure secure. With us, you’ll be able to make an impact while you hone your skills and grow in your career.

We are seeking a talented
Senior Database Administrator to join our team supporting the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) / Customs and Border Protection (CBP) / Air and Marine Operations (AMO) / Air and Marine Operations Center (AMOC) in their mission to protect the nation's borders and ensure the security of our communities. As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to perform all aspects of advanced Oracle environment system administration, contributing to the advancement of technologies that keep nations safe. With a focus on innovation, collaboration, and career growth, we offer a unique and empowering work environment that will help you achieve your full potential.



As An AMOC Senior Database Administrator, You Will


  • Perform all aspects of advanced Oracle environment System Administration for development, test and production activities
  • Diagnose and debug complicated performance, connectivity, and security issues involving critical C4I Oracle applications
  • Provide all C4I Oracle DBA support in such areas as proactive performance tuning and monitoring, trouble-shooting, back-up and recovery, partitioning, installations and configurations
  • Write and update PL/SQL statements and the maintenance of Oracle Database
  • Build, Modify and data query interfaces for visualization tools using Elasticsearch and OpenLayers
  • Support Law Enforcement and Operations by providing specialized Oracle Reports
  • Perform weekly, monthly and bi-monthly Oracle data updates



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


  • 10+ years of experience in evaluating, analyzing, and ensuring the effective operation of C4I communications capabilities and infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of C4I systems and technical requirements
  • Experience with system design, development, and implementation


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $120874 - $205486

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Job Description: Maintains the integrity, security and availability of multiple database(s). Duties include disaster recovery, performance analysis and tuning, index maintenance, and monitoring of data. Administers, maintains, develops and implements policies and procedures for ensuring the security and integrity of the database. Evaluates and recommends available database management system (DBMS) products. Performs database and software life-cycle activities to ensure highest level of system performance and availability and compliance with business requirements. Performs Oracle, SQL Server and SYBASE Database and Application server administration. Organizes and formats data for efficient query and storage processes.

#AJCM #PeratonRoyalMove

#MDFSP

DBA, DBMS, Oracle, SQL Server, and SYBASE. Disaster recovery. Performance analysis and tuning. Index maintenance. System monitoring of data. Data modeling. Prototype database implementations. Database performance

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

The Database Administrator shall possess the following capabilities:

  • Maintain the integrity, security, and availability of database(s)
  • Establish and maintain database user accounts
  • Administer, maintain, and Implement policies and procedures for ensuring the security and integrity of the database(s)
  • Organize and format data for efficient query and storage processes
  • Evaluate requirements and recommend available DBMS products
  • Provide server administration with a variety of database products that include Oracle, SQL Server, and SYBASE
  • Perform disaster recovery, performance analysis and tuning, index maintenance, and monitoring of data
  • Develop policies and procedures for ensuring the security and integrity of the database(s)
  • Perform database and software life-cycle activities to ensure highest level of system performance and availability
  • Support data modeling activities by way of prototype database implementations

Position Requirements (Experience and Education):

  • An Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required
  • Five (5) years of experience as a DBA in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in technical discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional DBA experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

Benefits: Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees supporting this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO accrued annually up to a generous PTO cap, and eligibility to participate in an attractive bonus plan.

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Job Description:

Make meaningful contributions that fuel critical outcomes for some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects. Join GDIT as an Oracle Database Analyst for a career where your growth is just as important as the mission you support.

Meaningful Work And Personal Impact:

As an Oracle Database Analyst, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of USSTRATCOM. USSTRATCOM is a Combatant Command responsible for strategic deterrence, nuclear operations, and enterprise IT services essential to national security. It oversees Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications (NC3), Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (JEMSO), Global Strike, and Missile Threat Assessments, working closely with other Combatant Commands, Services, and defense agencies. SCITLS will be a key component that will ensure mission success and the safety of the U.S. and its allies by providing 24/7 IT services and network support for NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS, and SAP/SAR environment.

You will play a crucial role in providing support in the following areas:

  • Responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Oracle database systems to ensure high performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and implement database schemas, monitor database health, and perform routine backups and recovery operations to safeguard mission-critical data.
  • Troubleshoot database-related issues, manage user access and permissions, and optimize queries to enhance system performance.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry standards while staying current on updates, patches, and advancements in Oracle technologies.

What You’ll Need To Succeed:

  • Technical training (or equivalent experience), 8+ years of experience
  • Security Clearance Level: Top Secret with SCI eligibility
  • Required Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation certified within 9 months of start; Cloud+, Security+, SSCP or GSEC
  • Location: Offutt AFB, NE
  • Oracle database administration (installation, configuration, tuning)
  • SQL and PL/SQL proficiency
  • Performance monitoring and optimization
  • Backup, recovery, and disaster‑recovery planning
  • Troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis
  • Security management and compliance
  • Patch management and staying current with Oracle updates
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Experience with Data Guard, RAC, Multitenant, ASM, OEM is a plus
  • Desired experience: OUD, Ansible

Gdit Is Your Place:

  • Excellent customizable health benefits (Medical, Dental and Vision)
  • 401K with company match
  • Educational Assistance and eLearning
  • Flexible work week
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to employee advancement
  • Rewards and Recognition programs
  • Innovative and collaborative environment encouraging highly motivated critical thinking

The likely salary range for this position is $129,813 - $166,750. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

None

Telecommuting Options:

Onsite

Work Location:

USA NE Offutt AFB

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards At GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. Lockheed Martin Space is seeking a full-time Database Administration Engineer. In this role, you will be assigned to a scrum team within the development organization supporting numerous activities to include:

  • Planning, conducting, and coordinating agile software development activities.
  • Designing, developing, documenting, testing, and debugging software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to critical mission issues.

The information below reflects the standard job description for this position:

Performs tech planning, design, devel, integ, v&v for total syst life cycle. Analyses performed at all levels of syst product incl. concept, design, fabrication, test, instl, operation, maintenance & disposal, incorp design methods & stds for Cyber Security, SW & HW infrastructure. Designs, devels, docs, tests & debugs SW that contains logical & math solutions to business/mission problems/questions in computer language. Ensures the logical & syst conversion of customer/product reqs into total syst solutions that ack tech, sched, cost constraints & align to SW & HW deployment pipelines & factories. Performs func & timeline analysis, detail trade & reqs allocation & interface defs studies to translate customer reqs into HW & SW feature defs & acceptance criteria. Applies stds, processes, procedures & tools throughout the devel life cycle. Applies HW & SW knowledge, cyber security stds in business/mission apps, & feedback from users to develop SW. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles doc of program devel & analyzes syst capabilities to resolve program problems, output/input data acq, programming tech & controls. Ensures SW stds are met. Validates incorp of features & use cases into implemented designs.

Implements and maintains smooth operation and physical design of databases. Reviews database design and integration of systems, provides backup recovery and makes recommendations regarding enhancements and/or improvements. Maintains security and integrity controls. Formulates policies, procedures, and standards relating to database management, and monitors transaction activity and utilization. Responsibilities include: database loading; development and management of operational procedures; environment management; database health (e.g. monitoring, proactive and reactive responses); resource planning; database upgrade planning; backup and recovery strategy planning and implementation; environment transition planning (development, test, stage, production).

Basic Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar field.
  • Java development experience.
  • Knowledge/Experience in COTS/FOSS integration and support.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and navigate multiple operating system environments (e.g., LINUX/Windows).
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies.
  • Must have an active TS/SCI security clearance to start with the ability to obtain and maintain a Poly. Applicants selected must be a US Citizen, will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Desired Skills

Desired Skills

  • Agile development experience and associated tools and processes.
  • Understanding of Cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong problem-solving skills. Strong communication skills. Proven team player.
  • Interest and experience in development tools and technologies (e.g., Angular, Oracle, Docker, sql, git, DevSecOPS, automated testing).
  • Big data technologies to include data Ingest, Analytics, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, GitOps pipelines, Kinetica and COTS Integration.
  • Python development.
  • AI/Machine Learning Technologies.
  • Database/SQL Development
  • TS/SCI with Poly

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data. You`ll also advise customers on database design, migration, and integration approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Redlands, CA area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, enterprise database environments
  • Configure and maintain database platforms
  • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing
  • Advise customers on enterprise database best practices

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Demonstrated experience with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (such as AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database)
  • Understanding of geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range is: $120,640 USD - $197,600 USD

descriptionHtml:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as a Senior Database Administrator located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a remote basis. This role reports to the Director of Network Systems.

Position Summary

The Senior Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for architecting, administering and optimizing all enterprise SQL Server databases, ensuring security, reliability, and scalability. The DBA collaborates with application owners and IT teams to support business operations and provides technical guidance to users accessing enterprise data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintains all enterprise SQL database operations including SQL server updates and patches
  • Maintains database security and compliance with company, industry and government standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)
  • Reviews current architecture and updates and optimizes all the firm's enterprise database systems
  • Architects and implements new database systems
  • Proactively monitors database performance and performs database tuning for optimal performance
  • Troubleshoots enterprise database servers and related systems
  • Supports system audits and provides documentation as required
  • Plans testing and implementation of DR and backup processes to ensure continuous operation
  • Creates custom queries, data-driven SSRS subscriptions, migration scripts, and executes other tasks as needed

Qualifications

Skills & Competencies

  • Sound understanding of SQL Server technology features and limitations
  • In-depth, advanced knowledge of SQL Server database structures, security, storage solutions, virtualization, replication, and clustering
  • Ability to create performance projections based upon hardware, OS, databases design, query structures and interactions between external systems with the database servers
  • Ability to evaluate and recommend technological changes in the database environment to support business objectives
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to effectively communicate technical details to persons without technical experience
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to accurately follow documented procedures and a strong aptitude for learning new technologies as they are incorporated into the computing environment

Education & Prior Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years’ experience in design, development, administration, and maintenance of enterprise-level MS SQL Server database systems
  • Demonstrable experience configuring, operating and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server, both on-prem and cloud environments
  • Demonstrable experience in database design, creating standards and processes, capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, accessibility, scalability and documentation for SQL Server
  • Demonstrable experience in development of complex queries, SSIS Packages and SSRS reports

The expected pay range for this position is: $123,371 - $136,060 Per year Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience, location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, short term disability, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, 401K, vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary critical illness and cancer insurance and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs may also be available in certain markets.

GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace committed to merit-based consideration and review without regard to an individual’s race, sex, or other protected characteristics and to the principles of non-discrimination on any protected basis.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DATABASE ADMINISTRATOR

SpaceX is looking for a Database Administrator with strong technical knowledge in Microsoft SQL/ PowerBI technologies as well as excellent interpersonal and communication skills. This employee will be a part of our IT Engineering organization and join a team of database administrators and engineers responsible for all database technologies used throughout SpaceX. The ideal candidate will be flexible, flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment and have an insatiable desire to learn, solve complex problems and help others. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.  This individual will need to demonstrate strong knowledge in Windows, server/storage infrastructure, and troubleshooting skills.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal customers to understand current challenges, plan/communicate improvements and anticipate future needs.
  • Perform root cause analysis of production-related database issues.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize schemas, queries, and database/server configurations.
  • Perform data migration / data transformation from OLTP to OLAP systems.
  • Develop code to automate routine tasks and provide end user self-service tools by leveraging PowerShell or a similar scripting language.
  • Engineer, deploy and maintain all aspects of Microsoft SQL database monitoring.
  • Quickly address critical support situations by providing effective solutions to database technical issues.
  • Manage PowerBI licensing, utilization, permissions and provide best-practices guidance and query optimization assistance for users.
  • Provide comprehensive and fully vetted backup and restore solutions.
  • Engineer, implement and routinely test Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
  • Develop and maintain strong documentation and support runbooks.
  • Support and foster the professional growth of other database engineering and administration staff via cross-training, coaching and responsibility sharing.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering and 3+ years of IT database administration, or 5+ years of IT database administration in lieu of a degree.
  • 1+ years experience in optimizing SQL queries and data replication & transformation.
  • 3+ years experience in monitoring and tuning databases to provide highly available and performant services.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Proficient in SQL Server and at least one other database technology (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle).
  • Proficient in resiliency and high availability methods for SQL Server, such as SQL Server log shipping, availability groups, database mirroring and replication.
  • Expertise in scaling large critical databases with high expectations for uptime and performance.
  • Ability to work effectively and provide technical leadership in high-stress situations such as production database outages.
  • Knowledge of configuration management automation and limiting the amount of manual toil.
  • Knowledge of data structure design and modeling.
  • Strong understanding of hardware in relation to SQL server; SAN, Virtualization, and basic networking for troubleshooting.
  • Good knowledge of development cycle to interface well with developers.
  • Working knowledge of adjacent database technologies (Postgres, Oracle, MySQL).
  • Strong attention to detail, high degree of accuracy, excellent oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Open to learn new database technologies especially Column-oriented databases.
  • Expertise in reporting options (SQL reports, PowerBI, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of big data and data warehouse concepts and technologies.  

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed (to respond to network and server errors after hours).
  • This role is an onsite position - remote work or hybrid work will not be considered.

Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Itar Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Your day at NTT DATA

The Senior Database Administrator is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for ensuring the availability, integrity and performance of complex and critical data assets and works closely with cross functional teams to support data-driven applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement robust backup and recovery strategies.

The Senior Database Administrator works closely with Change Control, Release Management, Asset and Configuration Management and Capacity and Availability Management to establish the needs of users, monitoring user access and security.

This role assists in controlling access to databases environments through permissions and privileges.

Key responsibilities:

  • Performs the installation, configuration, and maintenance of complex database management systems (DBMS), including SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or others, as required.
  • Collaborates with software developers/architects to design and optimize database schemas, data models, and database-related applications.
  • Participates in the writing of database documentation, including data standards, data flow diagrams, standard operating procedures and definitions for the data dictionary (metadata).
  • Monitors database performance, identifies performance bottlenecks, and optimizes queries and indexing for optimal database performance.
  • Designs and implements robust backup and disaster recovery strategies to ensure data availability and business continuity.
  • Monitors production databases regularly or respond to any database issues by bringing down the database or taking the database offline.
  • Proactively supports the development of database utilities and automated reporting.
  • Works closely with the Change Control and Release Management functions to commission and install new applications and customizing existing applications in order to make them fit for purpose.
  • Plans and executes database software upgrades and applies patches to keep systems up-to-date and secure.
  • Communicates regularly with technical, applications and operational employees to ensure database integrity and security.
  • Implements and manages security measures to safeguard databases from unauthorized access, data breaches, and data loss.
  • Conducts regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to maintain compliance with data protection standards and regulations.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, network engineers, and business stakeholders, to support database-related initiatives.
  • Provides technical support to end-users, assists with database-related enquiries, and conducts training sessions as needed.
  • Performs any other related task as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Advanced proficiency in database administration tasks, including database installation, configuration, maintenance, and performance tuning.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL (Structured Query Language) to write complex queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Advanced understanding of database security principles, access controls, and data encryption methods.
  • Advanced working knowledge in database backup and recovery strategies to ensure data availability and business continuity.
  • Ability to monitor database performance, identify and resolve issues, and optimize database operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently while maintaining a high level of attention to detail on each project.
  • Ability to learn new technologies as needed to provide the best solutions to all stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex IT information in simplified form depending on the target audience.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Advanced proficiency understanding of the principles of data architecture and data services.
  • Advanced knowledge of application development lifecycle and data access layers.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to troubleshoot database-related issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent analytical skills related to working with unstructured datasets
  • Ability to manipulate, process and extract value from large, disconnected datasets.

Academic qualifications and certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering, information technology or related field.
  • Relevant certification, such as MCSE DBA, oracles associate or equivalent preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified; Azure Database Administrator Associate; Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) - Database Administrator; MySQL Database Administrator; PostgreSQL Certified Professional preferred.
  • Completion of database management courses covering topics like database administration, data modelling, SQL, and performance tuning can provide foundational knowledge.

Required experience:

  • Advanced demonstrated experience working as a Database Administrator within an Information Technology organization.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience with database backup and recovery best practices.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience running and creating health assessment reports.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience working with suppliers to deliver solutions.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience in Oracle Enterprise.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Advanced demonstrated experience managing databases.

descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

PACCAR's Global Parts Information Technology team is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to manage and support mission-critical enterprise database environments.

The primary focus of this role is Oracle Database Administration, with secondary responsibilities supporting Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL. The candidate will manage databases across on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure environments, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational reliability.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on Oracle DBA experience, expertise in database performance tuning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, database security, and cloud database operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Oracle database administration and provide secondary support for Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize highly available and scalable database environments across development, testing, and production.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, and indexing strategies.
  • Support SQL Server T-SQL and PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL as needed.
  • Perform database upgrades, migrations, patching, and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Design and maintain High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, recovery, replication, and failover solutions.
  • Administer Rubrik backup and recovery solutions, including retention, monitoring, and data protection.
  • Manage database security, user provisioning, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and security patching.
  • Implement database auditing, activity monitoring, privileged-access tracking, and log-retention policies.
  • Support database environments hosted on AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Perform capacity planning, storage management, database monitoring, and proactive performance optimization.
  • Support Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments, including shell and PowerShell scripting.
  • Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Support database compliance, governance, audits, and enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor junior DBAs and participate in 24x7 on-call production support.

Required Technical Skills

Oracle Database Administration – Primary Requirement

  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle database administration.
  • Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development and troubleshooting.
  • Oracle performance tuning, query optimization, and execution plan analysis.
  • RMAN backup and recovery.
  • Oracle HA/DR, replication, and failover solutions.
  • Oracle database upgrades, migrations, and patching.

Microsoft SQL Server & PostgreSQL – Secondary Requirements

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server administration and T-SQL.
  • Experience with Always On Availability Groups, SQL Agent, and SSIS/SSRS as applicable.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL administration and PL/pgSQL.
  • Experience with database backup, recovery, monitoring, patching, and performance tuning.

Cloud Database Platforms

  • AWS: Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora.
  • Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with cloud database deployments, migrations, modernization, security, and cost optimization.

Backup, Security & Infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience with Rubrik backup and recovery solutions.
  • Database security, auditing, governance, and vulnerability management.
  • Linux/Unix and Windows Server administration.
  • Shell scripting and PowerShell automation.
  • Capacity planning, monitoring, and database health management.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience as a Database Administrator supporting enterprise database environments.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle DBA activities, preferably on Linux/Unix platforms.
  • Working experience supporting Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, RMAN, HA/DR, and Rubrik.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and Microsoft Azure database services.
  • Experience with enterprise database migrations, performance tuning, backup/recovery, security, and patching.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and participate in 24x7 on-call support.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Strong Oracle DBA background with enterprise-scale production database experience.
  • Experience managing databases across both on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of database security, compliance, auditing, and governance.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced enterprise IT environment.
