Location: Renton, WA

Experience: 7+ Years


Job Overview

PACCAR's Global Parts Information Technology team is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to manage and support mission-critical enterprise database environments.

The primary focus of this role is Oracle Database Administration, with secondary responsibilities supporting Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL. The candidate will manage databases across on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure environments, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational reliability.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on Oracle DBA experience, expertise in database performance tuning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, database security, and cloud database operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Oracle database administration and provide secondary support for Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize highly available and scalable database environments across development, testing, and production.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, and indexing strategies.
  • Support SQL Server T-SQL and PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL as needed.
  • Perform database upgrades, migrations, patching, and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Design and maintain High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, recovery, replication, and failover solutions.
  • Administer Rubrik backup and recovery solutions, including retention, monitoring, and data protection.
  • Manage database security, user provisioning, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and security patching.
  • Implement database auditing, activity monitoring, privileged-access tracking, and log-retention policies.
  • Support database environments hosted on AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Perform capacity planning, storage management, database monitoring, and proactive performance optimization.
  • Support Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments, including shell and PowerShell scripting.
  • Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Support database compliance, governance, audits, and enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor junior DBAs and participate in 24x7 on-call production support.

Required Technical Skills

Oracle Database Administration – Primary Requirement

  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle database administration.
  • Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development and troubleshooting.
  • Oracle performance tuning, query optimization, and execution plan analysis.
  • RMAN backup and recovery.
  • Oracle HA/DR, replication, and failover solutions.
  • Oracle database upgrades, migrations, and patching.

Microsoft SQL Server & PostgreSQL – Secondary Requirements

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server administration and T-SQL.
  • Experience with Always On Availability Groups, SQL Agent, and SSIS/SSRS as applicable.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL administration and PL/pgSQL.
  • Experience with database backup, recovery, monitoring, patching, and performance tuning.

Cloud Database Platforms

  • AWS: Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora.
  • Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with cloud database deployments, migrations, modernization, security, and cost optimization.

Backup, Security & Infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience with Rubrik backup and recovery solutions.
  • Database security, auditing, governance, and vulnerability management.
  • Linux/Unix and Windows Server administration.
  • Shell scripting and PowerShell automation.
  • Capacity planning, monitoring, and database health management.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience as a Database Administrator supporting enterprise database environments.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle DBA activities, preferably on Linux/Unix platforms.
  • Working experience supporting Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, RMAN, HA/DR, and Rubrik.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and Microsoft Azure database services.
  • Experience with enterprise database migrations, performance tuning, backup/recovery, security, and patching.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and participate in 24x7 on-call support.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Strong Oracle DBA background with enterprise-scale production database experience.
  • Experience managing databases across both on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of database security, compliance, auditing, and governance.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced enterprise IT environment.

Important: Candidates must be comfortable working onsite in Renton, WA.

Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, Senior Database Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 19c databases; manage high-availability and clustering architectures, including Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle Data Guard, and Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
  • Manage routine and disaster recovery backup and restore procedures utilizing RMAN and enterprise-grade backup utilities (such as Rubrik); perform regularly scheduled disaster recovery replication and failover exercises
  • Proactively monitor database health, troubleshoot complex operational issues, and conduct performance tuning (utilizing AWR, ADDM, and OEM); execute detailed root-cause analyses on SQL statements and system performance bottlenecks
  • Implement database security baselines, manage user provisioning, and enforce strict access controls; coordinate database code migrations across Development, Test, and Production environments; support and participate in a 24x7 team on-call support rotation to resolve critical database problems (including evenings and weekends as required)
  • Provide secondary or auxiliary administrative support for Azure Databricks operations, including cluster configurations, user access provisioning, Key Vaults, tokens, and secret scopes; support application and pipeline integration to enable seamless database-to-cloud workflows
  • Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three years of direct experience managing complex Oracle Database deployments
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field is preferred; high school diploma or GED required
  • Hands-on mastery of Oracle 19c, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and OEM; experience applying quarterly security patches and major database upgrades is required; strong command of Unix, Linux, and Solaris environments. (Windows Operating Systems knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of Azure Cloud Platform Administration and the enterprise tools interacting with Azure Databricks. Azure Data Services: Familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQLMI, and Unity Catalog
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including Azure DevOps and managed code deployment pipelines; proficiency or familiarity with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or PySpark for task automation
  • Exceptional project management, technical troubleshooting, and analytical judgment capabilities; strong verbal and written communication skills to support an environment driven by exceptional customer service and collaborative engineering teamwork

This individual will work under the guidance of the Database Manager to develop/support database solutions to support various company initiatives.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable database architectures on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Manage OCI database services including Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP‑D) and OCI GoldenGate.
  • Oversee installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle maintenance of Oracle Databases (19c and later).
  • Perform backup and recovery operations using RMAN, Data Guard, and OCI‑native tooling.
  • Optimize database performance through SQL tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis, and AWR/ASH diagnostics.
  • Configure and maintain Oracle Data Guard, Active Data Guard, and full disaster‑recovery environments.
  • Lead migrations of on‑prem Oracle databases into Oracle GovCloud using best‑practice methods.
  • Manage OCI resources including compute instances, databases, storage, networking, and block/object storage.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager.
  • Implement high‑availability strategies, autoscaling, and load‑balancing architectures.
  • Enforce database security policies including encryption, auditing, access control, and Oracle Vault key management.
  • Manage user roles, privileges, authentication, and identity integration with OCI IAM and IDCS.
  • Design and execute Oracle on‑prem to OCI migrations using Data Pump, Transportable Tablespaces, GoldenGate, or RMAN backup/restore.
  • Implement proactive monitoring using OCI Monitoring, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and Log Analytics.
  • Analyze incidents, troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver root‑cause resolutions for internal and external database applications.
  • Perform database cloning with data masking from production to lower environments across on‑prem and OCI Autonomous Databases.
  • Implement DDL/DML scripts in alignment with SCRUM‑based application release cycles.
  • Automate recurring tasks using SQL, PL/SQL, and scripting languages.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities for application, process, and operational improvements.

  • Support knowledge sharing, learning, and enablement across the DBA team.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues autonomously.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies and applications with minimal guidance.
  • Positive, solutions‑oriented “can‑do” attitude toward problem‑solving and task completion.
  • Deep experience with Oracle RAC, ASM, Exadata (on‑prem or cloud), Active Data Guard, performance tuning, RMAN, and OCI GoldenGate replication.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux OS administration.
  • Proficient in scripting using OCI CLI, Python, Bash, Perl, PowerShell, and related tools.
  • Expertise in backup strategies and all facets of database recovery, including simple restores and point‑in‑time recovery.
  • Experience managing and supporting Very Large Databases (VLDB).
  • Successful completion of the Nlets fingerprinting background assessment.

Personal Skills And Attributes

  • Capable of researching, analyzing, and resolving issues involving technologies outside core expertise.
  • Strong technical and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively and independently within a global team environment.
  • Proven analytical and problem‑solving abilities across diverse database platforms and technologies.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies and applications with minimal direction.
  • Extensive experience working in team‑oriented, collaborative environments, contributing to shared goals and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

GLOTECH, Inc. is seeking a Database Architect to support the corporate office of SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment, located in Orlando, Florida. Prefer local candidates to the Orlando, FL or surrounding area as this role will be required to be onsite one day per week. Remote candidates will only be considered from SeaWorld approved states (OR NJ CT WA NC VA CA FL PA TX). This position requires “on call” responsibilities for one week each month and also requires being on support 24/7 for high-priority system outages. This candidate will join a database team size of five people including the director and four other senior DBA's.

The ideal candidate will be in a technical lead architect role as the Director’s “right hand”. Their responsibilities include architect work 25% of the time, technical lead work 25% of the time and senior DBA work 50% of the time.

  • Architect breakdown (25%): The architect work entails having experience thinking of applications that could help streamline or create efficiency for a specific business problem. This person must have brought an application from conception through development AKA finding a business problem, creating a solution, designing that solution and then building it out. They will be responsible for architecting some work internal to the database team from concept to design to execution. An example of this work is building customized applications into the environment to monitor systems. Specifically, the person in this role before built a tool that could access the data in an effort to deploy it across fleets to see what users were accessing what systems. This tool could technically serve as an audit tool, but it was moreso used to determine what systems were not being used like hosts, databases, systems, etc. so that they could then be decommissioned.
  • Technical lead breakdown (25%): The technical lead work entails having experience working with cross department teams and working with them in order to ensure their application plans will be feasible with the database. This person must have the business acumen to work with other stakeholders and developers from other teams to guide, aid and solution how their specific application can or cannot integrate with the database (and if there’s an issue where it can’t interact, how can we get it there). This means they will be working with other application teams to design, implementation and make decisions on their applications so that it can integrate with all of the systems at SeaWorld. Basically, full SDLC knowledge and being able to document a written design plan, as well as why or why not a particular application would work. They will be working hand in hand on this type of work with the Director.
  • Senior DBA breakdown (50%): This person must be proficient in all versions of MS SQL server, SSIS and have a decent amount of experience/knowledge working with Azure cloud. This DBA will be responsible for the implementation, configuration, maintenance, and performance of critical SQL Server systems, to ensure the availability and consistent performance of our corporate applications. This is a hands-on position requiring solid technical skills as well as excellent interpersonal and communication skills. They will be responsible for the development and sustainment of SQL Server environments (DEV, QA, UAT and PROD), ensuring its operational readiness (security, health, and performance), performance tuning and data modeling in support of multiple development teams and 3rd party vendor products. The environments support an enterprise application suite of OLTP and OLAP solutions. The individual must be capable of working independently and collaboratively with the ability to quickly understand complex data solutions and schema. There are gaps right now as it pertains to the DBA team with the cloud and support will be needed with replication work - on a day to day, this person will be responsible for replicating, checking if backups have failed, re running tests, checking services (for example, sometimes they have alerts of discontention so they need to check the IO to see if there's a bottleneck that needs tuning), checking the health of the databases overall, performing tests on various settings within the databases and adjusting accordingly, etc. Additionally, this person will be writing queries in SQL sometimes but mostly setting up and configuring within MS SQL. They will be responsible for collecting metrics on servers that report back to the repository but need to migrate this to SSIS so it works well with the BI team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage SQL Server databases through multiple product lifecycle environments, from development to mission-critical production systems.
  • Configure and maintain database servers and processes, including monitoring of system health and performance, to ensure high levels of performance, availability, and security.
  • Apply data modeling techniques to ensure development and implementation support efforts meet integration and performance expectations.
  • Assist with design and implementation of a data loading tool to move sanitized data from production to a non-production environment.
  • Independently analyze, solve, and correct issues in real time, providing problem resolution end-to-end.
  • Refine and automate regular processes, track issues, and document changes.
  • Assist developers with complex query tuning and schema refinement.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24x7 support for critical production systems.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance and support release deployment activities after hours.
  • Share domain and technical expertise, providing technical mentorship and cross-training to other peers and team members.
  • Monitor and apply SQL Server Service Packs and Cumulative Updates.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years MS SQL Server Administration experience required
  • Performance Tuning and Optimization, using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools
  • Strong experience with backups, restores and recovery models
  • Expert level t-SQL tuning
  • Experience developing and maintaining SSIS packages
  • Experience migrating sanitized data from production to non-production environments
  • Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for SQL Server
  • Experience working with Windows server including Windows Clustering
  • Ability to organize and plan work independently
  • Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment
  • Ability to multi-task and context-switch effectively between different activities and teams
  • Strong experience with AlwaysOn Availability Groups
  • In depth knowledge and experience with SQL Server replication
  • Experience or good working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) with both VMs and DBaaS

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with the following tools
    • Spotlight Monitoring
    • Host Monitor
    • Litespeed
    • Jira
    • Confluence
    • Opsgenie
    • Microsoft Teams
  • Experience with MySQL
  • Experience with Oracle
  • Experience with SAP BusinessObjects
  • Experience with tools (such as ER Studio) to reverse engineer databases
  • Experience with one or more object-oriented programming language
  • Strong PowerShell skills

descriptionHtml:
Quantum Sky is searching for an experienced Senior Database Administrator to maintain, optimize, secure, and modernize critical Oracle database instances supporting the Defense Health Agency (DHA) E-Commerce System (ECS) in Aurora, Colorado.


The DHA ECS delivers integrated financial management, acquisition operations, and contract lifecycle support for TRICARE private-sector healthcare delivery across the Military Health System (MHS). Operating within a virtualized Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud East infrastructure via the DHA MedCOI Application Virtualization Hosting Environment (AVHE), this role is available in one specialized tracks:

  • Oracle E-Business Suite (Oracle Financials) Track — Specializes in multi-terabyte transactional and reporting databases, APPS DBA skills, high volume financial transactions, and performance tuning skills.

Responsibilities:

Track 1: EBS Database Administrator

  • Transactional Database Architecture: Maintain and optimize Oracle database instances across 4 environments (Development, System Test, QA/Pre-Prod, and Production) supporting Oracle EBS application, OID SSO and Analytical Reporting tool:
  • Oracle Federal Financials E-Business Suite application and database administration
  • Oracle Internet Directory (OID) and Oracle Access Manager (OAM) administration including Single Sign-on
  • Partner with Oracle Support and SRs engagement ability

Responsibilities:

1. Database Operations, Maintenance & Tuning

  • Perform routine proactive database administration, memory allocation (SGA/PGA), automated maintenance task scheduling, and SQL workload tuning.
  • Generate and analyze AWR, ADDM, and ASH reports to diagnose bottlenecks, lock contention, and query performance degradation.
  • Maintain complete database design documentation, data dictionaries, schema diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) compliant with CDRL 0010 (Solution Design Documentation).
  • Strictly enforce environment segregation: technical developers are prohibited from direct data access in QA/Pre-Prod and Production; DBAs execute and validate all production schema migrations.

2. Backup, Recovery & Disaster Preparedness

  • Configure, automate, and monitor comprehensive backup jobs using Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN) and AWS virtual machine snapshots.
  • Plan and execute mandatory monthly backup restore tests to formally validate DCOPS nightly and weekly backup integrity.
  • Maintain database reconstitution procedures under the DHA ECS Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP).
  • Participate in annual DHA ECS COOP / Disaster Recovery exercises, supporting full cutover to alternate AWS environments within 12 hours of declaration.

3. Cybersecurity, STIG Implementation & Audits

  • Apply and validate DISA Database Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) across all database instances.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified by Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) scans and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs).
  • Coordinate with the designated Security DBA and ISSO to close Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) findings no later than 10 calendar days before expiration.
  • Enforce DoD Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) authentication, encryption at rest (TDE), and encryption in transit across all database listeners and connections.
  • Provide technical responses and evidence for periodic DHA CRM financial audits, contract management audits, and RMF re-authorizations.

4. Outage Response & High-Availability SLAs

  • Adhere to strict contract restoration service-level agreements:
  • End-of-Month (EOM) and End-of-Year (EOY) Surges: During the window 5 days prior to 5 days following EOM, and throughout Fiscal Year End, restore production database service disruptions within 4 hours maximum allowable downtime.
  • Standard Operations: Restore production database disruptions within 8 hours; non-production environments within 24 hours.
  • Notify Government representatives within 30 minutes of production disruption identification and within 2 hours for lower environments.


Required:

  • Citizenship: Must be a United States Citizen (mandatory contractual requirement for DHA network authorization and clearance sponsorship).
  • Privileged Access: Must qualify for and maintain an IT Level II Privileged Access designation per DoD 5200.2-R.
  • Cybersecurity Certification: Must possess a valid DoD Manual 8140.03 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ ce, CCNA Security, CySA+, GSEC) upon hire or within 3 months of contract employment. Must complete relevant OS/DBMS Operating Environment training.
  • Formal Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience Substitution Rule: Fifteen (15) years of documented experience in database administration may be substituted in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience Mandates by Track:
  • EBS Track: Minimum of five (5) years of hands-on Oracle Database & Application Administration experience on a Linux/Unix platform supporting an enterprise Oracle E-Business Suite v12.2.X application of the size and complexity of DHA ECS EBS.

Planet Technologies, the Nation’s leading Microsoft services provider to the public sector, is looking for a highly motivated individual to join our growing team as Windows Server & Database Administrator . In this role, you will be supporting impactful projects that make a difference for our country.

This position serves as senior technical resource responsible for the design, implementation, administration, security, performance, and maintenance of Windows-based server environments and enterprise database systems. It requires deep expertise in Microsoft Windows Server technologies, Active Directory, virtualization platforms, database administration, cybersecurity best practices, and systems integration within classified environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong troubleshooting capabilities, the ability to lead complex technical initiatives, and experience supporting highly available and secure enterprise systems.

This position is based on site, full time in Albuquerque, NM and requires a TS or Q Clearance.

Responsibilities

Windows Server Administration

  • Design, implement, administer, and maintain enterprise Windows Server environments.
  • Manage Active Directory services, including Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, Federation Services, and certificate services.
  • Configure, monitor, and maintain Windows Server operating systems, ensuring optimal system performance and availability.
  • Administer Microsoft Windows Server environments across multiple security domains.
  • Perform server installations, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Develop and maintain server hardening standards in accordance with federal cybersecurity requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve advanced operating system, network, and application issues.
  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.

Database Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server and other enterprise database platforms as required.
  • Monitor database performance and implement tuning strategies to optimize system efficiency.
  • Develop and execute backup, recovery, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Perform database security administration, including user access controls, permissions management, and auditing.
  • Conduct database migrations, upgrades, and patch management activities.
  • Monitor database health and proactively mitigate performance and availability risks.
  • Ensure database environments comply with applicable security and governance requirements.

Infrastructure & Security Management

  • Support enterprise virtualization environments utilizing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar technologies.
  • Implement and maintain cybersecurity controls consistent with NIST, DoD, DOE, and federal security requirements.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and compliance reporting activities.
  • Manage system monitoring tools and perform root cause analysis on infrastructure events.
  • Support incident response, forensic investigations, and system recovery efforts when necessary.
  • Maintain secure system configurations and documentation for classified and sensitive environments.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical advisor for infrastructure modernization and optimization initiatives.
  • Lead system deployments, upgrades, migrations, and integration efforts.
  • Develop architecture recommendations and strategic infrastructure roadmaps.
  • Mentor junior administrators and provide technical guidance to project teams.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, networking, application, and engineering teams to ensure mission success.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and system diagrams.

Qualifications

  • Ability to hold and maintain an active Top Secret (TS) clearance or DOE Q Clearance at time of hire.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, with 10 years of progressively responsible experience in Windows Server administration and enterprise infrastructure support.
  • Minimum of 5 years of database administration experience supporting enterprise-class environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of:
    • Microsoft Windows Server
    • Active Directory
    • Group Policy
    • DNS/DHCP
    • Microsoft SQL Server
    • PowerShell scripting
    • Enterprise backup and recovery solutions
  • Experience supporting secure government, defense, national security, or energy-sector environments.
  • Experience implementing cybersecurity controls and security hardening practices.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex system, database, and infrastructure issues.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of Energy (DOE), Department of Defense (DoD), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), or other federal agencies.
  • Experience operating in classified computing environments.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including Microsoft Azure Government or hybrid architectures.
  • Knowledge of Storage Area Networks (SAN), enterprise storage platforms, and high-availability solutions.
  • Experience with configuration management and automation tools.
  • Familiarity with Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and federal compliance frameworks.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications are highly desirable:

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: SQL Server Certification
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CISSP
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
  • ITIL Foundation

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Advanced systems administration expertise
  • Advanced database administration skills
  • Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently within highly secure environments
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Overview

The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, security, availability, and performance of enterprise database environments. This role provides advanced production support for mission-critical systems, leads database migration and modernization initiatives, and supports disaster recovery, performance tuning, automation, and database security. The Senior DBA serves as a technical lead for database-related projects and supports a multi-platform environment including Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

Responsibilities

  • Cloud & Migration: Design, implement, and support enterprise database environments in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), leading modernization initiatives and migrations from on-premises platforms, as well as migrations from Oracle to MongoDB and PostgreSQL
  • Production Support: Provide advanced tier-3 production support for mission-critical systems to guarantee high availability, performance, and reliability
  • Incident Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for complex database incidents, outages, and performance bottlenecks; perform root-cause analysis and execute permanent corrective actions
  • Multi-Platform Administration: Core administration, lifecycle management, provisioning, patching, and upgrades across the enterprise footprint, with a primary focus on Oracle (including RAC, ASM, Grid Infrastructure, Data Guard, and Exadata) alongside SQL Server (including AG), PostgreSQL, and MongoDB environments
  • Performance Tuning: Proactively monitor, optimize, and tune database performance using Oracle diagnostic tools as well as platform-specific utility tools for non-Oracle systems
  • Business Continuity: Design, implement, and periodically test comprehensive backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies utilizing RMAN, Active Data Guard, and OCI Object Storage
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce robust database security architectures, including auditing, data encryption, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and compliance management
  • Automation & DevOps: Develop infrastructure-as-code and automation solutions through scripting (e.g., Shell, Python, PowerShell) and orchestration tools to drive operational efficiency
  • Governance: Establish and maintain enterprise database standards, technical architecture blueprints, and standard operational procedures


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field; a Master’s Degree with a concentration in database management is a plus

  • Critical thinking skills, ability to accurately analyze information and make sound decisions
  • Must be versatile, flexible, and proactive when resolving technical issues
  • Ability to handle diverse situations and rapidly changing priorities with deadlines

Chancellor's Office Statement

Join our team at the California State University, Office of the Chancellor, and make a difference in providing access to higher education. We are currently seeking experienced candidates for the position of Azure SQL Database Administrator. The CSU Chancellor's Office, located on the waterfront adjacent to the Aquarium of the Pacific in downtown Long Beach, is the headquarters for the nation's largest and most diverse system of higher education. The CSU Chancellor's Office offers a premium benefit package that includes outstanding health, and dental plans; a fee waiver education program; membership in the California Public Employees Retirement System (PERS); and 15 paid holidays a year.

Salary

The anticipated salary hiring range is up to $127,332 per year, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Work Arrangements

Flexibility to telecommute two days a week, with three days on-site at the main headquarters in Long Beach, California.

Premium Benefits

Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

15 paid holidays a year

Tuition waiver education program (also applies to eligible family members)

Membership in the California Public Employees Retirement System (PERS)

More details here: Comprehensive Benefits Package

Classification

Database Administrator III

Compensation Notice

CSU Classification Salary Range: $87,408 - $127,332 per year (Step 1 - Step 20); Step placement will be determined based on relevant qualifications and professional experience. Step placement upon appointment is not expected to exceed Step 20 ($127,332 per year). Future increases, including step advancement, are subject to contract negotiations.

Position Information

The California State University, Office of the Chancellor, is seeking an Azure SQL Database Administrator to provide secure, reliable, and efficient Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance environments that support the Chancellor’s Office (CO) applications and business operations. Working independently under general supervision, the position supports developers and application support teams, ensures database performance and availability, and maintains compliance with CSU standards and policies.

This position is approved for telecommuting (two days telecommuting, three days in office (in-person)) with onsite work at the main headquarters located in Long Beach, California.

Responsibilities

Under the general direction of the Associate Director of Productivity Services, the Azure SQL Database Administrator will perform duties as outlined below:

Duties

The Azure SQL Database Administrator provides support for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance environments at the Chancellor’s Office (CO). Duties include:

  • Plan and execute migrations from on-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including compatibility assessments, testing, cutover, and post-migration validation.
  • Provision, configure, and administer Azure SQL databases and managed instances to meet application and business requirements.
  • Design, implement, and maintain database schemas and objects in Azure SQL environments while ensuring compatibility with dependent applications.
  • Manage database changes and deployments across Azure SQL development, test, and production environments.
  • Analyze and tune queries, indexes, and database configurations to improve application and reporting performance.
  • Configure and maintain secure database access using Microsoft Entra ID authentication, database roles, permissions, auditing, and encryption.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure and networking teams to configure and troubleshoot Azure SQL connectivity, including virtual networks, private endpoints, firewall rules, and DNS.
  • Configure monitoring, alerts, and diagnostic logging using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and database monitoring tools.
  • Proactively monitor Azure SQL health, availability, performance, and capacity; investigate and resolve failures, slowdowns, and connectivity issues.
  • Manage compute, storage, service tiers, and scaling to meet workload requirements and optimize Azure SQL costs.
  • Configure backup retention, perform database restores, and validate point-in-time recovery capabilities.
  • Implement, document, and test high-availability and disaster recovery configurations for Azure SQL environments in alignment with business continuity requirements.
  • Automate Azure SQL provisioning, configuration, maintenance, and deployment activities using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and other approved tools.
  • Support application development, reporting, and data integrations that connect to Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including development testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Provide on-call support for Azure SQL incidents, including evenings and weekends as required, and coordinate resolution with application teams and Microsoft support.
  • Maintain Azure SQL operational documentation, configuration standards, migration plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Evaluate Azure SQL service changes and recommend improvements to security, reliability, performance, automation, and operational efficiency.

This position will also assist with special projects as needed, including determining requirements, selecting and implementing new tools and technologies, and designing and developing customer training and solutions.

Application Development Responsibilities Include

  • Meeting with stakeholders to identify business solutions needs.
  • Assist in developing solutions and integrations and participate/assist in user acceptance testing.
  • Assist in solution delivery and documentation.
  • Leads and innovates processes, process automation, and documentation with an emphasis on increasing efficiency and effectiveness of database setup and configuration, processes, and workflows, including APIs, using tools such as Boomi, N8N, and ServiceNow.

The Azure SQL Database Administrator is also responsible for any other duties as assigned. In addition, the incumbent is responsible for keeping current in the industry, including technology changes, trends, and best practices. The incumbent is also responsible for addressing any technical operations concerns with the appropriate supervisor.

Qualifications

This position requires:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work-related experience.
  • Three to Five years of professional experience supporting Azure databases and managed instances AND Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience with ServiceNow preferred.

Communication & People Skills

  • Advanced communication and interpersonal skills to effectively convey technical knowledge and procedures as well as persuade stakeholders and management regarding database design and development.
  • Solid written communication skills are necessary to provide accurate technical documentation and test results.
  • Supports an environment that motivates others and builds morale.
  • Works effectively and cooperatively with other team members to achieve goals and develop/maintain working relationships.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with various users.
  • Uses effective communication and listening skills to work with others and problem solve.
  • Ability to quickly gather information from and disseminate information to the appropriate parties.
  • Ability to communicate complex procedures and information to a variety of audiences.

Project Management Skills

  • Advanced project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple, large, and/or complex projects.
  • Ability to track and document information between multiple parties.
  • Experience in coordinating resource requirements.
  • Attention to detail and solid organizational skills are necessary.
  • Ability to schedule and prioritize to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently with little supervision.
  • Demonstrates self-motivation and ownership of assigned work.

Analytical Skills

  • Advanced analytical skills to understand problems from a broad perspective and discern applicable underlying principles to conceive and develop strategic database solutions.
  • Ability to assist in troubleshooting, including quickly identifying problems and acting appropriately.
  • Able to develop practical and thorough solutions to address all aspects of identified problems.
  • Seek assistance with problems as appropriate.
  • Identifies problems and uses appropriate sources to research technical problems.
  • Ability to independently apply technical judgment to standard applications and systems.
  • Considers the impact of recommendations or decisions on other departments and dependent systems.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced experience administering Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including provisioning, configuration, maintenance, security, monitoring, and performance management.
  • Experience planning and executing migrations from on-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including compatibility assessments, migration testing, cutover planning, and post-migration validation.
  • Experience optimizing Azure SQL performance using execution plans, Query Store, indexing, statistics, and wait analysis.
  • Experience securing Azure SQL environments using Microsoft Entra ID authentication, Azure role-based access control, database roles and permissions, auditing, encryption, and least-privilege access.
  • Knowledge of Azure networking for database connectivity, including virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, firewall rules, DNS, and connectivity between on-premises applications and Azure SQL services.
  • Experience managing backup retention, point-in-time recovery, database restoration, high availability, and disaster recovery for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, and diagnostic logs to troubleshoot database issues and monitor availability, performance, and capacity.
  • Ability to evaluate Azure SQL service tiers, compute and storage requirements, and scaling options to balance performance, availability, and cost.
  • Experience developing and maintaining T-SQL scripts and database objects in Azure SQL environments while ensuring application compatibility.
  • Ability to automate Azure SQL provisioning, configuration, deployment, and administration using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or comparable tools.
  • Experience applying version control, testing, and change-management practices to Azure SQL database deployments across development, test, and production environments.
  • Experience supporting application, reporting, and data integration connectivity to Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.

Application Period

Priority consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 26, 2026. Applications will be accepted until the job posting is removed.

How To Apply

Please click "Apply Now" to complete the California State University, Chancellor's Office online employment application.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Consistent with California law and federal civil rights laws, the CSU provides equal opportunity in education and employment without unlawful discrimination or preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified applicants with disabilities who self-disclose by contacting the Senior Human Resources Manager at (562) 951-4070.

Title IX

Please view the Notice of Non-Discrimination on the Basis of Gender or Sex and Contact Information for Title IX Coordinator at: https://www2.calstate.edu/titleix

E-Verify

This position requires new hire employment verification to be processed through the E-Verify program administered by the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (DHSUSCIS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA).

If hired, you will be required to furnish proof that you are legally authorized to work in the United States. The CSU Chancellor’s Office is not a sponsoring agency for staff and Management positions (i.e., H1-B VISAS).

COVID19 Vaccination Policy

Per the CSU COVID-19 Vaccination Policy , it is strongly recommended that all Chancellor’s Office employees who are accessing office and campus facilities follow COVID-19 vaccine recommendations adopted by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) applicable to their age, medical condition, and other relevant indications.

CSU Out of State Employment Policy

California State University, Office of the Chancellor, as part of the CSU system, is a State of California Employer. As such, the University requires all employees upon date of hire to reside in the State of California. As of January 1, 2022, the CSU Out-of-State Employment Policy prohibits the hiring of employees to perform CSU-related work outside the state of California.

Background

The Chancellor's Office policy requires that the selected candidate successfully complete a full background check (including a criminal records check) prior to assuming this position.

Learn more about working at the California State University and the impact of our mission.

  • Strong technical problem solver who can resolve issues within EPIC(Caché/Iris) database

Education and career growth

    • Up to 100% of tuition, books and fees paid for by UCHealth for specific educational degrees.

Job Description:

DHHS is seeking an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) to install, configure, maintain, secure, and optimize database systems across production, test, and development environments. • Implement database security, access controls, auditing, and compliance policies.

• Support database migration, modernization, and cloud database initiatives.

• Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to ensure effective database solutions.

• 7+ years of experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.

• 7+ years of experience with SQL, database architecture, backup/recovery, and database security.

• 7+ years of experience in performance tuning, query optimization, and capacity planning.

• 7+ years of experience with database migration and modernization strategies.

• 5+ years of experience with programming languages, APIs, and database design principles.

• 3+ years of experience with cloud database technologies such as Azure SQL, AWS RDS, or Google Cloud SQL.

• 5+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

• 7+ years of strong communication and collaboration experience with cross-functional teams.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• 2+ years of experience working with State Government organizations.

• ACTIVE TS/SCI SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIRED**

This position combines hands-on PostgreSQL administration with database engineering and architecture. You will serve as the team's primary database subject matter expert, partnering with software developers and systems engineers to maintain reliable database operations while improving database performance, design, security, and maintainability.

Our environment uses PostgreSQL for both transactional and analytical data workloads and leverages OpenShift for application deployment. The ideal candidate enjoys solving practical database challenges, can independently troubleshoot operational issues, and can recommend and implement improvements to how databases are designed, deployed, monitored, and maintained.

What You'll Do

  • Administer PostgreSQL databases: Manage database configuration, user accounts, roles, permissions, routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Design and improve database architectures: Develop and refine schemas, data models, indexing strategies, and data access patterns to support application functionality, performance, and evolving system requirements.
  • Optimize database performance: Analyze SQL queries and execution plans, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement improvements to queries, indexes, database configuration, and resource utilization.
  • Support database operations in OpenShift environments: Collaborate with platform and application teams to support PostgreSQL deployment, connectivity, configuration, monitoring, and operational integration with OpenShift-based systems.
  • Maintain database reliability and recoverability: Implement and maintain backup and restore procedures, validate recovery processes, and support existing high-availability, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Monitor database health: Configure and maintain database monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity tracking, and operational reporting to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with software developers: Advise on schema design, SQL development, transaction management, data access patterns, and database integration to ensure efficient and reliable application behavior.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Identify database performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability improvements; evaluate appropriate tools and approaches; and implement practical solutions.
  • Support database lifecycle management: Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and modernization efforts while minimizing operational risk and service disruption.
  • Establish and maintain standards: Document database architecture, configurations, security controls, operational procedures, and recommended engineering practices.
  • Maintain database security: Apply appropriate access controls, least-privilege permissions, auditing, and security practices in accordance with applicable customer and system requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance: Serve as the primary database technical resource for the engineering team, helping troubleshoot issues and make informed decisions about database design and operational practices.



WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance and ability to obtain and maintain a polygraph. Polygraph sponsorship may be available.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent education, training, certifications, and experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in database administration, database engineering, database architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting PostgreSQL databases.
  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, SQL, schema development, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience troubleshooting database issues and managing database users, roles, permissions, and configurations.
  • Experience with database backups, restores, upgrades, and routine maintenance.
  • Working knowledge of database high availability, replication, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to collaborate with developers and infrastructure engineers to resolve technical issues and improve system performance.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL in OpenShift, Kubernetes, containerized, or Linux-based environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL replication, failover, connection pooling, or high-availability technologies.
  • Experience with database monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting both transactional and analytical data workloads.
  • Experience with database automation, scripting, infrastructure as code, or repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with database security practices in regulated or classified environments.
  • Experience with Oracle database administration or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent, as required by the applicable customer environment.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Location: On-site at the customer location.
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI required; ability to obtain and maintain a polygraph. Sponsorship may be available.
  • Primary Database Technology: PostgreSQL.
  • Application Platform: OpenShift.
  • Other Technologies: Oracle experience is beneficial but not required.

Additional Information

  • All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  • Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically $140-150k. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.
  • Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Accrued PTO, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and more!

D2 Technical Services is committed to a merit-based recruitment process and encourages applications from all qualified individuals. As a Veteran-Owned Small Business, we particularly welcome applications from veterans who have the requisite skills and experience. Job applicants that are interested in one of our openings and may require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, should contact us to request an accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Database Engineer to design, build, and support the data infrastructure that powers our applications and services. This role bridges traditional on-premises database administration with modern cloud-native data architecture, requiring hands-on expertise across both relational and non-relational platforms. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical advisor to development teams, helping select and implement the right data layer for new services while maintaining the performance, security, and resiliency of existing systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with software engineering teams during the design phase of new services to recommend the appropriate data store and architecture based on access patterns, consistency requirements, scalability, and cost.
  • Design, deploy, and manage data layers across AWS (Amazon Web Services), including relational, non-relational, search, and caching technologies.
  • Administer, tune, and support SQL Server and Oracle databases in on-premises environments, including backup/recovery, high-availability, performance tuning, patching, and capacity planning.
  • Administer Snowﬂake cloud data warehouse environments, including security control enforcement, development of zero copy clone pipelines, and cost governance.
  • Develop and enforce data architecture standards, naming conventions, and best practices across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Monitor database health and performance across all platforms; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks, replication issues, and capacity constraints.
  • Implement and maintain data security controls, including encryption at rest/in transit, access management, and compliance with internal and regulatory data-handling requirements.
  • Build and maintain automation for provisioning (IaC), monitoring, backup, and maintenance of database platforms in Cloud environments.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for database-related incidents.
  • Document database architecture, data ﬂows, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate across business units on data migrations, integrations, and modernization initiatives.
  • Continuously identify process improvement opportunities, including the reduction of manual tasks and elimination of human error through automation.
  • Perform periodic evidence gathering and reviews in support of SOX IT general control objectives.

Required Qualiﬁcations

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related ﬁeld, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with AWS-managed data services, including several of the following: DynamoDB, DocumentDB, RDS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server), OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, and ElastiCache.
  • Hands-on experience administering SQL Server and Oracle databases in highly available, on-premises environments leveraging AOAG SQL Clusters and Oracle DataGuard.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowﬂake administration.
  • Strong understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing strategies, and query optimization.
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL and search-engine data modeling concepts (key-value, document, and search-index patterns).
  • Strong experience advising development teams on data architecture decisions‚ including trade-oﬀs between SQL and NoSQL, caching strategies, and search indexing.
  • Proﬁciency with SQL, PowerShell, and Bash scripting.
  • Solid experience with Terraform (IaC) for provisioning cloud data resources.
  • Understanding of data security, access control, and compliance principles as they apply to database environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualiﬁcations

  • AWS certiﬁcation(s) relevant to data/database services (e.g. AWS Certiﬁed Database‚ AWS Specialty, AWS Certiﬁed Solutions Architect).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines as they relate to database schema changes and deployments.
  • Experience developing Ansible playbooks to support database maintenance operations.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures that bridge legacy on-prem systems with cloud-native services.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • New services are consistently paired with the right data layer from the start, reducing costly re-architecture down the line.
  • Attention to detail and ability to deliver solutions to complex problems in a timely manner.
  • Collaboration across business units to achieve a common goal to grow the business.
  • Development teams view this role as a trusted advisor for data architecture decisions.
  • On-prem and cloud database environments run reliably, securely, and within performance SLAs.
  • Documentation and standards make it easier for the broader team to operate and troubleshoot the data layer.
  • Reliance on developing supportable automation pipelines to reduce repeated manual tasks.

Compensation & Benefits

Estimated Starting Range: $95,000 to $149,000 per year

(Note: The salary range listed above is specific to the local cost of labor for our Denver, CO office.)

The posted salary range represents the good-faith estimate of what Starz reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of initial hire. Individual compensation decisions are based on a variety of job related, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, specialized skills, qualifications, education, and specific office location.

Total Rewards Package: In addition to base salary, full-time employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Our time-off program includes paid company holidays annually, accrued vacation time (with accrual rates scaling and capped based on tenure), 80 hours of front-loaded sick leave each year, and 5 days of front-loaded wellness leave each year. This position is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target percentage determined by role level; actual payout is not guaranteed and remains dependent upon individual performance, company performance, and leadership approval.

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. The company expects this hiring window to remain open at least until January 15, 2027, but reserves the right to close the posting sooner if a high volume of qualified applications are received.

Location: Fairfax, VA

Salary: $170,000 - $210,000 per year plus 50% employer package

Clearance Requirements: Active Top Secret (TS) with SCI Eligibility

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to join a highly technical engineering team supporting mission-critical systems within the US Defense and Intelligence community in Fairfax, Virginia.

This opportunity is suited to a hands-on Oracle DBA with strong experience in Oracle Database 19c, Real Application Clusters (RAC), Automatic Storage Management (ASM), RMAN, Oracle Data Guard and Linux administration.

You will be responsible for the installation, configuration, administration, maintenance and optimisation of enterprise Oracle database environments, ensuring high availability, performance, security and resilience across critical infrastructure.

The position offers the opportunity to work with modern database technologies, cloud infrastructure, containerisation and automation within a technically challenging, security-focused environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, patch and administer Oracle Database 19c environments, including Oracle RAC, Clusterware and standalone databases.
  • Manage Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM), including storage configuration, administration and optimisation.
  • Implement and maintain Oracle RMAN backup and recovery processes to ensure database resilience and recoverability.
  • Configure and administer Oracle Data Guard for database replication, disaster recovery and high availability.
  • Install, configure and maintain Oracle Enterprise Manager 13c Cloud Control for database monitoring and management.
  • Perform Linux systems administration and develop shell scripts to automate database operations and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot database performance, availability and infrastructure issues across complex Oracle environments.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Database 19c, including RAC, Clusterware, ASM and RMAN.
  • Experience installing, configuring, patching and maintaining Oracle database environments.
  • Proven knowledge of Oracle Data Guard, high availability and disaster recovery.
  • Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager 13c Cloud Control.
  • Strong Linux administration and shell scripting skills, including Bash or equivalent.
  • Understanding of enterprise database architecture, storage management, backup and recovery.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, preferably Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a closely related field.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and database services.
  • Experience with Kubernetes Operators for Oracle or other database technologies.
  • Oracle GoldenGate replication and administration.
  • Oracle Spatial, Oracle Advanced Security or Oracle SQL Developer.
  • Oracle Database Appliance experience.
  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certification.
  • Experience automating database administration and monitoring using Linux scripting.

In addition to a competitive base salary, the wider benefits package includes:

  • 25% 401(k) contribution.
  • 25% Individual Benefits Account.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage.
  • Up to 8 weeks of paid time off, depending on benefits allocation.
  • Life insurance coverage.
  • 100% tuition assistance for eligible education and professional development.
  • Flexible working hours

Security Clearance Requirements

Applicants must hold an active Top Secret (TS) security clearance with SCI eligibility at the time of application. Candidates must also be willing and able to undergo a Counterintelligence (CI) Polygraph while employed.

If you're an Oracle Database Administrator with strong Oracle 19c, RAC, ASM, RMAN and Linux experience, and hold the required security clearance, we'd welcome a confidential conversation.

Apply today to learn more about this opportunity and the wider technical environment.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled SQL Database Administrator (DBA) to support, maintain, and optimize database environments across on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring database availability, performance, security, and reliability, including traditional Microsoft SQL Server deployments and cloud-based SQL Platform as a Service (PaaS) solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Administration: Install, configure, maintain, and support Microsoft SQL Server databases across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments.
  • Cloud Database Services: Administer and support SQL PaaS solutions, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and other cloud-hosted database services.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor database health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize queries, and implement performance improvements.
  • Maintenance & Reliability: Manage database backups, recovery, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, and routine maintenance.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement database security controls, manage access permissions, support auditing, and maintain compliance with organizational security standards.
  • Migration & Modernization: Support database migrations, platform upgrades, and transitions from traditional SQL Server environments to cloud-based database services.
  • Automation & Monitoring: Develop and maintain scripts, automated maintenance processes, monitoring solutions, and operational documentation.
  • Operational Support: Troubleshoot database incidents, resolve technical issues, and collaborate with infrastructure, application development, and cloud engineering teams.

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Required Technical Experience

  • Experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based SQL PaaS solutions, particularly Microsoft Azure SQL services.
  • Knowledge of SQL performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Proficiency in T-SQL and database administration tools.
  • Understanding of database security, access management, and monitoring practices.
  • Experience with database migrations, upgrades, and automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and enterprise database environments.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Azure automation, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Knowledge of Azure SQL monitoring, performance management, and cost optimization.
  • Experience working in environments with established IT service management and change control processes.

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is - $63,840 to $121,440 based on a full-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

descriptionHtml:
Trusted Connectivity for AI-Powered Dominance.

Everfox delivers trusted connectivity to protect the world’s most critical environments and safeguard the sensitive data powering decision advantage.

Built for mission-critical operations, Everfox protects what matters most by securing how data moves, how users access it, and how threats are neutralized across every domain. We enable mission speed and secure collaboration across networks, domains, and allies, while ensuring the data powering AI and advanced analytics remains trusted and protected.

We don’t just defend systems; we deliver decision dominance.

  • Our Purpose. Protect what matters most by enabling organizations to operate security in the most complex and high-risk digital environments.
  • Our Vision. To be the most trusted authority in high-assurance cybersecurity, enabling secure collaboration across every domain.
  • Our Belief. Security should never limit mission success – it should enable it.

Our Promise. We deliver absolute confidence in environments where failure is not an option.

About The Role

The Principal Oracle Database Administrator is responsible for installing, maintaining, upgrading, and troubleshooting Oracle database environments across physical and virtualized systems. This high‑visibility role requires a self‑starter who can effectively multitask, communicate clearly with customers and Everfox management, and independently support medium‑to‑large‑scale Oracle database deployments.

The position plays a key role in ensuring system stability, performance, and security while collaborating with product support, development teams, and onsite government or contractor personnel.

Location:

This is an on‑site role in Annapolis Junction, MD.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot RHEL 8.x operating systems supporting Oracle Database software in physical and virtualized environments.
  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot pluggable and containerized Oracle 19c databases in physical and virtualized environments.
  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle RAC 19c.
  • Perform RHEL 8.x and Oracle 19c upgrades and patching activities.
  • Periodically validate Oracle 19c backup and recovery operations leveraging RMAN.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Oracle database performance using AWR reports, database views, and related tools.
  • Provide on‑demand support for database issues, including coordinating with Oracle support as needed.
  • Work with product support and development teams to resolve issues or bugs found in deployed products.
  • Collaborate with onsite government, contractor, or subcontractor staff to resolve issues with onsite products as first‑line support.
  • Review, apply, and remediate security vulnerabilities or security controls following STIG guidance or scanning reports.
  • Install firmware updates on physical components including HPE servers and HP SANs.
  • Communicate daily with customers and Everfox management, providing detailed activity summaries and trip reports when applicable.
