Job Description

The Role

Fidelity Investments is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Database Administrator to provide operational excellence across our Development, Test, and Production database environments. This role will be responsible for the ongoing support of mission-critical database platforms supporting multiple Fidelity business units and enterprise applications.

The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in YugabyteDB database administration and strong working knowledge of SQL Server and Oracle platforms as a bonus. As a member of the team, you will lead complex troubleshooting efforts, improve reliability through maintaining up to date patching and release cycles, sql analysis and performance analysis. This role includes participation in an on-call rotation supporting highly available, 24x7 production environments.

The Expertise You Have

  • 5-10 years of experience administering RDS databases, YugabyteDB, in enterprise-scale, highly available production environments.
  • Deep expertise supporting YugabyteDB and newer database platforms and performance optimization.
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in mission-critical environments.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL; experience with Oracle or distributed database technologies is a plus.
  • Experience supporting databases in public cloud environments, preferably AWS and/or Azure.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Extensive experience performing Application DBA functions, including:
    • SQL and PL/SQL code review
    • Query optimization and performance tuning
    • Data modeling and physical database design
    • Database application architecture reviews
    • Development lifecycle support
    • Data engineering and integration support
  • Experience designing and implementing database high availability, disaster recovery, backup, recovery, and replication solutions.
  • Proven ability to lead root cause analysis efforts for complex production incidents and drive permanent corrective actions.
  • Experience mentoring junior DBAs and sharing knowledge across engineering teams.
The Skills You Bring

  • Expert-level proficiency with SQL and PL/SQL development, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced knowledge of YugabyteDB internals, optimizer behavior, indexing strategies, partitioning, and database performance diagnostics.
  • Strong experience implementing database infrastructure solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex production incident resolution efforts across multiple teams.
  • 7 plus years experience in scripting and automation using Shell, Python, or equivalent languages.
  • Expertise with Oracle GoldenGate, database replication technologies, and enterprise data movement strategies.
  • Strong understanding of database security, access controls, encryption, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and database deployment automation.
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and performance management tools.
  • Experience supporting 24x7 mission-critical enterprise systems with aggressive service-level objectives.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Value You Deliver

  • Lead the administration, support, and continuous improvement of YugabyteDB, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and emerging database platforms.
  • Proactively identify operational risks and implement solutions to improve system resilience and availability.
  • Partner with application development teams to design efficient and scalable database solutions.
  • Lead performance tuning efforts and optimize database workloads to meet business and service-level objectives.
  • Design, implement, and maintain high-availability and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues while leading root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
  • Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, and application teams to support modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
  • Contribute to database strategy, standards, governance, and best practices across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or PostgreSQL certifications.
  • Experience supporting large-scale financial services, healthcare, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, or equivalent technologies.

The Team

As part of the Advanced Process Solutions (APS) team, you will collaborate with engineering teams building software that enables business process automation and workflow management across Fidelity. Our platforms facilitate the movement of critical business transactions between multiple applications and business units, helping deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The database team is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational support of the databases that power these applications. We strive to leverage automation and engineering best practices to deliver resilient and highly available database services.

- Query optimization and performance tuning
- Data modeling and physical database design
- Database application architecture reviews
- Development lifecycle support
- Data engineering and integration support

SQL Server Database Administrator (Redwood City, CA)



*** We do not sponsor employment/work visas at this time, if you need sponsorship now or in the future, unfortunately, your application will not be considered ***



Job Summary:

The SQL Server Database Administrator is responsible for the architecture, implementation, configuration, maintenance, performance, security, capacity planning, migration, monitoring, troubleshooting, backup, and recovery of all SQL Server relational database systems to ensure high availability and consistent application performance.


This role partners with internal IT teams and vendor staff to build, support, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments that power transactional systems and the enterprise data warehouse. The position is also responsible for the ongoing development and support of the SQL Server data warehouse, including operational readiness, data loads, and data modeling to support multiple development teams.


Why Provident?

Provident Credit Union was established in 1950, and we rank among the top 10% of credit unions in the US. We believe having a culture that is accepting, supportive, diverse, and inclusive makes us all better. Provident has been a Bay Area “Top Workplace” since 2017, and our employees rank us on Glassdoor as one of the best credit unions in the nation.

Our values are:

  • Listen
  • Get Better
  • Do What’s Right



Essential Functions:


  • Provides end-to-end technical support, capacity planning, and problem resolution for SQL Server environments.
  • Provides 24x7 support for critical production systems, including participation in on-call and incident response activities.
  • Partners with IT Security to support annual risk assessments and respond to third-party security reviews and audits.
  • Designs and implements database architecture aligned with best practices.
  • Monitors and maintains the health, performance, and security of all SQL Server databases.
  • Monitors and optimize system resources, including CPU, memory, and storage utilization.
  • Develops and manage database logging, backup, restore, and recovery strategies.
  • Maintains and enhances high availability and disaster recovery infrastructure, including Always On environments, to support resiliency and performance.
  • Performs SQL Server version upgrades in coordination with application requirements and vendor support guidelines.
  • Partners with developers to tune complex queries, improve performance, and refine database schemas.
  • Performs scheduled maintenance and supports after-hours release and deployment activities as needed.
  • Shares technical expertise through mentoring, documentation, and cross-training with team members and peers.
  • Supports approved database service requests within established service levels and timeframes.
  • Maintains an accurate inventory of SQL Server databases and related platform components.
  • Ensures security patches are evaluated and implemented in a timely and effective manner.
  • Follows established change management policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Completes required BSA and OFAC training annually and adheres to related policies and procedures.


QUALIFICATIONS:


Education/Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • 8+ years of professional experience in Microsoft SQL Server database administration
  • Experience with performance tuning and optimization using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools
  • Experience with database backup, restore, and recovery models
  • Experience administering Windows Server environments, including Active Directory
  • Experience with replicated, load-balanced, and high-availability systems
  • Experience implementing and supporting SQL Server high availability group environments


Knowledge/Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery options
  • Advanced knowledge of database design, structure, and theory
  • Strong understanding of database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and shift effectively between tasks and teams
  • Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and project management skills
  • Strong customer service orientation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Commitment to continuously learning new technologies, features, and capabilities
  • Familiarity with reporting and data visualization tools
  • Ability to organize work effectively and operate independently


Licenses/Certifications:

  • Microsoft Certified Database Administrator (MCDBA) – highly preferred
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) – preferred
  • Microsoft Certified IT Specialist (MCITP/MCITS) – preferred


Benefits you will enjoy:

  • Quality medical, dental and vision care coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with up to 150% matching employer contributions
  • Annual discretionary bonus
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Employee Referral Bonus
  • Short and long-term disability coverage
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Provident membership
  • Rate discount on home and auto loans
  • Opportunity to use company owned condo in Maui and Lake Tahoe

Compensation:

Pay Grade is T4. This position is eligible for our twice-a-year discretionary bonus.

Targeted Pay: $50.00 – $62.00/hour (Depending on experience)


Provident is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Database Administration: What Makes GSU a Great Place to Work?: Georgia State University, one of the nation's most innovative public institutions, offers a collaborative environment where technology, research, and innovation drive student success and community impact.

GSU supports employee success through a comprehensive benefits package, including::
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Tuition Assistance Program (TAP)
  • Competitive retirement plans, including pension options
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities


Through TAP, eligible employees can continue their education while building their careers, reflecting GSU's commitment to lifelong learning and employee development.

Why Join the Instructional Innovation and Technology (IIT) Division?: Join a mission-driven technology division where your work directly supports student success, academic excellence, and university operations.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?:
  • Support critical systems used by students, faculty, and staff across the university.
  • Expand your expertise with technologies such as Ellucian Banner, PeopleSoft, Oracle APEX, Tomcat, and data warehousing.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams in a knowledge-sharing environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a stable organization that values operational excellence, reliability, and long-term success.


We do not expect candidates to be experts in every technology used across the university. We are seeking a strong Oracle DBA with solid technical fundamentals, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn and adapt in a complex enterprise environment while expanding expertise across Georgia State's enterprise application and data ecosystem.

Position Overview: Georgia State University's Instructional Innovation and Technology (IIT) Division is seeking an experienced Lead Database Administrator to join the Application Solutions team. This hands-on technical leadership role is responsible for administering, securing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments that power critical university operations, student success, and institutional services.

The Lead Database Administrator provides technical leadership and hands-on support for Oracle databases, data warehouse platforms, and related technologies, partnering with application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing systems.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, driving operational excellence, and continuously expanding your expertise, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities: Application & Database Support:
  • Administer, monitor, maintain, and optimize enterprise Oracle database environments.
  • Troubleshoot database and application issues involving performance, availability, security, capacity, patching, and code fixes.
  • Support data warehouse and ETL environments and collaborate with technical and business teams to ensure reliable service delivery.


Database Administration & Technology Management:
  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, clone, and manage Oracle databases throughout their lifecycle.
  • Administer Oracle technologies including RMAN, Data Guard, and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM).
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and disaster recovery plans.


Security, Compliance & Business Continuity:
  • Manage database security, access controls, auditing, and data integrity.
  • Ensure database availability, recoverability, and compliance with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Implement best practices for reliability, performance, and risk mitigation.


Project Leadership & Collaboration:
  • Support the implementation, testing, deployment, migration, and integration of database solutions.
  • Coordinate project activities, communicate status to stakeholders, and support technology modernization initiatives.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance while partnering with application, infrastructure, security, business, and vendor teams.


Additional Information:
  • This position is based in Atlanta and requires on-site work. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.
  • Georgia State University offers a competitive salary commensurate with qualifications, experience, and internal equity. The posted salary range represents the minimum to midpoint of the position's established pay grade.


Minimum Hiring Qualifications: Bachelor's degree and three (3) years of related experience; or a combination of education and experience.

Preferred Hiring Qualifications: Candidates will be most competitive with::
  • Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong Oracle database administration experience, including RMAN, Data Guard, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM).
  • Experience supporting enterprise Oracle database environments.
  • Experience with Oracle APEX.
  • Experience with Ellucian Banner, PeopleSoft, or other higher education systems.
  • Experience with Apache Tomcat.
  • Experience with data warehousing and ETL processes.
